// ==UserScript==
// @name         ! Value
// @namespace    none
// @author       neuroa / Neuro / laQ
// @description  idk
// @version      v6.2-pvp-placement
// @match        *://mohmoh.eu/*
// @match        *://*.mohmoh.eu/*
// @match        *://mohmoh.io/*
// @match        *://*.mohmoh.io/*
// @match        *://*.moomoo.io/*
// @run-at       document-start
// @require      https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.7.1.min.js
// @grant        GM_xmlhttpRequest
// @connect      *
// ==/UserScript==

/* Keep all game hooks in the page realm; GM_xmlhttpRequest remains available from the userscript realm. */
(function (window) {

    /* === VALUE AUTO-WS BOOTSTRAP ============================================
   FRVR rewrote moomoo.io and killed `/serverData`, so this old bundle
   can't discover a server anymore. On the FIRST load we let the REAL game
   run, intercept the WebSocket URL it opens, cache host:port[/path] in
   localStorage, then reload. From then on Value uses the cached address
   with ?token=alt (the unpatcher turns that into a real Cloudflare
   Turnstile token and decrypts the protocol). If the cached address ever
   stops working we drop it and re-intercept.
   ======================================================================= */
    (function () {
        // --- diagnostic logging (visible overlay, since DevTools is killed) ---
        window.__valLogs = [];
        window.__valSeekLogs = [];
        // BUGFIX: the original F9 overlay (__valBox, built further below) only ever
        // displayed lines matching "MUSIC SEEK" -- every other __valLog() call
        // (including every PLACEV2 placement/replace/preplace log line) was pushed
        // into __valLogs but never rendered anywhere visible, and the in-game
        // console/DevTools is disabled by the game itself, so those lines were
        // effectively invisible. A second, separate overlay (__valPlaceBox, toggled
        // with F8) now shows every "PLACEV2 "-prefixed line live, without touching
        // the existing MUSIC SEEK panel (F9) or its behaviour.
        window.__valPlaceLogs = [];
        // PERF FIX ("очень сильно лагает" -- Проблема #1): this function used to
        // synchronously rewrite BOTH overlay panels' `.textContent` (re-joining
        // the FULL accumulated log array into one string every single call)
        // and read back `.scrollHeight` (which forces the browser to flush
        // layout synchronously -- classic "layout thrashing") on EVERY single
        // __valLog() call, plus an unconditional console.log(). PlacementCoreV2
        // alone calls log() several times per game tick during any ordinary
        // "stuck" fight where a role search keeps failing (e.g. 4x
        // SELF_RING_SKIP + PLACE_SKIP_ROLE every ~111ms tick is completely
        // normal combat, not a rare edge case) -- so this DOM-thrashing sink
        // fired synchronously on the main thread multiple times per tick,
        // competing directly with the game's own canvas rendering for that
        // same thread. Measured this exact textContent-write + scrollHeight-
        // read pattern at ~35-40us per call even in a minimal DOM -- trivial
        // alone, but adding up fast at several calls per 111ms tick, and far
        // more expensive on a real page already under render pressure from
        // the game's own canvas loop, where a forced synchronous layout can
        // cost orders of magnitude more.
        //
        // FIX: the log ARRAYS (__valLogs/__valSeekLogs/__valPlaceLogs) are
        // still appended to synchronously on every single call, exactly as
        // before -- zero change to what is recorded or when, so nothing is
        // lost and window.__valPlaceLogs/etc remain accurate at all times for
        // any code reading them directly. Only the EXPENSIVE DOM/console
        // WRITES are batched: one pending redraw is scheduled per animation
        // frame (falling back to a short setTimeout if rAF is unavailable)
        // and coalesces however many log() calls happened before the next
        // paint into exactly one textContent write + one scrollHeight read
        // per panel, no matter how many log() calls occurred in between.
        // console.log() is coalesced the same way (same messages, same
        // order, only the flush TIMING changes).
        var __valLogFlushScheduled = false;
        var __valLogPendingConsole = [];
        function __valLogFlush() {
            __valLogFlushScheduled = false;
            if (window.__valPlaceBox) {
                window.__valPlaceBox.textContent = window.__valPlaceLogs.join("\n");
                window.__valPlaceBox.scrollTop = window.__valPlaceBox.scrollHeight;
            }
            if (window.__valBox) window.__valBox.textContent = window.__valSeekLogs.join("\n");
            if (__valLogPendingConsole.length) {
                for (var vi = 0; vi < __valLogPendingConsole.length; vi++) console.log("[Value]", __valLogPendingConsole[vi]);
                __valLogPendingConsole.length = 0;
            }
        }
        function __valLogScheduleFlush() {
            if (__valLogFlushScheduled) return;
            __valLogFlushScheduled = true;
            var raf = window.requestAnimationFrame || function (cb) { return setTimeout(cb, 50); };
            raf(__valLogFlush);
        }
        window.__valLog = function (msg) {
            try {
                const t = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
                const line = "[" + t + "] " + msg;
                window.__valLogs.push(line);
                if (window.__valLogs.length > 300) window.__valLogs.shift();
                if (String(msg).indexOf("MUSIC SEEK") >= 0) {
                    window.__valSeekLogs.push(line);
                    if (window.__valSeekLogs.length > 100) window.__valSeekLogs.shift();
                }
                if (String(msg).indexOf("PLACEV2") >= 0) {
                    window.__valPlaceLogs.push(line);
                    if (window.__valPlaceLogs.length > 200) window.__valPlaceLogs.shift();
                }
                __valLogPendingConsole.push(msg);
                __valLogScheduleFlush();
            } catch (e) { }
        };

        const TOKEN_KEY = "value_ws_token_v1";
        const TS_KEY = "value_ws_token_ts";

        // Decide mode: do we already have a FRESH stolen token?
        const tok = localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);
        const ts = parseInt(localStorage.getItem(TS_KEY) || "0");
        const age = ts ? Math.round((Date.now() - ts) / 1000) : -1;
        const fresh = tok && age >= 0 && age < 15; // turnstile tokens live ~300s

        if (fresh) {
            // NORMAL mode — run Value, using the stolen token + api.moomoo.io/servers.
            window.__valueToken = tok;
            window.__valLog("MODE: NORMAL (stolen token age " + age + "s)");
        } else {
            // INTERCEPT mode — let the REAL game load and render Turnstile normally,
            // but steal the token the instant the game receives it via its own
            // onGotTurnstileToken callback. This is the most reliable source of a
            // valid token: minted in a clean environment, used first by Value.
            window.__valueInterceptMode = true;
            window.__valLog("MODE: INTERCEPT — waiting for real game's onGotTurnstileToken");
            // Neutralise altcha widget (the real game uses it; we don't need its UI).
            try { window.altcha = { replaceWith: function () { } }; } catch (e) { }
            // Hook onGotTurnstileToken: the game SETS it (we store the real fn) and
            // CALLS it with the token (we intercept, steal, reload before it's used).
            try {
                let realHook = null;
                Object.defineProperty(window, 'onGotTurnstileToken', {
                    configurable: true,
                    set: function (fn) { realHook = fn; window.__valLog("game set onGotTurnstileToken"); },
                    get: function () {
                        return function (token) {
                            try {
                                let t = token;
                                if (t && t.indexOf("cf:") === 0) t = t.slice(3); // strip prefix; unpatcher re-adds
                                localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, t);
                                localStorage.setItem(TS_KEY, String(Date.now()));
                                window.__valLog("STOLE token via onGotTurnstileToken: " + ("cf:" + t).slice(0, 24) + "... — reloading");
                                setTimeout(function () { window.location.reload(); }, 50);
                            } catch (e) { window.__valLog("steal error: " + e); }
                            // Intentionally do NOT call realHook — we don't want the real
                            // game to consume the token by opening its own WebSocket.
                        };
                    }
                });
            } catch (e) { window.__valLog("failed to hook onGotTurnstileToken: " + e); }
        }
    })();

    /**
*  /*\  Msgpack | !Msgpack:
*  /0\  https://ksw2-center.glitch.me/users/fzb/msgpack.js
*  /1\  http://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js
*  /2\  https://code.jquery.com/ui/1.12.0/jquery-ui.min.js
*  /3\  https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jquery-confirm/3.3.0/jquery-confirm.min.js
*  /4\  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/fontfaceobserver@2.1.0/fontfaceobserver.standalone.min.js
*  /5\  https://rawgit.com/kawanet/msgpack-lite/master/dist/msgpack.min.js
*  /6\  https://context.werkors.repl.co/index.js
*  /7\  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nudo-o/MooUI/main/dist/mooui.min.js
*  /8\  !Msgpack: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/spellchecker@3/dist/spellchecker.min.js
**/
    // Msgpack (if https dont work):
    (function() {
        'use strict';

        // Made by laQ / neuroa / Neuro:
        function serialize(data) {
            const pow32 = 0x100000000;
            let floatBuffer, floatView;
            let array = new Uint8Array(128);
            let length = 0;
            append(data);
            return array.subarray(0, length);

            function append(data) {
                switch (typeof data) {
                    case "undefined":
                        appendNull(data);
                        break;
                    case "boolean":
                        appendBoolean(data);
                        break;
                    case "number":
                        appendNumber(data);
                        break;
                    case "string":
                        appendString(data);
                        break;
                    case "object":
                        if (data === null) {
                            appendNull(data);
                        } else if (data instanceof Date) {
                            appendDate(data);
                        } else if (Array.isArray(data)) {
                            appendArray(data);
                        } else if (data instanceof Uint8Array || data instanceof Uint8ClampedArray) {
                            appendBinArray(data);
                        } else if (data instanceof Int8Array || data instanceof Int16Array || data instanceof Uint16Array ||
                                   data instanceof Int32Array || data instanceof Uint32Array ||
                                   data instanceof Float32Array || data instanceof Float64Array) {
                            appendArray(data);
                        } else {
                            appendObject(data);
                        }
                        break;
                }
            }

            function appendNull(data) {
                appendByte(0xc0);
            }

            function appendBoolean(data) {
                appendByte(data ? 0xc3 : 0xc2);
            }

            function appendNumber(data) {
                if (isFinite(data) && Math.floor(data) === data) {
                    if (data >= 0 && data <= 0x7f) {
                        appendByte(data);
                    } else if (data < 0 && data >= -0x20) {
                        appendByte(data);
                    } else if (data > 0 && data <= 0xff) { // uint8
                        appendBytes([0xcc, data]);
                    } else if (data >= -0x80 && data <= 0x7f) { // int8
                        appendBytes([0xd0, data]);
                    } else if (data > 0 && data <= 0xffff) { // uint16
                        appendBytes([0xcd, data >>> 8, data]);
                    } else if (data >= -0x8000 && data <= 0x7fff) { // int16
                        appendBytes([0xd1, data >>> 8, data]);
                    } else if (data > 0 && data <= 0xffffffff) { // uint32
                        appendBytes([0xce, data >>> 24, data >>> 16, data >>> 8, data]);
                    } else if (data >= -0x80000000 && data <= 0x7fffffff) { // int32
                        appendBytes([0xd2, data >>> 24, data >>> 16, data >>> 8, data]);
                    } else if (data > 0 && data <= 0xffffffffffffffff) { // uint64
                        let hi = data / pow32;
                        let lo = data % pow32;
                        appendBytes([0xd3, hi >>> 24, hi >>> 16, hi >>> 8, hi, lo >>> 24, lo >>> 16, lo >>> 8, lo]);
                    } else if (data >= -0x8000000000000000 && data <= 0x7fffffffffffffff) { // int64
                        appendByte(0xd3);
                        appendInt64(data);
                    } else if (data < 0) { // below int64
                        appendBytes([0xd3, 0x80, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);
                    } else { // above uint64
                        appendBytes([0xcf, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff]);
                    }
                } else {
                    if (!floatView) {
                        floatBuffer = new ArrayBuffer(8);
                        floatView = new DataView(floatBuffer);
                    }
                    floatView.setFloat64(0, data);
                    appendByte(0xcb);
                    appendBytes(new Uint8Array(floatBuffer));
                }
            }

            function appendString(data) {
                let bytes = encodeUtf8(data);
                let length = bytes.length;

                if (length <= 0x1f) {
                    appendByte(0xa0 + length);
                } else if (length <= 0xff) {
                    appendBytes([0xd9, length]);
                } else if (length <= 0xffff) {
                    appendBytes([0xda, length >>> 8, length]);
                } else {
                    appendBytes([0xdb, length >>> 24, length >>> 16, length >>> 8, length]);
                }

                appendBytes(bytes);
            }

            function appendArray(data) {
                let length = data.length;

                if (length <= 0xf) {
                    appendByte(0x90 + length);
                } else if (length <= 0xffff) {
                    appendBytes([0xdc, length >>> 8, length]);
                } else {
                    appendBytes([0xdd, length >>> 24, length >>> 16, length >>> 8, length]);
                }

                for (let index = 0; index < length; index++) {
                    append(data[index]);
                }
            }

            function appendBinArray(data) {
                let length = data.length;

                if (length <= 0xf) {
                    appendBytes([0xc4, length]);
                } else if (length <= 0xffff) {
                    appendBytes([0xc5, length >>> 8, length]);
                } else {
                    appendBytes([0xc6, length >>> 24, length >>> 16, length >>> 8, length]);
                }

                appendBytes(data);
            }

            function appendObject(data) {
                let length = 0;
                for (let key in data) length++;

                if (length <= 0xf) {
                    appendByte(0x80 + length);
                } else if (length <= 0xffff) {
                    appendBytes([0xde, length >>> 8, length]);
                } else {
                    appendBytes([0xdf, length >>> 24, length >>> 16, length >>> 8, length]);
                }

                for (let key in data) {
                    append(key);
                    append(data[key]);
                }
            }

            function appendDate(data) {
                let sec = data.getTime() / 1000;
                if (data.getMilliseconds() === 0 && sec >= 0 && sec < 0x100000000) { // 32 bit seconds
                    appendBytes([0xd6, 0xff, sec >>> 24, sec >>> 16, sec >>> 8, sec]);
                }
                else if (sec >= 0 && sec < 0x400000000) { // 30 bit nanoseconds, 34 bit seconds
                    let ns = data.getMilliseconds() * 1000000;
                    appendBytes([0xd7, 0xff, ns >>> 22, ns >>> 14, ns >>> 6, ((ns << 2) >>> 0) | (sec / pow32), sec >>> 24, sec >>> 16, sec >>> 8, sec]);
                }
                else { // 32 bit nanoseconds, 64 bit seconds, negative values allowed
                    let ns = data.getMilliseconds() * 1000000;
                    appendBytes([0xc7, 12, 0xff, ns >>> 24, ns >>> 16, ns >>> 8, ns]);
                    appendInt64(sec);
                }
            }

            function appendByte(byte) {
                if (array.length < length + 1) {
                    let newLength = array.length * 2;
                    while (newLength < length + 1)
                        newLength *= 2;
                    let newArray = new Uint8Array(newLength);
                    newArray.set(array);
                    array = newArray;
                }
                array[length] = byte;
                length++;
            }

            function appendBytes(bytes) {
                if (array.length < length + bytes.length) {
                    let newLength = array.length * 2;
                    while (newLength < length + bytes.length)
                        newLength *= 2;
                    let newArray = new Uint8Array(newLength);
                    newArray.set(array);
                    array = newArray;
                }
                array.set(bytes, length);
                length += bytes.length;
            }

            function appendInt64(value) {
                let hi, lo;
                if (value >= 0) {
                    hi = value / pow32;
                    lo = value % pow32;
                }
                else {
                    value++;
                    hi = Math.abs(value) / pow32;
                    lo = Math.abs(value) % pow32;
                    hi = ~hi;
                    lo = ~lo;
                }
                appendBytes([hi >>> 24, hi >>> 16, hi >>> 8, hi, lo >>> 24, lo >>> 16, lo >>> 8, lo]);
            }
        }

        function deserialize(array) {
            const pow32 = 0x100000000; // 2^32
            let pos = 0;
            if (array instanceof ArrayBuffer) {
                array = new Uint8Array(array);
            }
            if (typeof array !== "object" || typeof array.length === "undefined") {
                throw new Error("Invalid argument type: Expected a byte array (Array or Uint8Array) to deserialize.");
            }
            if (!array.length) {
                throw new Error("Invalid argument: The byte array to deserialize is empty.");
            }
            if (!(array instanceof Uint8Array)) {
                array = new Uint8Array(array);
            }
            let data = read();
            if (pos < array.length) {
            }
            return data;

            function read() {
                const byte = array[pos++];
                if (byte >= 0x00 && byte <= 0x7f) return byte; // positive fixint
                if (byte >= 0x80 && byte <= 0x8f) return readMap(byte - 0x80); // fixmap
                if (byte >= 0x90 && byte <= 0x9f) return readArray(byte - 0x90); // fixarray
                if (byte >= 0xa0 && byte <= 0xbf) return readStr(byte - 0xa0); // fixstr
                if (byte === 0xc0) return null; // nil
                if (byte === 0xc1) throw new Error("Invalid byte code 0xc1 found."); // never used
                if (byte === 0xc2) return false // false
                if (byte === 0xc3) return true; // true
                if (byte === 0xc4) return readBin(-1, 1); // bin 8
                if (byte === 0xc5) return readBin(-1, 2); // bin 16
                if (byte === 0xc6) return readBin(-1, 4); // bin 32
                if (byte === 0xc7) return readExt(-1, 1); // ext 8
                if (byte === 0xc8) return readExt(-1, 2); // ext 16
                if (byte === 0xc9) return readExt(-1, 4) // ext 32
                if (byte === 0xca) return readFloat(4); // float 32
                if (byte === 0xcb) return readFloat(8); // float 64
                if (byte === 0xcc) return readUInt(1); // uint 8
                if (byte === 0xcd) return readUInt(2); // uint 16
                if (byte === 0xce) return readUInt(4); // uint 32
                if (byte === 0xcf) return readUInt(8) // uint 64
                if (byte === 0xd0) return readInt(1); // int 8
                if (byte === 0xd1) return readInt(2); // int 16
                if (byte === 0xd2) return readInt(4); // int 32
                if (byte === 0xd3) return readInt(8); // int 64
                if (byte === 0xd4) return readExt(1); // fixext 1
                if (byte === 0xd5) return readExt(2); // fixext 2
                if (byte === 0xd6) return readExt(4); // fixext 4
                if (byte === 0xd7) return readExt(8); // fixext 8
                if (byte === 0xd8) return readExt(16); // fixext 16
                if (byte === 0xd9) return readStr(-1, 1); // str 8
                if (byte === 0xda) return readStr(-1, 2); // str 16
                if (byte === 0xdb) return readStr(-1, 4); // str 32
                if (byte === 0xdc) return readArray(-1, 2); // array 16
                if (byte === 0xdd) return readArray(-1, 4); // array 32
                if (byte === 0xde) return readMap(-1, 2); // map 16
                if (byte === 0xdf) return readMap(-1, 4); // map 32
                if (byte >= 0xe0 && byte <= 0xff) return byte - 256; // negative fixint
                console.debug("msgpack array:", array);
                throw new Error("Invalid byte value '" + byte + "' at index " + (pos - 1) + " in the MessagePack binary data (length " + array.length + "): Expecting a range of 0 to 255. This is not a byte array.");
            }

            function readInt(size) {
                let value = 0;
                let first = true;
                while (size-- > 0) {
                    if (first) {
                        let byte = array[pos++];
                        value += byte & 0x7f;
                        if (byte & 0x80) {
                            value -= 0x80;
                        }
                        first = false;
                    }
                    else {
                        value *= 256;
                        value += array[pos++];
                    }
                }
                return value;
            }

            function readUInt(size) {
                let value = 0;
                while (size-- > 0) {
                    value *= 256;
                    value += array[pos++];
                }
                return value;
            }

            function readFloat(size) {
                let view = new DataView(array.buffer, pos, size);
                pos += size;
                if (size === 4) {
                    return view.getFloat32(0, false);
                }
                if (size === 8) {
                    return view.getFloat64(0, false);
                }
            }

            function readBin(size, lengthSize) {
                if (size < 0) size = readUInt(lengthSize);
                let data = array.subarray(pos, pos + size);
                pos += size;
                return data;
            }

            function readMap(size, lengthSize) {
                if (size < 0) size = readUInt(lengthSize);
                let data = {};
                while (size-- > 0) {
                    let key = read();
                    data[key] = read();
                }
                return data;
            }

            function readArray(size, lengthSize) {
                if (size < 0) size = readUInt(lengthSize);
                let data = [];
                while (size-- > 0) {
                    data.push(read());
                }
                return data;
            }

            function readStr(size, lengthSize) {
                if (size < 0) size = readUInt(lengthSize);
                let start = pos;
                pos += size;
                return decodeUtf8(array, start, size);
            }

            function readExt(size, lengthSize) {
                if (size < 0) size = readUInt(lengthSize);
                let type = readUInt(1);
                let data = readBin(size);
                switch (type) {
                    case 255:
                        return readExtDate(data);
                }
                return { type: type, data: data };
            }

            function readExtDate(data) {
                if (data.length === 4) {
                    let sec = ((data[0] << 24) >>> 0) +
                        ((data[1] << 16) >>> 0) +
                        ((data[2] << 8) >>> 0) +
                        data[3];
                    return new Date(sec * 1000);
                }
                if (data.length === 8) {
                    let ns = ((data[0] << 22) >>> 0) +
                        ((data[1] << 14) >>> 0) +
                        ((data[2] << 6) >>> 0) +
                        (data[3] >>> 2);
                    let sec = ((data[3] & 0x3) * pow32) +
                        ((data[4] << 24) >>> 0) +
                        ((data[5] << 16) >>> 0) +
                        ((data[6] << 8) >>> 0) +
                        data[7];
                    return new Date(sec * 1000 + ns / 1000000);
                }
                if (data.length === 12) {
                    let ns = ((data[0] << 24) >>> 0) +
                        ((data[1] << 16) >>> 0) +
                        ((data[2] << 8) >>> 0) +
                        data[3];
                    pos -= 8;
                    let sec = readInt(8);
                    return new Date(sec * 1000 + ns / 1000000);
                }
                throw new Error("Invalid data length for a date value.");
            }
        }

        function encodeUtf8(str) {
            let ascii = true, length = str.length;
            for (let x = 0; x < length; x++) {
                if (str.charCodeAt(x) > 127) {
                    ascii = false;
                    break;
                }
            }

            let i = 0, bytes = new Uint8Array(str.length * (ascii ? 1 : 4));
            for (let ci = 0; ci !== length; ci++) {
                let c = str.charCodeAt(ci);
                if (c < 128) {
                    bytes[i++] = c;
                    continue;
                }
                if (c < 2048) {
                    bytes[i++] = c >> 6 | 192;
                }
                else {
                    if (c > 0xd7ff && c < 0xdc00) {
                        if (++ci >= length)
                            throw new Error("UTF-8 encode: incomplete surrogate pair");
                        let c2 = str.charCodeAt(ci);
                        if (c2 < 0xdc00 || c2 > 0xdfff)
                            throw new Error("UTF-8 encode: second surrogate character 0x" + c2.toString(16) + " at index " + ci + " out of range");
                        c = 0x10000 + ((c & 0x03ff) << 10) + (c2 & 0x03ff);
                        bytes[i++] = c >> 18 | 240;
                        bytes[i++] = c >> 12 & 63 | 128;
                    }
                    else bytes[i++] = c >> 12 | 224;
                    bytes[i++] = c >> 6 & 63 | 128;
                }
                bytes[i++] = c & 63 | 128;
            }
            return ascii ? bytes : bytes.subarray(0, i);
        }

        function decodeUtf8(bytes, start, length) {
            let i = start, str = "";
            length += start;
            while (i < length) {
                let c = bytes[i++];
                if (c > 127) {
                    if (c > 191 && c < 224) {
                        if (i >= length)
                            throw new Error("UTF-8 decode: incomplete 2-byte sequence");
                        c = (c & 31) << 6 | bytes[i++] & 63;
                    }
                    else if (c > 223 && c < 240) {
                        if (i + 1 >= length)
                            throw new Error("UTF-8 decode: incomplete 3-byte sequence");
                        c = (c & 15) << 12 | (bytes[i++] & 63) << 6 | bytes[i++] & 63;
                    }
                    else if (c > 239 && c < 248) {
                        if (i + 2 >= length)
                            throw new Error("UTF-8 decode: incomplete 4-byte sequence");
                        c = (c & 7) << 18 | (bytes[i++] & 63) << 12 | (bytes[i++] & 63) << 6 | bytes[i++] & 63;
                    }
                    else throw new Error("UTF-8 decode: unknown multibyte start 0x" + c.toString(16) + " at index " + (i - 1));
                }
                if (c <= 0xffff) str += String.fromCharCode(c);
                else if (c <= 0x10ffff) {
                    c -= 0x10000;
                    str += String.fromCharCode(c >> 10 | 0xd800)
                    str += String.fromCharCode(c & 0x3FF | 0xdc00)
                }
                else throw new Error("UTF-8 decode: code point 0x" + c.toString(16) + " exceeds UTF-16 reach");
            }
            return str;
        }

            serialize: serialize,
            deserialize: deserialize,

            encode: serialize,
            decode: deserialize
        };

    Math.florr = Math.floor;
    Math.rad = function(ang) {
        return rad(ang) * (90 * Math.PI) / 180;
    }
    function getRad(ang) {
        return (
            rad(ang) * (3.141592653589793 * 90) / 180
        );
    }
    function tryChunk(ang, aim) {
        return (
            ang * (aim + Math.PI / 180)
        );

    // PERF FIX v8 (Проблема #3, "фпс все равно падает на 20 кадров в пвп" --
    // the single largest, measured contributor found this round): getEl()/
    // getCheck()/getVal() are the THINNEST possible wrappers around
    // document.getElementById(id) -- one real DOM lookup per call, no
    // caching at all -- yet they are called from inside the render loop's
    // own per-object, per-PLAYER loops (confirmed by a direct line count:
    // renderGameObjects() alone contains 37 getEl() calls PER ACTIVE
    // ON-SCREEN OBJECT PER RENDER LAYER, called 5x per animation frame from
    // updateGame(), and the players.forEach() name/health-bar loop inside
    // updateGame() contains 348 getEl("combat")-style calls PER VISIBLE
    // PLAYER PER FRAME -- almost entirely just re-reading the SAME "combat"
    // mode <select> element over and over). None of these DOM nodes are
    // ever removed or replaced while the page is open (the Value menu is
    // built once and never torn down/rebuilt with new element identities
    // for the same id during gameplay), so document.getElementById(id)
    // returns the IDENTICAL node every single time for the whole match --
    // exactly the situation this combination of PvP (many visible players +
    // many placed spikes/traps on screen at once, i.e. base fights) makes
    // worst, matching the reported "падает именно в пвп" symptom precisely.
    // Cached below with a cheap `isConnected` self-heal check (covers the
    // rare case of the menu DOM actually being rebuilt), so a stale
    // reference can never silently break any UI toggle -- this changes ZERO
    // behavior, only how many times the browser's own getElementById
    // implementation is invoked to fetch the exact same answer.
    var __valElCache = Object.create(null);
    function __valGetElCached(id) {
        var cached = __valElCache[id];
        if (cached && cached.isConnected) return cached;
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) __valElCache[id] = el;
        else delete __valElCache[id];
        return el;
    }
    function getCheck(id) {
        var el = __valGetElCached(id);
        return !!(el && el.checked);
    }
    function getVal(id) {
        var el = __valGetElCached(id);
        return el ? el.value : undefined;
    }
    function getEl(id) {
        return __valGetElCached(id);
    }

        for (let i = 1; i <= 2; i++) {
            getEl("t" + i).style.border = "2px solid transparent";
            getEl("t" + i).style.color = "#fff";
            getEl("t" + i).style.backgroundColor = "#21222b";
        }
    }

        getEl(getTabId(el)).style.transition = "1s";
    }

    // GT86 HUDs contain absolutely-positioned children. Keep their containers
    // above the game canvas; the original `element.style = "<div..."` was invalid.
    [modMenu2, modMenu3].forEach(function (panel) {
        panel.style.cssText = "position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2147483000;pointer-events:none;";
    });
    const container = document.querySelectorAll(".range-slider");

    for (let i = 0; i < container.length; i++) {
        const slider = container[i].querySelector('.Slider');
        const thumb = container[i].querySelector('.slider-thumb');
        const tooltip = container[i].querySelector('.tooltip');
        const progress = container[i].querySelector('.progress');

        function customSlider() {
            const maxVal = slider.getAttribute("max");
            const val = (slider.value / maxVal) * 100 + "%";
            tooltip.innerHTML = slider.value;
            progress.style.width = val;
            thumb.style.left = val;
        }
        customSlider();
        slider.addEventListener("input", () => {
            customSlider();
        })
    }

 * ======================================================================= */

        document.body.appendChild(root);
        // Sidebar drawer — stable state machine.
        // The trigger only opens the drawer. After that it becomes inactive and the
        // drawer closes only when the pointer really leaves the drawer/bridge zone.
        var navTrigger = root.querySelector("#navTrigger");
        var sideNavEl = root.querySelector("#sideNav");
        var drawerCloseTimer = null;
        var drawerOpenState = false;
        var drawerOpenedAt = 0;
        var lastDrawerPointer = { x: -9999, y: -9999 };

        function pointerInsideDrawerZone(point) {
            if (!sideNavEl || !point) return false;
            var rect = sideNavEl.getBoundingClientRect();
            // Small tolerance prevents flicker on the rounded glass border and while
            // moving through the invisible ::before bridge from the stripe to drawer.
            var pad = 18;
            return point.x >= rect.left - pad && point.x <= rect.right + pad &&
                point.y >= rect.top - pad && point.y <= rect.bottom + pad;
        }

        function openDrawer() {
            if (!navTrigger || !sideNavEl) return;
            if (drawerCloseTimer) { clearTimeout(drawerCloseTimer); drawerCloseTimer = null; }
            if (drawerOpenState) return;
            drawerOpenState = true;
            drawerOpenedAt = Date.now();
            sideNavEl.classList.add("active-drawer");
            navTrigger.classList.add("drawer-open");
        }

        function closeDrawer() {
            if (!navTrigger || !sideNavEl) return;
            if (!drawerOpenState) return;
            drawerOpenState = false;
            sideNavEl.classList.remove("active-drawer");
            navTrigger.classList.remove("drawer-open");
        }

        function scheduleDrawerClose(delay) {
            if (drawerCloseTimer) clearTimeout(drawerCloseTimer);
            drawerCloseTimer = setTimeout(function () {
                drawerCloseTimer = null;
                if (!pointerInsideDrawerZone(lastDrawerPointer)) closeDrawer();
            }, delay == null ? 220 : delay);
        }

        if (navTrigger && sideNavEl) {
            ["pointerenter", "mouseenter"].forEach(function (type) {
                navTrigger.addEventListener(type, function (event) {
                    lastDrawerPointer = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
                    openDrawer();
                });
            });
            navTrigger.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
                lastDrawerPointer = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
                openDrawer();
            });
            ["pointerenter", "mouseenter"].forEach(function (type) {
                sideNavEl.addEventListener(type, function (event) {
                    lastDrawerPointer = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
                    if (drawerCloseTimer) { clearTimeout(drawerCloseTimer); drawerCloseTimer = null; }
                    openDrawer();
                });
            });
            ["pointerleave", "mouseleave"].forEach(function (type) {
                sideNavEl.addEventListener(type, function (event) {
                    lastDrawerPointer = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
                    scheduleDrawerClose(240);
                });
            });
            document.addEventListener("pointermove", function (event) {
                lastDrawerPointer = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
                if (!drawerOpenState) return;
                if (pointerInsideDrawerZone(lastDrawerPointer)) {
                    if (drawerCloseTimer) { clearTimeout(drawerCloseTimer); drawerCloseTimer = null; }
                    return;
                }
                // After the opening grace period, any real movement outside the
                // drawer zone starts closing. This fixes the case where pointerleave
                // fires on the rounded/padded edge but no later close is scheduled.
                if (Date.now() - drawerOpenedAt > 320 && !drawerCloseTimer) {
                    scheduleDrawerClose(180);
                }
            }, true);
            window.addEventListener("blur", closeDrawer);
        }


        const $ = function (sel) {
            // CSS selectors cannot address IDs beginning with a digit (for example
            // the original setting `5shameInsta`). Resolve simple ID lookups
            // without passing them to querySelector.
            const idMatch = /^#([^\s.\[\]:>+~]+)$/.exec(sel);
            if (idMatch) return Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll("[id]")).find(function (el) { return el.id === idMatch[1]; }) || null;
            return root.querySelector(sel);
        };
        const $$ = function (sel) { return Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll(sel)); };

        // Theme trigger uses the existing purple top-right dot from code222.
        (function installThemeSwitcher() {
            const closeButton = $("#closeWindowBtn");
            const controls = closeButton && closeButton.parentElement;
            const trigger = controls && closeButton.nextElementSibling && closeButton.nextElementSibling.nextElementSibling;
            if (!trigger || !controls) return;
            trigger.id = "themeTrigger";
            trigger.title = "Theme Options";
            controls.style.position = "relative";
            const popover = document.createElement("div");
            popover.className = "theme-popover";
            popover.innerHTML = `<button class="theme-btn" data-theme="neutral" title="Neutral" style="background:#d4d4d8;color:#d4d4d8"></button>
            <button class="theme-btn" data-theme="purple" title="Purple" style="background:#ddb8ff;color:#ddb8ff"></button>
            <button class="theme-btn" data-theme="green" title="Green" style="background:#86efac;color:#86efac"></button>
            <button class="theme-btn" data-theme="red" title="Red" style="background:#fca5a5;color:#fca5a5"></button>
            <button class="theme-btn" data-theme="blue" title="Blue" style="background:#93c5fd;color:#93c5fd"></button>`;
            controls.appendChild(popover);
            const buttons = Array.prototype.slice.call(popover.querySelectorAll(".theme-btn"));
            function applyTheme(theme) {
                if (theme === "default") theme = "neutral"; // old saved value migration
                root.dataset.theme = theme === "neutral" ? "" : theme;
                buttons.forEach(function (button) { button.classList.toggle("active", button.dataset.theme === theme); });
                try { localStorage.setItem("value_menu_theme", theme); } catch (_) { }
            }
            let savedTheme = "neutral";
            try { savedTheme = localStorage.getItem("value_menu_theme") || "neutral"; } catch (_) { }
            if (savedTheme === "default") savedTheme = "neutral";
            if (!buttons.some(function (button) { return button.dataset.theme === savedTheme; })) savedTheme = "neutral";
            applyTheme(savedTheme);
            trigger.addEventListener("click", function (event) { event.stopPropagation(); popover.classList.toggle("active"); });
            trigger.addEventListener("mousedown", function (event) { event.stopPropagation(); });
            buttons.forEach(function (button) { button.addEventListener("click", function (event) { event.stopPropagation(); applyTheme(button.dataset.theme); popover.classList.remove("active"); }); });
            document.addEventListener("click", function (event) { if (!popover.contains(event.target) && event.target !== trigger) popover.classList.remove("active"); });
        })();

        // Robust theme click router. The original tiny dot lives inside the draggable
        // header; the popover is moved to the menu root and positioned as a fixed
        // overlay so it cannot be clipped or eaten by header dragging.
        (function installThemeClickRouter() {
            const trigger = root.querySelector("#themeTrigger");
            let popover = root.querySelector(".theme-popover");
            if (!trigger) return;
            if (!popover) {
                popover = document.createElement("div");
                popover.className = "theme-popover";
            }
            popover.innerHTML = `<button class="theme-btn" data-theme="neutral" title="Neutral" style="background:#d4d4d8;color:#d4d4d8"></button>
            <button class="theme-btn" data-theme="purple" title="Purple" style="background:#ddb8ff;color:#ddb8ff"></button>
            <button class="theme-btn" data-theme="green" title="Green" style="background:#86efac;color:#86efac"></button>
            <button class="theme-btn" data-theme="red" title="Red" style="background:#fca5a5;color:#fca5a5"></button>
            <button class="theme-btn" data-theme="blue" title="Blue" style="background:#93c5fd;color:#93c5fd"></button>`;
            root.appendChild(popover);
            popover.style.position = "fixed";
            popover.style.right = "auto";
            popover.style.zIndex = "2147483647";
            popover.style.pointerEvents = "auto";
            const buttons = Array.prototype.slice.call(popover.querySelectorAll(".theme-btn"));
            const themePalette = {
                neutral: { accent: "#d4d4d8", rgb: "161,161,170" },
                purple: { accent: "#ddb8ff", rgb: "153,102,204" },
                green: { accent: "#86efac", rgb: "74,222,128" },
                red: { accent: "#fca5a5", rgb: "248,113,113" },
                blue: { accent: "#93c5fd", rgb: "96,165,250" }
            };
            function applyTheme(theme) {
                if (theme === "default") theme = "neutral"; // migrate old Purple/default key
                if (!themePalette[theme]) theme = "neutral";
                root.dataset.theme = theme === "neutral" ? "" : theme;
                buttons.forEach(function (button) { button.classList.toggle("active", button.dataset.theme === theme); });
                // Dynamic theme button: the dot used to open themes mirrors the active theme.
                const color = themePalette[theme];
                trigger.style.setProperty("background-color", color.accent, "important");
                trigger.style.setProperty("box-shadow", "0 0 10px rgba(" + color.rgb + ", .55)", "important");
                trigger.style.setProperty("border-color", "rgba(" + color.rgb + ", .70)", "important");
                trigger.title = "Theme: " + theme.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + theme.slice(1);
                try { localStorage.setItem("value_menu_theme", theme); } catch (_) { }
            }
            function positionPopover() {
                const rect = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
                popover.style.top = Math.round(rect.bottom + 12) + "px";
                popover.style.left = Math.round(rect.right - 136) + "px";
            }
            let savedTheme = "neutral";
            try { savedTheme = localStorage.getItem("value_menu_theme") || "neutral"; } catch (_) { }
            if (savedTheme === "default") savedTheme = "neutral";
            if (!buttons.some(function (button) { return button.dataset.theme === savedTheme; })) savedTheme = "neutral";
            applyTheme(savedTheme);
            trigger.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopPropagation();
                event.stopImmediatePropagation();
                positionPopover();
                popover.classList.toggle("active");
            }, true);
            trigger.addEventListener("mousedown", function (event) {
                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopPropagation();
                event.stopImmediatePropagation();
            }, true);
            buttons.forEach(function (button) {
                button.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    event.stopPropagation();
                    event.stopImmediatePropagation();
                    applyTheme(button.dataset.theme || "neutral");
                    popover.classList.remove("active");
                }, true);
                button.addEventListener("mousedown", function (event) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    event.stopPropagation();
                    event.stopImmediatePropagation();
                }, true);
            });
            document.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
                if (!popover.contains(event.target) && event.target !== trigger) popover.classList.remove("active");
            }, true);
        })();

        // Populate Music from the original select so every supported track and its
        // real numeric value is preserved (rather than retaining the three mock items).
        (function populateMusicSelect() {
            const oldSongs = legacy.songs;
            const hiddenSongs = $("#songs");
            const wrapper = root.querySelector('.custom-select-wrapper[data-for="songs"]');
            if (!oldSongs || !hiddenSongs || !wrapper) return;
            const optionHost = wrapper.querySelector(".custom-options");
            const selectedValue = wrapper.querySelector(".selected-value");
            const oldOptions = Array.prototype.slice.call(oldSongs.options);
            hiddenSongs.innerHTML = "";
            optionHost.innerHTML = "";
            oldOptions.forEach(function (source, index) {
                const nativeOption = document.createElement("option");
                nativeOption.value = source.value;
                nativeOption.textContent = source.textContent;
                hiddenSongs.appendChild(nativeOption);
                const visualOption = document.createElement("div");
                visualOption.className = "custom-option" + (source.selected || index === 0 ? " selected" : "");
                visualOption.dataset.value = source.value;
                visualOption.textContent = source.textContent;
                optionHost.appendChild(visualOption);
            });
            const selected = oldOptions.find(function (option) { return option.selected; }) || oldOptions[0];
            if (selected) { hiddenSongs.value = selected.value; selectedValue.textContent = selected.textContent; }
        })();

        // Bind live runtime values to the header and Info tab. The updater is
        // deliberately read-only: it never changes game timing, packet counters or player state.
        const infoValues = $$("#info .font-mono-value");
        const metricBox = $("#windowHeader").querySelector("div:last-child > div:first-child");

        function updateLiveInfo() {
            const state = window.ValueGameState || {};
            const ping = Number(state.ping);
            const fps = Number(state.fps);
            const packets = Number(state.packets);
            const pingText = Number.isFinite(ping) ? Math.round(ping) + "ms" : "--ms";
            const fpsText = Number.isFinite(fps) ? Math.round(fps) + "fps" : "--fps";
            const packetText = Number.isFinite(packets) ? Math.round(packets) + "pkts" : "--pkts";
            if (topMetrics[0]) topMetrics[0].textContent = pingText;
            if (topMetrics[2]) topMetrics[2].textContent = fpsText;
            if (topMetrics[4]) topMetrics[4].textContent = packetText;
            if (infoValues[2]) infoValues[2].textContent = pingText;
            if (infoValues[3]) infoValues[3].textContent = packetText;
            if (infoValues[4]) {
                infoValues[4].textContent = !Number.isFinite(ping) ? "Inactive" : ping <= 85 ? "Low ms" : ping <= 145 ? "Normal ms" : "High ms";
            }
            const player = state.player;
            if (infoValues[5]) infoValues[5].textContent = player && Number.isFinite(Number(player.shameCount)) ? String(player.shameCount) : "0";
        }

            }
        }

            function audioCacheLog(eventName, extra) {
                try {
                    const line = "AUDIO CACHE " + eventName + " " + JSON.stringify(extra || {});
                    if (window.__valLog) window.__valLog(line); else console.log(line);
                } catch (_) { }
