            function openAudioCache() {
                if (audioCacheDbPromise) return audioCacheDbPromise;
                audioCacheDbPromise = new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
                    const idb = window.indexedDB;
                    if (!idb) { reject(new Error("IndexedDB is unavailable")); return; }
                    let request;
                    try { request = idb.open(AUDIO_CACHE_DB, 1); } catch (error) { reject(error); return; }
                    request.onupgradeneeded = function () {
                        const db = request.result;
                        if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(AUDIO_CACHE_STORE)) {
                            const store = db.createObjectStore(AUDIO_CACHE_STORE, { keyPath: "key" });
                            store.createIndex("lastUsedAt", "lastUsedAt", { unique: false });
                        }
                    };
                    request.onsuccess = function () {
                        const db = request.result;
                        db.onversionchange = function () { try { db.close(); } catch (_) { } audioCacheDbPromise = null; };
                        resolve(db);
                    };
                    request.onerror = function () { reject(request.error || new Error("Unable to open audio cache")); };
                });
                return audioCacheDbPromise;
            }
            function touchCachedAudio(key) {
                return openAudioCache().then(function (db) {
                    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
                        const tx = db.transaction(AUDIO_CACHE_STORE, "readwrite");
                        const store = tx.objectStore(AUDIO_CACHE_STORE);
                        const request = store.get(key);
                        request.onsuccess = function () { const entry = request.result; if (entry) { entry.lastUsedAt = Date.now(); store.put(entry); } };
                        request.onerror = function () { reject(request.error || new Error("Unable to touch cache entry")); };
                        tx.oncomplete = function () { resolve(); };
                        tx.onerror = function () { reject(tx.error || new Error("Unable to touch cache entry")); };
                        tx.onabort = function () { reject(tx.error || new Error("Audio cache transaction aborted")); };
                    });
                });
            }
            function getCachedAudio(key) {
                return openAudioCache().then(function (db) {
                    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
                        const tx = db.transaction(AUDIO_CACHE_STORE, "readonly");
                        const request = tx.objectStore(AUDIO_CACHE_STORE).get(key);
                        request.onsuccess = function () { resolve(request.result || null); };
                        request.onerror = function () { reject(request.error || new Error("Unable to read audio cache")); };
                        tx.onerror = function () { reject(tx.error || new Error("Unable to read audio cache")); };
                    });
                }).then(function (entry) {
                    if (entry) touchCachedAudio(key).catch(function () { });
                    return entry;
                });
            }
            function pruneAudioCache() {
                return openAudioCache().then(function (db) {
                    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
                        const readTx = db.transaction(AUDIO_CACHE_STORE, "readonly");
                        const getAll = readTx.objectStore(AUDIO_CACHE_STORE).getAll();
                        getAll.onerror = function () { reject(getAll.error || new Error("Unable to inspect audio cache")); };
                        getAll.onsuccess = function () {
                            const entries = getAll.result || [];
                            let total = entries.reduce(function (sum, entry) { return sum + (Number(entry.bytes) || (entry.blob && entry.blob.size) || 0); }, 0);
                            if (total <= AUDIO_CACHE_LIMIT) { resolve({ total: total, removed: 0 }); return; }
                            entries.sort(function (a, b) { return (a.lastUsedAt || a.savedAt || 0) - (b.lastUsedAt || b.savedAt || 0); });
                            const writeTx = db.transaction(AUDIO_CACHE_STORE, "readwrite");
                            const store = writeTx.objectStore(AUDIO_CACHE_STORE);
                            let removed = 0;
                            entries.forEach(function (entry) {
                                if (total <= AUDIO_CACHE_LIMIT) return;
                                total -= Number(entry.bytes) || (entry.blob && entry.blob.size) || 0;
                                removed++;
                                store.delete(entry.key);
                            });
                            writeTx.oncomplete = function () { resolve({ total: total, removed: removed }); };
                            writeTx.onerror = function () { reject(writeTx.error || new Error("Unable to prune audio cache")); };
                            writeTx.onabort = function () { reject(writeTx.error || new Error("Audio cache prune aborted")); };
                        };
                    });
                });
            }
            function storeCachedAudio(key, blob) {
                if (!blob || !blob.size) return Promise.reject(new Error("Empty audio Blob"));
                return openAudioCache().then(function (db) {
                    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
                        const tx = db.transaction(AUDIO_CACHE_STORE, "readwrite");
                        const store = tx.objectStore(AUDIO_CACHE_STORE);
                        const request = store.get(key);
                        request.onsuccess = function () {
                            const old = request.result || {};
                            store.put({ key: key, blob: blob, bytes: blob.size, type: blob.type || old.type || "audio/mpeg", duration: old.duration || 0, savedAt: old.savedAt || Date.now(), lastUsedAt: Date.now() });
                        };
                        request.onerror = function () { reject(request.error || new Error("Unable to write audio cache")); };
                        tx.oncomplete = function () { resolve(); };
                        tx.onerror = function () { reject(tx.error || new Error("Unable to write audio cache")); };
                        tx.onabort = function () { reject(tx.error || new Error("Audio cache write aborted")); };
                    });
                }).then(pruneAudioCache);
            }
            function updateCachedAudioDuration(key, duration) {
                if (!Number.isFinite(duration) || duration <= 0) return Promise.resolve();
                return openAudioCache().then(function (db) {
                    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
                        const tx = db.transaction(AUDIO_CACHE_STORE, "readwrite");
                        const store = tx.objectStore(AUDIO_CACHE_STORE);
                        const request = store.get(key);
                        request.onsuccess = function () { const entry = request.result; if (entry) { entry.duration = duration; entry.lastUsedAt = Date.now(); store.put(entry); } };
                        request.onerror = function () { reject(request.error || new Error("Unable to update cached duration")); };
                        tx.oncomplete = function () { resolve(); };
                        tx.onerror = function () { reject(tx.error || new Error("Unable to update cached duration")); };
                        tx.onabort = function () { reject(tx.error || new Error("Audio cache duration update aborted")); };
                    });
                });
            }
            function audioCacheStats() {
                return openAudioCache().then(function (db) {
                    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
                        const tx = db.transaction(AUDIO_CACHE_STORE, "readonly");
                        const request = tx.objectStore(AUDIO_CACHE_STORE).getAll();
                        request.onsuccess = function () {
                            const entries = request.result || [];
                            resolve({ count: entries.length, bytes: entries.reduce(function (sum, entry) { return sum + (Number(entry.bytes) || (entry.blob && entry.blob.size) || 0); }, 0) });
                        };
                        request.onerror = function () { reject(request.error || new Error("Unable to read cache statistics")); };
                        tx.onerror = function () { reject(tx.error || new Error("Unable to read cache statistics")); };
                    });
                });
            }
            function clearAudioCache() {
                return openAudioCache().then(function (db) {
                    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
                        const tx = db.transaction(AUDIO_CACHE_STORE, "readwrite");
                        tx.objectStore(AUDIO_CACHE_STORE).clear();
                        tx.oncomplete = function () { resolve(); };
                        tx.onerror = function () { reject(tx.error || new Error("Unable to clear audio cache")); };
                        tx.onabort = function () { reject(tx.error || new Error("Audio cache clear aborted")); };
                    });
                });
            }
            function formatCacheBytes(bytes) {
                const amount = Math.max(0, Number(bytes) || 0);
                return amount < 1024 * 1024 ? Math.round(amount / 1024) + " KB" : (amount / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(amount < 10 * 1024 * 1024 ? 1 : 0) + " MB";
            }
            function refreshAudioCacheInfo() {
                if (!cacheInfo) return;
                cacheInfo.textContent = "Checking cache…";
                audioCacheStats().then(function (stats) {
                    cacheInfo.textContent = stats.count + " track" + (stats.count === 1 ? "" : "s") + " · " + formatCacheBytes(stats.bytes) + " / " + formatCacheBytes(AUDIO_CACHE_LIMIT);
                }).catch(function () { cacheInfo.textContent = "Cache unavailable"; });
            }
            const parseLrc = function (text) {
                const result = [];
                String(text || "").split(/\r?\n/).forEach(function (line) {
                    const matches = Array.from(line.matchAll(/\[(\d{1,2}):(\d{2}(?:\.\d{1,3})?)\]/g));
                    const content = line.replace(/\[\d{1,2}:\d{2}(?:\.\d{1,3})?\]/g, "").trim();
                    matches.forEach(function (match) { if (content) result.push({ time: Number(match[1]) * 60 + Number(match[2]), text: content }); });
                });
                return result.sort(function (a, b) { return a.time - b.time; });
            };
            function lyricChatLog(eventName, extra) {
                try {
                    const payload = Object.assign({ audioTime: audio ? Number(audio.currentTime.toFixed(3)) : null, queued: lyricChatQueue.length }, extra || {});
                    const line = "LYRIC CHAT " + eventName + " " + JSON.stringify(payload);
                    if (window.__valLog) window.__valLog(line); else console.log(line);
                } catch (_) { }
            }
            function cancelLyricQueue() {
                lyricsSessionId++;
                if (lyricChatTimer) clearTimeout(lyricChatTimer);
                lyricChatTimer = null;
                lyricChatQueue = [];
                lyricChatNextAt = 0;
                queuedLyrics.clear();
            }
            function splitLyricForChat(text) {
                const chunks = [];
                let rest = String(text || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
                while (rest.length > LYRIC_CHAT_MAX_CHARS) {
                    let cut = rest.lastIndexOf(" ", LYRIC_CHAT_MAX_CHARS);
                    if (cut < 1) cut = LYRIC_CHAT_MAX_CHARS;
                    // Do not leave a meaningless one-word tail such as "you" in
                    // its own chat bubble.  Move the preceding word with it when
                    // that keeps both fragments readable and under the limit.
                    const tail = rest.slice(cut).trim();
                    if (tail.length <= 6 && cut > 10) {
                        const previousSpace = rest.lastIndexOf(" ", cut - 1);
                        if (previousSpace > 10 && cut - previousSpace <= 13) cut = previousSpace;
                    }
                    const chunk = rest.slice(0, cut).trim();
                    if (chunk) chunks.push(chunk);
                    rest = rest.slice(cut).trim();
                }
                if (rest) chunks.push(rest);
                return chunks;
            }
            function finishQueuedLyricPart(item) {
                if (!item.lastPart) return;
                sentLyrics.add(item.lyricIndex);
                queuedLyrics.delete(item.lyricIndex);
                lyricChatLog("LINE_SENT", { lyricIndex: item.lyricIndex, parts: item.totalParts });
            }
            function lyricChatGapAfter(item) {
                const next = lyricChatQueue[0];
                if (!next || !audio || next.lyricIndex === item.lyricIndex) return LYRIC_CHAT_MIN_GAP;
                const untilNextLyric = (next.lyricTime - audio.currentTime) * 1000;
                return untilNextLyric < LYRIC_CHAT_MIN_GAP ? LYRIC_CHAT_CATCHUP_GAP : LYRIC_CHAT_MIN_GAP;
            }
            function dispatchLyricChatQueue() {
                if (lyricChatTimer || !lyricChatQueue.length) return;
                const item = lyricChatQueue[0];
                const now = Date.now();
                // A line is never sent before its LRC timestamp.  The extra check
                // below also protects against a stalled audio clock.
                const untilLyric = audio ? Math.max(0, (item.lyricTime - audio.currentTime) * 1000) : 0;
                const dispatchAt = Math.max(now + untilLyric, lyricChatNextAt);
                lyricChatTimer = setTimeout(function () {
                    lyricChatTimer = null;
                    if (item.session !== lyricsSessionId || !audio || audio.paused || audio.ended || autoChat.getAttribute("aria-pressed") !== "true") {
                        if (item.session === lyricsSessionId) cancelLyricQueue();
                        return;
                    }
                    // Do not let a timer get ahead of playback after buffering or a
                    // browser timing correction.
                    if (audio.currentTime + .001 < item.lyricTime) { dispatchLyricChatQueue(); return; }
                    const sender = window.ValueSendChatRaw || window.ValueSendChat;
                    if (typeof sender !== "function") {
                        lyricChatLog("NO_SENDER", { lyricIndex: item.lyricIndex });
                        cancelLyricQueue();
                        return;
                    }
                    try {
                        sender(item.text);
                    } catch (error) {
                        item.attempts = (item.attempts || 0) + 1;
                        lyricChatLog("SEND_ERROR", { lyricIndex: item.lyricIndex, attempt: item.attempts, message: String(error) });
                        if (item.attempts < 2) {
                            lyricChatNextAt = Date.now() + LYRIC_CHAT_MIN_GAP;
                            dispatchLyricChatQueue();
                        } else {
                            lyricChatQueue.shift();
                            queuedLyrics.delete(item.lyricIndex);
                            dispatchLyricChatQueue();
                        }
                        return;
                    }
                    lyricChatQueue.shift();
                    const nextGap = lyricChatGapAfter(item);
                    lyricChatNextAt = Date.now() + nextGap;
                    lyricChatLog("PART_SENT", { lyricIndex: item.lyricIndex, part: item.part + 1, total: item.totalParts, gap: nextGap, text: item.text });
                    finishQueuedLyricPart(item);
                    dispatchLyricChatQueue();
                }, Math.max(0, dispatchAt - now));
            }
            function enqueueLyricLine(text, lyricIndex, lyricTime) {
                const parts = splitLyricForChat(text);
                if (!parts.length) { queuedLyrics.delete(lyricIndex); sentLyrics.add(lyricIndex); return; }
                const session = lyricsSessionId;
                parts.forEach(function (part, partIndex) {
                    lyricChatQueue.push({ text: part, lyricIndex: lyricIndex, lyricTime: lyricTime, part: partIndex, totalParts: parts.length, lastPart: partIndex === parts.length - 1, session: session, attempts: 0 });
                });
                lyricChatLog("LINE_QUEUED", { lyricIndex: lyricIndex, lyricTime: lyricTime, parts: parts.length });
                dispatchLyricChatQueue();
            }
            function normalizeTranslation(text) {
                return String(text || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
            }
            function isUsableEnglishTranslation(source, translated) {
                const original = normalizeTranslation(source);
                const result = normalizeTranslation(translated);
                if (!result) return false;
                const sourceWords = original ? original.split(" ").filter(Boolean).length : 0;
                const resultWords = result.split(" ").filter(Boolean).length;
                // A one-word answer such as "you" for a full Russian lyric is a
                // known bad/partial result from the free endpoint.  Never cache or
                // send it as if it were the complete line.
                if (sourceWords >= 4 && resultWords < 2) return false;
                if (sourceWords >= 3 && result.length < Math.max(4, Math.floor(original.length * .20))) return false;
                return true;
            }
            function readGoogleTranslation(data) {
                const segments = data && Array.isArray(data[0]) ? data[0] : [];
                return normalizeTranslation(segments.map(function (segment) {
                    return Array.isArray(segment) && typeof segment[0] === "string" ? segment[0] : "";
                }).join(""));
            }
            function requestEnglishTranslation(line, sourceLanguage) {
                const endpoint = "https://translate.googleapis.com/translate_a/single?client=gtx&sl=" + sourceLanguage + "&tl=en&dt=t&q=" + encodeURIComponent(line);
                return fetch(endpoint, { cache: "no-store" }).then(function (response) {
                    if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Translation HTTP " + response.status);
                    return response.json();
                }).then(readGoogleTranslation);
            }
            function translationKey(track, line) {
                return String((track && (track.id || track.url)) || "current") + "\u0000" + line;
            }
            function cachedEnglishTranslation(track, line) {
                const cache = track && (track.translations || (track.translations = {}));
                const cached = cache && cache[line] ? normalizeTranslation(cache[line]) : "";
                if (cached && isUsableEnglishTranslation(line, cached)) return cached;
                // Do not keep poisoned partial responses such as a cached "you".
                if (cached && cache) { delete cache[line]; save(); lyricChatLog("TRANSLATION_CACHE_REJECTED", { value: cached }); }
                return "";
            }
            function runTranslationJob(job) {
                return requestEnglishTranslation(job.line, "ru").then(function (translated) {
                    if (isUsableEnglishTranslation(job.line, translated)) return translated;
                    lyricChatLog("TRANSLATION_RETRY", { reason: "short_or_partial_ru_result" });
                    return requestEnglishTranslation(job.line, "auto");
                }).then(function (translated) {
                    const result = normalizeTranslation(translated);
                    if (!isUsableEnglishTranslation(job.line, result)) throw new Error("Translation result is incomplete");
                    const cache = job.track && (job.track.translations || (job.track.translations = {}));
                    if (cache) { cache[job.line] = result; save(); }
                    return result;
                });
            }
            function pumpTranslationJobs() {
                while (lyricTranslationActive < LYRIC_TRANSLATION_CONCURRENCY && lyricTranslationJobs.length) {
                    const job = lyricTranslationJobs.shift();
                    job.started = true;
                    lyricTranslationActive++;
                    Promise.resolve().then(function () { return runTranslationJob(job); }).then(job.resolve, job.reject).finally(function () {
                        lyricTranslationActive--;
                        lyricTranslationPending.delete(job.key);
                        pumpTranslationJobs();
                    });
                }
            }
            function queuedEnglishTranslation(track, line, priority) {
                const cached = cachedEnglishTranslation(track, line);
                if (cached) return Promise.resolve(cached);
                const key = translationKey(track, line);
                const pending = lyricTranslationPending.get(key);
                if (pending) {
                    // If playback catches a line before its prefetch begins, put
                    // that exact line ahead of the remaining look-ahead work.
                    if (priority && !pending.started) {
                        const position = lyricTranslationJobs.indexOf(pending);
                        if (position > 0) { lyricTranslationJobs.splice(position, 1); lyricTranslationJobs.unshift(pending); }
                    }
                    return pending.promise;
                }
                let resolveJob, rejectJob;
                const job = { key: key, track: track, line: line, started: false, resolve: null, reject: null, promise: null };
                job.promise = new Promise(function (resolve, reject) { resolveJob = resolve; rejectJob = reject; });
                job.resolve = resolveJob;
                job.reject = rejectJob;
                lyricTranslationPending.set(key, job);
                if (priority) lyricTranslationJobs.unshift(job); else lyricTranslationJobs.push(job);
                pumpTranslationJobs();
                return job.promise;
            }
            function prefetchUpcomingTranslations() {
                if (translateMode.value !== "en" || !currentTrack || !audio) return;
                const now = Number(audio.currentTime) || 0;
                lyricEntries.forEach(function (entry) {
                    if (entry.time >= now - .1 && entry.time <= now + LYRIC_TRANSLATION_LOOKAHEAD && /[А-Яа-яЁё]/.test(entry.text)) {
                        queuedEnglishTranslation(currentTrack, entry.text, false).catch(function () { /* sendLine will use original if needed */ });
                    }
                });
            }
            const sendLine = function (line, lyricIndex, lyricTime) {
                const taskSession = lyricsSessionId;
                const queue = function (text) { if (taskSession === lyricsSessionId) enqueueLyricLine(text, lyricIndex, lyricTime); };
                if (translateMode.value !== "en" || !/[А-Яа-яЁё]/.test(line)) { queue(line); return; }
                // This normally resolves from the look-ahead cache.  If it does
                // not, the active lyric is promoted above background requests.
                queuedEnglishTranslation(currentTrack, line, true).then(function (translated) {
                    if (taskSession === lyricsSessionId) queue(translated);
                }).catch(function (error) {
                    if (taskSession !== lyricsSessionId) return;
                    lyricChatLog("TRANSLATION_FALLBACK_ORIGINAL", { lyricIndex: lyricIndex, message: String(error) });
                    queue(line);
                });
            };
            const syncLyrics = function () {
                if (!audio || audio.ended) return;
                const now = audio.currentTime;
                let current = "";
                lyricEntries.forEach(function (entry) { if (entry.time <= now) current = entry.text; });
                if (currentLyric) currentLyric.textContent = current || "—";
                // Fill the translation cache while the next verse is still ahead,
                // so a network request cannot add a visible delay to its timestamp.
                prefetchUpcomingTranslations();
                if (audio.paused || autoChat.getAttribute("aria-pressed") !== "true") return;
                lyricEntries.forEach(function (entry, index) {
                    if (entry.time <= now && !sentLyrics.has(index) && !queuedLyrics.has(index)) {
                        // Reserve it before translation or queuing; completion is
                        // recorded only after the final chat fragment is sent.
                        queuedLyrics.add(index);
                        sendLine(entry.text, index, entry.time);
                    }
                });
            };
            const formatTime = function (seconds) { seconds = Number.isFinite(seconds) ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(seconds)) : 0; return Math.floor(seconds / 60) + ":" + String(seconds % 60).padStart(2, "0"); };
            function musicSeekLog(eventName, extra) {
                try {
                    const info = audio ? {
                        track: currentTrack && currentTrack.name,
                        url: currentTrack && currentTrack.url,
                        readyState: audio.readyState,
                        networkState: audio.networkState,
                        duration: audio.duration,
                        currentTime: audio.currentTime,
                        paused: audio.paused,
                        error: audio.error ? { code: audio.error.code, message: audio.error.message } : null,
                        seekable: audio.seekable ? Array.from({ length: audio.seekable.length }, function (_, i) { return [audio.seekable.start(i), audio.seekable.end(i)]; }) : []
                    } : { audio: null };
                    const line = "MUSIC SEEK " + eventName + " " + JSON.stringify(Object.assign(info, extra || {}));
                    if (window.__valLog) window.__valLog(line);
                    else console.log(line);
                } catch (error) { console.warn("MUSIC SEEK LOG ERROR", error); }
            }
            function getSeekBounds() {
                if (!audio) return null;
                const duration = Number(audio.duration);
                // A Blob is a complete local file, so duration is a trustworthy
                // seek range even before the browser emits its first progress event.
                if (audio.__valueSourceMode === "blob" && Number.isFinite(duration) && duration > 0) {
                    return { start: 0, end: duration, mode: "blob" };
                }
                // A remote stream may advertise duration without accepting Range
                // requests.  Only use a real non-empty TimeRange in that mode.
                const ranges = audio.seekable;
                if (!ranges || !ranges.length) return null;
                const now = Number(audio.currentTime) || 0;
                let fallback = null;
                for (let i = 0; i < ranges.length; i++) {
                    try {
                        const start = ranges.start(i), end = ranges.end(i);
                        if (!Number.isFinite(start) || !Number.isFinite(end) || end - start < .05) continue;
                        const range = { start: start, end: end, mode: "stream" };
                        if (now >= start - .05 && now <= end + .05) return range;
                        fallback = range;
                    } catch (_) { }
                }
                return fallback;
            }
            function getDisplayDuration(bounds) {
                const duration = audio ? Number(audio.duration) : 0;
                return Number.isFinite(duration) && duration > 0 ? duration : (bounds ? bounds.end : 0);
            }
            function syncLyricsToTime(time) {
                const t = Number.isFinite(time) ? Math.max(0, time) : 0;
                cancelLyricQueue();
                sentLyrics = new Set(lyricEntries.map(function (entry, index) { return entry.time <= t ? index : -1; }).filter(function (index) { return index >= 0; }));
                let current = "";
                lyricEntries.forEach(function (entry) { if (entry.time <= t + .05) current = entry.text; });
                if (currentLyric) currentLyric.textContent = current || "—";
            }
            // previewPercent is used while the thumb is being dragged.  It keeps
            // the UI under the pointer without firing dozens of network seeks.
            function renderSeek(previewPercent) {
                const bounds = getSeekBounds();
                const duration = getDisplayDuration(bounds);
                const current = audio ? Math.max(0, Number(audio.currentTime) || 0) : 0;
                const hasBounds = !!bounds && bounds.end > bounds.start;
                let p = hasBounds ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (current - bounds.start) / (bounds.end - bounds.start) * 100)) : 0;
                let shownTime = current;
                if (hasBounds && Number.isFinite(previewPercent)) {
                    p = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, previewPercent));
                    shownTime = bounds.start + (bounds.end - bounds.start) * p / 100;
                }
                seekNative.value = String(p);
                seekNative.disabled = !hasBounds;
                seekNative.setAttribute("aria-disabled", hasBounds ? "false" : "true");
                if (seekContainer && seekThumb && seekProgress) {
                    const thumbWidth = seekThumb.offsetWidth || 36;
                    const availableWidth = Math.max(1, seekContainer.getBoundingClientRect().width - thumbWidth);
                    const left = p / 100 * availableWidth;
                    seekProgress.style.width = (left + thumbWidth / 2) + "px";
                    seekThumb.style.left = left + "px";
                    seekContainer.setAttribute("aria-valuenow", String(Math.round(p)));
                }
                seekCurrent.textContent = formatTime(shownTime);
                seekDuration.textContent = formatTime(duration);
            }
            let seekDragging = false, pendingSeekPercent = null;
            function applyNativeSeek() {
                const bounds = getSeekBounds();
                if (!bounds) {
                    musicSeekLog("NO_SEEKABLE_RANGE", { value: seekNative.value, sourceMode: audio && audio.__valueSourceMode });
                    if (audio && audio.__valueSourceMode !== "blob") status.textContent = "Source is buffering — seeking will unlock when available";
                    renderSeek();
                    return;
                }
                const percent = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(pendingSeekPercent == null ? seekNative.value : pendingSeekPercent) || 0));
                // Setting exactly duration can turn a click at 100% into an ended
                // event.  Keep it infinitesimally inside the valid range instead.
                const rawTime = bounds.start + (bounds.end - bounds.start) * percent / 100;
                const time = Math.max(bounds.start, Math.min(bounds.end - .001, rawTime));
                if (!Number.isFinite(time)) return;
                const targetAudio = audio;
                try { targetAudio.currentTime = time; } catch (error) { musicSeekLog("SET_TIME_ERROR", { time: time, message: String(error) }); return; }
                musicSeekLog("SET_TIME", { percent: percent, targetTime: time, bounds: bounds, sourceMode: targetAudio.__valueSourceMode });
                setTimeout(function () { if (audio === targetAudio) musicSeekLog("AFTER_0MS", { targetTime: time, actualTime: targetAudio.currentTime, seeking: targetAudio.seeking }); }, 0);
                setTimeout(function () {
                    if (audio !== targetAudio) return;
                    const actual = Number(targetAudio.currentTime) || 0;
                    musicSeekLog("AFTER_700MS", { targetTime: time, actualTime: actual, seeking: targetAudio.seeking });
                    // A server that ignores Range requests silently returns to the
                    // beginning.  Do not pretend that its duration is seekable.
                    if (!targetAudio.seeking && Math.abs(actual - time) > 1.6) {
                        musicSeekLog("SEEK_REJECTED_BY_SOURCE", { targetTime: time, actualTime: actual, sourceMode: targetAudio.__valueSourceMode });
                        if (targetAudio.__valueSourceMode !== "blob") status.textContent = "This host does not support streaming seek; reload the track";
                    }
                }, 700);
                pendingSeekPercent = null;
                renderSeek();
            }
            function beginSeek(event) {
                if (!getSeekBounds()) { musicSeekLog("DOWN_NO_SEEKABLE_RANGE", { sourceMode: audio && audio.__valueSourceMode }); return; }
                seekDragging = true;
                pendingSeekPercent = Number(seekNative.value);
                if (seekThumb) seekThumb.classList.add("active");
                if (event) event.stopPropagation();
            }
            function finishSeek(event) {
                if (!seekDragging) return;
                seekDragging = false;
                if (seekThumb) seekThumb.classList.remove("active");
                if (event) event.stopPropagation();
                applyNativeSeek();
            }
            // Use native range hit-testing.  input only previews the position;
            // committing on pointer release prevents a burst of competing seeks.
            seekNative.addEventListener("pointerdown", beginSeek, true);
            seekNative.addEventListener("mousedown", beginSeek, true); // older browsers without Pointer Events
            seekNative.addEventListener("input", function (event) {
                const bounds = getSeekBounds();
                if (!bounds) { musicSeekLog("INPUT_NO_SEEKABLE_RANGE", { value: seekNative.value }); renderSeek(); return; }
                event.stopPropagation();
                pendingSeekPercent = Number(seekNative.value);
                if (seekDragging) renderSeek(pendingSeekPercent);
                else applyNativeSeek(); // keyboard range changes
            }, true);
            seekNative.addEventListener("change", function (event) { finishSeek(event); }, true);
            document.addEventListener("pointerup", finishSeek, true);
            document.addEventListener("mouseup", finishSeek, true);
            seekNative.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
                const bounds = getSeekBounds();
                if (!bounds) return;
                if (event.key === "ArrowLeft" || event.key === "ArrowRight") {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    event.stopPropagation();
                    const delta = event.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -5 : 5;
                    const time = Math.max(bounds.start, Math.min(bounds.end - .001, audio.currentTime + delta));
                    pendingSeekPercent = (time - bounds.start) / (bounds.end - bounds.start) * 100;
                    seekNative.value = String(pendingSeekPercent);
                    applyNativeSeek();
                }
            }, true);
            function animateSeek() {
                if (audio && !seekDragging) renderSeek();
                requestAnimationFrame(animateSeek);
            }
            requestAnimationFrame(animateSeek);
            function mimeForUrl(sourceUrl, headers) {
                const match = /(?:^|\n)\s*content-type\s*:\s*([^;\r\n]+)/i.exec(String(headers || ""));
                if (match) return match[1].trim();
                const ext = (String(sourceUrl).split("?")[0].match(/\.([a-z0-9]+)$/i) || [])[1];
                return ({ mp3: "audio/mpeg", ogg: "audio/ogg", oga: "audio/ogg", wav: "audio/wav", m4a: "audio/mp4", aac: "audio/aac", flac: "audio/flac" })[String(ext || "").toLowerCase()] || "audio/mpeg";
            }
            function gmDownloadBlob(sourceUrl) {
                return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
                    if (typeof GM_xmlhttpRequest !== "function") { reject(new Error("GM_xmlhttpRequest is unavailable")); return; }
                    try {
                        GM_xmlhttpRequest({
                            method: "GET",
                            url: sourceUrl,
                            responseType: "arraybuffer",
                            timeout: 120000,
                            onload: function (response) {
                                const statusCode = Number(response.status) || 0;
                                if (statusCode < 200 || statusCode >= 300 || !response.response || !response.response.byteLength) {
                                    reject(new Error("GM request HTTP " + statusCode)); return;
                                }
                                resolve(new Blob([response.response], { type: mimeForUrl(sourceUrl, response.responseHeaders) }));
                            },
                            onerror: function () { reject(new Error("GM request failed")); },
                            ontimeout: function () { reject(new Error("GM request timed out")); },
                            onabort: function () { reject(new Error("GM request aborted")); }
                        });
                    } catch (error) { reject(error); }
                });
            }
            const stopAudio = function () {
                audioLoadId++;
                if (audioLoadController) { try { audioLoadController.abort(); } catch (_) { } audioLoadController = null; }
                if (audio) {
                    audio.pause();
                    if (audio.__valueObjectUrl) { URL.revokeObjectURL(audio.__valueObjectUrl); audio.__valueObjectUrl = ""; }
                    audio.removeAttribute("src");
                    try { audio.load(); } catch (_) { }
                }
                audio = null;
                sentLyrics.clear();
                cancelLyricQueue();
            };
            const playTrack = function (track) {
                if (!track || !track.url) return;
                stopAudio();
                const loadId = ++audioLoadId;
                currentTrack = track;
                lyrics.value = track.lyrics || lyrics.value || "";
                lyricEntries = parseLrc(lyrics.value);
                sentLyrics.clear();
                audio = new Audio();
                audio.preload = "auto";
                audio.__valueSourceMode = "loading";
                const targetAudio = audio;
                const directUrl = track.url;
                const isCurrentLoad = function () { return audio === targetAudio && audioLoadId === loadId; };
                audio.addEventListener("error", function () { if (isCurrentLoad()) { status.textContent = "Link is not a playable direct audio file"; musicSeekLog("ERROR", { sourceMode: targetAudio.__valueSourceMode }); } });
                audio.addEventListener("loadedmetadata", function () {
                    musicSeekLog("LOADED_METADATA", { sourceMode: targetAudio.__valueSourceMode });
                    if (targetAudio.__valueCacheKey && Number.isFinite(targetAudio.duration) && targetAudio.duration > 0) {
                        Promise.resolve(targetAudio.__valueCacheWritePromise).then(function () {
                            return updateCachedAudioDuration(targetAudio.__valueCacheKey, targetAudio.duration);
                        }).catch(function () { });
                    }
                    renderSeek();
                });
                audio.addEventListener("durationchange", function () { musicSeekLog("DURATION_CHANGE", { sourceMode: targetAudio.__valueSourceMode }); renderSeek(); });
                audio.addEventListener("stalled", function () { musicSeekLog("STALLED", { sourceMode: targetAudio.__valueSourceMode }); });
                audio.addEventListener("seeking", function () { musicSeekLog("SEEKING", { sourceMode: targetAudio.__valueSourceMode }); });
                audio.addEventListener("seeked", function () { musicSeekLog("SEEKED", { sourceMode: targetAudio.__valueSourceMode }); if (!seekDragging) syncLyricsToTime(targetAudio.currentTime); renderSeek(); });
                const volumeControl = legacy.mscVolume;
                audio.volume = volumeControl ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(volumeControl.value) / 100)) : .7;
                audio.muted = !!(legacy.msync && legacy.msync.checked);
                audio.addEventListener("progress", renderSeek);
                audio.addEventListener("canplay", renderSeek);
                audio.addEventListener("timeupdate", function () { syncLyrics(); renderSeek(); });
                audio.addEventListener("ended", function () { if (isCurrentLoad()) { status.textContent = "Ended"; sentLyrics.clear(); cancelLyricQueue(); } });
                // Warm only the next part of the song through the bounded
                // translation queue.  The previous all-at-once loop could issue
                // dozens of Google requests, get throttled, and make later lyrics
                // arrive late or as partial translations.
                if (translateMode.value === "en" && lyricEntries.length) prefetchUpcomingTranslations();
                const startPlayback = function () {
                    if (!isCurrentLoad()) return;
                    targetAudio.play().then(function () { if (isCurrentLoad()) status.textContent = "Playing: " + track.name; }).catch(function () { if (isCurrentLoad()) status.textContent = "Audio URL blocked/unavailable"; });
                };
                const useBlob = function (blob, via, fromPersistentCache) {
                    if (!isCurrentLoad() || !blob || !blob.size) throw new Error("Empty audio response");
                    const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                    targetAudio.__valueObjectUrl = objectUrl;
                    targetAudio.__valueSourceMode = "blob";
                    targetAudio.__valueCacheKey = directUrl;
                    targetAudio.__valueFromPersistentCache = !!fromPersistentCache;
                    if (fromPersistentCache) {
                        targetAudio.__valueCacheWritePromise = Promise.resolve();
                        touchCachedAudio(directUrl).catch(function () { });
                        audioCacheLog("HIT", { bytes: blob.size, url: directUrl });
                    } else {
                        targetAudio.__valueCacheWritePromise = storeCachedAudio(directUrl, blob);
                        targetAudio.__valueCacheWritePromise.then(function (result) {
                            audioCacheLog("STORED", { bytes: blob.size, url: directUrl, pruned: result && result.removed || 0 });
                            refreshAudioCacheInfo();
                        }).catch(function (error) {
                            audioCacheLog("STORE_FAILED", { url: directUrl, message: String(error) });
                        });
                    }
                    targetAudio.src = objectUrl;
                    targetAudio.load();
                    musicSeekLog("LOCAL_BLOB_READY", { via: via, bytes: blob.size, type: blob.type || "unknown", persistentCache: !!fromPersistentCache });
                    startPlayback();
                };
                const useStreamFallback = function (reason) {
                    if (!isCurrentLoad()) return;
                    targetAudio.__valueSourceMode = "stream";
                    targetAudio.src = directUrl;
                    targetAudio.load();
                    status.textContent = "Streaming — seek availability is being checked…";
                    musicSeekLog("REMOTE_STREAM_FALLBACK", { message: String(reason || "unknown") });
                    startPlayback();
                };
                const downloadSeekableSource = function () {
                    if (!isCurrentLoad()) return;
                    // First use page fetch where CORS permits it.  The full response
                    // is a Blob and is therefore always seekable.  The GM path
                    // handles storage/CDN hosts that omit CORS headers.
                    status.textContent = "Downloading seekable audio…";
                    audioLoadController = typeof AbortController !== "undefined" ? new AbortController() : null;
                    const fetchOptions = { mode: "cors", cache: "no-store" };
                    if (audioLoadController) fetchOptions.signal = audioLoadController.signal;
                    fetch(directUrl, fetchOptions).then(function (response) {
                        if (!response.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
                        return response.blob();
                    }).then(function (blob) {
                        if (!isCurrentLoad()) return;
                        audioLoadController = null;
                        useBlob(blob, "fetch", false);
                    }).catch(function (fetchError) {
                        if (!isCurrentLoad()) return;
                        audioLoadController = null;
                        musicSeekLog("FETCH_BLOB_FAILED", { message: String(fetchError) });
                        status.textContent = "Downloading through userscript…";
                        return gmDownloadBlob(directUrl).then(function (blob) {
                            if (!isCurrentLoad()) return;
                            useBlob(blob, "GM_xmlhttpRequest", false);
                        }).catch(function (gmError) {
                            if (!isCurrentLoad()) return;
                            musicSeekLog("GM_BLOB_FAILED", { message: String(gmError) });
                            useStreamFallback(gmError);
                        });
                    });
                };
                // IndexedDB survives page reloads.  A hit bypasses fetch entirely;
                // the cached Blob is immediately a fully seekable local source.
                status.textContent = "Checking local audio cache…";
                getCachedAudio(directUrl).then(function (entry) {
                    if (!isCurrentLoad()) return;
                    if (entry && entry.blob && entry.blob.size) {
                        useBlob(entry.blob, "IndexedDB cache", true);
                        refreshAudioCacheInfo();
                        return;
                    }
                    audioCacheLog("MISS", { url: directUrl });
                    downloadSeekableSource();
                }).catch(function (error) {
                    if (!isCurrentLoad()) return;
                    audioCacheLog("READ_FAILED", { url: directUrl, message: String(error) });
                    downloadSeekableSource();
                });
            };
            const loadLyricsForTrack = function (track, automatic) {
                if (!track || track.lyrics) { if (track && track.lyrics) { lyrics.value = track.lyrics; lyricEntries = parseLrc(track.lyrics); } return; }
                const urlName = decodeURIComponent(String(track.url || "").split("?")[0].split("/").pop() || "").replace(/\.[a-z0-9]+$/i, "").replace(/[_+]+/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
                const rawName = (track.name && track.name !== "Custom track" ? track.name : urlName) || urlName;
                const split = rawName.split(/\s[-–—]\s/);
                const a = (track.artist || artist.value || (split.length > 1 ? split.shift() : "")).trim();
                const t = (track.title || title.value || (split.length ? split.join(" - ") : rawName)).trim();
                if (!t) return;
                status.textContent = automatic ? "Searching synced lyrics…" : "Searching lyrics…";
                const endpoint = a ? "https://lrclib.net/api/get?artist_name=" + encodeURIComponent(a) + "&track_name=" + encodeURIComponent(t) : "https://lrclib.net/api/search?q=" + encodeURIComponent(t);
                fetch(endpoint).then(function (response) { if (!response.ok) throw new Error(); return response.json(); }).then(function (data) {
                    const result = Array.isArray(data) ? data.find(function (item) { return item.syncedLyrics; }) : data;
                    if (!result || !result.syncedLyrics) throw new Error();

                    lyrics.value = track.lyrics; artist.value = track.artist; title.value = track.title; lyricEntries = parseLrc(track.lyrics); save(); status.textContent = "Synced lyrics loaded";
                }).catch(function () { status.textContent = "Lyrics not found — paste LRC manually"; });
            };

                if (!openNow) { wrapper.classList.add("open"); trigger.classList.add("open"); const card = wrapper.closest(".control-card"); if (card) card.classList.add("is-open"); }
            });
            options.forEach(function (option) { option.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
                event.stopPropagation(); options.forEach(function (o) { o.classList.remove("selected"); }); option.classList.add("selected");

                const visibleNative = $("#" + sourceId);

                if (selectMap[sourceId] && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(selectMap[sourceId], label)) {
                    setLegacy(legacyId, selectMap[sourceId][label]);

                    // Extended camera modes are not part of the original map; their
                    // matching option in the compatibility select supplies the value.
                    valueByLabel(legacyId, label);

        // Checkbox controls are direct adapters to the original game settings.
        // FIX v11 (explicit user request: "Я не могу включить auto-push и
        // проверить, добавь переключатель в combat вкладку" -- found
        // by exact reproduction: the visible V5 Combat-tab toggle buttons for
        // #autoPush/#autoPreplace were already added to the HTML/legacy list in a
        // previous session, but were NEVER added to THIS specific adapter array --
        // the one that actually wires a visible button's clicks to
        // setLegacyChecked() updates on the real hidden checkbox. Without this,
        // clicking the visible "Auto-Push"/"Preplace" buttons did nothing: the
        // button's own aria-pressed toggled visually with no listener to
        // propagate that into the real #autoPush/#autoPreplace checkbox the game
        // logic (getCheck("autoPush")/preplaceToggleOn()) actually reads -- so the
        // feature could never be turned on from the visible UI at all, exactly
        // the reported symptom. Every other toggle already worked because it was
        // already present in this array.

        // Reliable switch router. It runs in capture phase and owns all toggle
        // state changes, preventing the old per-button listeners from double
        // toggling the same button.
        (function installReliableSwitchRouter() {
            function animate(toggle) {
                toggle.dataset.active = "true";
                setTimeout(function () { toggle.removeAttribute("data-active"); }, 200);
            }
            function applySpecial(toggle, next) {
                if (toggle.id === "animHealth") {
                    window.ValueAnimHealth = next;
                    try { localStorage.setItem("value_anim_health", next ? "1" : "0"); } catch (_) { }
                    return true;
                }
                if (toggle.id === "circularHealth") {
                    window.ValueCircularHealth = next;
                    try { localStorage.setItem("value_circular_health", next ? "1" : "0"); } catch (_) { }
                    return true;
                }
                if (toggle.id === "enemyPreviewToggle") {
                    window.ValueEnemyPreview = next;
                    try { localStorage.setItem("value_enemy_preview", next ? "1" : "0"); } catch (_) { }
                    return true;
                }
                if (toggle.id === "proximityObjectFade") {
                    window.ValueProximityObjectFade = next;
                    try { localStorage.setItem("value_proximity_object_fade", next ? "1" : "0"); } catch (_) { }
                    return true;
                }
                if (toggle.id === "valueLyricsAuto") {
                    window.ValueLyricsAutoChat = next;
                    try { localStorage.setItem("value_lyrics_auto_chat", next ? "1" : "0"); } catch (_) { }
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            }
            function setToggle(toggle, next) {
                toggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed", next ? "true" : "false");
                animate(toggle);
                const legacyId = toggle.dataset.legacyId || (legacy[toggle.id] ? toggle.id : "");
                if (legacyId) setLegacyChecked(legacyId, next);
                else applySpecial(toggle, next);
            }
            root.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
                const toggle = event.target && event.target.closest ? event.target.closest(".liquid-toggle") : null;
                if (!toggle || !root.contains(toggle)) return;
                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopPropagation();
                event.stopImmediatePropagation();
                const next = toggle.getAttribute("aria-pressed") !== "true";
                setToggle(toggle, next);
            }, true);
            root.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
                const toggle = event.target && event.target.closest ? event.target.closest(".liquid-toggle") : null;
                if (!toggle || !root.contains(toggle) || !(event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ")) return;
                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopPropagation();
                event.stopImmediatePropagation();
                const next = toggle.getAttribute("aria-pressed") !== "true";
                setToggle(toggle, next);
            }, true);
        })();

        // Custom Liquid Glass volume slider. It is only the visible control; the
        // original hidden #mscVolume input remains the compatibility source used by
        // the rest of the script and music code.
        (function installGlassVolumeSlider() {
            const container = $("#mscVolumeContainer");
            const progress = $("#mscVolumeProgress");
            const thumb = $("#mscVolumeThumb");
            const source = legacy.mscVolume;
            if (!container || !progress || !thumb || !source) return;

            let dragging = false;
            let currentValue = Number(source.value);
            if (!Number.isFinite(currentValue)) currentValue = 50;

            function clamp(value) { return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(value) || 0)); }
            function readSourceValue() { return clamp(source.value); }
            function writeSourceValue(value, finalEvent) {
                source.value = String(Math.round(clamp(value)));
                emit(source, "input");
                if (finalEvent) emit(source, "change");
            }
            function render(value) {
                currentValue = clamp(value);
                const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
                const thumbWidth = thumb.offsetWidth || 36;
                const availableWidth = Math.max(1, rect.width - thumbWidth);
                if (rect.width <= 0) return;
                const thumbLeft = (currentValue / 100) * availableWidth;
                const progressWidth = thumbLeft + (thumbWidth / 2);
                progress.style.width = progressWidth + "px";
                thumb.style.left = thumbLeft + "px";
                container.setAttribute("aria-valuenow", String(Math.round(currentValue)));
            }
            function setValue(value, finalEvent) {
                const next = clamp(value);
                render(next);
                writeSourceValue(next, !!finalEvent);
            }
            function percentFromClientX(clientX) {
                const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
                const thumbWidth = thumb.offsetWidth || 36;
                const availableWidth = Math.max(1, rect.width - thumbWidth);
                let offsetX = clientX - rect.left - (thumbWidth / 2);
                offsetX = Math.max(0, Math.min(availableWidth, offsetX));
                let percent = (offsetX / availableWidth) * 100;
                // Gentle iOS-like edge magnetism: when the finger is near 0/100,
                // the thumb continues into the endpoint instead of feeling pinned
                // around the middle of the track.
                const edge = 12;
                if (percent < edge) percent = (percent * percent) / edge;
                else if (percent > 100 - edge) { const remain = 100 - percent; percent = 100 - (remain * remain) / edge; }
                return percent;
            }
            function pointerSet(event, finalEvent) {
                setValue(percentFromClientX(event.clientX), finalEvent);
            }
            function startDrag(event) {
                if (event.button !== undefined && event.button !== 0) return;
                dragging = true;
                thumb.classList.add("active");
                pointerSet(event, false);
                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopPropagation();
            }
            function moveDrag(event) {
                if (!dragging) return;
                pointerSet(event, false);
                event.preventDefault();
            }
            function stopDrag() {
                if (!dragging) return;
                dragging = false;
                thumb.classList.remove("active");
                writeSourceValue(currentValue, true);
            }
            container.addEventListener("pointerdown", startDrag);
            thumb.addEventListener("pointerdown", startDrag);
            document.addEventListener("pointermove", moveDrag, true);
            document.addEventListener("pointerup", stopDrag, true);
            document.addEventListener("pointercancel", stopDrag, true);
            container.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
                let step = event.shiftKey ? 10 : 5;
                if (event.key === "ArrowLeft" || event.key === "ArrowDown") { event.preventDefault(); setValue(currentValue - step, true); }
                else if (event.key === "ArrowRight" || event.key === "ArrowUp") { event.preventDefault(); setValue(currentValue + step, true); }
                else if (event.key === "Home") { event.preventDefault(); setValue(0, true); }
                else if (event.key === "End") { event.preventDefault(); setValue(100, true); }
            });
            source.addEventListener("input", function () { if (!dragging) render(readSourceValue()); });
            source.addEventListener("change", function () { if (!dragging) render(readSourceValue()); });
            window.addEventListener("resize", function () { render(currentValue); });
            navItems.forEach(function (item) {
                item.addEventListener("click", function () {
                    if (item.getAttribute("data-target") === "music") setTimeout(function () { render(readSourceValue()); }, 80);
                });
            });
            // The menu starts hidden, so its slider can initially have width 0.
            // Re-render when it becomes measurable instead of leaving the CSS default
            // thumb at the centre while the source value is elsewhere.
            if (window.ResizeObserver) new ResizeObserver(function () { if (!dragging) requestAnimationFrame(function () { render(readSourceValue()); }); }).observe(container);
            new MutationObserver(function () { if (!dragging) requestAnimationFrame(function () { render(readSourceValue()); }); }).observe(root, { attributes: true, subtree: true, attributeFilter: ["class", "style"] });
            window.setInterval(function () {
                if (dragging) return;
                const externalValue = readSourceValue();
                if (Math.abs(externalValue - currentValue) >= 1) render(externalValue);
            }, 500);
            requestAnimationFrame(function () { render(readSourceValue()); });
            setTimeout(function () { render(readSourceValue()); }, 180);
        })();

        function cosmeticState(entry) {
            const state = window.ValueGameState;
            const player = state && state.player;
            if (!player) return { known: false, owned: false, canBuy: false };
            const owned = entry.accessory ? !!player.tails[entry.id] : !!player.skins[entry.id];
            const products = entry.accessory ? state.accessories : state.hats;
            const product = products && products.find(function (x) { return x.id === entry.id; });
            return { known: true, owned: owned, canBuy: !!product && player.points >= product.price };

    function calcPoint(x, y, angle, dist) {

    // Smooth health display state. This is render-only: it never writes to a
    // player/object health value and therefore cannot affect gameplay or packets.
    window.ValueAnimHealth = (function () {
        try { return localStorage.getItem("value_anim_health") === "1"; } catch (_) { return false; }

    window.valueSmoothHealthRatio = function (obj) {
        const max = Number(obj && obj.maxHealth) || 100;
        const target = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (Number(obj && obj.health) || 0) / max));
        if (!window.ValueAnimHealth) {
            obj.__valueDisplayedHealth = target;
            return target;
        }
        let shown = Number(obj.__valueDisplayedHealth);
        if (!Number.isFinite(shown)) shown = target;
        // Exponential interpolation gives a smooth effect at any FPS and never
        // overshoots the server-provided health value.
        shown += (target - shown) * 0.16;
        if (Math.abs(target - shown) < 0.001) shown = target;
        obj.__valueDisplayedHealth = shown;
        return shown;
    };

    // Dead-player snapshots are created outside the webpack Player module. The
    // bundled DeadPlayer class is scoped inside that module and therefore cannot
    // be constructed by addDeadPlayer; keep this equivalent, self-contained class
    // in the renderer scope.
    class DeadPlayer {
        constructor(x, y, dir, buildIndex, weaponIndex, skinIndex, tailIndex, weaponVariant, skinColor, scale, name) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.lastDir = dir || 0;
            this.dir = this.lastDir + Math.PI;
            this.buildIndex = buildIndex;
            this.weaponIndex = weaponIndex;
            this.weaponVariant = weaponVariant;
            this.skinIndex = skinIndex;
            this.tailIndex = tailIndex;
            this.skinColor = skinColor;
            this.scale = scale || 0;
            this.visScale = 0;
            this.skinRot = 0;
            this.name = name || "";
            this.effectMode = getVal("deadPlayer");
            this.alpha = 1;
            this.active = true;
        }

        animate(delta) {
            const tau = Math.PI * 2;
            const rawDistance = Math.abs(this.lastDir - this.dir) % tau;
            const angleDistance = rawDistance > Math.PI ? tau - rawDistance : rawDistance;
            if (angleDistance > 0.01) this.dir += angleDistance / 20;
            else this.dir = this.lastDir;

            if (this.visScale < this.scale) {
                this.visScale = Math.min(this.scale, this.visScale + delta / (this.scale / 2 || 1));
            }
            this.alpha = Math.max(0, this.alpha - delta / 30000);
            if (this.alpha === 0) this.active = false;
        }
    }
    function addDeadPlayer(tmpObj) {
        deadPlayers.push(new DeadPlayer(tmpObj.x, tmpObj.y, tmpObj.dir, tmpObj.buildIndex, tmpObj.weaponIndex, tmpObj.skinIndex, tmpObj.tailIndex, tmpObj.weaponVariant, tmpObj.skinColor, tmpObj.scale, tmpObj.name));
    }

                     * Filter constructor.
                     * @constructor
                     * @param {object} options - Filter instance options
                     * @param {boolean} options.emptyList - Instantiate filter with no blacklist
                     * @param {array} options.list - Instantiate filter with custom list
                     * @param {string} options.placeHolder - Character used to replace profane words.
                     * @param {string} options.regex - Regular expression used to sanitize words before comparing them to blacklist.
                     * @param {string} options.replaceRegex - Regular expression used to replace profane words with placeHolder.
                     */
                    constructor(options={}) {
                        Object.assign(this, {
                            list: (options.emptyList && []) || Array.prototype.concat.apply(localList, [baseList, options.list || [], ]),
                            exclude: options.exclude || [],
                            placeHolder: options.placeHolder || "*",
                            regex: options.regex || /[^a-zA-Z0-9|\$|\@]|\^/g,
                            replaceRegex: options.replaceRegex || /\w/g,
                        });
                    }
                    /**
                     * Determine if a string contains profane language.
                     * @param {string} string - String to evaluate for profanity.
                     */
                    isProfane(string) {
                        return (this.list.filter((word)=>{
                            const wordExp = new RegExp(`\\b ${word.replace(/(\W)/g, "\\$1")}\\b`,"gi");
                            return (!this.exclude.includes(word.toLowerCase()) && wordExp.test(string));
                        }
                                                ).length > 0 || false);
                    }
                    /**
                     * Replace a word with placeHolder characters;
                     * @param {string} string - String to replace.
                     */
                    replaceWord(string) {
                        return string.replace(this.regex, "").replace(this.replaceRegex, this.placeHolder);
                    }
                    /**
                     * Evaluate a string for profanity and return an edited version.
                     * @param {string} string - Sentence to filter.
                     */
                    clean(string) {
                        return string.split(/\b/).map((word)=>{
                            return this.isProfane(word) ? this.replaceWord(word) : word;
                        }
                                                     ).join("");
                    }
                    /**
                     * Add word(s) to blacklist filter / remove words from whitelist filter
                     * @param {...string} word - Word(s) to add to blacklist
                     */
                    addWords() {
                        let words = Array.from(arguments);
                        this.list.push(...words);
                        words.map((word)=>word.toLowerCase()).forEach((word)=>{
                            if (this.exclude.includes(word)) {
                                this.exclude.splice(this.exclude.indexOf(word), 1);
                            }
                        }
                                                                     );
                    }
                    /**
                     * Add words to whitelist filter
                     * @param {...string} word - Word(s) to add to whitelist.
                     */
                    removeWords() {
                        this.exclude.push(...Array.from(arguments).map((word)=>word.toLowerCase()));
                    }
                }

            "./node_modules/base64-js/index.js": /*!*****************************************!*\
  !*** ./node_modules/base64-js/index.js ***!
  \*****************************************/
            /*! no static exports found */
            /***/
            function(module, exports, __webpack_require__) {
                "use strict";
                exports.byteLength = byteLength;
                exports.toByteArray = toByteArray;
                exports.fromByteArray = fromByteArray;
                var lookup = [];
                var revLookup = [];
                var Arr = typeof Uint8Array !== "undefined" ? Uint8Array : Array;
                var code = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";
                for (var i = 0, len = code.length; i < len; ++i) {
                    lookup[i] = code[i];
                    revLookup[code.charCodeAt(i)] = i;
                }
                // Support decoding URL-safe base64 strings, as Node.js does.
                // See: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Base64#URL_applications
                revLookup["-".charCodeAt(0)] = 62;
                revLookup["_".charCodeAt(0)] = 63;

                function getLens(b64) {
                    var len = b64.length;
                    if (len % 4 > 0) {
                        throw new Error("Invalid string. Length must be a multiple of 4");
                    }
                    // Trim off extra bytes after placeholder bytes are found
                    // See: https://github.com/beatgammit/base64-js/issues/42
                    var validLen = b64.indexOf("=");
                    if (validLen === -1)
                        validLen = len;
                    var placeHoldersLen = validLen === len ? 0 : 4 - (validLen % 4);
                    return [validLen, placeHoldersLen];
                }
                // base64 is 4/3 + up to two characters of the original data
                function byteLength(b64) {
                    var lens = getLens(b64);
                    var validLen = lens[0];
                    var placeHoldersLen = lens[1];
                    return ((validLen + placeHoldersLen) * 3) / 4 - placeHoldersLen;
                }

                function _byteLength(b64, validLen, placeHoldersLen) {
                    return ((validLen + placeHoldersLen) * 3) / 4 - placeHoldersLen;
                }

                function toByteArray(b64) {
                    var tmp;
                    var lens = getLens(b64);
                    var validLen = lens[0];
                    var placeHoldersLen = lens[1];
                    var arr = new Arr(_byteLength(b64, validLen, placeHoldersLen));
                    var curByte = 0;
                    // if there are placeholders, only get up to the last complete 4 chars
                    var len = placeHoldersLen > 0 ? validLen - 4 : validLen;
                    var i;
                    for (i = 0; i < len; i += 4) {
                        tmp = (revLookup[b64.charCodeAt(i)] << 18) | (revLookup[b64.charCodeAt(i + 1)] << 12) | (revLookup[b64.charCodeAt(i + 2)] << 6) | revLookup[b64.charCodeAt(i + 3)];
                        arr[curByte++] = (tmp >> 16) & 0xff;
                        arr[curByte++] = (tmp >> 8) & 0xff;
                        arr[curByte++] = tmp & 0xff;
                    }
                    if (placeHoldersLen === 2) {
                        tmp = (revLookup[b64.charCodeAt(i)] << 2) | (revLookup[b64.charCodeAt(i + 1)] >> 4);
                        arr[curByte++] = tmp & 0xff;
                    }
                    if (placeHoldersLen === 1) {
                        tmp = (revLookup[b64.charCodeAt(i)] << 10) | (revLookup[b64.charCodeAt(i + 1)] << 4) | (revLookup[b64.charCodeAt(i + 2)] >> 2);
                        arr[curByte++] = (tmp >> 8) & 0xff;
                        arr[curByte++] = tmp & 0xff;
                    }
                    return arr;
                }

                function tripletToBase64(num) {
                    return (lookup[(num >> 18) & 0x3f] + lookup[(num >> 12) & 0x3f] + lookup[(num >> 6) & 0x3f] + lookup[num & 0x3f]);
                }

                function encodeChunk(uint8, start, end) {
                    var tmp;
                    var output = [];
                    for (var i = start; i < end; i += 3) {
                        tmp = ((uint8[i] << 16) & 0xff0000) + ((uint8[i + 1] << 8) & 0xff00) + (uint8[i + 2] & 0xff);
                        output.push(tripletToBase64(tmp));
                    }
                    return output.join("");
                }

                function fromByteArray(uint8) {
                    var tmp;
                    var len = uint8.length;
                    var extraBytes = len % 3;
                    // if we have 1 byte left, pad 2 bytes
                    var parts = [];
                    var maxChunkLength = 16383;
                    // must be multiple of 3
                    // go through the array every three bytes, we'll deal with trailing stuff later
                    for (var i = 0, len2 = len - extraBytes; i < len2; i += maxChunkLength) {
                        parts.push(encodeChunk(uint8, i, i + maxChunkLength > len2 ? len2 : i + maxChunkLength));
                    }
                    // pad the end with zeros, but make sure to not forget the extra bytes
                    if (extraBytes === 1) {
                        tmp = uint8[len - 1];
                        parts.push(lookup[tmp >> 2] + lookup[(tmp << 4) & 0x3f] + "==");
                    } else if (extraBytes === 2) {
                        tmp = (uint8[len - 2] << 8) + uint8[len - 1];
                        parts.push(lookup[tmp >> 10] + lookup[(tmp >> 4) & 0x3f] + lookup[(tmp << 2) & 0x3f] + "=");
                    }
                    return parts.join("");
                }

            /*! no static exports found */
