                , portPattern = /:[0-9]*$/
                , // Special case for a simple path URL
                    simplePathPattern = /^(\/\/?(?!\/)[^\?\s]*)(\?[^\s]*)?$/
                , // RFC 2396: characters reserved for delimiting URLs.
                    // We actually just auto-escape these.
                    delims = ["<", ">", '"', "`", " ", "\r", "\n", "\t"]
                , // RFC 2396: characters not allowed for various reasons.
                    unwise = ["{", "}", "|", "\\", "^", "`"].concat(delims)
                , // Allowed by RFCs, but cause of XSS attacks.  Always escape these.
                    autoEscape = ["'"].concat(unwise)
                , // Characters that are never ever allowed in a hostname.
                    // Note that any invalid chars are also handled, but these
                    // are the ones that are *expected* to be seen, so we fast-path
                    // them.
                    nonHostChars = ["%", "/", "?", ";", "#"].concat(autoEscape)
                , hostEndingChars = ["/", "?", "#"]
                , hostnameMaxLen = 255
                , hostnamePartPattern = /^[+a-z0-9A-Z_-]{0,63}$/
                , hostnamePartStart = /^([+a-z0-9A-Z_-]{0,63})(.*)$/
                , // protocols that can allow "unsafe" and "unwise" chars.
                    unsafeProtocol = {
                        javascript: true,
                        "javascript:": true,
                    }
                , // protocols that never have a hostname.
                    hostlessProtocol = {
                        javascript: true,
                        "javascript:": true,
                    }
                , // protocols that always contain a // bit.
                    slashedProtocol = {
                        http: true,
                        https: true,
                        ftp: true,
                        gopher: true,
                        file: true,
                        "http:": true,
                        "https:": true,
                        "ftp:": true,
                        "gopher:": true,
                        "file:": true,
                    }
                , querystring = __webpack_require__(/*! querystring */
                    "./node_modules/querystring-es3/index.js");

                function urlParse(url, parseQueryString, slashesDenoteHost) {
                    if (url && util.isObject(url) && url instanceof Url)
                        return url;
                    var u = new Url();
                    u.parse(url, parseQueryString, slashesDenoteHost);
                    return u;
                }
                Url.prototype.parse = function(url, parseQueryString, slashesDenoteHost) {
                    if (!util.isString(url)) {
                        throw new TypeError("Parameter 'url' must be a string, not " + typeof url);
                    }
                    // Copy chrome, IE, opera backslash-handling behavior.
                    // Back slashes before the query string get converted to forward slashes
                    // See: https://code.google.com/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=25916
                    var queryIndex = url.indexOf("?")
                    , splitter = queryIndex !== -1 && queryIndex < url.indexOf("#") ? "?" : "#"
                    , uSplit = url.split(splitter)
                    , slashRegex = /\\/g;
                    uSplit[0] = uSplit[0].replace(slashRegex, "/");
                    url = uSplit.join(splitter);
                    var rest = url;
                    // trim before proceeding.
                    // This is to support parse stuff like "  http://foo.com  \n"
                    rest = rest.trim();
                    if (!slashesDenoteHost && url.split("#").length === 1) {
                        // Try fast path regexp
                        var simplePath = simplePathPattern.exec(rest);
                        if (simplePath) {
                            this.path = rest;
                            this.href = rest;
                            this.pathname = simplePath[1];
                            if (simplePath[2]) {
                                this.search = simplePath[2];
                                if (parseQueryString) {
                                    this.query = querystring.parse(this.search.substr(1));
                                } else {
                                    this.query = this.search.substr(1);
                                }
                            } else if (parseQueryString) {
                                this.search = "";
                                this.query = {};
                            }
                            return this;
                        }
                    }
                    var proto = protocolPattern.exec(rest);
                    if (proto) {
                        proto = proto[0];
                        var lowerProto = proto.toLowerCase();
                        this.protocol = lowerProto;
                        rest = rest.substr(proto.length);
                    }
                    // figure out if it's got a host
                    // user@server is *always* interpreted as a hostname, and url
                    // resolution will treat //foo/bar as host=foo,path=bar because that's
                    // how the browser resolves relative URLs.
                    if (slashesDenoteHost || proto || rest.match(/^\/\/[^@\/]+@[^@\/]+/)) {
                        var slashes = rest.substr(0, 2) === "//";
                        if (slashes && !(proto && hostlessProtocol[proto])) {
                            rest = rest.substr(2);
                            this.slashes = true;
                        }
                    }
                    if (!hostlessProtocol[proto] && (slashes || (proto && !slashedProtocol[proto]))) {
                        // there's a hostname.
                        // the first instance of /, ?, ;, or # ends the host.
                        //
                        // If there is an @ in the hostname, then non-host chars *are* allowed
                        // to the left of the last @ sign, unless some host-ending character
                        // comes *before* the @-sign.
                        // URLs are obnoxious.
                        //
                        // ex:
                        // http://a@b@c/ => user:a@b host:c
                        // http://a@b?@c => user:a host:c path:/?@c
                        // v0.12 TODO(isaacs): This is not quite how Chrome does things.
                        // Review our test case against browsers more comprehensively.
                        // find the first instance of any hostEndingChars
                        var hostEnd = -1;
                        for (var i = 0; i < hostEndingChars.length; i++) {
                            var hec = rest.indexOf(hostEndingChars[i]);
                            if (hec !== -1 && (hostEnd === -1 || hec < hostEnd))
                                hostEnd = hec;
                        }
                        // at this point, either we have an explicit point where the
                        // auth portion cannot go past, or the last @ char is the decider.
                        var auth, atSign;
                        if (hostEnd === -1) {
                            // atSign can be anywhere.
                            atSign = rest.lastIndexOf("@");
                        } else {
                            // atSign must be in auth portion.
                            // http://a@b/c@d => host:b auth:a path:/c@d
                            atSign = rest.lastIndexOf("@", hostEnd);
                        }
                        // Now we have a portion which is definitely the auth.
                        // Pull that off.
                        if (atSign !== -1) {
                            auth = rest.slice(0, atSign);
                            rest = rest.slice(atSign + 1);
                            this.auth = decodeURIComponent(auth);
                        }
                        // the host is the remaining to the left of the first non-host char
                        hostEnd = -1;
                        for (var i = 0; i < nonHostChars.length; i++) {
                            var hec = rest.indexOf(nonHostChars[i]);
                            if (hec !== -1 && (hostEnd === -1 || hec < hostEnd))
                                hostEnd = hec;
                        }
                        // if we still have not hit it, then the entire thing is a host.
                        if (hostEnd === -1)
                            hostEnd = rest.length;
                        this.host = rest.slice(0, hostEnd);
                        rest = rest.slice(hostEnd);
                        // pull out port.
                        this.parseHost();
                        // we've indicated that there is a hostname,
                        // so even if it's empty, it has to be present.
                        this.hostname = this.hostname || "";
                        // if hostname begins with [ and ends with ]
                        // assume that it's an IPv6 address.
                        var ipv6Hostname = this.hostname[0] === "[" && this.hostname[this.hostname.length - 1] === "]";
                        // validate a little.
                        if (!ipv6Hostname) {
                            var hostparts = this.hostname.split(/\./);
                            for (var i = 0, l = hostparts.length; i < l; i++) {
                                var part = hostparts[i];
                                if (!part)
                                    continue;
                                if (!part.match(hostnamePartPattern)) {
                                    var newpart = "";
                                    for (var j = 0, k = part.length; j < k; j++) {
                                        if (part.charCodeAt(j) > 127) {
                                            // we replace non-ASCII char with a temporary placeholder
                                            // we need this to make sure size of hostname is not
                                            // broken by replacing non-ASCII by nothing
                                            newpart += "x";
                                        } else {
                                            newpart += part[j];
                                        }
                                    }
                                    // we test again with ASCII char only
                                    if (!newpart.match(hostnamePartPattern)) {
                                        var validParts = hostparts.slice(0, i);
                                        var notHost = hostparts.slice(i + 1);
                                        var bit = part.match(hostnamePartStart);
                                        if (bit) {
                                            validParts.push(bit[1]);
                                            notHost.unshift(bit[2]);
                                        }
                                        if (notHost.length) {
                                            rest = "/" + notHost.join(".") + rest;
                                        }
                                        this.hostname = validParts.join(".");
                                        break;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (this.hostname.length > hostnameMaxLen) {
                            this.hostname = "";
                        } else {
                            // hostnames are always lower case.
                            this.hostname = this.hostname.toLowerCase();
                        }
                        if (!ipv6Hostname) {
                            // IDNA Support: Returns a punycoded representation of "domain".
                            // It only converts parts of the domain name that
                            // have non-ASCII characters, i.e. it doesn't matter if
                            // you call it with a domain that already is ASCII-only.
                            this.hostname = punycode.toASCII(this.hostname);
                        }
                        var p = this.port ? ":" + this.port : "";
                        var h = this.hostname || "";
                        this.host = h + p;
                        this.href += this.host;
                        // strip [ and ] from the hostname
                        // the host field still retains them, though
                        if (ipv6Hostname) {
                            this.hostname = this.hostname.substr(1, this.hostname.length - 2);
                            if (rest[0] !== "/") {
                                rest = "/" + rest;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    // now rest is set to the post-host stuff.
                    // chop off any delim chars.
                    if (!unsafeProtocol[lowerProto]) {
                        // First, make 100% sure that any "autoEscape" chars get
                        // escaped, even if encodeURIComponent doesn't think they
                        // need to be.
                        for (var i = 0, l = autoEscape.length; i < l; i++) {
                            var ae = autoEscape[i];
                            if (rest.indexOf(ae) === -1)
                                continue;
                            var esc = encodeURIComponent(ae);
                            if (esc === ae) {
                                esc = escape(ae);
                            }
                            rest = rest.split(ae).join(esc);
                        }
                    }
                    // chop off from the tail first.
                    var hash = rest.indexOf("#");
                    if (hash !== -1) {
                        // got a fragment string.
                        this.hash = rest.substr(hash);
                        rest = rest.slice(0, hash);
                    }
                    var qm = rest.indexOf("?");
                    if (qm !== -1) {
                        this.search = rest.substr(qm);
                        this.query = rest.substr(qm + 1);
                        if (parseQueryString) {
                            this.query = querystring.parse(this.query);
                        }
                        rest = rest.slice(0, qm);
                    } else if (parseQueryString) {
                        // no query string, but parseQueryString still requested
                        this.search = "";
                        this.query = {};
                    }
                    if (rest)
                        this.pathname = rest;
                    if (slashedProtocol[lowerProto] && this.hostname && !this.pathname) {
                        this.pathname = "/";
                    }
                    //to support http.request
                    if (this.pathname || this.search) {
                        var p = this.pathname || "";
                        var s = this.search || "";
                        this.path = p + s;
                    }
                    // finally, reconstruct the href based on what has been validated.
                    this.href = this.format();
                    return this;
                }
                ;
                // format a parsed object into a url string
                function urlFormat(obj) {
                    // ensure it's an object, and not a string url.
                    // If it's an obj, this is a no-op.
                    // this way, you can call url_format() on strings
                    // to clean up potentially wonky urls.
                    if (util.isString(obj))
                        obj = urlParse(obj);
                    if (!(obj instanceof Url))
                        return Url.prototype.format.call(obj);
                    return obj.format();
                }
                Url.prototype.format = function() {
                    var auth = this.auth || "";
                    if (auth) {
                        auth = encodeURIComponent(auth);
                        auth = auth.replace(/%3A/i, ":");
                        auth += "@";
                    }
                    var protocol = this.protocol || ""
                    , pathname = this.pathname || ""
                    , hash = this.hash || ""
                    , host = false
                    , query = "";
                    if (this.host) {
                        host = auth + this.host;
                    } else if (this.hostname) {
                        host = auth + (this.hostname.indexOf(":") === -1 ? this.hostname : "[" + this.hostname + "]");
                        if (this.port) {
                            host += ":" + this.port;
                        }
                    }
                    if (this.query && util.isObject(this.query) && Object.keys(this.query).length) {
                        query = querystring.stringify(this.query);
                    }
                    var search = this.search || (query && "?" + query) || "";
                    if (protocol && protocol.substr(-1) !== ":")
                        protocol += ":";
                    // only the slashedProtocols get the //.  Not mailto:, xmpp:, etc.
                    // unless they had them to begin with.
                    if (this.slashes || ((!protocol || slashedProtocol[protocol]) && host !== false)) {
                        host = "//" + (host || "");
                        if (pathname && pathname.charAt(0) !== "/")
                            pathname = "/" + pathname;
                    } else if (!host) {
                        host = "";
                    }
                    if (hash && hash.charAt(0) !== "#")
                        hash = "#" + hash;
                    if (search && search.charAt(0) !== "?")
                        search = "?" + search;
                    pathname = pathname.replace(/[?#]/g, function(match) {
                        return encodeURIComponent(match);
                    });
                    search = search.replace("#", "%23");
                    return protocol + host + pathname + search + hash;
                }
                ;

                function urlResolve(source, relative) {
                    return urlParse(source, false, true).resolve(relative);
                }
                Url.prototype.resolve = function(relative) {
                    return this.resolveObject(urlParse(relative, false, true)).format();
                }
                ;

                function urlResolveObject(source, relative) {
                    if (!source)
                        return relative;
                    return urlParse(source, false, true).resolveObject(relative);
                }
                Url.prototype.resolveObject = function(relative) {
                    if (util.isString(relative)) {
                        var rel = new Url();
                        rel.parse(relative, false, true);
                        relative = rel;
                    }
                    var result = new Url();
                    var tkeys = Object.keys(this);
                    for (var tk = 0; tk < tkeys.length; tk++) {
                        var tkey = tkeys[tk];
                        result[tkey] = this[tkey];
                    }
                    // hash is always overridden, no matter what.
                    // even href="" will remove it.
                    result.hash = relative.hash;
                    // if the relative url is empty, then there's nothing left to do here.
                    if (relative.href === "") {
                        result.href = result.format();
                        return result;
                    }
                    // hrefs like //foo/bar always cut to the protocol.
                    if (relative.slashes && !relative.protocol) {
                        // take everything except the protocol from relative
                        var rkeys = Object.keys(relative);
                        for (var rk = 0; rk < rkeys.length; rk++) {
                            var rkey = rkeys[rk];
                            if (rkey !== "protocol")
                                result[rkey] = relative[rkey];
                        }
                        //urlParse appends trailing / to urls like http://www.example.com
                        if (slashedProtocol[result.protocol] && result.hostname && !result.pathname) {
                            result.path = result.pathname = "/";
                        }
                        result.href = result.format();
                        return result;
                    }
                    if (relative.protocol && relative.protocol !== result.protocol) {
                        // if it's a known url protocol, then changing
                        // the protocol does weird things
                        // first, if it's not file:, then we MUST have a host,
                        // and if there was a path
                        // to begin with, then we MUST have a path.
                        // if it is file:, then the host is dropped,
                        // because that's known to be hostless.
                        // anything else is assumed to be absolute.
                        if (!slashedProtocol[relative.protocol]) {
                            var keys = Object.keys(relative);
                            for (var v = 0; v < keys.length; v++) {
                                var k = keys[v];
                                result[k] = relative[k];
                            }
                            result.href = result.format();
                            return result;
                        }
                        result.protocol = relative.protocol;
                        if (!relative.host && !hostlessProtocol[relative.protocol]) {
                            var relPath = (relative.pathname || "").split("/");
                            while (relPath.length && !(relative.host = relPath.shift()))
                                ;
                            if (!relative.host)
                                relative.host = "";
                            if (!relative.hostname)
                                relative.hostname = "";
                            if (relPath[0] !== "")
                                relPath.unshift("");
                            if (relPath.length < 2)
                                relPath.unshift("");
                            result.pathname = relPath.join("/");
                        } else {
                            result.pathname = relative.pathname;
                        }
                        result.search = relative.search;
                        result.query = relative.query;
                        result.host = relative.host || "";
                        result.auth = relative.auth;
                        result.hostname = relative.hostname || relative.host;
                        result.port = relative.port;
                        // to support http.request
                        if (result.pathname || result.search) {
                            var p = result.pathname || "";
                            var s = result.search || "";
                            result.path = p + s;
                        }
                        result.slashes = result.slashes || relative.slashes;
                        result.href = result.format();
                        return result;
                    }
                    var isSourceAbs = result.pathname && result.pathname.charAt(0) === "/"
                    , isRelAbs = relative.host || (relative.pathname && relative.pathname.charAt(0) === "/")
                    , mustEndAbs = isRelAbs || isSourceAbs || (result.host && relative.pathname)
                    , removeAllDots = mustEndAbs
                    , srcPath = (result.pathname && result.pathname.split("/")) || []
                    , relPath = (relative.pathname && relative.pathname.split("/")) || []
                    , psychotic = result.protocol && !slashedProtocol[result.protocol];
                    // if the url is a non-slashed url, then relative
                    // links like ../.. should be able
                    // to crawl up to the hostname, as well.  This is strange.
                    // result.protocol has already been set by now.
                    // Later on, put the first path part into the host field.
                    if (psychotic) {
                        result.hostname = "";
                        result.port = null;
                        if (result.host) {
                            if (srcPath[0] === "")
                                srcPath[0] = result.host;
                            else
                                srcPath.unshift(result.host);
                        }
                        result.host = "";
                        if (relative.protocol) {
                            relative.hostname = null;
                            relative.port = null;
                            if (relative.host) {
                                if (relPath[0] === "")
                                    relPath[0] = relative.host;
                                else
                                    relPath.unshift(relative.host);
                            }
                            relative.host = null;
                        }
                        mustEndAbs = mustEndAbs && (relPath[0] === "" || srcPath[0] === "");
                    }
                    if (isRelAbs) {
                        // it's absolute.
                        result.host = relative.host || relative.host === "" ? relative.host : result.host;
                        result.hostname = relative.hostname || relative.hostname === "" ? relative.hostname : result.hostname;
                        result.search = relative.search;
                        result.query = relative.query;
                        srcPath = relPath;
                        // fall through to the dot-handling below.
                    } else if (relPath.length) {
                        // it's relative
                        // throw away the existing file, and take the new path instead.
                        if (!srcPath)
                            srcPath = [];
                        srcPath.pop();
                        srcPath = srcPath.concat(relPath);
                        result.search = relative.search;
                        result.query = relative.query;
                    } else if (!util.isNullOrUndefined(relative.search)) {
                        // just pull out the search.
                        // like href='?foo'.
                        // Put this after the other two cases because it simplifies the booleans
                        if (psychotic) {
                            result.hostname = result.host = srcPath.shift();
                            //occationaly the auth can get stuck only in host
                            //this especially happens in cases like
                            //url.resolveObject('mailto:local1@domain1', 'local2@domain2')
                            var authInHost = result.host && result.host.indexOf("@") > 0 ? result.host.split("@") : false;
                            if (authInHost) {
                                result.auth = authInHost.shift();
                                result.host = result.hostname = authInHost.shift();
                            }
                        }
                        result.search = relative.search;
                        result.query = relative.query;
                        //to support http.request
                        if (!util.isNull(result.pathname) || !util.isNull(result.search)) {
                            result.path = (result.pathname ? result.pathname : "") + (result.search ? result.search : "");
                        }
                        result.href = result.format();
                        return result;
                    }
                    if (!srcPath.length) {
                        // no path at all.  easy.
                        // we've already handled the other stuff above.
                        result.pathname = null;
                        //to support http.request
                        if (result.search) {
                            result.path = "/" + result.search;
                        } else {
                            result.path = null;
                        }
                        result.href = result.format();
                        return result;
                    }
                    // if a url ENDs in . or .., then it must get a trailing slash.
                    // however, if it ends in anything else non-slashy,
                    // then it must NOT get a trailing slash.
                    var last = srcPath.slice(-1)[0];
                    var hasTrailingSlash = ((result.host || relative.host || srcPath.length > 1) && (last === "." || last === "..")) || last === "";
                    // strip single dots, resolve double dots to parent dir
                    // if the path tries to go above the root, `up` ends up > 0
                    var up = 0;
                    for (var i = srcPath.length; i >= 0; i--) {
                        last = srcPath[i];
                        if (last === ".") {
                            srcPath.splice(i, 1);
                        } else if (last === "..") {
                            srcPath.splice(i, 1);
                            up++;
                        } else if (up) {
                            srcPath.splice(i, 1);
                            up--;
                        }
                    }
                    // if the path is allowed to go above the root, restore leading ..s
                    if (!mustEndAbs && !removeAllDots) {
                        for (; up--; up) {
                            srcPath.unshift("..");
                        }
                    }
                    if (mustEndAbs && srcPath[0] !== "" && (!srcPath[0] || srcPath[0].charAt(0) !== "/")) {
                        srcPath.unshift("");
                    }
                    if (hasTrailingSlash && srcPath.join("/").substr(-1) !== "/") {
                        srcPath.push("");
                    }
                    var isAbsolute = srcPath[0] === "" || (srcPath[0] && srcPath[0].charAt(0) === "/");
                    // put the host back
                    if (psychotic) {
                        result.hostname = result.host = isAbsolute ? "" : srcPath.length ? srcPath.shift() : "";
                        //occationaly the auth can get stuck only in host
                        //this especially happens in cases like
                        //url.resolveObject('mailto:local1@domain1', 'local2@domain2')
                        var authInHost = result.host && result.host.indexOf("@") > 0 ? result.host.split("@") : false;
                        if (authInHost) {
                            result.auth = authInHost.shift();
                            result.host = result.hostname = authInHost.shift();
                        }
                    }
                    mustEndAbs = mustEndAbs || (result.host && srcPath.length);
                    if (mustEndAbs && !isAbsolute) {
                        srcPath.unshift("");
                    }
                    if (!srcPath.length) {
                        result.pathname = null;
                        result.path = null;
                    } else {
                        result.pathname = srcPath.join("/");
                    }
                    //to support request.http
                    if (!util.isNull(result.pathname) || !util.isNull(result.search)) {
                        result.path = (result.pathname ? result.pathname : "") + (result.search ? result.search : "");
                    }
                    result.auth = relative.auth || result.auth;
                    result.slashes = result.slashes || relative.slashes;
                    result.href = result.format();
                    return result;
                }
                ;
                Url.prototype.parseHost = function() {
                    var host = this.host;
                    var port = portPattern.exec(host);
                    if (port) {
                        port = port[0];
                        if (port !== ":") {
                            this.port = port.substr(1);
                        }
                        host = host.substr(0, host.length - port.length);
                    }
                    if (host)
                        this.hostname = host;
                }
                ;

            },

                    isObject: function(arg) {
                        return typeof arg === "object" && arg !== null;
                    },
                    isNull: function(arg) {

            function(module, exports) {
                var g;
                // This works in non-strict mode
                g = (function() {
                    return this;
                }
                    )();
                try {
                    // This works if eval is allowed (see CSP)
                    g = g || new Function("return this")();
                } catch (e) {
                    // This works if the window reference is available
                    if (typeof window === "object")
                        g = window;
                }
                // g can still be undefined, but nothing to do about it...
                // We return undefined, instead of nothing here, so it's
                // easier to handle this case. if(!global) { ...}
                module.exports = g;

            "./node_modules/webpack/buildin/module.js": /*!***********************************!*\

                            try {

                                            near2.inTrap = false;

                                                this.testCanPlace(2, 0, angle + vulnerableAngle, Math.PI / 24, near.aim2, 0, { inTrap: near2.inTrap });

                                                }

                                        }
                                    } else {

                                            if (player.items[4] == 15) {
                                                this.testCanPlace(4, 0, angle + vulnerableAngle, Math.PI / 24, near.aim2);
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }

                class Objectmanager {
                    constructor(GameObject, gameObjects, UTILS, config, players, server) {
                        let mathFloor = Math.floor,
                            mathABS = Math.abs,
                            mathCOS = Math.cos,
                            mathSIN = Math.sin,
                            mathPOW = Math.pow,
                            mathSQRT = Math.sqrt;

                        this.ignoreAdd = false;
                        this.hitObj = [];

                        // DISABLE OBJ:
                        this.disableObj = function (obj) {
                            if (!obj || typeof obj !== "object") return;
                            // Some protocol paths call disableObj directly rather than
                            // disableBySid. Intercept those too so Destroy-anim is not
                            // bypassed by a direct removal.
                            if (getCheck("dst") && obj.startDestroyAnimation && !obj.isDestroying) {
                                obj.startDestroyAnimation(this, obj.sid);
                                return;
                            }
                            obj.active = false;
                            if (config.anotherVisual) { } else {
                                obj.alive = false;
                            }
                        };

                        // ADD NEW:
                        let tmpObj;
                        this.add = function (sid, x, y, dir, s, type, data, setSID, owner) {
                            tmpObj = findObjectBySid(sid);
                            if (!tmpObj) {
                                tmpObj = gameObjects.find((tmp) => !tmp.active);
                                if (!tmpObj) {
                                    tmpObj = new GameObject(sid);
                                    gameObjects.push(tmpObj);
                                }
                            }
                            if (setSID) {
                                tmpObj.sid = sid;
                            }
                            tmpObj.init(x, y, dir, s, type, data, owner);
                        };

                        // DISABLE BY SID:
                        this.disableBySid = function (sid) {
                            const find = findObjectBySid(sid);
                            if (!find) return;
                            // This is the actual server-side object-removal path.
                            // Start a fade once, then the object's own destroy callback
                            // re-enters here and performs the final disable.
                            if (getCheck("dst") && find.startDestroyAnimation && !find.isDestroying) {
                                find.startDestroyAnimation(this, sid);
                                return;
                            }
                            this.disableObj(find);
                        };

                        // REMOVE ALL FROM PLAYER:
                        this.removeAllItems = function (sid, server) {
                            gameObjects.filter((tmp) => tmp.active && tmp.owner && tmp.owner.sid == sid).forEach((tmp) => this.disableObj(tmp));
                        };

                        // CHECK IF PLACABLE:
                        this.checkItemLocation = function (x, y, s, sM, indx, ignoreWater, placer) {
                            let cantPlace = gameObjects.find((tmp) => tmp.active && UTILS.getDistance(x, y, tmp.x, tmp.y) < s + (tmp.blocker ? tmp.blocker : tmp.getScale(sM, tmp.isItem)));
                            if (cantPlace) return false;
                            if (!ignoreWater && indx != 18 && y >= config.mapScale / 2 - config.riverWidth / 2 && y <= config.mapScale / 2 + config.riverWidth / 2) return false;
                            return true;
                        };

                    }

                // URL PARAMS:
                function getParameterByName(name, url) {
                    if (!url) {
                        url = window.location.href;
                    }
                    name = name.replace(/[\[\]]/g, "\\$&");
                    var regex = new RegExp("[?&]" + name + "(=([^&#]*)|&|#|$)")
                    , results = regex.exec(url);
                    if (!results)
                        return null;
                    if (!results[2])
                        return "";
                    return decodeURIComponent(results[2].replace(/\+/g, " "));
                }

                // SOCKET & CONNECTION:
                var connected = false;
                var startedConnecting = false;
                function connectSocketIfReady() {
                    // MAKE SURE IT'S READY:
                    if (!didLoad || !captchaReady) return;
                    startedConnecting = true;
                    // Token is now obtained by the unpatcher (Cloudflare Turnstile via token=alt),
                    // so we skip grecaptcha (which isn't loaded anyway) and connect directly.
                    connectSocket(null);
                }

                function connectSocket(token) {
                    window.__valLog && window.__valLog("connectSocket() called");
                    // Use the WS address cached by the bootstrap interceptor
                    // (the real game's address, discovered automatically on first load).
                    // "token=alt" tells the unpatcher to fetch a Cloudflare Turnstile
                    // token and decrypt the encrypted websocket protocol.
                    const TOKEN_KEY_L = "value_ws_token_v1";
                    const FAIL_KEY = "value_4001_count";
                    // 4001 = "Invalid Connection": the token was rejected. Tokens are
                    // single-use, so re-trying the same one never works. Drop the stale
                    // token and reload into intercept mode to steal a FRESH one from the
                    // real game's onGotTurnstileToken callback.
                    function freshTokenCycle() {
                        let n = 0;
                        try { n = parseInt(localStorage.getItem(FAIL_KEY) || "0") + 1; } catch (e) { n = 1; }
                        if (n >= 25) {
                            window.__valLog && window.__valLog("STOP: 25 failed 4001 cycles. Not reloading. Refresh manually to try again.");
                            return;
                        }
                        try { localStorage.setItem(FAIL_KEY, String(n)); } catch (e) { }
                        let wait = 3;
                        window.__valLog && window.__valLog("4001 #" + n + "/25 — re-stealing a FRESH token in " + wait + "s...");
                        let left = wait;
                        const tick = setInterval(() => {
                            left--;
                            if (window.__valBox && left > 0) {
                                window.__valBox.textContent = (window.__valLogs.join("\n") + "\n\n>>> re-stealing fresh token in " + left + "s <<<");
                            }
                            if (left <= 0) {
                                clearInterval(tick);
                                try { localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY_L); localStorage.removeItem("value_ws_token_ts"); } catch (e) { }
                                window.location.reload();
                            }
                        }, 1000);
                    }
                    function dropCacheAndReload() {
                        window.__valLog && window.__valLog("dropCacheAndReload() — clearing token, reloading to re-intercept");
                        try { localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY_L); localStorage.removeItem("value_ws_token_ts"); localStorage.removeItem(FAIL_KEY); } catch (e) { }
                        setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 1200);
                    }
                    function ensureTurnstile(cb) {
                        // If we stole a REAL token from the genuine game in Phase 1, hijack
                        // turnstile.render so the unpatcher's useTurnstile() uses OUR token
                        // instead of minting a new (often server-rejected) one. This keeps
                        // the unpatcher's decryption path active (token=alt branch) while
                        // sending a token that actually passes server-side verification.
                        if (window.__valueToken) {
                            window.__valLog && window.__valLog("Hijacking turnstile.render -> using STOLEN real token");
                            window.turnstile = window.turnstile || {};
                            window.turnstile.render = function (elem, opts) {
                                try {
                                    if (opts && typeof opts.callback === "function") opts.callback(window.__valueToken);
                                } catch (e) { }
                                return "value-stolen-token-widget";
                            };
                            cb();
                            return;
                        }
                        // No stolen token — fall back to minting one (less reliable).
                        if (window.turnstile) { window.__valLog && window.__valLog("Turnstile already loaded (no stolen token, will mint)"); return cb(); }
                        window.__valLog && window.__valLog("Loading Turnstile script...");
                        var s = document.createElement("script");
                        s.src = "https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js";
                        s.onload = function () { window.__valLog && window.__valLog("Turnstile script loaded"); cb(); };
                        s.onerror = function () { window.__valLog && window.__valLog("Turnstile script FAILED to load"); cb(); };
                        (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(s);
                    }
                    function doConnect() {
                        if (!window.__valueToken) {
                            window.__valLog && window.__valLog("ERROR: no stolen token — back to intercept");
                            freshTokenCycle();
                            return;
                        }

                        function connectToServer(wsAddress) {
                            window.__valLog && window.__valLog("Connecting to: " + wsAddress);
                            io.connect(wsAddress, function(error) {
                                if (error) {
                                    disconnect(error);
                                    window.__valLog && window.__valLog("Connection error: " + error);
                                    if (error === "Invalid Connection") {
                                        freshTokenCycle();
                                    } else {
                                        dropCacheAndReload();
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    try { localStorage.removeItem(FAIL_KEY); } catch (e) { }
                                    connected = true;
                                    window.__valLog && window.__valLog("CONNECTED! starting game...");
                                    startGame();
                                    pingSocket();
                                    setInterval(() => pingSocket(), 2500);
                                    console.log(" [ Start game. Connected Ws ] ")
                                }
                            }, {
                                A: setInitData,
                                B: disconnect,
                                C: setupGame,
                                D: addPlayer,
                                E: removePlayer,
                                a: updatePlayers,
                                G: updateLeaderboard,
                                H: loadGameObject,
                                I: loadAI,
                                J: animateAI,
                                K: gatherAnimation,
                                L: wiggleGameObject,
                                M: shootTurret,
                                N: updatePlayerValue,
                                O: updateHealth,
                                P: killPlayer,
                                Q: killObject,
                                R: killObjects,
                                S: updateItemCounts,
                                T: updateAge,
                                U: updateUpgrades,
                                V: updateItems,
                                X: addProjectile,
                                Y: remProjectile,
                                Z: serverShutdownNotice,
                                g: addAlliance,
                                "1": deleteAlliance,
                                "2": allianceNotification,
                                "3": setPlayerTeam,
                                "4": setAlliancePlayers,
                                "5": updateStoreItems,
                                "6": receiveChat,
                                "7": updateMinimap,
                                "8": showText,
                                "9": pingMap,
                                "0": pingSocketResponse,
                            });
                        }

                        // Use correct API endpoint based on hostname (sandbox vs regular)
                        var apiBase = "sandbox.moomoo.io" === window.location.hostname
                        ? "https://api-sandbox.moomoo.io"
                        : "https://api.moomoo.io";
                        window.__valLog && window.__valLog("Fetching server list from " + apiBase + "/servers...");
                        fetch(apiBase + "/servers?v=1.27").then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (servers) {
                            window.__valLog && window.__valLog("Got " + (servers && servers.length) + " servers");
                            var chosen = null;
                            try {
                                var a = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("server");
                                if (a) {
                                    var parts = a.split(":");
                                    chosen = servers.find(function (s) { return s.region === parts[0] && s.name === parts[1]; });
                                }
                            } catch (e) { }
                            if (!chosen) chosen = servers.find(function (s) { return s.playerCount < s.playerCapacity; }) || servers[0];
                            if (!chosen) {
                                window.__valLog && window.__valLog("No servers found in API response");
                                freshTokenCycle();
                                return;
                            }
                            var addr = "wss://" + chosen.key + "." + chosen.region + ".moomoo.io";
                            if (chosen.port && chosen.port !== 443) addr += ":" + chosen.port;
                            var wsAddress = addr + "?token=cf:" + encodeURIComponent(window.__valueToken);
                            window.__valLog && window.__valLog("Server: " + chosen.region + ":" + chosen.name + " " + chosen.playerCount + "/" + chosen.playerCapacity);
                            connectToServer(wsAddress);
                        }).catch(function (e) {
                            window.__valLog && window.__valLog("servers fetch failed: " + e + " — back to intercept");
                            freshTokenCycle();
                        });
                    }
                    doConnect();
                }

                // MATHS:
                var mathPI = Math.PI;
                var mathPI2 = mathPI * 2;
                var mathPI3 = mathPI * 3;
                Math.lerpAngle = function(value1, value2, amount) {
                    var difference = Math.abs(value2 - value1);
                    if (difference > mathPI) {
                        if (value1 > value2) {
                            value2 += mathPI2;
                        } else {
                            value1 += mathPI2;
                        }
                    }
                    var value = value2 + (value1 - value2) * amount;
                    if (value >= 0 && value <= mathPI2)
                        return value;
                    return value % mathPI2;
                }

                // REOUNDED RECTANGLE:
                CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.roundRect = function(x, y, w, h, r) {
                    if (w < 2 * r)
                        r = w / 2;
                    if (h < 2 * r)
                        r = h / 2;
                    if (r < 0)
                        r = 0;
                    this.beginPath();
                    this.moveTo(x + r, y);
                    this.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
                    this.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
                    this.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
                    this.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
                    this.closePath();
                    return this;
                }

                let enemyPreviewTheme = "";
                function syncEnemyPreviewTheme() {
                    let theme = "neutral";
                    try { theme = localStorage.getItem("value_menu_theme") || "neutral"; } catch (_) { }
                    if (!enemyPreviewThemes[theme]) theme = "neutral";
                    if (theme === enemyPreviewTheme) return;
                    enemyPreviewTheme = theme;
                    const palette = enemyPreviewThemes[theme];
                    enemyPreviewPanel.style.setProperty("--value-panel-accent", palette[0]);
                    enemyPreviewPanel.style.setProperty("--value-panel-strong", palette[1]);
                    enemyPreviewPanel.style.setProperty("--value-panel-rgb", palette[2]);

                const ENEMY_PREVIEW_RADIUS = 1400;
                function targetCandidates() {
                    return players.filter(function (candidate) {
                        return candidate && candidate !== player && candidate.alive && candidate.visible && Number(candidate.health) > 0 &&
                            !(candidate.team && player && candidate.team === player.team) &&
                            Math.hypot(candidate.x - player.x, candidate.y - player.y) <= ENEMY_PREVIEW_RADIUS;
                    });
                }
                function paintTargetAvatar(canvas, target) {
                    const c = canvas.getContext("2d"); c.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                    c.save(); c.translate(canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 6); c.scale(.52, .52);
                    c.rotate((target.dir || 0) + (target.dirPlus || 0));
                    c.globalAlpha = 1; c.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over"; c.filter = "none";
                    c.lineWidth = outlineWidth; c.lineJoin = "miter"; c.strokeStyle = darkOutlineColor; c.fillStyle = "#ddd";
                    try { renderPlayer(target, c); } catch (_) { }
                    c.restore();
                }
                function renderTargetPopover() {
                    if (!player) return;
                    const candidates = targetCandidates();
                    enemyPreviewTargetPopover.textContent = "";
                    const add = function (target, auto) {
                        const button = document.createElement("button"); button.type = "button";
                        button.className = "value-target-option" + (auto ? " auto" : "") + ((auto ? enemyPreviewTargetSid === "auto" : enemyPreviewTargetSid === String(target.sid)) ? " selected" : "");
                        if (auto) { button.innerHTML = "<span>◎&nbsp; AUTO / NEAREST</span>"; }
                        else { const canvas = document.createElement("canvas"); canvas.width = canvas.height = 128; button.appendChild(canvas); paintTargetAvatar(canvas, target); const name = document.createElement("span"); name.textContent = target.name || "Unknown"; button.appendChild(name); }
                        button.addEventListener("click", function (event) { event.stopPropagation(); enemyPreviewTargetSid = auto ? "auto" : String(target.sid); enemyPreviewTargetTrigger.title = auto ? "Target: Auto" : "Target: " + (target.name || "Unknown"); enemyPreviewTargetPopover.classList.remove("open"); enemyPreviewTargetTrigger.classList.remove("active"); });
                        enemyPreviewTargetPopover.appendChild(button);
                    };
                    add(null, true); candidates.forEach(function (candidate) { add(candidate, false); });
                    if (!candidates.length) { const empty = document.createElement("div"); empty.style.cssText = "padding:9px;color:rgba(232,224,233,.48);font:10px Inter,Arial;text-align:center"; empty.textContent = "No enemies nearby"; enemyPreviewTargetPopover.appendChild(empty); }
                }
                // Pointer-down is used as well as click: some MooMoo builds swallow
                // click events after canvas mouse handlers, while pointer events still
                // reach this overlay button.
                enemyPreviewTargetTrigger.style.pointerEvents = "auto";
                let lastTargetPointerToggle = 0;
                function toggleEnemyTargetPopover(event) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    event.stopPropagation();

                let enemyPreviewArchiveKey = "";
                function renderEnemyPreviewArchive() {
                    enemyPreviewArchive.textContent = "";

                    const messages = subject && subject.__valueChatArchive ? subject.__valueChatArchive.slice().reverse() : [];

                });

                let __valueEnemyPreviewLastFrame = 0;
                function updateEnemyPreview() {
                    requestAnimationFrame(updateEnemyPreview);
                    const __epNow = Date.now();
                    if (__epNow - __valueEnemyPreviewLastFrame < 100) return;
                    __valueEnemyPreviewLastFrame = __epNow;
                    syncEnemyPreviewTheme();
                    if (!window.ValueEnemyPreview || (window.ValueMenu && window.ValueMenu.isOpen) || !player || !player.alive || !player.visible || Number(player.health) <= 0) {
                        enemyPreviewPanel.style.display = "none";
                        enemyPreviewTargetTrigger.style.display = "none";
                        enemyPreviewTargetPopover.classList.remove("open");
                        return;
                    }
                    enemyPreviewTargetTrigger.style.display = "block";
                    // Minimap is the stable anchor across visual layouts.
                    const map = getEl("mapDisplay");
                    const mapRect = map && map.getBoundingClientRect();
                    const hasMapAnchor = !!(mapRect && mapRect.width && mapRect.height);
                    if (hasMapAnchor) {
                        // Target tab stays vertically centred on the minimap. It uses
                        // the inner edge: map left -> tab right; map right -> tab left.
                        const mapOnRight = mapRect.left + mapRect.width / 2 > window.innerWidth / 2;
                        const buttonSize = 26, gap = 8;
                        const buttonLeft = mapOnRight ? mapRect.left - buttonSize - gap : mapRect.right + gap;
                        const popoverLeft = mapOnRight ? buttonLeft - 234 - gap : buttonLeft + buttonSize + gap;
                        const buttonTop = Math.max(8, Math.min(window.innerHeight - buttonSize - 8, mapRect.top + mapRect.height / 2 - buttonSize / 2));
                        const popoverTop = Math.max(8, Math.min(window.innerHeight - 278, buttonTop - 8));
                        enemyPreviewTargetTrigger.style.display = "block";
                        enemyPreviewTargetTrigger.style.left = buttonLeft + "px";
                        enemyPreviewTargetTrigger.style.top = buttonTop + "px";
                        enemyPreviewTargetPopover.style.left = Math.max(8, Math.min(window.innerWidth - 242, popoverLeft)) + "px";
                        enemyPreviewTargetPopover.style.top = popoverTop + "px";
                    } else {
                        enemyPreviewTargetTrigger.style.display = "none";
                        enemyPreviewTargetPopover.classList.remove("open");
                    }
                    // Preview card sits directly above minimap, with a gap so it
                    // never overlaps the gold/resource HUD below it.
                    const rect = hasMapAnchor ? mapRect : (leaderboard && leaderboard.getBoundingClientRect());
                    const panelWidth = 234;
                    enemyPreviewPanel.style.display = "block";
                    if (rect && rect.width && rect.height) {
                        const panelLeft = rect.left + rect.width / 2 - panelWidth / 2;
                        enemyPreviewPanel.style.left = Math.max(8, Math.min(window.innerWidth - panelWidth - 8, panelLeft)) + "px";
                        enemyPreviewPanel.style.top = Math.max(8, rect.top - enemyPreviewPanel.offsetHeight - 70) + "px";
                    } else {
                        enemyPreviewPanel.style.left = "16px";
                        enemyPreviewPanel.style.top = "16px";
                    }
                    // Target button belongs at the middle of the panel edge, not at
                    // an independently calculated minimap coordinate.
                    const panelRect = enemyPreviewPanel.getBoundingClientRect();
                    // Mirror the measured card width, not a duplicated CSS constant.
                    // This remains pixel-identical if panel padding/width changes later.
                    enemyPreviewTargetPopover.style.width = Math.round(panelRect.width) + "px";
                    enemyPreviewTargetPopover.style.height = Math.round(panelRect.height) + "px";
                    enemyPreviewTargetPopover.style.maxHeight = Math.round(panelRect.height) + "px";
                    enemyPreviewTargetPopover.style.boxSizing = "border-box";
                    const panelOnRight = panelRect.left + panelRect.width / 2 > window.innerWidth / 2;
                    const targetButtonSize = 26, targetGap = 8;
                    const targetLeft = panelOnRight ? panelRect.left - targetButtonSize / 2 : panelRect.right - targetButtonSize / 2;
                    const targetTop = panelRect.top + panelRect.height / 2 - targetButtonSize / 2;
                    const targetPopoverLeft = panelOnRight ? targetLeft - 234 - targetGap : targetLeft + targetButtonSize + targetGap;
                    enemyPreviewTargetTrigger.style.left = Math.max(4, Math.min(window.innerWidth - targetButtonSize - 4, targetLeft)) + "px";
                    enemyPreviewTargetTrigger.style.top = Math.max(4, Math.min(window.innerHeight - targetButtonSize - 4, targetTop)) + "px";
                    enemyPreviewTargetPopover.style.left = Math.max(8, Math.min(window.innerWidth - 242, targetPopoverLeft)) + "px";
                    enemyPreviewTargetPopover.style.top = Math.max(8, Math.min(window.innerHeight - 278, targetTop - 8)) + "px";
                    // `enemy` and `near` are rebuilt from the latest server player
                    // update. Unlike a raw scan of players, they immediately drop a
                    // dead, teleported, invisible or out-of-range target.
                    const autoTarget = enemy.length && near && near.alive && near.visible && Number(near.health) > 0 && near.dist2 <= ENEMY_PREVIEW_RADIUS ? near : null;
                    const selected = enemyPreviewTargetSid === "auto" ? null : targetCandidates().find(function (candidate) { return String(candidate.sid) === enemyPreviewTargetSid; });
                    // A selected target deliberately becomes unavailable (rather than
                    // silently switching) when dead, far away, or no longer an enemy.
                    const resolvedTarget = enemyPreviewTargetSid === "auto" ? autoTarget : (selected || null);
                    // TEST MODE: preview the local player. Restore `resolvedTarget || null`
                    // here after validating the map/object renderer.
                    const nearest = resolvedTarget || null;
                    const nearestDistance = nearest ? Math.hypot(nearest.x - player.x, nearest.y - player.y) : Infinity;
                    const targetChanged = enemyPreviewState.target !== nearest;
                    if (targetChanged) enemyPreviewArchive.classList.remove("open");
                    const ctx = enemyPreviewContext;
                    const virtualSceneScale = .48;
                    const sceneCenterX = enemyPreviewCanvas.width / 2, sceneCenterY = enemyPreviewCanvas.height / 2 + 13;
                    const sceneWorldY = nearest ? nearest.y : config.mapScale / 2;
                    const sceneToY = function (worldY) { return sceneCenterY + (worldY - sceneWorldY) * virtualSceneScale; };
                    const mode = getEl("combat").value;
                    let previewColors = null;
                    try {
                        if ((mode === "me" || mode === "fz" || mode === "Jet") && dayCycle) previewColors = nightColors;
                        else if ((mode === "dev" || mode === "fr") && dayCycles) previewColors = nightColors;
                        else previewColors = dayColors;
                    } catch (_) { }
                    previewColors = previewColors || { grass: "#a5c65b", desert: "#dbc666", snow: "#e8edf3", river: "#74a7c8" };
                    // This is the panel's permanent virtual camera.  It never reads
                    // pixels from the main game canvas, so it works at every distance.
                    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, enemyPreviewCanvas.width, enemyPreviewCanvas.height);
                    ctx.fillStyle = previewColors.grass || "#a5c65b";
                    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, enemyPreviewCanvas.width, enemyPreviewCanvas.height);
                    const snowLine = sceneToY(config.snowBiomeTop);
                    const desertLine = sceneToY(config.mapScale - config.snowBiomeTop);
                    if (snowLine > 0) { ctx.fillStyle = previewColors.snow || "#e8edf3"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, enemyPreviewCanvas.width, Math.min(enemyPreviewCanvas.height, snowLine)); }
                    if (desertLine < enemyPreviewCanvas.height) { ctx.fillStyle = previewColors.desert || "#dbc666"; ctx.fillRect(0, Math.max(0, desertLine), enemyPreviewCanvas.width, enemyPreviewCanvas.height - Math.max(0, desertLine)); }
                    const riverTop = sceneToY(config.mapScale / 2 - config.riverWidth / 2);
                    const riverBottom = sceneToY(config.mapScale / 2 + config.riverWidth / 2);
                    const riverPadding = Math.max(0, Number(config.riverPadding) || 0) * virtualSceneScale;
                    ctx.fillStyle = previewColors.desert || "#dbc666";
                    ctx.fillRect(0, riverTop - riverPadding, enemyPreviewCanvas.width, riverBottom - riverTop + riverPadding * 2);
                    ctx.fillStyle = previewColors.river || "#74a7c8";
                    ctx.fillRect(0, riverTop, enemyPreviewCanvas.width, riverBottom - riverTop);
                    const noGrid = ["cele", "zeph", "sal", "chick", "gt86", "blism", "fr", "chick1", "ar", "s0", "s1", "s2", "ueh1"].indexOf(mode) >= 0;
                    if (!noGrid) {
                        const worldGridSize = mode === "me" ? 120 : mode === "black" ? 30 : mode === "devs" ? 110 : ["zyenith", "TesterMode", "Totalew", "Pixelz", "2yl", "Uncve", "hae"].indexOf(mode) >= 0 ? 1440 : 60;
                        const gridSize = Math.max(6, worldGridSize * virtualSceneScale);
                        const gridStart = function (center, world) { return ((center - world * virtualSceneScale) % gridSize + gridSize) % gridSize - gridSize; };
                        ctx.save();
                        ctx.globalAlpha = mode === "me" ? .05 : .06;
                        ctx.strokeStyle = "#000";
                        ctx.lineWidth = mode === "me" ? 1.4 : 1.8;
                        for (let x = gridStart(sceneCenterX, nearest ? nearest.x : 0); x < enemyPreviewCanvas.width + gridSize; x += gridSize) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, 0); ctx.lineTo(x, enemyPreviewCanvas.height); ctx.stroke(); }
                        for (let y = gridStart(sceneCenterY, sceneWorldY); y < enemyPreviewCanvas.height + gridSize; y += gridSize) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(enemyPreviewCanvas.width, y); ctx.stroke(); }
                        ctx.restore();
                    }
                    if (!nearest) {
                        enemyPreviewName.textContent = enemyPreviewTargetSid === "auto" ? "NO ENEMY" : "TARGET UNAVAILABLE";
                        enemyPreviewDistance.textContent = "--";
                        enemyPreviewHealth.style.width = "0%";
                        enemyPreviewPrimaryReload.style.width = "0%";
                        enemyPreviewSecondaryReload.style.width = "0%";
                        enemyPreviewTurretReload.style.width = "0%";
                        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.35)";
                        ctx.font = "10px Inter,Arial";
                        ctx.textAlign = "center";
                        ctx.fillText("No enemy in " + ENEMY_PREVIEW_RADIUS + "px", enemyPreviewCanvas.width / 2, 51);
                        return;
                    }
                    enemyPreviewName.textContent = nearest.name || "Unknown";
                    enemyPreviewDistance.textContent = Math.round(nearestDistance) + " px";
                    const previewHealth = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, nearest.health / nearest.maxHealth));
                    enemyPreviewHealth.style.width = (previewHealth * 100) + "%";
                    const reloadProgress = function (weaponIndex) {
                        const weapon = items.weapons[weaponIndex];
                        const reload = Number(nearest.reloads && nearest.reloads[weaponIndex]);
                        return !weapon || !Number.isFinite(reload) ? 1 : Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (weapon.speed - reload) / weapon.speed));
                    };
                    enemyPreviewPrimaryReload.style.width = (reloadProgress(nearest.primaryIndex) * 100) + "%";
                    enemyPreviewSecondaryReload.style.width = (reloadProgress(nearest.secondaryIndex) * 100) + "%";
                    const turretReload = Number(nearest.reloads && nearest.reloads[53]);
                    const turretProgress = Number.isFinite(turretReload) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (2500 - turretReload) / 2500)) : 1;
                    enemyPreviewTurretReload.style.width = (turretProgress * 100) + "%";
                    const chatText = nearest.chatCountdown > 0 && nearest.chatMessage ? String(nearest.chatMessage).slice(0, 24) : "";
                    if (chatText !== enemyPreviewState.chat) { enemyPreviewChat.style.opacity = "0"; enemyPreviewChat.style.transform = "translateY(5px)"; setTimeout(function(){ enemyPreviewChat.textContent = chatText; enemyPreviewChat.style.display = "block"; enemyPreviewChat.style.opacity = "1"; enemyPreviewChat.style.transform = "translateY(0)"; }, 140); enemyPreviewState.chat = chatText; }
                    // Reset motion when the target is replaced or teleported.
                    const previousDistance = Math.hypot(nearest.x - enemyPreviewState.x, nearest.y - enemyPreviewState.y);
                    const targetTeleported = targetChanged || nearest.forcePos || previousDistance > 420;
                    // One renderer for every distance: no screen-crop mode and no
                    // fallback mode.  The scene below is rebuilt from live world data.
                    const previewRange = Math.max(270, Math.hypot(enemyPreviewCanvas.width / 2, enemyPreviewCanvas.height / 2) / virtualSceneScale + 28);
                    gameObjects.filter(function (obj) { return obj && obj.active && Math.hypot(obj.x - nearest.x, obj.y - nearest.y) <= previewRange; }).sort(function (a, b) { return a.y - b.y; }).forEach(function (obj) {
                        const distance = Math.hypot(obj.x - nearest.x, obj.y - nearest.y);
                        const sprite = obj.isItem ? getItemSprite(obj) : getResSprite(obj);
                        if (!sprite) return;
                        // xWiggle/yWiggle are the actual gather/turret hit animation
                        // values maintained by GameObject.update in the main loop.
                        // Reusing them keeps hit recoil identical at any distance.
                        const scale = virtualSceneScale, ox = enemyPreviewCanvas.width / 2 + (obj.x + (obj.xWiggle || 0) - nearest.x) * scale, oy = enemyPreviewCanvas.height / 2 + 13 + (obj.y + (obj.yWiggle || 0) - nearest.y) * scale;
                        let objectAlpha = 1;
                        try { if (obj.isDestroying && typeof obj.getDestroyAlpha === "function") objectAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - obj.getDestroyAlpha()); } catch (_) { }
                        // Destruction is the same short fade used by the real object

                        ctx.save(); ctx.globalAlpha = objectAlpha; ctx.translate(ox, oy); ctx.scale(scale, scale); if (obj.isItem) ctx.rotate(obj.dir || 0); ctx.drawImage(sprite, -sprite.width / 2, -sprite.height / 2); ctx.restore();
                    });
                    const drawVirtualProjectiles = function (layer) {

                            return projectile && projectile.active && projectile.layer == layer && Math.hypot(projectile.x - nearest.x, projectile.y - nearest.y) <= previewRange;

                            ctx.scale(virtualSceneScale, virtualSceneScale);

                            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

                            ctx.lineWidth = outlineWidth;
                            ctx.lineJoin = "miter";
                            ctx.strokeStyle = darkOutlineColor;
                            ctx.fillStyle = "#ddd";
                            renderPlayer(candidate, ctx);
                            ctx.restore();
                        } catch (_) { try { ctx.restore(); } catch (_) { } }
                    };
                    // Layer-zero projectiles sit behind bodies; layer-one projectiles
                    // will be added over them after the target avatar is painted.
                    drawVirtualProjectiles(0);

                    }).sort(function (a, b) { return a.y - b.y; }).forEach(function (candidate) {
                        drawVirtualPlayer(candidate, candidate === player ? .94 : .90);
                    });

                    // A teleport / force-position update must reset preview motion
                    // immediately rather than carrying the player over from the old area.
                    const teleported = targetTeleported;
                    enemyPreviewState.target = nearest;
                    if (enemyPreviewArchive.classList.contains("open")) {
                        const liveMessages = nearest && nearest.__valueChatArchive ? nearest.__valueChatArchive.slice().reverse() : [];

                        if (liveKey !== enemyPreviewArchiveKey) renderEnemyPreviewArchive();

                    const scale = virtualSceneScale;

                    ctx.rotate((nearest.dir || 0) + (nearest.dirPlus || 0));
                    ctx.__valuePreviewScale = scale;
                    // Full canvas state reset — every compositing, shadow, and
                    // color property must be at its default before we render the
                    // preview avatar, otherwise it can inherit brightness/dark
                    // glow from a previous draw cycle and appear lit up or washed out.
                    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
                    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
                    ctx.filter = "none";
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
                    ctx.shadowColor = "transparent";
                    ctx.shadowOffsetX = 0;
                    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 0;
                    // Match the exact canvas state used by the original player renderer.
                    // renderPlayer relies on its caller to set the dark outline style.
                    // The virtual scene draws only the avatar here, so it must be as opaque as
                    // the live canvas crop; the panel owns HP/reload UI separately.
                    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
                    ctx.lineWidth = outlineWidth;
                    ctx.lineJoin = "miter";
                    ctx.strokeStyle = darkOutlineColor;
                    ctx.fillStyle = "#ddd";
                    renderPlayer(nearest, ctx);
                    ctx.restore();

                    // Keep the same day/night readability as the game without
                    // making the avatar translucent or switching render modes.
                    if (getEl("darkmode").checked) {
                        const darkness = ctx.createRadialGradient(sceneCenterX, sceneCenterY, 6, sceneCenterX, sceneCenterY, 150);
                        darkness.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0,0,0,.08)");
                        darkness.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,.42)");
                        ctx.fillStyle = darkness;
                        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, enemyPreviewCanvas.width, enemyPreviewCanvas.height);
                    }
                }
