                // SETUP SERVER SELECTOR:
                var gamesPerServer = 1;
                var serverPlayerCounts = [];

                function setupServerStatus() {
                    var tmpHTML = "";

                    // ADD SERVER SELECTOR:
                    var overallTotal = 0;
                    var regionCounter = 0;
                    for (var region in vultrClient.servers) {
                        var serverList = vultrClient.servers[region];

                        // COUNT PLAYERS:
                        var totalPlayers = 0;
                        for (var i = 0; i < serverList.length; i++) {
                            for (var j = 0; j < serverList[i].games.length; j++) {
                                totalPlayers += serverList[i].games[j].playerCount;
                            }
                        }
                        overallTotal += totalPlayers;

                        // ADD REGION LABELS:
                        var regionName = vultrClient.regionInfo[region].name;
                        tmpHTML += "<option disabled>" + regionName + " - " + totalPlayers + " players</option>"

                        // ADD INDIVIDUAL SERVERS IF EXPANDED:
                        for (var serverIndex = 0; serverIndex < serverList.length; serverIndex++) {
                            var server = serverList[serverIndex];

                            // ADD INDIVIDUAL GAMES:
                            for (var gameIndex = 0; gameIndex < server.games.length; gameIndex++) {
                                var game = server.games[gameIndex];
                                var adjustedIndex = server.index * gamesPerServer + gameIndex + 1;
                                var isSelected = vultrClient.server && vultrClient.server.region === server.region && vultrClient.server.index === server.index && vultrClient.gameIndex == gameIndex;
                                var serverLabel = regionName + " " + adjustedIndex + " [" + Math.min(game.playerCount, config.maxPlayers) + "/" + config.maxPlayers + "]";
                                // var itemClass = "menuSelector" + (isSelected ? " selectedMenuSelector" : "") + (game.isPrivate ? " privateMenuSelector" : "");
                                // var onClick = game.isPrivate ? "" : "switchServer(" + region + "," + serverIndex + "," + gameIndex + ")";
                                let serverID = vultrClient.stripRegion(region) + ":" + serverIndex + ":" + gameIndex;
                                if (isSelected) partyButton.getElementsByTagName("span")[0].innerText = serverID;
                                let selected = isSelected ? "selected" : "";
                                tmpHTML += "<option value='" + serverID + "' " + selected + ">" + serverLabel + "</option>";
                            }
                        }

                        // ADD BREAK AFTER EACH SERVER:
                        tmpHTML += "<option disabled></option>";

                        // INCREMENT COUNTER:
                        regionCounter++;
                    }

                    // ADD TOTAL PLAYERS:
                    tmpHTML += "<option disabled>All Servers - " + overallTotal + " players</option>";

                    // SET HTML:
                    serverBrowser.innerHTML = tmpHTML;

                    // ALT SERVER:
                    var altServerText;
                    var altServerURL;
                    if (location.hostname == "sandbox.moomoo.io") {
                        altServerText = "Back to MooMoo";
                        altServerURL = "//moomoo.io/";
                    } else {
                        altServerText = "Try the sandbox";
                        altServerURL = "//sandbox.moomoo.io/";
                    }
                    document.getElementById("altServer").innerHTML = "<a href='" + altServerURL + "'>" + altServerText + "<i class='material-icons' style='font-size:10px;vertical-align:middle'>arrow_forward_ios</i></a>";
                }

                function updateServerList() {
                    var xmlhttp = new XMLHttpRequest();
                    var url = "/serverData";
                    xmlhttp.onreadystatechange = function() {
                        if (this.readyState == 4) {
                            if (this.status == 200) {
                                // Parse the text and set it to Vultr
                                window.vultr = JSON.parse(this.responseText);
                                vultrClient.processServers(vultr.servers);

                                // Setup servers
                                setupServerStatus();
                            } else {
                                console.error("Failed to load server data with status code:", this.status);
                            }
                        }
                    };
                    xmlhttp.open("GET", url, true);
                    xmlhttp.send();
                }

                }));

                var preContentContainer = document.getElementById("pre-content-container");
                var preAdInterval = 1000 * 60 * 5; // 5 minutes
                var preAdLastShowTime = 0;
                var preAdGameCount = 0;
                function showPreAdIfReady() {
                    // Make sure the ad should be shown
                    preAdGameCount++;
                    var validGame = preAdGameCount > 1;
                    var validTime = (Date.now() - preAdLastShowTime) > preAdInterval;
                    if (validGame && validTime) {
                        preAdLastShowTime = Date.now();
                        showPreAd();
                    } else {
                        enterGame();
                    }
                }
                function showPreAd() {
                    // API FAILED TO LOAD:
                    if (!window.adsbygoogle) {
                        return console.log("Failed to load video ad API");
                        void enterGame();
                    }
                    // ATTEMPT TO LOAD OR SHOW:
                    // https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vS9eMymhLHkiscofJ442dPIKmXIGD3X2bbSF723b-3Btfao70nE885OlEPkbcM2NfrRaitWL_7KtT6I/pub
                    window.adsbygoogle.push({
                        type: "next",
                        adBreakDone: ()=>{
                            enterGame();
                        }
                    })
                }
                window.adsbygoogle && window.adsbygoogle.push({
                    preloadAdBreaks: "on"
                });
                window.showPreAd = showPreAd;

                                });
                            }
                        }
                    } else {
                        itemInfoHolder.classList.remove("visible");
                        // chatButton.classList.remove("hide");
                    }
                }

                // MINIMAP:
                var lastDeath;
                var minimapData;
                var mapMarker;
                var mapPings = [];
                var tmpPing;

                function MapPing() {
                    this.init = function(x, y) {
                        this.scale = 0;
                        this.x = x;
                        this.y = y;
                        this.active = true;
                    }
                    ;
                    this.update = function(ctxt, delta) {
                        if (this.active) {
                            this.scale += 0.05 * delta;
                            if (this.scale >= config.mapPingScale) {
                                this.active = false;
                            } else {
                                ctxt.globalAlpha = 1 - Math.max(0, this.scale / config.mapPingScale);
                                ctxt.beginPath();
                                ctxt.arc((this.x / config.mapScale) * mapDisplay.width, (this.y / config.mapScale) * mapDisplay.width, this.scale, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
                                ctxt.stroke();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    ;
                }

                function pingMap(x, y) {
                    for (var i = 0; i < mapPings.length; ++i) {
                        if (!mapPings[i].active) {
                            tmpPing = mapPings[i];
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (!tmpPing) {
                        tmpPing = new MapPing();
                        mapPings.push(tmpPing);
                    }
                    tmpPing.init(x, y);
                }

                function updateMapMarker() {
                    if (!mapMarker)
                        mapMarker = {};
                    mapMarker.x = player.x;
                    mapMarker.y = player.y;
                }

                function updateMinimap(data) {
                    minimapData = data;
                }

                function renderMinimap(delta) {
                    if (player && player.alive) {
                        mapContext.clearRect(0, 0, mapDisplay.width, mapDisplay.height);
                        // RENDER PINGS:
                        mapContext.strokeStyle = "#fff";
                        mapContext.lineWidth = 4;
                        for (var i = 0; i < mapPings.length; ++i) {
                            tmpPing = mapPings[i];
                            tmpPing.update(mapContext, delta);
                        }
                        // RENDER PLAYERS:
                        if (!streamerMode) {
                            mapContext.globalAlpha = 1;
                            mapContext.fillStyle = "#fff";
                            renderCircle((player.x / config.mapScale) * mapDisplay.width, (player.y / config.mapScale) * mapDisplay.height, 7, mapContext, true);
                        }
                        mapContext.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";
                        if (player.team && minimapData) {
                            for (var i = 0; i < minimapData.length; ) {
                                renderCircle((minimapData[i] / config.mapScale) * mapDisplay.width, (minimapData[i + 1] / config.mapScale) * mapDisplay.height, 7, mapContext, true);
                                i += 2;
                            }
                        }
                        // DEATH LOCATION:
                        if (lastDeath) {
                            mapContext.fillStyle = "#fc5553";
                            mapContext.font = "34px Hammersmith One";
                            mapContext.textBaseline = "middle";
                            mapContext.textAlign = "center";
                            mapContext.fillText("x", (lastDeath.x / config.mapScale) * mapDisplay.width, (lastDeath.y / config.mapScale) * mapDisplay.height);
                        }
                        // MAP MARKER:
                        if (mapMarker) {
                            mapContext.fillStyle = "#fff";
                            mapContext.font = "34px Hammersmith One";
                            mapContext.textBaseline = "middle";
                            mapContext.textAlign = "center";
                            mapContext.fillText("x", (mapMarker.x / config.mapScale) * mapDisplay.width, (mapMarker.y / config.mapScale) * mapDisplay.height);
                        }
                        // BREAK TRACKER:
                        if (breakTracks.length && (getEl("combat").value == "me" || getEl("combat").value == "cele" || getEl("combat").value == "fz" || getEl("combat").value == "zyenith" || getEl("combat").value == "Uncve" || getEl("combat").value == "2yl")) {
                            for (let i = 0; i < breakTracks.length; i++) {
                                tmpObj = breakTracks[i];
                                mapContext.fillStyle = "#fff";
                                mapContext.font = "34px Hammersmith One";
                                mapContext.textBaseline = "middle";
                                mapContext.textAlign = "center";
                                mapContext.fillText("L", (tmpObj.x / config.mapScale) * mapDisplay.width, (tmpObj.y / config.mapScale) * mapDisplay.height);
                            }
                        }
                        // TELEPORTS:
                        if (myTeles.length && (getEl("combat").value == "me" || getEl("combat").value == "cele" || getEl("combat").value == "zyenith")) {
                            for (let i = 0; i < myTeles.length; i++) {
                                tmpObj = myTeles[i];
                                mapContext.fillStyle = "#d76edb";
                                mapContext.font = "34px Hammersmith One";
                                mapContext.textBaseline = "middle";
                                mapContext.textAlign = "center";
                                mapContext.fillText("T", (tmpObj.x / config.mapScale) * mapDisplay.width, (tmpObj.y / config.mapScale) * mapDisplay.height);
                            }
                        }
                        // CAM COORDS:
                        if (freeCam.active) {
                            mapContext.globalAlpha = 1;
                            mapContext.fillStyle = "#ff0000";
                            renderCircle((camX / config.mapScale) * mapDisplay.width, (camY / config.mapScale) * mapDisplay.height, 7, mapContext, true);
                        }
                    }
                }

                function buyEquip(id, index) {
                    // BUY AND EQUIP:
                    if (player.alive) {
                        if (index == 0) {
                            if (player.skins[id]) {
                                if (player.skinIndex != id) {
                                    io.send("13c", 0, id, 0);
                                }
                            } else {
                                if (config.isSandbox) {
                                    let find = findID(hats, id);
                                    if (find) {
                                        if (player.points >= find.price) {
                                            io.send("13c", 1, id, 0);
                                            io.send("13c", 0, id, 0);
                                        } else {
                                            if (player.skinIndex != 0) {
                                                io.send("13c", 0, 0, 0);
                                            }
                                        }
                                    } else {
                                        if (player.skinIndex != 0) {
                                            io.send("13c", 0, 0, 0);
                                        }
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    if (player.skinIndex != 0) {
                                        io.send("13c", 0, 0, 0);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        } else if (index == 1) {
                            if (player.tails[id]) {
                                if (player.tailIndex != id) {
                                    io.send("13c", 0, id, 1);
                                }
                            } else {
                                if (config.isSandbox) {
                                    let find = findID(accessories, id);
                                    if (find) {
                                        if (player.points >= find.price) {
                                            io.send("13c", 1, id, 1);
                                            io.send("13c", 0, id, 1);
                                        } else {
                                            if (player.tailIndex != 0) {
                                                io.send("13c", 0, 0, 1);
                                            }
                                        }
                                    } else {
                                        if (player.tailIndex != 0) {
                                            io.send("13c", 0, 0, 1);
                                        }
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    if (player.tailIndex != 0) {
                                        io.send("13c", 0, 0, 1);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // PREPARE UI:
                function prepareUI() {
                    // NATIVE RESOLUTION:
                    var savedNativeValue = getSavedVal("native_resolution");
                    // Keep CSS/UI dimensions unchanged while rendering the game canvas
                    // at high DPI. This replaces browser-zoom "quality" without making
                    // HUD/menu elements smaller or moving them.
                    setUseNativeResolution(true);
                    // SHOW PING:
                    showPing = getSavedVal("show_ping") == "true";
                    pingDisplay.hidden = !showPing;

                    // MOBILE DOWNLOADS:

                            getEl("mobileDownloadButtonContainer").classList.add("cordova");

                    }, 1000);
                    // SKIN COLOR PICKER:
                    updateSkinColorPicker();
                    // ACTION BAR:
                    UTILS.removeAllChildren(actionBar);
                    for (var i = 0; i < items.weapons.length + items.list.length; ++i) {
                        (function(i) {
                            UTILS.generateElement({
                                id: "actionBarItem" + i,
                                class: "actionBarItem",
                                style: "display:none",
                                onmouseout: function() {
                                    showItemInfo();
                                },
                                parent: actionBar,
                            });
                        }
                        )(i);
                    }
                    for (var i = 0; i < items.list.length + items.weapons.length; ++i) {
                        (function(i) {
                            var tmpCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
                            tmpCanvas.width = tmpCanvas.height = 66;
                            tmpCanvas.tmpW = tmpCanvas.tmpH = 66;
                            var tmpContext = tmpCanvas.getContext("2d");
                            tmpContext.translate(tmpCanvas.width / 2, tmpCanvas.height / 2);
                            tmpContext.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
                            tmpContext.webkitImageSmoothingEnabled = false;
                            tmpContext.mozImageSmoothingEnabled = false;
                            if (items.weapons[i]) {
                                tmpContext.rotate(Math.PI / 4 + Math.PI);
                                var tmpSprite = new Image();
                                toolSprites[items.weapons[i].src] = tmpSprite;
                                tmpSprite.onload = function() {
                                    this.isLoaded = true;
                                    var tmpPad = 1 / (this.height / this.width);
                                    var tmpMlt = items.weapons[i].iPad || 1;
                                    tmpContext.drawImage(this, -(tmpCanvas.width * tmpMlt * config.iconPad * tmpPad) / 2, -(tmpCanvas.height * tmpMlt * config.iconPad) / 2, tmpCanvas.width * tmpMlt * tmpPad * config.iconPad, tmpCanvas.height * tmpMlt * config.iconPad);

                                tmpUnit.onmouseover = UTILS.checkTrusted(function() {
                                    showItemInfo(items.weapons[i], true);
                                });
                                tmpUnit.onclick = UTILS.checkTrusted(function() {
                                    selectWeapon(player ? player.weapons[items.weapons[i].type] : i);
                                });
                                UTILS.hookTouchEvents(tmpUnit);
                            } else {
                                var tmpSprite = getItemSprite(items.list[i - items.weapons.length], true);
                                var tmpScale = Math.min(tmpCanvas.width - config.iconPadding, tmpSprite.width);
                                tmpContext.globalAlpha = 1;
                                tmpContext.drawImage(tmpSprite, -tmpScale / 2, -tmpScale / 2, tmpScale, tmpScale);

                function updateItems(data, wpn) {
                    if (data) {
                        if (wpn)
                            player.weapons = data;
                        else
                            player.items = data;
                    }
                    for (let i = 0; i < items.list.length; i++) {
                        let tmpI = items.weapons.length + i;
                        getEl("actionBarItem" + tmpI).style.display = (getEl("combat").value == "cele" || getEl("combat").value == "Oldae" || getEl("combat").value == "ae" || getEl("combat").value == "WasdMode" || getEl("combat").value == "Totalew" ||getEl("combat").value == "TesterMode" || getEl("combat").value == "EwV" ||getEl("combat").value == "hans" ? player.firstItems : player.items).indexOf(items.list[i].id) >= 0 ? "inline-block" : "none";
                    }
                    for (let i = 0; i < items.weapons.length; i++) {
                        getEl("actionBarItem" + i).style.display = player.weapons[items.weapons[i].type] == items.weapons[i].id ? "inline-block" : "none";
                    }
                }

                function setUseNativeResolution(useNative) {
                    useNativeResolution = useNative;
                    // At least 1.25x supersampling on ordinary 1x monitors; cap at
                    // 2x to preserve frame rate and avoid excessively large canvases.
                    pixelDensity = useNative ? Math.min(2, Math.max(1.25, window.devicePixelRatio || 1)) : .55;
                    nativeResolutionCheckbox.checked = useNative;
                    saveVal("native_resolution", useNative.toString());
                    resize();
                }

                function toggleChat() {
                    if (!usingTouch) {
                        if (chatHolder.style.display == "block") {
                            if (chatBox.value) {
                                sendChat(chatBox.value);
                            }
                            closeChat();
                        } else {
                            storeMenu.style.display = "none";
                            allianceMenu.style.display = "none";
                            chatHolder.style.display = "block";
                            chatBox.autocomplete = "off";
                            if (getEl("combat").value == "ae" || getEl("combat").value == "hans" || getEl("combat").value == "Oldae" || getEl("combat").value == "EwV" || getEl("combat").value == "hae" || getEl("combat").value == "goofy") {
                                chatHolder.style.opacity = "0";
                            } else {
                                chatHolder.style.opacity = "1";
                            }
                            chatBox.focus();
                            resetMoveDir();
                        }
                    } else {
                        setTimeout(function() {
                            var chatMessage = prompt("chat message");
                            if (chatMessage) {
                                sendChat(chatMessage);
                            }
                        }, 1);
                    }
                    chatBox.value = "";
                }

                function formatSentence(sentence) {
                    // 1. Capitalize the first letter of the sentence and after a period
                    sentence = sentence.replace(/(^|[.!?><=+&%$@^]\s+)(\w)/g, function(match, p1, p2) {
                        return p1 + p2.toUpperCase();
                    });

                    // 2. Automatic comma placement
                    sentence = sentence.replace(/(\w+)\s*([.,?!])\s*(\w+)/g, function(match, p1, p2, p3) {
                        if (p2 === ',' && p1.charAt(p1.length - 1) !== ',') {
                            return p1 + ', ' + p3;
                        } else if (p2 !== ',' && p1.charAt(p1.length - 1) === ',') {
                            return p1.slice(0, -1) + p2 + ' ' + p3;
                        } else {
                            return match;
                        }
                    });

                    // 3. Automatic period at the end of the sentence
                    if (!/[.?!;:<>[\]{}=+\-]$/.test(sentence)) {
                        sentence += '.';
                    }

                    // 5. Automatic removal of leading and trailing spaces
                    sentence = sentence.trim();

                    // 6. Automatic removal of spaces between words
                    sentence = sentence.replace(/\s+/g, ' ');

                    // 7. Add a space after question marks and exclamation marks
                    sentence = sentence.replace(/(\w+[?!])(\S+)/g, function(match, p1, p2) {
                        return p1 + ' ' + p2.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + p2.slice(1);
                    });

                    // Remove spaces before commas and periods
                    sentence = sentence.replace(/\s+([,.])/g, '$1');

                    // Add a space after commas and periods if not already present
                    sentence = sentence.replace(/([,.])(\S)/g, '$1 $2');

                    // Remove spaces before exclamation marks and question marks
                    sentence = sentence.replace(/\s+([?!])/g, '$1');

                    // Add a space before exclamation marks and question marks if not already present
                    sentence = sentence.replace(/(\S)([?!])/g, '$1 $2');

                    return sentence;
                }
                function sendChat(message) {
                    let command = function(chat) {
                        return message === "." + chat;
                    };
                    if (command("dcc")) {
                        let chickens = [];
                        let timeout = 0;
                        players.forEach((i)=>{
                            tmpObj = players[i];
                            if (tmpObj != player && tmpObj.visible) {
                                chickens.push({
                                    name: tmpObj.name,
                                    timeout: timeout
                                });
                                timeout += 600;
                            }
                        })
                        chickens.forEach((ahaha)=>{
                            setTimeout(()=>{
                                io.send("ch", "!c!dc user " + ahaha.name);
                            }
                                       , ahaha.timeout);
                        }
                                        );
                    } else if (command("exit")) {
                        io.send("ch", "Disconnencting...");
                        setTimeout(()=>{
                            io.close();
                        }
                                   , 500);
                    } else {
                        if (getEl("chatc").checked && !singing.toggle && !singing.audio) {
                            io.send("ch", (formatSentence(message)).slice(0, 30));
                        } else {
                            io.send("ch", message.slice(0, 30));
                        }
                    }
                }

                function playMusic(value) {
                    let song = songs[parseInt(value) - 1]
                    if (singing.audio) {
                        singing.audio.currentTime = 0;
                        singing.audio.pause();
                    }
                    singing.name = song.name;
                    singing.audio = new Audio(song.src);
                    singing.timeouts.forEach(e => clearTimeout(e));
                    singing.timeouts = [];

                    if (singing.toggle && singing.audio) {
                        singing.audio.onended = function() {
                            singing.toggle = false;
                            singing.audio.currentTime = 0;
                            singing.audio.pause()
                        };
                        if (singing.audio.paused) {
                            singing.audio.play();
                        }
                        for (let time in song.sync) {
                            let message = song.sync[time];
                            singing.timeouts.push(setTimeout(() => {
                                io.send("ch", "" + message ?? "");
                            }, time));
                        }
                    } else {
                        singing.audio && (singing.audio.currentTime = 0, singing.audio.pause());
                    }
                }

                function toggleSing(value) {
                    playMusic(value);
                    singing.toggle = !singing.toggle;
                    singing.timeouts.forEach(e => clearTimeout(e));
                    singing.timeouts = [];
                    let song = songs[parseInt(value) - 1];
                    if (singing.toggle && singing.audio) {
                        singing.audio.onended = function() {
                            singing.toggle = false;
                            singing.audio.currentTime = 0;
                            singing.audio.pause()
                        };
                        if (singing.audio.paused) {
                            singing.audio.play();
                        }
                        for (let time in song.sync) {
                            let message = song.sync[time];
                            singing.timeouts.push(setTimeout(() => {
                                io.send("ch", "" + message ?? "");
                            }, time));
                        }
                    } else {
                        singing.audio && (singing.audio.currentTime = 0, singing.audio.pause());
                    }
                }

                var JsDelay = (time) => {
                    let newTime = time.split(":").reverse();
                    time = 0;
                    let convert = [6e4 * 60, 6e4, 1000, 1].reverse();
                    newTime.forEach((b, c) => {
                        time += b * convert[c];
                    });
                    return time;
                };

                function checkProfanityString(text) {
                    var tmpString;
                    if (getEl("combat").value != "fz" && getEl("combat").value != "Uncve" && getEl("combat").value == "zyenith") {
                        for (var i = 0; i < profanityList.length; ++i) {
                            if (text.indexOf(profanityList[i]) > -1) {
                                tmpString = "";
                                for (var y = 0; y < profanityList[i].length; ++y) {
                                    tmpString += tmpString.length ? "o" : "M";
                                }
                                var re = new RegExp(profanityList[i],"g");
                                text = text.replace(re, tmpString);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    return text;
                }

                function touchMove(ev) {
                    ev.preventDefault();
                    ev.stopPropagation();
                    setUsingTouch(true);
                    for (var i = 0; i < ev.changedTouches.length; i++) {
                        var t = ev.changedTouches[i];
                        if (t.identifier == controllingTouch.id) {
                            controllingTouch.currentX = t.pageX;
                            controllingTouch.currentY = t.pageY;
                            sendMoveDir();
                        } else if (t.identifier == attackingTouch.id) {
                            attackingTouch.currentX = t.pageX;
                            attackingTouch.currentY = t.pageY;
                            attackState = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
                gameCanvas.addEventListener("touchstart", UTILS.checkTrusted(touchStart), false);

                function touchStart(ev) {
                    ev.preventDefault();
                    ev.stopPropagation();
                    setUsingTouch(true);
                    for (var i = 0; i < ev.changedTouches.length; i++) {
                        var t = ev.changedTouches[i];
                        if (t.pageX < document.body.scrollWidth / 2 && controllingTouch.id == -1) {
                            controllingTouch.id = t.identifier;
                            controllingTouch.startX = controllingTouch.currentX = t.pageX;
                            controllingTouch.startY = controllingTouch.currentY = t.pageY;
                            sendMoveDir();
                        } else if (t.pageX > document.body.scrollWidth / 2 && attackingTouch.id == -1) {
                            attackingTouch.id = t.identifier;
                            attackingTouch.startX = attackingTouch.currentX = t.pageX;
                            attackingTouch.startY = attackingTouch.currentY = t.pageY;
                            if (player.buildIndex < 0) {
                                attackState = 1;
                                sendAtckState();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                gameCanvas.addEventListener("touchend", UTILS.checkTrusted(touchEnd), false);
                gameCanvas.addEventListener("touchcancel", UTILS.checkTrusted(touchEnd), false);
                gameCanvas.addEventListener("touchleave", UTILS.checkTrusted(touchEnd), false);

                function touchEnd(ev) {
                    ev.preventDefault();
                    ev.stopPropagation();
                    setUsingTouch(true);
                    for (var i = 0; i < ev.changedTouches.length; i++) {
                        var t = ev.changedTouches[i];
                        if (t.identifier == controllingTouch.id) {
                            controllingTouch.id = -1;
                            sendMoveDir();
                        } else if (t.identifier == attackingTouch.id) {
                            attackingTouch.id = -1;
                            if (player.buildIndex >= 0) {
                                attackState = 1;
                                sendAtckState();
                            }
                            attackState = 0;
                            sendAtckState();
                        }
                    }
                }

                // INPUT UTILS:
                function getMoveDir() {
                    var dx = 0;
                    var dy = 0;
                    if (controllingTouch.id != -1) {
                        dx += controllingTouch.currentX - controllingTouch.startX;
                        dy += controllingTouch.currentY - controllingTouch.startY;
                    } else {
                        for (var key in moveKeys) {
                            var tmpDir = moveKeys[key];
                            dx += !!keys[key] * tmpDir[0];
                            dy += !!keys[key] * tmpDir[1];
                        }
                    }
                    return dx == 0 && dy == 0 ? undefined : UTILS.fixTo(Math.atan2(dy, dx), 2);
                }

                function getAttackDir() {
                    let customDir = getSafeDir();
                    if (!player)
                        return 0;
                    try {
                        if (typeof AutoModCore !== "undefined" && AutoModCore.toggleOn && AutoModCore.toggleOn()) {
                            const autoModAim = AutoModCore.attackAimOverride && AutoModCore.attackAimOverride();
                            if (Number.isFinite(autoModAim)) return autoModAim;
                        }
                    } catch (_) { }
                    // FIX ("при autobreak ближайший spike не ломается вражеский, проверь
                    // там ли ты вставил функцию, там ли ты это реализовал"): traced past
                    // the priority-swap code itself (which DOES correctly set traps.aim
                    // toward the enemy spike, see the trap-fight block below) all the way
                    // to the actual packet-direction dispatcher. getAttackDir() is what
                    // actually produces the angle sent in io.send("2", atckDir) every
                    // tick ("SEND DIR" block) -- and its FIRST branch here (autoAim ||
                    // clicks.left-with-ready-reload || autos.bull, which covers the
                    // overwhelming majority of real combat: autoAim is on for most combat
                    // presets, and simply holding left-click satisfies the clicks.left
                    // condition) used to return `near.aim2` UNCONDITIONALLY, completely
                    // ignoring `traps.in`/`traps.aim` -- the trap-vs-spike retarget only
                    // ever took effect in the narrow final `else` branch below, which this
                    // first branch's condition almost always short-circuits past first.
                    // So the priority-autobreak swap silently never reached the actual
                    // outgoing packet whenever autoAim/left-click-attack was active --
                    // exactly the reported symptom. Mirrors the SAME weapon-reload
                    // condition the existing third branch below already uses (whichever of
                    // primary/secondary is the better trap-breaking tool right now), so
                    // this doesn't diverge from that branch's own criteria for "am I
                    // actually ready to swing at what traps.aim points at".
                    if (traps.in && player.reloads[traps.healths > items.weapons[player.weapons[0]].dmg && player.weapons[1] == 10 ? player.weapons[1] : player.weapons[0]] == 0) {
                        return traps.aim;
                    }
                    if (autoAim || (clicks.left && player.reloads[player.weapons[0]] == 0 && !getEl("grind").checked) || autos.bull) {
                        return enemy.length ? clicks.middle || clicks.none ? near.aim2 : near.aim2 : getSafeDir();
                    } else if (clicks.right && player.reloads[(player.weapons[1] == 10) ? player.weapons[1] : player.weapons[0]] == 0) {
                        return getSafeDir();
                    } else {
                        if (traps.in && (getEl("combat").value == "Oldae" || getEl("combat").value == "sal" || getEl("combat").value == "kto" || getEl("combat").value == "syl"|| getEl("combat").value == "obs" || getEl("combat").value == "j" || getEl("combat").value == "WasdMode" || getEl("combat").value == "Totalew" || getEl("combat").value == "ae" ? true : player.reloads[traps.healths > items.weapons[player.weapons[0]].dmg && player.weapons[1] == 10 ? player.weapons[1] : player.weapons[0]] == 0)) {

                function sendMoveDir() {
                    var newMoveDir = getMoveDir();
                    if (lastMoveDir == undefined || newMoveDir == undefined || Math.abs(newMoveDir - lastMoveDir) > 0.3) {

                // === AUTO-PUSH (v10, ported from the reference "Badcode" userscript's
                // own autoPush(), see the header comment on `pushState` above for the
                // pathfinder-dependency decision). Faithful port of the reference's own
                // geometry/logic, with only the identifiers swapped for this file's real
                // equivalents:
                //   nearTrap: reference used `tmp.trap && tmp.isTeamObject(player)`
                //     scoped to "close enough to `near` (the tracked enemy) to matter" --
                //     identical here.
                //   spike: the reference's own "friendly spike close to that trap"
                //     lookup, unchanged.
                //   pos/pos2: the reference's own escape-vector geometry (250 units past
                //     the spike along the trap->spike direction, and the point exactly
                //     player.scale beyond the spike along the same line) -- reproduced
                //     exactly, since this is pure vector math with zero engine-specific
                //     dependencies.
                //   finds: the reference's own "would the straight walking line from
                //     here to `pos2` hit anything solid" check via UTILS.lineInRect --
                //     identical here, using the real gameObjects list.
                //   packet("a", dir, 1): this file's own move-direction packet is
                //     `io.send("33", dir)` (confirmed at sendMoveDir() just above,
                //     matching the reference's own packet map entry \'"33": "9" //
                //     MOVE\'); "undefined" clears movement exactly the same way in both.
                // ===
                function autoPush() {
                    if (!near || typeof near !== "object" || Array.isArray(near) || !near.alive) {
                        if (pushState.active) { pushState.active = false; io.send("33", lastMoveDir); }
                        return;
                    }
                    let nearTrap = gameObjects.filter(function (tmp) {
                        return tmp.trap && tmp.active && tmp.isTeamObject(player) && UTILS.getDist(tmp, near, 0, 2) <= (near.scale + tmp.getScale() + 5);
                    }).sort(function (a, b) {
                        return UTILS.getDist(a, near, 0, 2) - UTILS.getDist(b, near, 0, 2);
                    })[0];
                    if (!nearTrap) {
                        if (pushState.active) { pushState.active = false; io.send("33", lastMoveDir); }
                        return;
                    }
                    let spike = gameObjects.filter(function (tmp) {
                        return tmp.dmg && tmp.active && tmp.isTeamObject(player) && UTILS.getDist(tmp, nearTrap, 0, 0) <= (near.scale + nearTrap.scale + tmp.scale);
                    }).sort(function (a, b) {
                        return UTILS.getDist(a, near, 0, 2) - UTILS.getDist(b, near, 0, 2);
                    })[0];
                    if (!spike) {
                        if (pushState.active) { pushState.active = false; io.send("33", lastMoveDir); }
                        return;
                    }
                    const escapeDir = UTILS.getDirect(near, spike, 2, 0);
                    const pos = {
                        x: spike.x + (250 * Math.cos(escapeDir)),
                        y: spike.y + (250 * Math.sin(escapeDir)),
                        x2: spike.x + ((UTILS.getDist(near, spike, 2, 0) + player.scale) * Math.cos(escapeDir)),
                        y2: spike.y + ((UTILS.getDist(near, spike, 2, 0) + player.scale) * Math.sin(escapeDir)),
                    };
                    const finds = gameObjects.filter(function (tmp) { return tmp.active; }).find(function (tmp) {
                        const tmpScale = tmp.getScale();
                        return !tmp.ignoreCollision && UTILS.lineInRect(tmp.x - tmpScale, tmp.y - tmpScale, tmp.x + tmpScale, tmp.y + tmpScale, player.x2, player.y2, pos.x2, pos.y2);
                    });
                    if (finds) {
                        if (pushState.active) { pushState.active = false; io.send("33", lastMoveDir); }
                        return;
                    }
                    pushState.active = true;
                    pushState.data = { x: spike.x, y: spike.y, x2: pos.x2, y2: pos.y2 };
                    const scale = player.scale / 10;
                    if (UTILS.lineInRect(player.x2 - scale, player.y2 - scale, player.x2 + scale, player.y2 + scale, near.x2, near.y2, pos.x, pos.y)) {
                        io.send("33", near.aim2);
                    } else {
                        io.send("33", UTILS.getDirect(pos, player, 2, 2));
                    }
                }

                // BETTER TIMEOUT FOR POWERFULL:
                function betterSetTimeout(callback, delay, ...args) {
                    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            try {
                                const result = callback(...args);
                                resolve(result);
                            } catch (error) {
                                reject(error);
                            }
                        }, delay);
                    }).then((result)=>{
                        return result;
                    }).catch((e)=>{
                        console.error(e);
                    });
                }

                            return `cursor: none`;
                        }
                    }
                }

                // TIMEOUT2:
                function SetTimeout(callback, delay, ...args) {
                    const start = Date.now();

                    function checkTime() {
                        const elapsed = Date.now() - start;
                        if (elapsed >= delay) {
                            callback(...args);
                        } else {
                            requestAnimationFrame(checkTime);
                        }
                    }

                    requestAnimationFrame(checkTime);
                }

                function caf(e, t) {
                    try {
                        return Math.atan2((t.y2 || t.y) - (e.y2 || e.y), (t.x2 || t.x) - (e.x2 || e.x));
                    } catch (e) {
                        return 0;
                    }
                }
                function fgd(a, b){
                    return Math.sqrt(Math.pow((b.y2-a[2]),2)+Math.pow((b.x2-a[1]),2));
                }
                function fgdo(a, b){
                    return Math.sqrt(Math.pow((b.y-a.y),2)+Math.pow((b.x-a.x),2));
                }

                class GameObjectsReplacer {
                    constructor(UTILS, findObj, dist, items, sid) {

                        this.objectPredict = [];
                        this.info = {};
                        this.toReturn = undefined;
                        this.dist = function (a, b){
                            return Math.sqrt(Math.pow((b.y2 || b.y) - a[2], 2) + Math.pow((b.x2 || b.x) - a[1], 2))
                        }
                        this.notFast = function() {
                            return player.weapons[1] == 10 && ((this.info.health > items.weapons[player.weapons[0]].dmg) || player.weapons[0] == 5);
                        }
                        this.distances = function (a, b, a2, b2, a3, b3, nearest, value) {
                            let toReturn;

                            toReturn = UTILS.getDist(a, nearest, a2, b2) - UTILS.getDist(b, nearest, a2, b2);

                            if (value) {
                                toReturn = UTILS.getDist(a, nearest, a2, b2) - UTILS.getDist(b, nearest, a3, b3);
                            }

                            return toReturn;
                        };
                        this.checkSecond = function (id, angle) {
                            let item = items.list[player.items[id]];
                            let scale = 35 + item.scale + (item.placeOffset || 0);
                            let x = player.x2 + Math.cos(angle) * scale;
                            let y = player.y2 + Math.sin(angle) * scale;
                            for(let i = 0; i < this.objectPredict.length; i++) {
                                let _ = this.objectPredict[i];
                                if(_ && Math.hypot(_.y - y, _.x - x) <= scale + _.scale) {
                                    return false;
                                }
                            }
                            return true;
                        }
                        this.forPlace = function (id, start, repeat, plus, radian, forEachOrFor, each = undefined) {
                            const type = new Set([null, NaN, undefined, 0, 1, 2, ""]);
                            if (forEachOrFor && each !== undefined) {
                                if (type.has(each)) {
                                    let aim = this.UTILS.getDirect(findObj, player, 0, 2);
                                    place(id, aim);
                                } else {
                                    each.forEach((tmp) => {
                                        let aim = this.UTILS.getDirect(tmp, player, 0, 2);
                                        place(id, aim);
                                    });
                                }
                            } else {
                                for (let gz = start; gz <= repeat; gz += plus) {
                                    let relAim = radian + gz;
                                    place(id, relAim);
                                }
                            }
                        };
                        this.placer = function (id, first = -(Math.PI / 2), repeat = (Math.PI / 2), plus = (Math.PI / 18), radian, radian2, replacer) {
                            try {
                                let item = items.list[player.items[id]];
                                let tmpS = player.scale + item.scale + (item.placeOffset || 0);
                                let counts = {
                                    attempts: 0,
                                    placed: 0
                                };
                                let tmpObjects = [];
                                gameObjects.forEach((p) => {
                                    tmpObjects.push({
                                        x: p.x,
                                        y: p.y,
                                        active: p.active,
                                        blocker: p.blocker,
                                        scale: p.scale,
                                        isItem: p.isItem,
                                        type: p.type,
                                        colDiv: p.colDiv,
                                        getScale: function(sM, ig) {
                                            sM = sM || 1;
                                            return this.scale * ((this.isItem || this.type == 2 || this.type == 3 || this.type == 4) ? 1: (0.6 * sM)) * (ig ? 1 : this.colDiv);
                                        },
                                    });
                                });
                                for (let i = first; i < repeat; i += plus) {
                                    counts.attempts++;
                                    let relAim = radian + i;
                                    let tmpX = player.x2 + tmpS * Math.cos(relAim);
                                    let tmpY = player.y2 + tmpS * Math.sin(relAim);
                                    let cantPlace = tmpObjects.find((tmp) => tmp.active && UTILS.getDistance(tmpX, tmpY, tmp.x, tmp.y) < item.scale + (tmp.blocker ? tmp.blocker : tmp.getScale(0.6, tmp.isItem)));
                                    if (cantPlace) continue;
                                    if (item.id != 18 && tmpY >= config.mapScale / 2 - config.riverWidth / 2 && tmpY <= config.mapScale / 2 + config.riverWidth / 2) continue;
                                    place(id, relAim, 1);
                                    tmpObjects.push({
                                        x: tmpX,
                                        y: tmpY,
                                        active: true,
                                        blocker: item.blocker,
                                        scale: item.scale,
                                        isItem: true,
                                        type: null,
                                        colDiv: item.colDiv,
                                        getScale: function() {
                                            return this.scale;
                                        },
                                    });
                                    if (UTILS.getAngleDist(near.aim2, relAim) <= 1) {
                                        counts.placed++;
                                    }
                                }
                                if (counts.placed > 0 && replacer && item.dmg) {
                                    if (near.dist2 <= items.weapons[player.weapons[0]].range + (player.scale * 1.8) && configs.spikeTick) {
                                        instaC.canSpikeTick = true;
                                    }
                                }
                            } catch (err) {
                                log(err);
                            }
                        };
                        this.protect = function (object, findObj, sid) {
                            let spike = gameObjects.find((e) => Math.hypot(e.y - player.y, e.x - player.x) <= 212 && /spik/.test(e.name) && e.active && e.owner.sid != player.sid);
                            let spikes = gameObjects.filter((e) => Math.hypot(e.y - player.y, e.x - player.x) <= 212 && /spik/.test(e.name) && e.active && e.owner.sid != player.sid).sort(function (a, b) {
                                return (UTILS.getDist(a, player, 0, 2) - UTILS.getDist(b, player, 0, 2));
                            })[0];
                            let range = items.weapons[player.weapons[0]].range + 70;
                            if (findObj) {
                                if (tmpObj == player) {
                                    tmpObj.damaged = tmpObj.oldHealth - tmpObj.health;
                                    if ((spike || spikes) && tmpObj.health < 56 || (spike || spikes) && tmpObj.health < 66 && tmpObj.skinIndex != 6 && player.weaponVariant > 0) {
                                        buyEquip(6, 0);
                                    } else {
                                        if (tmpObj.health < 56 || tmpObj.health < 66 && tmpObj.skinIndex != 6 && player.weaponVariant > 0) {
                                            buyEquip(6, 0);
                                        } else {
                                            if (this.dist2 <= 222) {
                                                buyEquip(6, 0);
                                                this.placer(2, 0, (Math.PI * 2), (Math.PI / 18), near.aim2, near.aim2, 1);
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        };
                        this.replacer = function (n, object) {
                            if (!n) return;
                            if (!inGame) return;

                            const scalarProduct = (a, b) => {
                                return Math.cos((a * b) / (a * b));
                            }, magnitude = (a) => {
                                return Math.sqrt(a.x ** 2 + a.y ** 2 + nEA);
                            };
                            const angles = Math.acos(scalarProduct(nEy, player) / (magnitude(findObj) * magnitude(player)));
                            let objAim = this.UTILS.getDirect(findObj, player, 0, 2);
                            let objDst = this.UTILS.getDist(findObj, player, 0, 2);
                            let range = items.weapons[player.weapons[0]].range + 70;
                            let tmpAim = Math.atan2(n.y - player.y, n.x - player.x) + Math.PI;
                            let radian = objAim || tmpAim;
                            let radianToPlace = tmpAim || tryChunk(angles);
                            let objAimInRadians = objAim * Math.PI / 180;
                            let radians = objAimInRadians + Math.PI / 1.5;
                            let radianPlace = radians || objAim;
                            let weaponReady = player.reloads[player.weapons[0]] <= 1;
                            let _value = 0;
                            let _distance = this.distances;
                            let _UTILS = this.UTILS;
                            let nearObject = function (func) {
                                let functions = {
                                    scale: n.scale,
                                    objectX: n.x,
                                    objectY: n.y,
                                    gameObj: gameObjects,
                                };

                                return functions[func];
                            };
                            let gearDmgs = [0.25, 0.45].map((val) => val * items.weapons[player.weapons[0]].dmg * n.scale - (near.scale + nearObject("scale")));
                            let setsForGroup = new Set([2, 4]); // Lazy
                            const perfectAim = ((player.canSee(n) && objDst <= 184 && setsForGroup.has(n.group.id) && (player.moveDir == undefined || Math.hypot(n.x - player.x2, n.y - n.y) <= 72)) ? Math.hypot(n.x - player.x2, n.y - n.y) : objAim);
                            const aiming = Math.hypot(n.x - player.x, n.y - n.y);
                            const aimTo = Math.hypot(n.x - player.x2, n.y - n.y);
                            if (this.dist2 <= 600 && enemy.length) {
                                if (objDst <= 400 && this.dist2 <= 400) {

                                    for (let o = Math.PI / 2; o < Math.PI / 2; o += Math.PI / 18) {
                                        radianPlace = o;
                                    }

                                    for (let _ = nEA - Math.PI / 3; _ < nEA + Math.PI / 3; _ += Math.PI / 18) {
                                        radian = _;
                                        radianToPlace = objAim + _;
                                    }

                                    if (this.dist2 <= 280 && objDst <= 280) {

                                        if (traps.inTrap) {
                                            this.placer(2, -(Math.PI / 2), (Math.PI / 2), (Math.PI / 18), objAim + Math.PI);
                                        }

                                        if (["pit trap"].includes(n.name)) {
                                            if (this.dist2 <= 200 && objDst <= 200) {
                                                place(2, aiming);
                                                waitSpikeTick2 = true;

                                                if (this.dist2 <= 184 && objDst <= 184) {
                                                    if (weaponReady && (objDst - this.dist2) == 145) checkPlace(2, objAim);
                                                } else {
                                                    this.placer(2, 0, (Math.PI * 2), (Math.PI / 24), objAim, objAim);
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }

                                        if ((this.dist2 > 245 && objDst > 245) && (this.dist2 <= 280 && objDst <= 280)) {
                                            this.placer(2, (nEA - Math.PI / 3), (nEA + Math.PI / 3), (Math.PI / 18), nEA, nEA);
                                        }
                                        else {

                                            if (objDst <= 145 && weaponReady) this.placer(2, 0, (Math.PI * 2), (Math.PI / 24), objAim, objAim);

                                            if (/spik/.test(n.name) && this.dist2 <= 112 && objDst <= 80) checkPlace(2, perfectAim);
                                            else {
                                                if (objDst <= 212 && this.dist2 <= 212) {
                                                    if (objDst <= 70) {
                                                        checkPlace(2, objAim + Math.PI);
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            }

                                            if (["pit trap"].includes(n.name)) {
                                                place(2, aiming);

                                                if (this.dist2 <= 232) {
                                                    checkPlace(2, radianPlace);
                                                    this.placer(2, (0), (Math.PI * 2), (Math.PI / 24), objAim, objAim);
                                                } else {
                                                    player.items[4] == 15 && this.placer(4, (Math.PI / 2), (Math.PI / 2), (Math.PI / 18), objAim + Math.PI);
                                                }
                                            } else if (/spik/.test(n.name)) {
                                                place(2, aiming);

                                                if (this.dist2 <= 222) {
                                                    checkPlace(2, aimTo);

                                                    this.placer(2, (nEA - Math.PI / 3), (nEA + Math.PI / 3), (Math.PI / 18), nEA, nEA);
                                                } else {
                                                    player.items[4] == 15 && this.placer(4, (Math.PI / 2), (Math.PI / 2), (Math.PI / 18), objAim + Math.PI);
                                                }
                                            } else {
                                                checkPlace(2, aiming);

                                                if (this.dist2 <= 133 && weaponReady) this.placer(2, (Math.PI / 2), (Math.PI / 2), (Math.PI / 18), objAim + Math.PI);

                                                if (this.dist2 <= 225) {
                                                    checkPlace(2, radian);
                                                } else {
                                                    player.items[4] == 15 && this.placer(4, (Math.PI / 2), (Math.PI / 2), (Math.PI / 18), objAim + Math.PI);
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }

                                    if (this.dist2 >= 205 && weaponReady && (ticks.tick % 2) === 0) {
                                        player.items[4] == 15 && this.placer(4, 0, (2 * Math.PI), (Math.PI / 9), objAim, objAim);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        };
                    }
                };
                function cdf(e, t) {
                    try {
                        return Math.hypot((t.y2 || t.y) - (e.y2 || e.y), (t.x2 || t.x) - (e.x2 || e.x));
                    } catch (e) {
                        return Infinity;
                    }
                }
                function toD(e) {
                    var n = (e / Math.PI * 360) % 360;
                    return n >= 360 ? n - 360 : n;
                }
                function toR(e) {
                    var n = (e * Math.PI / 180) % (2 * Math.PI);
                    return n > Math.PI ? Math.PI - n : n
                }
                window.spikeTickDst = 200;
                function killObject(sid) {
                    let findObj = findObjectBySid(sid);
                    if (PlacementCoreV2.isNewPlacementEnabled()) {
                        // PlacementCoreV2 owns Auto Replace + Preplace reactively: it
                        // computes the replacement role/geometry itself (see
                        // onObjectRemoved), reusing a pre-armed plan when one exists
                        // (preplace) or building a fresh one on the spot otherwise, and it
                        // checks the #autoReplace toggle internally. `findObj` here is the
                        // object as it existed the instant BEFORE removal, so its
                        // role/owner/trap/dmg flags are still valid; the removal itself
                        // still happens via disableBySid below, same as the legacy path.
                        // This disable must always run to keep the client's own object
                        // list in sync with the server, regardless of whether a reactive
                        // replace fires below -- unconditional, exactly as before.
                        objectManager.disableBySid(sid);
                        // FIX v9 (explicit user request: "killObject player.alive &&
                        // enemy.length даже после смерти или без игрока работает preplace.
                        // Это странно"): scope Auto Replace/Preplace's REACTIVE trigger
                        // (this call site) to only fire while the player is alive AND at
                        // least one enemy is currently in sight (enemy.length) -- the same
                        // player.alive+enemy.length rule now also applied to the
                        // PROACTIVE autoplace tick() dispatch below, so both paths agree
                        // on one consistent gate. NOTE: PlacementCoreV2.onObjectRemoved()
                        // already refuses internally once the player is dead
                        // (playerIsActive(), the v6 fix using the real `inGame` death
                        // signal rather than the client's never-updated `player.alive`) --
                        // this adds the FURTHER, explicitly requested enemy.length
                        // requirement on top, which playerIsActive() does not itself
                        // enforce (self-hold-restore-with-no-enemy was previously allowed
                        // to run by design, per the v3/v4 "умный реплейс" fix); per this
                        // explicit request that specific case is intentionally no longer
                        // triggered from here.
                        if (player.alive && inGame && enemy.length && near.dist2 <= 300) {
                            PlacementCoreV2.onObjectRemoved(sid, findObj);
                        }
                        return;
                    }
                    // LEGACY FALLBACK (byte-for-byte the original killObject body): only
                    // reached if PlacementCoreV2 has been explicitly disabled from the
                    // console via window.__valueUseNewPlacement = false.
                    objectManager.disableBySid(sid);
                    let n = findObj;
                    if (n && cdf(player, n) < 300) {
                        if (enemy.length) {
                            let enemya = near;
                            let A = player;
                            let dist = cdf(A, enemya);
                            let dir = caf(A, enemya);
                            let dir2 = caf(player, dir + toR(180));//this dir can works to laggy players
                            let ignore = [0, 0];
                            let placec = function(t, f) {
                                checkPlace(t, f);
                            }
                            if (dist < 500) {
                                let range = items.weapons[player.weapons[0]].range + 70;
                                let nearTrap = gameObjects.filter(e => e.trap && e.active && UTILS.getDist(e, tmpObj, 0, 2) <= (tmpObj.scale + e.getScale() + 5) && e.isTeamObject(tmpObj)).sort(function(a, b) {
                                    return UTILS.getDist(a, tmpObj, 0, 2) - UTILS.getDist(b, tmpObj, 0, 2);
                                })[0];
                                for(let i = 0; i != 2; i++) {
                                    if (dist < 200) {
                                        for(let i = 0; i < Math.PI; i += toR(items.list[A.items[2]].scale)) {
                                            let placed;
                                            let a = Math.hypot(tmpObj.y-player.y, tmpObj.x-player.x);
                                            let e = {
                                                x: tmpObj.x + (100 * Math.cos(Math.atan2(tmpObj.y-player.y, tmpObj.x-player.x))),
                                                y: tmpObj.y + (100 * Math.sin(Math.atan2(tmpObj.y-player.y, tmpObj.x-player.x)))
                                            }
                                            if (ignore[0]) {
                                                placed = false;
                                                ignore[0]--;
                                            } else {
                                                if (Math.hypot(tmpObj.x - player.x, tmpObj.y - tmpObj.y) <= 164) {
                                                    if (UTILS.getAngleDist(dir2 + i, dir2 - i) > toR(items.list[A.items[2]].scale) * 1.8) {
                                                        placec(2, (dir + Math.PI / 18) * i) && (i);
                                                    } else {
                                                        if(Math.hypot(tmpObj.y - player.y, tmpObj.x - player.x) > 100) {
                                                            if(Math.abs(Math.atan2(tmpObj.y - player.y, tmpObj.x - player.x) - toR(items.list[A.items[2]].scale)) > Math.PI / 4) {
                                                                placec(2, Math.atan2(tmpObj.y - player.y, tmpObj.x - player.x) + Math.PI / 2);
                                                            } else {
                                                                placec(2, Math.atan2(tmpObj.y - player.y, tmpObj.x - player.x) - Math.PI / 2);
                                                            }
                                                        } else {
                                                            let b = Math.atan2(player.y - e.y, player.x - e.x)
                                                            , c = e.x + ((35 + items.list[player.items[2]].scale) * Math.cos(b))
                                                            , d = e.y + ((35 + items.list[player.items[2]].scale) * Math.sin(b));
                                                            placec(2, Math.atan2(d - player.y, c - player.x));
                                                        }
                                                    }
                                                } else {
                                                    if(nearTrap && dist <= 77 + items.list[A.items[4]].scale){
                                                        placec(2, Math.atan2(tmpObj.y - player.y, tmpObj.x - player.x) + (a / items.list[A.items[4]].scale));
                                                        placec(2, Math.atan2(tmpObj.y - player.y, tmpObj.x - player.x) - (a / items.list[A.items[4]].scale));
                                                    }
                                                    else{
                                                        placec(2, (dir || dir2) + i) && (toD(i) < items.list[A.items[2]].scale && (ignore[1] = Math.ceil(items.list[A.items[2]].scale / toD(Math.PI / 12))), placed = true);
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            }
                                            placed && (ignore[0] = Math.ceil(items.list[A.items[2]].scale / toD(Math.PI / 12)));
                                            if (!placed || UTILS.getAngleDist(dir + i, dir - i) > toR(items.list[A.items[2]].scale)) {
                                                if (ignore[1]) {
                                                    ignore[1]--;
                                                } else {
                                                    if (nearTrap && dist <= 52 + Math.ceil(items.list[A.items[4]].scale / toD(Math.PI / 12))) {
                                                        placec(2, Math.atan2(e.y-player.y, tmpObj.x-player.x));
                                                    } else {
                                                        placec(2, dir - i) && (ignore[1] = Math.ceil(items.list[A.items[2]].scale / toD(Math.PI / 12)))
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            }
                                        }
                                        placec(4, toR(toD(dir) - 180));
                                    } else {
                                        let ignore = 0;
                                        if (ignore) {
                                            ignore--;
                                        } else {
                                            for(let i = 0; i < Math.PI/2; i += Math.PI / 3) {
                                                checkPlace(4, dir + i) && (ignore = Math.ceil(50 / Math.PI / 6));
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
