                // UPDATE UPGRADES:
                var tmpList = [];
                let stopSend = false;
                let upgradeLoop = 0;

                function updateUpgrades(points, age) {
                    player.upgradePoints = points;
                    player.upgrAge = age;
                    upgradeLoop = points;
                    if (points > 0) {
                        tmpList.length = 0;
                        UTILS.removeAllChildren(upgradeHolder);
                        for (var i = 0; i < items.weapons.length; ++i) {
                            if (items.weapons[i].age == age && (items.weapons[i].pre == undefined || player.weapons.indexOf(items.weapons[i].pre) >= 0)) {
                                var e = UTILS.generateElement({
                                    id: "upgradeItem" + i,
                                    class: "actionBarItem",
                                    onmouseout: function() {
                                        showItemInfo();
                                    },
                                    parent: upgradeHolder,
                                });
                                e.style.backgroundImage = getEl("actionBarItem" + i).style.backgroundImage;
                                tmpList.push(i);
                            }
                        }
                        for (var i = 0; i < items.list.length; ++i) {
                            if (items.list[i].age == age && (items.list[i].pre == undefined || player.items.indexOf(items.list[i].pre) >= 0)) {
                                var tmpI = items.weapons.length + i;
                                var e = UTILS.generateElement({
                                    id: "upgradeItem" + tmpI,
                                    class: "actionBarItem",
                                    onmouseout: function() {
                                        showItemInfo();
                                    },
                                    parent: upgradeHolder,
                                });
                                e.style.backgroundImage = getEl("actionBarItem" + tmpI).style.backgroundImage;
                                tmpList.push(tmpI);
                            }
                        }
                        for (var i = 0; i < tmpList.length; i++) {
                            (function(i) {
                                var tmpItem = getEl("upgradeItem" + i);
                                tmpItem.onmouseover = function() {
                                    if (items.weapons[i]) {
                                        showItemInfo(items.weapons[i], true);
                                    } else {
                                        showItemInfo(items.list[i - items.weapons.length]);
                                    }
                                }
                                ;
                                tmpItem.onclick = UTILS.checkTrusted(function() {
                                    if (!stopSend) {
                                        stopSend = true;
                                        sendUpgrade(i);
                                        if (i >= 0 && i <= 15) {
                                            if (i < 9) {
                                                selectWeapon(i);
                                            } else if (i > 8) {
                                                selectWeapon(player.weapons[0]);
                                            }
                                        }
                                        setTimeout(()=>{
                                            stopSend = false;
                                        }
                                                   , window.pingTime * 1.2);
                                    }
                                });
                                UTILS.hookTouchEvents(tmpItem);
                            }
                            )(tmpList[i]);
                        }
                        if (tmpList.length) {
                            upgradeHolder.style.display = "block";
                            upgradeCounter.style.display = "block";
                            upgradeCounter.innerHTML = "";
                            if (getEl("aaauaua").checked) {
                                autoUpgrade(getEl("autoupgrade").value);
                            }
                        } else {
                            upgradeHolder.style.display = "none";
                            upgradeCounter.style.display = "none";
                            showItemInfo();
                        }
                    } else {
                        upgradeHolder.style.display = "none";
                        upgradeCounter.style.display = "none";
                        showItemInfo();
                    }
                }

                function sendUpgrade(index) {
                    player.reloads[index] = 0;
                    io.send("6", index);
                }
                let upgrading = false;
                let upgradeType = "ae86modnocapezez";

                function autoUpgrade(value) {
                    let doUpgrade = function(t) {
                        if (!upgrading) {
                            if (getEl("upgradeItem" + t) && getEl("upgradeItem" + t).style.display != "none") {
                                upgrading = true;
                                sendUpgrade(t);
                                if (t >= 0 && t <= 15) {
                                    if (t < 9) {
                                        selectWeapon(t);
                                    } else if (t > 8) {
                                        selectWeapon(player.weapons[0]);
                                    }
                                }
                                setTimeout(()=>{
                                    upgrading = false;
                                }
                                           , window.pingTime);
                            }
                        }
                    };
                    if (value == "dh") {
                        if (upgradeType != "kh" && upgradeType != "sm") {
                            setTickout(()=>{
                                upgradeType = "dh";
                                doUpgrade(7);
                                doUpgrade(17);
                                doUpgrade(31);
                                doUpgrade(27);
                                doUpgrade(10);
                                doUpgrade(38);
                                doUpgrade(28);
                                doUpgrade(25);
                            }, 1);
                        }
                    } else if (value == "kh") {
                        if (upgradeType != "dh" && upgradeType != "sm") {
                            setTickout(()=>{
                                upgradeType = "kh";
                                doUpgrade(3);
                                doUpgrade(17);
                                doUpgrade(31);
                                doUpgrade(27);
                                doUpgrade(10);
                                doUpgrade(38);
                                doUpgrade(4);
                                doUpgrade(25);
                            }, 1);
                        }
                    } else if (value == "sm") {
                        if (upgradeType != "dh" && upgradeType != "kh") {
                            setTickout(()=>{
                                upgradeType = "sm";
                                doUpgrade(3);
                                doUpgrade(17);
                                doUpgrade(31);
                                doUpgrade(23);
                                doUpgrade(9);
                                doUpgrade(38);
                            }, 1);
                        }
                    } else if (value == "ph") {
                        if (upgradeType != "dh" && upgradeType != "sm" && upgradeType != "kh") {
                            setTickout(()=>{
                                upgradeType = "ph";
                                doUpgrade(5);
                                doUpgrade(17);
                                doUpgrade(31);
                                doUpgrade(27);
                                doUpgrade(10);
                                doUpgrade(38);
                                doUpgrade(4);
                                doUpgrade(25);
                            }, 1);
                        }
                    }
                }

                    if (getEl("aaauaua").checked) {

                // UPDATE AGE:
                function updateAge(xp, mxp, age) {
                    if (xp != undefined)
                        player.XP = xp;
                    if (mxp != undefined)
                        player.maxXP = mxp;
                    if (age != undefined)
                        player.age = age;
                    if (age == config.maxAge) {
                        ageText.innerHTML = "MAX AGE";
                        ageBarBody.style.width = getEl("combat").value == "cele" || getEl("combat").value == "ae" ? "0%" : "100%";
                    } else {
                        ageText.innerHTML = "AGE " + player.age;
                        if (getEl("combat").value == "hans" || getEl("combat").value == "EwV" || getEl("combat").value == "hae" || getEl("combat").value == "goofy" || getEl("combat").value == "devs") {
                            ageBarBody.style.transition = "1s";
                        } else {
                            ageBarBody.style.transition = null;
                        }
                        ageBarBody.style.width = (getEl("combat").value == "cele" || getEl("combat").value == "ae" ? "0" : (player.XP / player.maxXP) * 100) + "%";
                    }
                }

                    UTILS.removeAllChildren(leaderboardData);

                                    text: (getEl("combat").value == "zeph" ? "{" + data[i] + "} " : "") + tmpC + ". " + (data[i + 1] != "" ? data[i + 1] : "unknown"),
                                }), UTILS.generateElement({

                    }

                // UPDATE GAME:
                let freeCam = {
                    active: false,
                    dir: undefined,
                };
                function BuildPosition(id, x, y, building, angle, buildRadius, xOffset, yOffset) {
                    this.id = id
                    this.x = x
                    this.y = y
                    this.building = building
                    this.angle = angle
                    this.buildRadius = buildRadius

                    this.radius = 2

                    this.color = "#479e00"

                    this.canBuild = true
                    this.obstacle = null
                    this.phantomObstacle = null

                    this.setTo = function(x, y) {
                        this.x = x
                        this.y = y

                        this.buildX = this.x - (this.building.scale / 2 + Math.abs(this.building.placeOffset * 2)) * Math.cos(this.angle)
                        this.buildY = this.y - (this.building.scale / 2 + Math.abs(this.building.placeOffset * 2)) * Math.sin(this.angle)
                    }

                    this.setTo(this.x, this.y)

                    this.update = function() {
                        for (let i = 0; i < gameObjects.length; i++) {
                            const building = i;

                            if (!building.active) continue

                            const distance = Math.hypot(this.y - building.y, this.x - building.x) - (building.getScale ? building.getScale() : building.scale)
                            const angle = Math.atan2(building.y - this.y, building.x - this.x)

                            if (!isOnScreen(building.x - xOffset, building.y - yOffset, building.scale + (building.blocker || 0))) continue

                            if (!this.canBuild && this.obstacle) {
                                if (building.sid === this.obstacle.sid) {
                                    if (distance > this.radius) {
                                        this.canBuild = true
                                        this.obstacle = null

                                        building.isObstacle = false

                                        continue
                                    } else {
                                        break
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    continue
                                }
                            }

                            if (!this.canBuild && this.phantomObstacle) {
                                if (building.sid === this.phantomObstacle.sid) {
                                    if (distance > this.radius) {
                                        this.canBuild = true
                                        this.phantomObstacle = null

                                        continue
                                    } else {
                                        break
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    continue
                                }
                            }

                            if (distance > this.radius) continue

                            this.canBuild = false
                            this.phantomObstacle = building

                            !building.isObstacle && (this.obstacle = building)

                            building.isObstacle = true
                        }
                    }
                }

                const buildPositions = new Map();

                function updateBuildPosition(xOffset, yOffset) {
                    buildPositions.active = false;

                    for (var i = 0, len = items.list.length; i < len; i++) {
                        var building = items.list[i];
                    }

                    buildPositions.oldBuilding = building;

                    const radius = tmpObj.scale * 2 + building.scale + Math.abs(building.placeOffset);
                    const steps = radius;

                    for (let j = 0; j < steps; j++) {
                        const angle = (2 * Math.PI * j) / steps;
                        const x = tmpObj.x + radius * Math.cos(angle);
                        const y = tmpObj.y + radius * Math.sin(angle);

                        if (buildPositions.has(j)) {
                            buildPositions.get(j).setTo(x, y);
                            continue;
                        }

                        buildPositions.set(j, new BuildPosition(j, x, y, building, angle, radius, xOffset, yOffset));
                    }

                    buildPositions.active = true;
                }

                function renderFreeBuildPositions(xOffset, yOffset) {
                    const building = items.list[tmpObj.buildIndex];
                    const freePositions = Array.from(buildPositions.values()).filter((buildPosition) => buildPosition.canBuild);

                    for (var i = 0; i < freePositions.length; ++i) {
                        const freePosition = freePositions[i];
                        const positions = freePositions.filter((position) => position.id !== freePosition.id && position.isCanBuild);
                        const nearPosition = positions.sort((a, b) =>
                                                            Math.hypot(a.buildY - freePosition.buildY, a.buildX - freePosition.buildX) -
                                                            Math.hypot(b.buildY - freePosition.buildY, b.buildX - freePosition.buildX)
                                                           )[0];

                        if (nearPosition) {
                            const distance = Math.hypot(nearPosition.buildY - freePosition.buildY, nearPosition.buildX - freePosition.buildX);

                            if (distance <= freePosition.building.scale) continue;
                        }
                        const isCanBuild = objectManager.checkItemLocation(freePosition.buildX, freePosition.buildY, freePosition.building.scale, 0.6, freePosition.building.id, false, player)

                        if (isCanBuild) {
                            buildPositions.get(freePosition.id).isCanBuild = true;
                            mainContext.save();
                            mainContext.fillStyle = "#3896ad";
                            mainContext.strokeStyle = "#2a7183";
                            mainContext.lineWidth = freePosition.radius;
                            mainContext.beginPath();
                            mainContext.globalAlpha = .25;
                            renderCircle(freePosition.buildX - xOffset, freePosition.buildY - yOffset, freePosition.building.scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                            mainContext.fill();
                            mainContext.globalAlpha = .55;
                            renderCircle(freePosition.buildX - xOffset, freePosition.buildY - yOffset, freePosition.building.scale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                            mainContext.stroke();
                            mainContext.restore();
                        } else {
                            buildPositions.get(freePosition.id).isCanBuild = false;
                        }
                    }
                }
                function updateGame() {
                    if (true) {
                        // UPDATE DIRECTION:
                        if (player) {
                            if (!lastSent || now - lastSent >= 1000 / config.clientSendRate) {
                                lastSent = now;
                            }
                        }
                        // DEATH TEXT:
                        if (deathTextScale < 120) {
                            deathTextScale += 0.1 * delta;
                            diedText.style.fontSize = Math.min(Math.round(deathTextScale), 120) + "px";
                        }
                        // MOVE CAMERA:
                        if (player) {
                            if (freeCam.active) {
                                if (freeCam.dir !== undefined) {
                                    camX += 20 * Math.cos(freeCam.dir);
                                    camY += 20 * Math.sin(freeCam.dir);
                                }
                            } else {
                                const cameraMode = getEl("smoothCamera").value;
                                // Legacy camera modes from badcode. They use targets rather
                                // than changing gameplay camera state; only render camX/camY.
                                if (cameraMode === "Cam1") {
                                    // Mouse lead, using the real viewport centre instead of
                                    // the old fixed 1920px reference (which caused jumps).
                                    const viewportW = window.innerWidth || 1920;
                                    const viewportH = window.innerHeight || 1080;
                                    const targetCamX = player.x + ((mouseX - viewportW / 2) / 20);
                                    const targetCamY = player.y + ((mouseY - viewportH / 2) / 20);
                                    camX += (targetCamX - camX) * 0.18;
                                    camY += (targetCamY - camY) * 0.18;
                                } else if (cameraMode === "Cam0") {
                                    const targetCamX = player.x + 32;
                                    const targetCamY = player.y + 32;
                                    camX += (targetCamX - camX) * 0.10;
                                    camY += (targetCamY - camY) * 0.10;
                                } else if (cameraMode === "Cam2" || cameraMode === "Cam3") {
                                    const targetCamX = player.x + 32;
                                    const targetCamY = player.y + 32;
                                    camX += (targetCamX - camX) * 0.016;
                                    camY += (targetCamY - camY) * 0.016;
                                } else if (cameraMode === "Cam4") {
                                    // Camera 4: slow centred cinematic follow.
                                    camX += (player.x - camX) * 0.008;
                                    camY += (player.y - camY) * 0.008;
                                } else if (cameraMode === "Cam+") {
                                    // A stable fast follow. The former delta-based 0.08 speed
                                    // could snap on a long frame and create visible flashing.
                                    camX += (player.x - camX) * 0.22;
                                    camY += (player.y - camY) * 0.22;
                                } else {
                                    const tmpDist = UTILS.getDistance(camX, camY, player.x, player.y);
                                    const tmpDir = UTILS.getDirection(player.x, player.y, camX, camY);
                                    const nearDistCount = [null, undefined, NaN, Infinity];
                                    let tmpSpeed;
                                    if (cameraMode === "0.00065") {
                                        tmpSpeed = nearDistCount.some(function (count) { return near.dist2 === count; }) || near.dist2 > 300 ? 0.0045 : 0.00065;
                                    } else tmpSpeed = parseFloat(cameraMode);
                                    const camSpd = Math.min(tmpSpeed * tmpDist * delta, tmpDist);
                                    if (tmpDist > 0.05) {
                                        camX += camSpd * Math.cos(tmpDir);
                                        camY += camSpd * Math.sin(tmpDir);
                                    } else {
                                        camX = player.x;
                                        camY = player.y;
                                    }
                                }
                                // Never allow a malformed mouse/camera value to poison the
                                // canvas offset; NaN offsets render as a flashing screen.
                                if (!Number.isFinite(camX) || !Number.isFinite(camY)) {
                                    camX = player.x;
                                    camY = player.y;
                                }
                            }
                        } else {
                            camX = config.mapScale / 2;
                            camY = config.mapScale / 2;
                        }
                        // INTERPOLATE PLAYERS AND AI:
                        var lastTime = now - 1000 / config.serverUpdateRate;
                        var tmpDiff;
                        for (var i = 0; i < players.length + ais.length; ++i) {
                            tmpObj = players[i] || ais[i - players.length];
                            if (tmpObj && tmpObj.visible) {
                                if (tmpObj.forcePos) {
                                    tmpObj.x = tmpObj.x2;
                                    tmpObj.y = tmpObj.y2;
                                    tmpObj.dir = tmpObj.d2;
                                } else {
                                    var total = tmpObj.t2 - tmpObj.t1;
                                    var fraction = lastTime - tmpObj.t1;
                                    var ratio = fraction / total;
                                    var rate = 170;
                                    var rate2 = config.tickRate;
                                    tmpObj.dt += delta;
                                    tmpObj.rt = Math.min(1, tmpObj.dt / config.tickRate);
                                    var tmpRate = Math.min(1.7, tmpObj.dt / rate);
                                    var tmpDiff = tmpObj.x2 - tmpObj.x1;
                                    tmpObj.x = tmpObj.x1 + tmpDiff * tmpRate;
                                    tmpDiff = tmpObj.y2 - tmpObj.y1;
                                    tmpObj.y = tmpObj.y1 + tmpDiff * tmpRate;
                                    tmpObj.dir = Math.lerpAngle(tmpObj.d2, tmpObj.d1, Math.min(1.2, ratio));
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        // RENDER CORDS:
                        var xOffset = camX - maxScreenWidth / 2;
                        var yOffset = camY - maxScreenHeight / 2;
                        // RENDER BACKGROUND:
                        let biomeColor = getEl("combat").value == "me" || getEl("combat").value == "fz" || getEl("combat").value == "Jet" ? dayCycle ? nightColors : dayColors : getEl("combat").value == "dev" || getEl("combat").value == "fr"  ? dayCycles ? nightColors : dayColors : dayColors
                        if (config.snowBiomeTop - yOffset <= 0 && config.mapScale - config.snowBiomeTop - yOffset >= maxScreenHeight) {
                            mainContext.fillStyle = biomeColor.grass;
                            mainContext.fillRect(0, 0, maxScreenWidth, maxScreenHeight);
                        } else if (config.mapScale - config.snowBiomeTop - yOffset <= 0) {
                            mainContext.fillStyle = biomeColor.desert;
                            mainContext.fillRect(0, 0, maxScreenWidth, maxScreenHeight);
                        } else if (config.snowBiomeTop - yOffset >= maxScreenHeight) {
                            mainContext.fillStyle = biomeColor.snow;
                            mainContext.fillRect(0, 0, maxScreenWidth, maxScreenHeight);
                        } else if (config.snowBiomeTop - yOffset >= 0) {
                            mainContext.fillStyle = biomeColor.snow;
                            mainContext.fillRect(0, 0, maxScreenWidth, config.snowBiomeTop - yOffset);
                            mainContext.fillStyle = biomeColor.grass;
                            mainContext.fillRect(0, config.snowBiomeTop - yOffset, maxScreenWidth, maxScreenHeight - (config.snowBiomeTop - yOffset));
                        } else {
                            mainContext.fillStyle = biomeColor.grass;
                            mainContext.fillRect(0, 0, maxScreenWidth, config.mapScale - config.snowBiomeTop - yOffset);
                            mainContext.fillStyle = biomeColor.desert;
                            mainContext.fillRect(0, config.mapScale - config.snowBiomeTop - yOffset, maxScreenWidth, maxScreenHeight - (config.mapScale - config.snowBiomeTop - yOffset));
                        }
                        // RENDER WATER AREAS:
                        if (!firstSetup) {
                            waterMult += waterPlus * config.waveSpeed * delta;
                            if (waterMult >= config.waveMax) {
                                waterMult = config.waveMax;
                                waterPlus = -1;
                            } else if (waterMult <= 1) {
                                waterMult = waterPlus = 1;
                            }
                            mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
                            mainContext.fillStyle = biomeColor.desert;
                            renderWaterBodies(xOffset, yOffset, mainContext, getEl("combat").value == "me" ? 1440 : config.riverPadding);
                            mainContext.fillStyle = biomeColor.river;
                            renderWaterBodies(xOffset, yOffset, mainContext, (waterMult - 1) * 250);
                        }
                        // RENDER GRID:
                        if (getEl("combat").value != "cele" && getEl("combat").value != "zeph" && getEl("combat").value != "sal" && getEl("combat").value != "chick" && getEl("combat").value != "gt86" && getEl("combat").value != "blism" &&getEl("combat").value != "fr" && getEl("combat").value != "chick1" && getEl("combat").value != "ar" && getEl("combat").value != "s0" && getEl("combat").value != "s1" && getEl("combat").value != "s2" && getEl("combat").value != "ueh1") {
                            mainContext.lineWidth = getEl("combat").value == "me" ? 3 : 4;
                            mainContext.strokeStyle = "#000";
                            mainContext.globalAlpha = getEl("combat").value == "me" ? 0.05 : 0.06;
                            mainContext.beginPath();
                            let ratfrr = (getEl("combat").value == "me" ? 120 : getEl("combat").value == "black" ? 30 : getEl("combat").value == "devs" ? 110 : getEl("combat").value == "zyenith" || getEl("combat").value == "TesterMode" || getEl("combat").value == "Totalew" || getEl("combat").value == "Pixelz" || getEl("combat").value == "2yl" ||getEl("combat").value == "Uncve"||getEl("combat").value == "hae" ? 1440 : 60);
                            if (getEl("combat").value == "hans" || getEl("combat").value == "devs" || getEl("combat").value == "dev" || getEl("combat").value == "syl" || getEl("combat").value == "kto" || getEl("combat").value == "obs") {
                                for (var r = -camX; r < maxScreenWidth; r += maxScreenHeight / 18) {
                                    if (r > 0) {
                                        mainContext.moveTo(r, 0);
                                        mainContext.lineTo(r, maxScreenHeight);
                                    }
                                }
                                for (var f = -camY; f < maxScreenHeight; f += maxScreenHeight / 18) {
                                    if (r > 0) {
                                        mainContext.moveTo(0, f);
                                        mainContext.lineTo(maxScreenWidth, f);
                                    }
                                }
                            } else {
                                for (var x = -xOffset % ratfrr; x < maxScreenWidth; x += ratfrr) {
                                    if (x > 0) {
                                        mainContext.moveTo(x, 0);
                                        mainContext.lineTo(x, maxScreenHeight);
                                    }
                                }
                                for (var y = -yOffset % ratfrr; y < maxScreenHeight; y += ratfrr) {
                                    if (y > 0) {
                                        mainContext.moveTo(0, y);
                                        mainContext.lineTo(maxScreenWidth, y);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            mainContext.stroke();
                        }
                        // RENDER DEAD PLAYERS:
                        mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
                        mainContext.strokeStyle = outlineColor;
                        renderDeadPlayers(xOffset, yOffset);
                        // RENDER BOTTOM LAYER:
                        mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
                        mainContext.strokeStyle = outlineColor;
                        renderGameObjects(-1, xOffset, yOffset);
                        // RENDER PROJECTILES:
                        mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
                        mainContext.lineWidth = outlineWidth;
                        renderProjectiles(0, xOffset, yOffset);
                        // RENDER PLAYERS:
                        renderPlayers(xOffset, yOffset, 0);
                        // RENDER AI:
                        mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
                        for (var i = 0; i < ais.length; ++i) {
                            tmpObj = ais[i];
                            if (tmpObj.active && tmpObj.visible) {
                                tmpObj.animate(delta);
                                mainContext.save();
                                mainContext.translate(tmpObj.x - xOffset, tmpObj.y - yOffset);
                                mainContext.rotate(tmpObj.dir + tmpObj.dirPlus - Math.PI / 2);
                                renderAI(tmpObj, mainContext);
                                mainContext.restore();
                            }
                        }
                        // RENDER GAME OBJECTS (LAYERED):
                        renderGameObjects(0, xOffset, yOffset);
                        renderProjectiles(1, xOffset, yOffset);
                        renderGameObjects(1, xOffset, yOffset);
                        renderPlayers(xOffset, yOffset, 1);
                        renderGameObjects(2, xOffset, yOffset);
                        renderGameObjects(3, xOffset, yOffset);
                        // AUTOPUSH LINE (v13, explicit user request: "В auto-push было
                        // показано как движется игрок, тоесть линия его прохождения. То
                        // как он идет, посмотри оригинальный код она там вроде есть" -- confirmed
                        // present in the reference userscript, uploads/"Текстовый
                        // документ (1488).txt" ~line 12656, under its own "//
                        // AUTOPUSH LINE:" comment, gated on `my.autoPush` (this file's own
                        // `pushState.active`) and drawing `player -> pushData.x2,y2 ->
                        // pushData.x,y` -- i.e. the walking line THROUGH the escape point
                        // (autoPush()'s own `pos.x2,y2`, 250 units past the spike) and
                        // ending AT the spike's own position (autoPush()'s own `pos.x,y`),
                        // so the player can see exactly which gap autoPush() is walking
                        // them through -- matching the reference geometry/field names
                        // exactly (`pushState.data` is the direct equivalent of the
                        // reference's own `my.pushData`, already populated with the SAME
                        // x/y/x2/y2 fields inside autoPush() itself, see its own
                        // `pushState.data = { x: spike.x, y: spike.y, x2: pos.x2, y2:
                        // pos.y2 }` assignment).
                        if (player && pushState.active && pushState.data) {
                            mainContext.save();
                            mainContext.lineWidth = 5;
                            mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
                            mainContext.lineCap = "round";
                            mainContext.beginPath();
                            mainContext.strokeStyle = "#fff";
                            mainContext.moveTo(player.x - xOffset, player.y - yOffset);
                            mainContext.lineTo(pushState.data.x2 - xOffset, pushState.data.y2 - yOffset);
                            mainContext.lineTo(pushState.data.x - xOffset, pushState.data.y - yOffset);
                            mainContext.stroke();
                            mainContext.restore();
                        }
                        // AUTO-MOD MOVEMENT LINE (v14, explicit user request: "Нужно
                        // сделать линию отходящую от игрока (центра) которая
                        // показывает куда идет игрок при auto-mod" -- drawn the exact same
                        // way as the Auto-Push line just above it (same white colour,
                        // same 5px round-cap stroke), a single ray FROM the player's own
                        // position outward in AutoModCore's CURRENT real movement
                        // direction (currentMoveDirForTrail(), the same value literally
                        // just sent to the server this tick -- never a stale/guessed
                        // heading, and correctly absent whenever AutoMod is holding
                        // still, e.g. mid-combat with both strafe directions blocked).
                        // Length is capped at a fixed on-screen distance rather than
                        // drawn all the way to the actual next waypoint, so the line
                        // reads as a clear directional indicator at any zoom level
                        // instead of stretching arbitrarily far off-screen.
                        if (player && AutoModCore.toggleOn()) {

                            const rays = (typeof AutoModCore.getDebugRays === "function" ? AutoModCore.getDebugRays() : []) || [];
                            const path = (typeof AutoModCore.getDebugPath === "function" ? AutoModCore.getDebugPath() : []) || [];
                            const intentDbg = (typeof AutoModCore.getIntentDebug === "function" ? AutoModCore.getIntentDebug() : null);
                            const stateDbg = (AutoModCore._debug && AutoModCore._debug.getState ? AutoModCore._debug.getState() : "AUTO");
                            const px = player.x - xOffset, py = player.y - yOffset;
                            if (path.length || rays.length || autoModDir !== undefined) {
                                mainContext.save();
                                mainContext.lineCap = "round";
                                mainContext.lineJoin = "round";
                                mainContext.font = "11px JetBrains Mono, monospace";

                                        const z = trapZones[tz];
                                        const spr = trapSpriteItem ? getItemSprite({ id: trapSpriteItem.id, scale: trapSpriteItem.scale, name: trapSpriteItem.name, isItem: true }) : null;
                                        mainContext.save();
                                        mainContext.globalAlpha = Math.max(0.08, Math.min(0.60, z.confidence || 0.16));
                                        mainContext.translate(z.x - xOffset, z.y - yOffset);
                                        if (spr && spr.width) mainContext.drawImage(spr, -spr.width / 2, -spr.height / 2);
                                        mainContext.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,60,80,.35)";
                                        mainContext.lineWidth = 2;
                                        mainContext.setLineDash([6, 6]);
                                        mainContext.beginPath();
                                        mainContext.arc(0, 0, z.scale || 50, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                                        mainContext.stroke();
                                        mainContext.restore();
                                    }
                                } catch (_) { }
                                try {
                                    const pGhosts = (typeof AutoModCore.getPlacementGhosts === "function" ? AutoModCore.getPlacementGhosts() : []) || [];

                                        const g = pGhosts[pg];
                                        const item = (typeof items !== "undefined" && items.list) ? items.list.find(function (it) { return it && it.id === g.itemId; }) : null;
                                        const spr = item ? getItemSprite({ id: item.id, scale: item.scale, name: item.name, isItem: true }) : null;

                                        if (spr && spr.width) mainContext.drawImage(spr, -spr.width / 2, -spr.height / 2);
                                        mainContext.rotate(-(Number.isFinite(g.dir) ? g.dir : 0));

                                        mainContext.beginPath(); mainContext.arc(0, 0, g.scale || 50, 0, Math.PI * 2); mainContext.stroke();
                                        mainContext.restore();
                                    }
                                } catch (_) { }
                                function col(type) { return type === "selected" ? "#35ff6b" : type === "risk" ? "#ff9f1c" : type === "blocked" ? "#ff3d3d" : type === "straight" ? "#ffe45c" : "#48d7ff"; }
                                function arrow(x, y, dir, color) {
                                    mainContext.save(); mainContext.translate(x, y); mainContext.rotate(dir); mainContext.fillStyle = color;
                                    mainContext.beginPath(); mainContext.moveTo(11, 0); mainContext.lineTo(-6, 5); mainContext.lineTo(-2, 0); mainContext.lineTo(-6, -5); mainContext.closePath(); mainContext.fill(); mainContext.restore();
                                }
                                function drawWorldPath(points, color, label) {
                                    if (!points || points.length < 2) return;
                                    mainContext.save();
                                    mainContext.globalAlpha = 0.95;
                                    mainContext.lineWidth = 9;
                                    mainContext.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.42)";
                                    mainContext.beginPath();
                                    for (let i = 0; i < points.length; i++) {
                                        const x = points[i].x - xOffset, y = points[i].y - yOffset;
                                        if (i === 0) mainContext.moveTo(x, y); else mainContext.lineTo(x, y);
                                    }
                                    mainContext.stroke();
                                    mainContext.lineWidth = 5;
                                    mainContext.strokeStyle = color;
                                    mainContext.setLineDash([22, 12]);
                                    try { mainContext.lineDashOffset = -(Date.now() / 32); } catch (_) { }
                                    mainContext.beginPath();
                                    for (let i = 0; i < points.length; i++) {
                                        const x = points[i].x - xOffset, y = points[i].y - yOffset;
                                        if (i === 0) mainContext.moveTo(x, y); else mainContext.lineTo(x, y);
                                    }
                                    mainContext.stroke();
                                    mainContext.setLineDash([]);
                                    // waypoint joints: these show every real path displacement, like auto-push polyline.
                                    for (let i = 1; i < points.length - 1; i++) {
                                        mainContext.globalAlpha = 0.9;
                                        mainContext.fillStyle = color;
                                        mainContext.beginPath();
                                        mainContext.arc(points[i].x - xOffset, points[i].y - yOffset, 4.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                                        mainContext.fill();
                                    }
                                    const a = points[points.length - 2], b = points[points.length - 1];
                                    arrow(b.x - xOffset, b.y - yOffset, Math.atan2(b.y - a.y, b.x - a.x), color);
                                    if (label) {
                                        mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
                                        mainContext.fillStyle = color;
                                        mainContext.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.7)";
                                        mainContext.lineWidth = 3;
                                        mainContext.strokeText(label, b.x - xOffset, b.y - yOffset - 15);
                                        mainContext.fillText(label, b.x - xOffset, b.y - yOffset - 15);
                                    }
                                    mainContext.restore();
                                }

                                    mainContext.globalAlpha = ray.type === "blocked" ? .22 : ray.type === "selected" ? .58 : .30;

                                    const my = py + Math.sin(ray.dir) * len * .55 + Math.sin(ray.dir + Math.PI / 2) * (ri % 2 ? 10 : -10);
                                    mainContext.lineTo(mx, my);
                                    mainContext.lineTo(px + Math.cos(ray.dir) * len, py + Math.sin(ray.dir) * len);
                                    mainContext.stroke();
                                    mainContext.setLineDash([]);
                                    mainContext.restore();

                                            mainContext.drawImage(iconSprites[tmpObj.name == "MOOFIE" ? "skull" : "crown"], tmpX, tmpObj.y - yOffset - tmpObj.scale - config.nameY - tmpS / 2 - 5, tmpS, tmpS);
                                        }
                                    }
                                    if (tmpObj.health > 0) {
                                        // HEALTH HOLDER:
                                        var tmpWidth = config.healthBarWidth;
                                        mainContext.fillStyle = darkOutlineColor;
                                        mainContext.roundRect(tmpObj.x - xOffset - config.healthBarWidth - config.healthBarPad, tmpObj.y - yOffset + tmpObj.scale + config.nameY, config.healthBarWidth * 2 + config.healthBarPad * 2, 17, 8);
                                        mainContext.fill();
                                        // HEALTH BAR:
                                        mainContext.fillStyle = "#cc5151";
                                        mainContext.roundRect(tmpObj.x - xOffset - config.healthBarWidth, tmpObj.y - yOffset + tmpObj.scale + config.nameY + config.healthBarPad, config.healthBarWidth * 2 * window.valueSmoothHealthRatio(tmpObj), 17 - config.healthBarPad * 2, 7);
                                        mainContext.fill();
                                        if (tmpObj.name == "MOOSTAFA") {
                                            // MOOSTAFA RELOAD HOLDER:
                                            var tmpWidth = config.healthBarWidth;
                                            mainContext.fillStyle = darkOutlineColor;
                                            mainContext.roundRect(tmpObj.x - xOffset - config.healthBarWidth - config.healthBarPad, tmpObj.y - yOffset + tmpObj.scale + config.nameY - 13, config.healthBarWidth + config.healthBarPad * 2, 17, 8);
                                            mainContext.fill();
                                            // MOOSTAFA RELOAD BAR:
                                            mainContext.fillStyle = outlineColor;
                                            mainContext.roundRect(tmpObj.x - xOffset - config.healthBarWidth, tmpObj.y - yOffset + tmpObj.scale + config.nameY - 13 + config.healthBarPad, config.healthBarWidth * ((600 - tmpObj.weaponReload) / 600), 17 - config.healthBarPad * 2, 7);
                                            mainContext.fill();
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                                   );
                        // RENDER ANIM TEXTS:
                        textManager.update(delta, mainContext, xOffset, yOffset);
                        // RENDER CHAT MESSAGES:
                        players.forEach((tmp)=>{
                            tmpObj = tmp;
                            if (tmpObj.visible && tmpObj.chatCountdown > 0) {
                                // A previous clamp used Math.max(1, ...), which made the
                                // countdown impossible to reach zero. Keep the proven old
                                // behaviour: subtract frame delta and clamp at exactly 0.
                                tmpObj.chatCountdown = Math.max(0, tmpObj.chatCountdown - delta);
                                if (tmpObj.chatCountdown <= 0) return;
                                mainContext.font = "32px Hammersmith One";
                                var tmpSize = mainContext.measureText(tmpObj.chatMessage);
                                mainContext.textBaseline = "middle";
                                mainContext.textAlign = "center";
                                var tmpX = tmpObj.x - xOffset;
                                var tmpY = tmpObj.y - tmpObj.scale - yOffset - 90;
                                var tmpH = 47;
                                var tmpW = tmpSize.width + 17;
                                mainContext.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.2)";
                                mainContext.roundRect(tmpX - tmpW / 2, tmpY - tmpH / 2, tmpW, tmpH, 6);
                                mainContext.fill();
                                mainContext.fillStyle = getEl("combat").value == "gt86" ? isTeam(tmpObj) ? "#c8f799" : "#fabbbb" : "#fff";
                                mainContext.fillText(tmpObj.chatMessage, tmpX, tmpY);
                            }
                        }
                                       );
                    }
                    // RENDER MINIMAP:
                    renderMinimap(delta);
                    // RENDER CONTROLS:
                    if (controllingTouch.id !== -1) {
                        renderControl(controllingTouch.startX, controllingTouch.startY, controllingTouch.currentX, controllingTouch.currentY);
                    }
                    if (attackingTouch.id !== -1) {
                        renderControl(attackingTouch.startX, attackingTouch.startY, attackingTouch.currentX, attackingTouch.currentY);
                    }
                    if (mainContext && (getEl("darkmode").checked || getEl("combat").value == "hans" || getEl("combat").value == "EwV" || getEl("combat").value == "hae" || getEl("combat").value == "goofy" || getEl("combat").value == "devs" || getEl("combat").value == "syl"|| getEl("combat").value == "chick1")) {
                        mainContext.beginPath();
                        let screenW = maxScreenWidth / 2;
                        let screenH = maxScreenHeight / 2;
                        let gradient = mainContext.createRadialGradient(screenW, screenH, 0, screenW, screenH, getEl("combat").value == "hans" || getEl("combat").value == "hae" || getEl("combat").value == "goofy" || getEl("combat").value == "EwV" || getEl("combat").value == "syl" || getEl("combat").value == "devs" ? maxScreenWidth : maxScreenHeight);
                        for (let i = 0; i <= 1; i++) {
                            gradient.addColorStop(i, "rgba(0, 0, 0, " + i + ")");
                        }
                        mainContext.fillStyle = gradient;
                        mainContext.rect(0, 0, maxScreenWidth, maxScreenHeight);
                        mainContext.fill();
                    }
                    window.__valueCompletedRenderFrame = (window.__valueCompletedRenderFrame || 0) + 1;

                }
                // RENDER CONTROL:
                function renderControl(startX, startY, currentX, currentY) {
                    mainContext.save();
                    mainContext.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
                    // mainContext.resetTransform();
                    mainContext.scale(pixelDensity, pixelDensity);
                    var controlRadius = 50;
                    mainContext.beginPath();
                    mainContext.arc(startX, startY, controlRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2, false);
                    mainContext.closePath();
                    mainContext.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)";
                    mainContext.fill();
                    var controlRadius = 50;
                    var offsetX = currentX - startX;
                    var offsetY = currentY - startY;
                    var mag = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(offsetX, 2) + Math.pow(offsetY, 2));
                    var divisor = mag > controlRadius ? mag / controlRadius : 1;
                    offsetX /= divisor;
                    offsetY /= divisor;
                    mainContext.beginPath();
                    mainContext.arc(startX + offsetX, startY + offsetY, controlRadius * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2, false);
                    mainContext.closePath();
                    mainContext.fillStyle = "white";
                    mainContext.fill();
                    mainContext.restore();
                }
                // RENDER PROJECTILES:
                function renderProjectiles(layer, xOffset, yOffset) {
                    for (var i = 0; i < projectiles.length; ++i) {
                        tmpObj = projectiles[i];
                        if (tmpObj.active && tmpObj.layer == layer) {
                            tmpObj.update(delta);
                            if (tmpObj.active && isOnScreen(tmpObj.x - xOffset, tmpObj.y - yOffset, tmpObj.scale)) {
                                mainContext.save();
                                mainContext.translate(tmpObj.x - xOffset, tmpObj.y - yOffset);
                                mainContext.rotate(tmpObj.dir);
                                renderProjectile(0, 0, tmpObj, mainContext, 1);
                                mainContext.restore();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                // RENDER PROJECTILE:
                var projectileSprites = {};

                function renderProjectile(x, y, obj, ctxt, debug) {
                    if (obj.src) {
                        var tmpSrc = items.projectiles[obj.indx].src;
                        var tmpSprite = projectileSprites[tmpSrc];
                        if (!tmpSprite) {
                            tmpSprite = new Image();
                            tmpSprite.onload = function() {
                                this.isLoaded = true;
                            }
                            ;
                            tmpSprite.src = ".././img/weapons/" + tmpSrc + ".png";
                            projectileSprites[tmpSrc] = tmpSprite;
                        }
                        if (tmpSprite.isLoaded)
                            ctxt.drawImage(tmpSprite, x - obj.scale / 2, y - obj.scale / 2, obj.scale, obj.scale);
                    } else if (obj.indx == 1) {
                        ctxt.fillStyle = "#939393";
                        renderCircle(x, y, obj.scale, ctxt);
                    }
                }
                // RENDER WATER BODIES:
                function renderWaterBodies(xOffset, yOffset, ctxt, padding) {
                    // MIDDLE RIVER:
                    var tmpW = config.riverWidth + padding;
                    var tmpY = config.mapScale / 2 - yOffset - tmpW / 2;
                    if (tmpY < maxScreenHeight && tmpY + tmpW > 0) {
                        ctxt.fillRect(0, tmpY, maxScreenWidth, tmpW);
                    }
                }
                function lerpAngle(start, end, t) {
                    const difference = end - start;
                    if (Math.abs(difference) > Math.PI) {
                        if (difference > 0) {
                            end -= 2 * Math.PI;
                        } else {
                            end += 2 * Math.PI;
                        }
                    }
                    return start * (1 - t) + end * t;
                }

                function drawHealth(tmpObj, mainContext, xOffset, yOffset) {
                    const targetHealth = window.valueSmoothHealthRatio(tmpObj);

                    let currentAngle = tmpObj.currentAngle || 0;
                    const diff = currentAngle - Math.PI * 2 * targetHealth;
                    currentAngle -= diff * 0.1;
                    tmpObj.currentAngle = currentAngle;

                    mainContext.save();

                    // Draw only around the damaged object. The previous version also drew
                    // two absolute-position arcs from an unfinished prototype, which
                    // produced the stray grey semicircle on the game canvas.
                    mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
                    mainContext.lineCap = 'round';
                    mainContext.strokeStyle = darkOutlineColor;
                    mainContext.lineWidth = 7;
                    mainContext.beginPath();
                    mainContext.arc(tmpObj.x - xOffset, tmpObj.y - yOffset, tmpObj.scale * 0.54, 0, currentAngle, false);
                    mainContext.stroke();
                    mainContext.beginPath();

                    mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
                    mainContext.lineCap = 'round';
                    mainContext.strokeStyle = tmpObj.isTeamObject(player) ? "#42aaff" : "#6B305E";
                    mainContext.lineWidth = 5;
                    mainContext.beginPath();
                    mainContext.arc(tmpObj.x - xOffset, tmpObj.y - yOffset, tmpObj.scale * 0.54, 0, currentAngle, false);
                    mainContext.stroke();
                    mainContext.beginPath();

                    // Restore the previous state of the rendering context
                    mainContext.restore();
                }
                // Aurora Build Health: a smooth glass-style health display for
                // damaged structures. It is strictly canvas rendering and does not
                // modify object health or game state.
                function renderAuroraBuildHealth(obj, ctxt, x, y) {
                    const maximum = Number(obj.maxHealth) || 1;
                    const target = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (Number(obj.health) || 0) / maximum));
                    let shown = Number(obj.__valueAuroraHealth);
                    if (!Number.isFinite(shown)) shown = target;
                    shown += (target - shown) * 0.16;
                    if (Math.abs(target - shown) < 0.001) shown = target;
                    obj.__valueAuroraHealth = shown;

                    const width = Math.max(56, config.healthBarWidth * 1.65);
                    const height = 11;
                    const left = x - width / 2;
                    const top = y - (obj.scale || 0) - 18;
                    const ally = typeof obj.isTeamObject === "function" && obj.isTeamObject(player);
                    const bright = ally ? "#86efac" : "#b99cff";
                    const deep = ally ? "#22c55e" : "#6d42ba";
                    ctxt.save();
                    ctxt.shadowColor = ally ? "rgba(74,222,128,.55)" : "rgba(178,132,255,.55)";
                    ctxt.shadowBlur = 12;
                    ctxt.fillStyle = "rgba(9,12,19,.86)";
                    ctxt.roundRect(left - 3, top - 3, width + 6, height + 6, 8);
                    ctxt.fill();
                    ctxt.shadowBlur = 0;
                    ctxt.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.10)";
                    ctxt.roundRect(left, top, width, height, 6);
                    ctxt.fill();
                    if (shown > 0) {
                        const gradient = ctxt.createLinearGradient(left, top, left + width, top);
                        gradient.addColorStop(0, deep);
                        gradient.addColorStop(.55, bright);
                        gradient.addColorStop(1, "#f3edff");
                        ctxt.fillStyle = gradient;
                        ctxt.roundRect(left, top, Math.max(2, width * shown), height, 6);
                        ctxt.fill();
                        ctxt.globalAlpha = .45;
                        ctxt.fillStyle = "#fff";
                        ctxt.roundRect(left + 2, top + 2, Math.max(0, width * shown - 4), 2, 2);
                        ctxt.fill();
                    }
                    ctxt.globalAlpha = 1;
                    ctxt.restore();
                }

                // Cached alpha-outline masks prevent a per-frame pixel scan. Each
                // mask is produced from the original sprite, so every spike, mill,
                // turret, wall, resource etc. retains its own real silhouette.
                const valueBuildContourCache = new WeakMap();
                function getBuildContourMask(sprite, color) {
                    if (!sprite || !sprite.width || !sprite.height) return null;
                    let entry = valueBuildContourCache.get(sprite);
                    if (!entry) { entry = {}; valueBuildContourCache.set(sprite, entry); }
                    if (entry[color]) return entry[color];
                    const pad = 4, w = sprite.width + pad * 2, h = sprite.height + pad * 2;
                    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas"); canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h;
                    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
                    // Soft alpha stamps round the contour at sprite corners rather
                    // than leaving the square/pixelated joins of a raw alpha mask.
                    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
                    ctx.filter = "blur(0.65px)";
                    [[-3,0],[3,0],[0,-3],[0,3],[-2,-2],[2,-2],[-2,2],[2,2]].forEach(function (o) {
                        ctx.drawImage(sprite, pad + o[0], pad + o[1]);
                    });
                    ctx.filter = "none";
                    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-out";
                    ctx.drawImage(sprite, pad, pad);
                    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-in";
                    ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
                    entry[color] = canvas;
                    return canvas;
                }
                function renderSpriteContourBuildHealth(obj, x, y) {
                    const sprite = obj.isItem ? getItemSprite(obj) : getResSprite(obj);
                    if (!sprite || !sprite.width || !sprite.height) return;
                    const max = Number(obj.maxHealth) || 1;
                    const target = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(obj.health) / max));
                    let shown = Number(obj.__valueSpriteContourHealth);
                    if (!Number.isFinite(shown)) shown = target;
                    shown += (target - shown) * 0.14;
                    if (Math.abs(target - shown) < 0.001) shown = target;
                    obj.__valueSpriteContourHealth = shown;
                    const ally = typeof obj.isTeamObject === "function" && obj.isTeamObject(player);
                    const live = getBuildContourMask(sprite, ally ? "#3b82f6" : "#ff6574");
                    if (!live) return;
                    const pad = 3, dx = -sprite.width / 2 - pad, dy = -sprite.height / 2 - pad;
                    const reach = Math.hypot(sprite.width, sprite.height) + pad * 2;
                    mainContext.save();
                    mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
                    mainContext.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
                    mainContext.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
                    mainContext.translate(x, y);
                    // Item sprites are rotated by their object direction in the game.
                    if (obj.isItem && Number.isFinite(obj.dir)) mainContext.rotate(obj.dir);
                    if (shown > 0) {
                        // Top point, clockwise. No full dark remainder is painted:
                        // it previously looked like a black line across nearby blocks.
                        mainContext.save();
                        mainContext.beginPath();
                        mainContext.moveTo(0, 0);
                        mainContext.arc(0, 0, reach, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + Math.PI * 2 * shown, false);
                        mainContext.closePath();
                        mainContext.clip();
                        mainContext.drawImage(live, dx, dy);
                        mainContext.restore();
                    }
                    mainContext.restore();
                }

                function getAutoModBreakMark(obj) {
                    try {
                        if (typeof AutoModCore !== "undefined" && AutoModCore && typeof AutoModCore.getBreakMark === "function") return AutoModCore.getBreakMark(obj);
                    } catch (_) { }
                    return null;
                }
                function renderSpriteContourAutoModBreak(obj, x, y) {
                    const mark = getAutoModBreakMark(obj);
                    if (!mark) return;
                    const sprite = obj.isItem ? getItemSprite(obj) : getResSprite(obj);
                    if (!sprite || !sprite.width || !sprite.height) return;
                    const selected = !!mark.selected;
                    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 105 + (obj.sid || 0));
                    const live = getBuildContourMask(sprite, selected ? "#ff1238" : "#ff5b6f");
                    const glow = getBuildContourMask(sprite, "#ff001f");
                    if (!live) return;
                    const pad = 4, dx = -sprite.width / 2 - pad, dy = -sprite.height / 2 - pad;
                    mainContext.save();
                    mainContext.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
                    mainContext.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
                    mainContext.translate(x, y);
                    if (obj.isItem && Number.isFinite(obj.dir)) mainContext.rotate(obj.dir);
                    // big visible red sprite-silhouette marker for objects AutoMod wants
                    // to break / is considering breaking. Draw twice with shadow for
                    // visibility on grass/snow and over busy PvP bases.
                    mainContext.globalAlpha = selected ? (0.92 + pulse * 0.08) : (0.48 + pulse * 0.18);
                    mainContext.shadowColor = selected ? "#ff0022" : "#ff4a5f";
                    mainContext.shadowBlur = selected ? (typeof currentFPS !== "undefined" && currentFPS < 50 ? 8 : 14) : 0;
                    mainContext.drawImage(live, dx, dy);
                    if (selected && glow && !(typeof currentFPS !== "undefined" && currentFPS < 50)) {
                        mainContext.globalAlpha = 0.28 + pulse * 0.18;
                        mainContext.shadowBlur = 16;
                        mainContext.drawImage(glow, dx, dy);
                    }
                    mainContext.shadowBlur = 0;
                    if (selected) {
                        mainContext.globalAlpha = 0.9;
                        mainContext.strokeStyle = "#ff1238";
                        mainContext.lineWidth = 3;
                        mainContext.beginPath();
                        mainContext.arc(0, 0, (obj.getScale ? obj.getScale() : obj.scale) + 10 + pulse * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        mainContext.stroke();
                    }
                    mainContext.restore();
                }

                function applyProximityObjectFade(obj, alpha) {
                    if (!window.ValueProximityObjectFade || !player || !player.alive) return alpha;
                    const dx = obj.x - player.x, dy = obj.y - player.y;
                    const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
                    const nearDistance = (Number(obj.scale) || 0) + (Number(player.scale) || 35) + 24;
                    const target = distance < nearDistance ? 0.30 : 1;
                    let shown = Number(obj.__valueProximityAlpha);
                    if (!Number.isFinite(shown)) shown = target;
                    shown += (target - shown) * 0.18;
                    if (Math.abs(target - shown) < 0.01) shown = target;
                    obj.__valueProximityAlpha = shown;
                    return alpha * shown;
                }

                // RENDER GAME OBJECTS:
                function renderGameObjects(layer, xOffset, yOffset) {
                    var tmpSprite, tmpX, tmpY;
                    gameObjects.forEach((tmp)=>{
                        tmpObj = tmp;
                        if (tmpObj.active) {
                            tmpX = tmpObj.x + tmpObj.xWiggle - xOffset;
                            tmpY = tmpObj.y + tmpObj.yWiggle - yOffset;
                            if (layer == 0) {
                                tmpObj.update(delta);
                            }
                            if (getEl("combat").value != "fr") {
                                if (tmpObj.layer == layer && isOnScreen(tmpX, tmpY, tmpObj.scale + (tmpObj.blocker || 0))) {
                                    const defaultAlpha = tmpObj.hideFromEnemy ? .6 : 1
                                    if (getCheck("darkmode")) {
                                        mainContext.globalAlpha = true ?tmpObj.isDestroying ? 1 - tmpObj.getDestroyAlpha() : defaultAlpha : defaultAlpha;
                                        let camXY = {
                                            x: camX,
                                            y: camY,
                                        };
                                        mainContext.globalAlpha = tmpObj.isDestroying ? 1 - tmpObj.getDestroyAlpha() : Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (720 - UTILS.getDist(tmpObj, camXY, 0, 0)) / 240));
                                    } else {
                                        mainContext.globalAlpha = getCheck("dst") ? tmpObj.isDestroying ? 1 - tmpObj.getDestroyAlpha() : defaultAlpha : defaultAlpha;
                                    }
                                    mainContext.globalAlpha = applyProximityObjectFade(tmpObj, mainContext.globalAlpha);
                                    if (tmpObj.isItem) {
                                        if ((tmpObj.dmg || tmpObj.trap) && getEl("combat").value != "0" && getEl("combat").value != "Uncve2" && getEl("combat").value != "blism" && getEl("combat").value != "kto" && getEl("combat").value != "s0" && getEl("combat").value != "ar" && getEl("combat").value != "ae" && getEl("combat").value != "EwV" && getEl("combat").value != "Jet" && getEl("combat").value != "TesterMode" && getEl("combat").value != "Oldae" && getEl("combat").value != "WasdMode" && getEl("combat").value != "Totalew" && player && player.sid != tmpObj.owner.sid && !findAllianceBySid(tmpObj.owner.sid)) {
                                            getEl("combat").value == "Uncve" ? tmpSprite = getItemSprite(tmpObj) : tmpSprite = getObjSprite(tmpObj);
                                        } else {
                                            if ((tmpObj.dmg || tmpObj.trap) && getEl("combat").value == "Uncve") {
                                                tmpSprite = getObjSprite(tmpObj)
                                            } else {
                                                tmpSprite = getItemSprite(tmpObj)
                                            }
                                        }
                                        mainContext.save();
                                        mainContext.translate(tmpX, tmpY);
                                        if ((getEl("combat").value != "cele" && getEl("combat").value != "ae" && getEl("combat").value != "EwV" && getEl("combat").value != "gt86" && getEl("combat").value != "hae" && getEl("combat").value != "kto" && getEl("combat").value != "s2" && getEl("combat").value != "obs" && getEl("combat").value != "s0" && getEl("combat").value != "ar" && getEl("combat").value != "sal" && getEl("combat").value != "devs" && getEl("combat").value != "Jet" && getEl("combat").value != "TesterMode" && getEl("combat").value != "Oldae" && getEl("combat").value != "s1" && getEl("combat").value != "s2" && getEl("combat").value != "WasdMode" && getEl("combat").value != "Totalew" && getEl("combat").value != "2yl") || tmpObj.doUpdate) {
                                            mainContext.rotate(tmpObj.dir);
                                        }
                                        mainContext.drawImage(tmpSprite, -(tmpSprite.width / 2), -(tmpSprite.height / 2));
                                        if (tmpObj.blocker) {
                                            mainContext.strokeStyle = isTeam(tmpObj) ? "#2a2770" : "#780c0c";
                                            getEl("combat").value == "chick" ? mainContext.globalAlpha = 0.8:
                                            mainContext.globalAlpha = 0.3;
                                            mainContext.lineWidth = 6;
                                            renderCircle(0, 0, tmpObj.blocker, mainContext, false, true);
                                        }
                                        mainContext.restore();
                                    } else {
                                        tmpSprite = getResSprite(tmpObj);
                                        mainContext.drawImage(tmpSprite, tmpX - tmpSprite.width / 2, tmpY - tmpSprite.height / 2);
                                    }
                                }
                            } else {
                                if (tmpObj.layer == layer && isOnScreen(tmpX, tmpY, tmpObj.scale + (tmpObj.blocker||0))) {
                                    mainContext.globalAlpha = tmpObj.hideFromEnemy?0.6:1;
                                    mainContext.globalAlpha = applyProximityObjectFade(tmpObj, mainContext.globalAlpha);
                                    if (tmpObj.isItem) {
                                        tmpSprite = getItemSprite(tmpObj);
                                        mainContext.save();
                                        mainContext.translate(tmpX, tmpY);
                                        mainContext.rotate(tmpObj.dir);
                                        mainContext.drawImage(tmpSprite, -(tmpSprite.width / 2), -(tmpSprite.height / 2));
                                        if (tmpObj.trap || tmpObj.dmg) {
                                            mainContext.strokeStyle = isTeam(tmpObj) ? "#2a2770" : "#780c0c";
                                            mainContext.globalAlpha = 0.6;
                                            mainContext.lineWidth = 4;
                                            renderCircle(0, 0, tmpObj.scale, mainContext, false, true);
                                        }
                                        if (tmpObj.blocker) {
                                            mainContext.strokeStyle = "#780c0c";
                                            mainContext.globalAlpha = 0.3;
                                            mainContext.lineWidth = 6;
                                            renderCircle(0, 0, tmpObj.blocker, mainContext, false, true);
                                        }
                                        mainContext.restore();
                                    } else {
                                        tmpSprite = getResSprite(tmpObj);
                                        mainContext.drawImage(tmpSprite, tmpX - (tmpSprite.width / 2), tmpY - (tmpSprite.height / 2));
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            // Sprite Contour must be painted in the same pass/order as
                            // its object. A late layer-3 overlay caused contours to sit
                            // on top of unrelated nearby builds.
                            if (tmpObj.layer == layer && getVal("bh") == "4" && tmpObj.maxHealth && tmpObj.health !== undefined && tmpObj.health < tmpObj.maxHealth) {
                                renderSpriteContourBuildHealth(tmpObj, tmpX, tmpY);
                            }
                            if (tmpObj.layer == layer) {
                                renderSpriteContourAutoModBreak(tmpObj, tmpX, tmpY);
                            }
                            if (layer == 3) {
                                if (tmpObj.maxHealth && tmpObj.health !== undefined && tmpObj.health < tmpObj.maxHealth) {
                                    // alert removed
                                    if (getVal("bh") == "1") {
                                        drawHealth(tmpObj, mainContext, xOffset, yOffset);
                                    } else if (getVal("bh") == "2") {
                                        // HEALTH HOLDER:
                                        mainContext.fillStyle = darkOutlineColor;
                                        mainContext.roundRect(tmpX - config.healthBarWidth / 2 - config.healthBarPad, tmpY - config.healthBarPad, config.healthBarWidth + config.healthBarPad * 2, 17, 8);
                                        mainContext.fill();

                                        // HEALTH BAR:
                                        mainContext.fillStyle = tmpObj.isTeamObject(player) ? "#8ecc51" : "#cc5151";
                                        mainContext.roundRect(tmpX - config.healthBarWidth / 2, tmpY, config.healthBarWidth * window.valueSmoothHealthRatio(tmpObj), 17 - config.healthBarPad * 2, 7);
                                        mainContext.fill();
                                    } else if (getVal("bh") == "3") {
                                        renderAuroraBuildHealth(tmpObj, mainContext, tmpX, tmpY);
                                    } else if (getVal("bh") == "4") {
                                        // Drawn above in the object's own render pass.
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    });
                    // PLACE VISIBLE:
                    if (layer == 0) {
                        if (placeVisible.length) {
                            placeVisible.forEach((places) => {
                                tmpX = places.x - xOffset;
                                tmpY = places.y - yOffset;
                                markObject(places, tmpX, tmpY);
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
                function markObject(tmpObj, tmpX, tmpY) {
                    getMarkSprite(tmpObj, mainContext, tmpX, tmpY);
                }
                // GATHER ANIMATION:
                let hittedObj = [];
                let hittedObj2 = [];

                function objHitC(dmg, index) {
                    return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
                        resolve({
                            dmg: dmg,
                            index: index
                        });
                    }
                                      );
