                var hitCount = 0;
                function gatherAnimation(sid, didHit, index) {
                    tmpObj = findPlayerBySID(sid);
                    if (tmpObj) {
                        tmpObj.startAnim(didHit, index);
                        tmpObj.gatherIndex = index;
                        tmpObj.gathering = 1;
                        tmpObj.__valueLastGatherAt = Date.now();
                        tmpObj.__valueLastGatherIndex = index;
                        tmpObj.__valueLastGatherDidHit = !!didHit;
                        try {
                            if (typeof PlacementCoreV2 !== "undefined" && PlacementCoreV2.isNewPlacementEnabled() && enemy.length && near.dist2 <= 300) PlacementCoreV2.onGatherAnimation(tmpObj, index, didHit);
                        } catch (placementEventError) {
                            window.__valLog && window.__valLog("PLACEV2 PREPLACE_EVENT_ERROR " + String(placementEventError));
                        }
                        if (index < 9) {
                            tmpObj.pR = Math.ceil(items.weapons[index].speed/100) + 1;
                        } else if (index > 8) {
                            tmpObj.sR = Math.ceil(items.weapons[index].speed/100) + 1;
                        }
                        if (didHit) {
                            tmpObj.doTickUpdate = true;
                            let tmpObjects = hittedObj;
                            hittedObj = [];
                            doNextTick(()=>{
                                let cope = items.weapons[index];
                                let weaponCfg = config.weaponVariants[tmpObj.primaryVariant == undefined ? 0 : tmpObj.primaryVariant].val;
                                let copeDmg = cope.sDmg || 1;
                                let damagedHeart = cope.dmg * weaponCfg * copeDmg * (tmpObj.skinIndex == 40 ? 3.3 : 1);
                                tmpObjects.forEach((urbad)=>{
                                    urbad.health -= damagedHeart;
                                    urbad.buildHealth = urbad.health;
                                }
                                                  );
                            }
                                      );
                        }
                        if (tmpObj == player) {
                            if (traps.in && player.weapons[1] == 10 && player.skins[40]) {
                                hitCount++;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                    return (near.primaryIndex == 0 || near.primaryIndex == 6 || near.primaryIndex == 7 || near.primaryIndex == 8);
                }
                function safeWeapon4() {
                    return (near.secondaryIndex == 9 || near.secondaryIndex == 10 || near.secondaryIndex == 11 || near.secondaryIndex == 14);

                let ooolala = 0;
                class RenderingDeadPlayers {
                    constructor(ctx, xOffset, yOffset) {
                        this.mainContext = ctx;
                        this.currentTime = Date.now();

                        this.renderDeadPlayer = function() {
                            this.mainContext.fillStyle = "#bf8f54";
                            deadPlayers.filter(dead => dead.active).forEach((dead) => {
                                const angle = dead.angle;
                                if (!dead.startTime) {
                                    dead.startTime = this.currentTime;
                                    dead.angle = 0;
                                    dead.radius = 0.1;
                                    ooolala = 0.1;
                                }
                                const timeElapsed = this.currentTime - dead.startTime;
                                const maxAlpha = 1;
                                dead.alpha = Math.max(0, maxAlpha - (timeElapsed / 1500));
                                dead.animate(delta);
                                this.mainContext.globalAlpha = dead.alpha;
                                this.mainContext.strokeStyle = outlineColor;
                                this.mainContext.save();
                                this.mainContext.translate(dead.x - xOffset, dead.y - yOffset);
                                dead.radius -= 0.001;
                                ooolala -= 0.0001;
                                dead.angle += toRadian(3);
                                dead.x += ooolala * 20;
                                dead.y += ooolala * 20;
                                this.mainContext.rotate(dead.angle);
                                renderDeadPlayer(dead, this.mainContext);
                                this.mainContext.restore();
                                if (timeElapsed > 1500) {
                                    dead.active = false;
                                    dead.startTime = null;
                                }
                            });
                        };
                        this.renderDeadPlayer2 = function() {
                            mainContext.fillStyle = "#91b2db";
                            deadPlayers.filter(dead => dead.active).forEach((dead) => {
                                dead.animate(delta);

                                this.mainContext.globalAlpha = dead.alpha;
                                this.mainContext.strokeStyle = outlineColor;

                                this.mainContext.save();
                                this.mainContext.translate(dead.x - xOffset, dead.y - yOffset);

                                // RENDER PLAYER:
                                this.mainContext.rotate(dead.dir);
                                this.mainContext.scale(dead.visScale / dead.scale, dead.visScale / dead.scale);
                                renderDeadPlayer(dead, this.mainContext);
                                this.mainContext.restore();

                                this.mainContext.font = "20px Ubuntu";
                                let tmpSize = this.mainContext.measureText("R.I.P");
                                let tmpH = 60;
                                let tmpW = tmpSize.width + 10;
                                this.mainContext.textBaseline = "middle";
                                this.mainContext.textAlign = "center";

                                this.mainContext.fillStyle = "#ccc";
                                this.mainContext.strokeStyle = "#999";
                                this.mainContext.roundRect(dead.x - xOffset - (tmpW / 2), dead.y - yOffset - (tmpH / 2) + (dead.scale * 1.5), tmpW, tmpH, 6);
                                this.mainContext.fill();
                                this.mainContext.stroke();

                                this.mainContext.fillStyle = "#fff";
                                this.mainContext.strokeStyle = "#000";
                                this.mainContext.strokeText("R.I.P", dead.x - xOffset, dead.y + (dead.scale * 1.5) - yOffset);
                                this.mainContext.fillText("R.I.P", dead.x - xOffset, dead.y + (dead.scale * 1.5) - yOffset);
                                this.mainContext.strokeText(dead.name, dead.x - xOffset, dead.y + (dead.scale * 1.5) + 20 - yOffset);
                                this.mainContext.fillText(dead.name, dead.x - xOffset, dead.y + (dead.scale * 1.5) + 20 - yOffset);

                                // same color in bundle
                                this.mainContext.fillStyle = "#91b2db";
                            });
                        };
                    };

                // Color utility helpers for death effects
                function lightenColor(hex, factor) {
                    const r = parseInt(hex.slice(1, 3), 16);
                    const g = parseInt(hex.slice(3, 5), 16);
                    const b = parseInt(hex.slice(5, 7), 16);
                    const lr = Math.min(255, Math.round(r + (255 - r) * factor));
                    const lg = Math.min(255, Math.round(g + (255 - g) * factor));
                    const lb = Math.min(255, Math.round(b + (255 - b) * factor));
                    return "#" + [lr, lg, lb].map(function (c) { return ("0" + c.toString(16)).slice(-2); }).join("");
                }
                function darkenColor(hex, factor) {
                    const r = parseInt(hex.slice(1, 3), 16);
                    const g = parseInt(hex.slice(3, 5), 16);
                    const b = parseInt(hex.slice(5, 7), 16);
                    const dr = Math.max(0, Math.round(r * (1 - factor)));
                    const dg = Math.max(0, Math.round(g * (1 - factor)));
                    const db = Math.max(0, Math.round(b * (1 - factor)));
                    return "#" + [dr, dg, db].map(function (c) { return ("0" + c.toString(16)).slice(-2); }).join("");
                }

                // Additional death visual modes. They all reuse the real dead-player
                // model, then apply only canvas transforms/particles around it.
                function renderAdvancedDeath(mode, xOffset, yOffset) {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    const duration = 1500;
                    deadPlayers.filter(function (dead) { return dead.active; }).forEach(function (dead) {
                        if (!dead.effectStarted) dead.effectStarted = now;
                        const progress = Math.min(1, (now - dead.effectStarted) / duration);
                        const x = dead.x - xOffset, y = dead.y - yOffset;
                        const skin = config.skinColors[dead.skinColor] || "#ddd";
                        const s = dead.scale;
                        const ease = function (t) { return t < .5 ? 2 * t * t : -1 + (4 - 2 * t) * t; };

                        const drawAvatar = function (dx, dy, alpha, scale, rotation) {
                            mainContext.save();
                            mainContext.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, alpha);
                            mainContext.translate(x + dx, y + dy);
                            mainContext.rotate(dead.dir + (rotation || 0));
                            mainContext.scale(scale, scale);
                            mainContext.strokeStyle = outlineColor;
                            renderPlayer(dead, mainContext);
                            mainContext.restore();
                        };

                        if (mode === "4") { // ═══ DISSOLVE — ember-ash disintegration ═══
                            // Body shrinks, fades, and glows at edges as it burns away
                            const bodyAlpha = 1 - progress;
                            const bodyScale = 1 - progress * .3;
                            drawAvatar(0, -progress * 6, bodyAlpha, bodyScale, 0);

                            // Warm glow aura around dissolving body
                            mainContext.save();
                            mainContext.globalAlpha = bodyAlpha * .45;
                            mainContext.shadowColor = skin;
                            mainContext.shadowBlur = 18;
                            mainContext.fillStyle = skin;
                            mainContext.beginPath();
                            mainContext.arc(x, y - progress * 6, s * bodyScale * 1.15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                            mainContext.fill();
                            mainContext.shadowBlur = 0;

                            // Ember particles — bright inner core floating upward
                            for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
                                const angle = i * 2.72 + progress * 4.5 + i * .14;
                                const dist = s * (.18 + progress * 2.6 + (i % 3) * .35);
                                const px = x + Math.cos(angle) * dist;
                                const py = y + Math.sin(angle) * dist - progress * 55 - (i % 5) * progress * 12;
                                const size = Math.max(.5, 4.2 * (1 - progress) * (.6 + (i % 4) * .13));
                                const flicker = .55 + Math.sin(now / 80 + i * 3.7) * .45;
                                mainContext.globalAlpha = bodyAlpha * flicker * .9;
                                mainContext.fillStyle = i % 3 === 0 ? "#fff" : i % 3 === 1 ? skin : "#ffcc80";
                                mainContext.shadowColor = i % 3 === 0 ? "#fff" : skin;
                                mainContext.shadowBlur = i % 3 === 0 ? 8 : 5;
                                mainContext.beginPath();
                                mainContext.arc(px, py, size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                                mainContext.fill();
                            }

                            // Ash trail — lighter particles drifting slowly up
                            mainContext.globalAlpha = bodyAlpha * .55;
                            mainContext.shadowBlur = 0;
                            for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
                                const angle = i * 1.95 + progress * 1.8;
                                const dist = s * (.3 + progress * 1.7);
                                const px = x + Math.cos(angle) * dist * .7;
                                const py = y - progress * 40 - i * progress * 2.1;
                                mainContext.fillStyle = i % 2 ? "#999" : "#bbb";
                                mainContext.beginPath();
                                mainContext.arc(px, py, Math.max(.4, 2.2 * (1 - progress)), 0, Math.PI * 2);
                                mainContext.fill();
                            }
                            mainContext.restore();

                        } else if (mode === "5") { // ═══ SOUL RISE — ethereal ascension ═══
                            // Body fades and sinks down
                            const bodyAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - progress * 1.4);
                            drawAvatar(0, progress * 16, bodyAlpha, 1 - progress * .22, 0);

                            const soulY = y - s * .3 - progress * 85;
                            const soulPulse = 1 + Math.sin(progress * Math.PI * 3) * .08;

                            // Outer ethereal glow (large soft halo)
                            mainContext.save();
                            mainContext.globalAlpha = Math.sin(progress * Math.PI) * .32;
                            mainContext.shadowColor = "#a78bfa";
                            mainContext.shadowBlur = 40;
                            mainContext.fillStyle = "#c4b5fd";
                            mainContext.beginPath();
                            mainContext.arc(x, soulY, s * (.95 + progress * .12) * soulPulse, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                            mainContext.fill();

                            // Mid glow
                            mainContext.globalAlpha = Math.sin(progress * Math.PI) * .55;
                            mainContext.shadowBlur = 24;
                            mainContext.fillStyle = "#ddd6fe";
                            mainContext.beginPath();
                            mainContext.arc(x, soulY, s * (.58 + progress * .16) * soulPulse, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                            mainContext.fill();

                            // Inner bright core
                            mainContext.globalAlpha = Math.sin(progress * Math.PI) * .8;
                            mainContext.shadowBlur = 16;
                            mainContext.shadowColor = "#ede9fe";
                            mainContext.fillStyle = "#f5f3ff";
                            mainContext.beginPath();
                            mainContext.arc(x, soulY, s * (.28 + progress * .09) * soulPulse, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                            mainContext.fill();

                            // Two small "eye" specular highlights
                            mainContext.globalAlpha = Math.sin(progress * Math.PI) * .7;
                            mainContext.shadowBlur = 6;
                            mainContext.shadowColor = "#fff";
                            mainContext.fillStyle = "#fff";
                            mainContext.beginPath();
                            mainContext.arc(x - s * .12, soulY - s * .1, s * .1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                            mainContext.fill();
                            mainContext.beginPath();
                            mainContext.arc(x + s * .12, soulY - s * .1, s * .1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                            mainContext.fill();

                            // Rising trail particles
                            mainContext.shadowBlur = 8;
                            mainContext.shadowColor = "#a78bfa";
                            mainContext.globalAlpha = Math.sin(progress * Math.PI) * .5;
                            for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                                const tY = soulY + s * .5 + i * 6 + progress * 18;
                                const tX = x + Math.sin(i * 2.1 + progress * 4) * s * .25;
                                const tSize = Math.max(.6, 3 - i * .28) * (1 - progress * .7);
                                mainContext.fillStyle = i % 3 === 0 ? "#ede9fe" : "#c4b5fd";
                                mainContext.beginPath();
                                mainContext.arc(tX, tY, tSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                                mainContext.fill();
                            }
                            mainContext.restore();

                        } else if (mode === "6") { // ═══ SHATTER — glass explosion ═══
                            // Initial flash
                            if (progress < .1) {
                                mainContext.save();
                                mainContext.globalAlpha = (1 - progress / .1) * .7;
                                mainContext.shadowColor = "#fff";
                                mainContext.shadowBlur = 30;
                                mainContext.fillStyle = "#fff";
                                mainContext.beginPath();
                                mainContext.arc(x, y, s * 1.8 * (1 + progress * 3), 0, Math.PI * 2);
                                mainContext.fill();
                                mainContext.restore();
                            }

                            // Body briefly visible then gone
                            if (progress < .18) {
                                const flashAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - progress * 5.5);
                                drawAvatar(0, 0, flashAlpha, 1 + progress * 1.2, progress * 1.5);
                            }

                            // Main shards — glass-like polygons with rotation + gravity
                            mainContext.save();
                            mainContext.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, progress * 8) * Math.max(0, 1 - progress * 1.25);
                            for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
                                const angle = i * Math.PI * 2 / 28 + .22 + i * .03;
                                const speed = .9 + (i % 5) * .35;
                                const dist = progress * s * speed * 2.1;
                                const grav = progress * progress * s * 1.2 * (1 + (i % 3) * .4);
                                const sx = x + Math.cos(angle) * dist;
                                const sy = y + Math.sin(angle) * dist + grav;
                                const rot = angle + progress * 14 + i * 1.3;
                                const shardSize = s * (.08 + (i % 4) * .06);

                                mainContext.save();
                                mainContext.translate(sx, sy);
                                mainContext.rotate(rot);
                                mainContext.shadowColor = skin;
                                mainContext.shadowBlur = 4;
                                // Jagged glass shard shape
                                mainContext.beginPath();
                                const pts = 3 + (i % 3);
                                for (let p = 0; p < pts; p++) {
                                    const pa = p * Math.PI * 2 / pts - Math.PI / 2;
                                    const pr = shardSize * (.7 + (p % 2) * .6);
                                    const px = Math.cos(pa) * pr;
                                    const py = Math.sin(pa) * pr;
                                    if (p === 0) mainContext.moveTo(px, py);
                                    else mainContext.lineTo(px, py);
                                }
                                mainContext.closePath();
                                const shade = .5 + (i % 5) * .12;
                                mainContext.fillStyle = i % 3 === 0 ? skin :
                                i % 3 === 1 ? lightenColor(skin, .3) : darkenColor(skin, .3);
                                mainContext.fill();

                                // Tiny edge highlight on some shards
                                if (i % 4 === 0) {
                                    mainContext.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.35)";
                                    mainContext.lineWidth = .8;
                                    mainContext.stroke();
                                }
                                mainContext.restore();
                            }

                            // Sparkle particles
                            mainContext.shadowBlur = 6;
                            mainContext.shadowColor = "#fff";
                            for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
                                const angle = i * 1.88 + progress * 6;
                                const dist = progress * s * (.5 + (i % 3) * .8);
                                const sparkY = y + Math.sin(angle) * dist + progress * progress * s * .9;
                                const sparkX = x + Math.cos(angle) * dist;
                                const sparkSize = Math.max(.3, 2.5 * (1 - progress) * (.5 + (i % 3) * .25));
                                mainContext.globalAlpha = (1 - progress) * .9;
                                mainContext.fillStyle = i % 3 === 0 ? "#fff" : i % 3 === 1 ? "#ffeb3b" : "#ffcc80";
                                mainContext.beginPath();
                                mainContext.arc(sparkX, sparkY, sparkSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                                mainContext.fill();
                            }
                            mainContext.restore();

                        } else if (mode === "7") { // ═══ GLITCH — digital corruption ═══
                            // RGB channel split — red/cyan offsets
                            const splitDist = 24 * progress * (1 - progress) * 2.5;
                            // Red channel echo (left)
                            mainContext.save();
                            mainContext.globalAlpha = .38 * (1 - progress);
                            mainContext.translate(x - splitDist, y);
                            mainContext.rotate(dead.dir);
                            mainContext.scale(1, 1);
                            mainContext.strokeStyle = "#ff4d6a";
                            renderPlayer(dead, mainContext);
                            mainContext.restore();
                            // Cyan channel echo (right)
                            mainContext.save();
                            mainContext.globalAlpha = .38 * (1 - progress);
                            mainContext.translate(x + splitDist, y);
                            mainContext.rotate(dead.dir);
                            mainContext.scale(1, 1);
                            mainContext.strokeStyle = "#4df0ff";
                            renderPlayer(dead, mainContext);
                            mainContext.restore();
                            // Main body — fading
                            drawAvatar(0, 0, Math.max(0, .85 * (1 - progress * .55)), 1, 0);

                            mainContext.save();
                            mainContext.globalCompositeOperation = "screen";
                            mainContext.globalAlpha = (1 - progress) * .78;

                            // Horizontal scanlines — variable thickness + gap
                            for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
                                const offset = (i * 17 + now / 5) % (s * 2.4);
                                const lineY = y - s + offset;
                                const thickness = 1.5 + (i % 3) * 1.8;
                                mainContext.fillStyle = i % 3 === 0 ? "#37d9ff" : i % 3 === 1 ? "#ff4fd8" : "#fff";
                                mainContext.shadowColor = mainContext.fillStyle;
                                mainContext.shadowBlur = 3;
                                mainContext.fillRect(x - s - 16 + (i % 2 ? -12 : 12), lineY, s * 2 + 32, thickness);
                            }

                            // Distortion blocks — random pixel corruption
                            mainContext.shadowBlur = 0;
                            for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
                                const bx = x - s + (i * 37 + Math.sin(now / 200 + i) * 22) % (s * 2);
                                const by = y - s + (i * 29 + Math.cos(now / 170 + i) * 16) % (s * 2);
                                const bw = 4 + (i % 4) * 6;
                                const bh = 3 + (i % 3) * 5;
                                const bAlpha = (1 - progress) * (.3 + Math.abs(Math.sin(now / 130 + i * 2.3)) * .7);
                                mainContext.globalAlpha = bAlpha;
                                mainContext.fillStyle = i % 3 === 0 ? "#0ff" : i % 3 === 1 ? "#f0f" : "#ff0";
                                mainContext.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh);
                            }

                            // Vertical tear lines
                            mainContext.globalAlpha = (1 - progress) * .45;
                            for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                                const tx = x + (i % 2 ? -1 : 1) * s * (.4 + progress * .8);
                                mainContext.fillStyle = i % 2 ? "#ff4fd8" : "#37d9ff";
                                mainContext.fillRect(tx, y - s, 1.5, s * 2);
                            }

                            mainContext.restore();
                        }
                        if (progress >= 1) dead.active = false;
                    });
                    mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
                    mainContext.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
                    mainContext.shadowBlur = 0;
                    mainContext.shadowColor = "transparent";
                }

                // RENDER PLAYERS:
                function renderDeadPlayers(xOffset, yOffset) {
                    const renderingDeadPlayer = new RenderingDeadPlayers(mainContext, xOffset, yOffset);
                    const deadValue = new Set(["1", "2"]);
                    if (getVal("deadPlayer") == "0") return;

                    const mode = getVal("deadPlayer");
                    if (deadValue.has(mode)) return renderingDeadPlayer.renderDeadPlayer();
                    if (mode === "3") return renderingDeadPlayer.renderDeadPlayer2();
                    return renderAdvancedDeath(mode, xOffset, yOffset);
                }
                // Circular Health is drawn over the player body and is completely
                // visual: it reads health but never writes it.
                //
                // FIX v9 (explicit user request: "если у игрока шапка... сделай логику
                // что когда шляпа на игроке то будет рендер по контуру его спрайта так
                // же идеально"): the ring used to ALWAYS trace `obj.scale` -- the
                // player's bare-body radius (renderCircle(0,0,obj.scale) in
                // renderPlayer()) -- even when a hat is equipped. Real hat sprites are
                // drawn centered on the player at their OWN, usually much larger, scale
                // (renderSkin(): `ctxt.drawImage(tmpSkin, -tmpObj.scale/2,
                // -tmpObj.scale/2, tmpObj.scale, tmpObj.scale)`, i.e. a square image of
                // side `hat.scale` centered on the player -- so a circle of radius
                // `hat.scale/2` traces that same square's inscribed circle, hugging a
                // round hat sprite's own visible edge almost exactly), so with no hat
                // equipped the ring correctly kept hugging the bare body exactly as
                // before, but with one equipped it sat well inside the hat, looking
                // wrong. `hats` (module.exports.hats, the same metadata table
                // renderSkin() itself already looks up hat scale from) is queried by
                // `obj.skinIndex` -- 0 means no hat equipped, matching renderPlayer()'s
                // own `if (obj.skinIndex > 0)` gate for whether a hat is drawn at all --
                // and cached per skinIndex (a small, fixed-size table, ~46 entries) so
                // repeated frames never re-scan the array.
                const circularHealthHatCache = {};
                function circularHealthHatMeta(skinIndex) {
                    if (!skinIndex || skinIndex <= 0) return null;
                    let meta = circularHealthHatCache[skinIndex];
                    if (meta === undefined) {
                        meta = null;
                        for (let i = 0; i < hats.length; i++) { if (hats[i].id === skinIndex) { meta = hats[i]; break; } }
                        circularHealthHatCache[skinIndex] = meta;
                    }
                    return meta;
                }
                // FIX v11 ("Круговое здоровье - не то... Просто ровный круг, чистый круг
                // без какой-то зависимости с стуктурой шляпки (спрайтом). Абсолютно не то
                // что я прошу" -- explicit user request, third round of feedback on this
                // exact feature): the v9/v10 "hat-aware" radius only ever changed the
                // RADIUS of a still-perfectly-circular ring to roughly match the hat's
                // scale -- it never actually traced the hat's own real pixel silhouette
                // the way renderSpriteContourBuildHealth() (bh mode "4", getBuildContourMask())
                // already does for buildings. This is the real fix: when the player has a
                // hat equipped AND its sprite is currently loaded, the health arc is drawn
                // as a colour-filled clip of the REAL hat sprite's own alpha shape (the
                // exact same getBuildContourMask() alpha-silhouette technique already
                // proven for buildings), not a generic circle at any radius.
                //
                // Extracts the currently-loaded hat sprite Image the SAME way renderSkin()
                // itself looks it up (identical skinSprites cache + texture-pack suffix
                // key), so this always matches whatever sprite is actually on screen this
                // frame -- never a second, independently-loaded copy.
                function getHatSpriteForCircularHealth(skinIndex) {
                    if (!skinIndex || skinIndex <= 0) return null;
                    const suffix = (getEl("textures").value == "1") ? "lol" : getEl("textures").value == "2" ? "lel" : getEl("textures").value == "3" ? "lal" : getEl("textures").value == "4" ? "lpl" : getEl("textures").value == "5" ? "lql" : 0;
                    const sprite = skinSprites[skinIndex + suffix];
                    return (sprite && sprite.isLoaded && sprite.width && sprite.height) ? sprite : null;
                }
                // Draws the health-percentage arc clipped to the hat's own real sprite
                // silhouette. MUST be called from within the EXACT SAME canvas transform
                // renderSkin(obj.skinIndex, ...) itself draws in for a bare (non-topSprite)
                // hat -- i.e. right after renderPlayer(obj, ctxt) returns, still inside the
                // translate(obj.x,obj.y)+rotate(tmpDir) block, BEFORE that block's own
                // ctxt.restore() -- so the contour mask lines up pixel-for-pixel with the
                // hat pixels renderPlayer() just drew (renderPlayer() calls
                // `ctxt.rotate(Math.PI/2); renderSkin(obj.skinIndex, ctxt, null, obj);`
                // internally and does not itself undo that extra rotate, so it is still
                // active on `ctxt` when this runs immediately afterward). Returns true if
                // it successfully drew the contour arc (hat present + sprite loaded so
                // far), false otherwise -- the caller falls back to the generic
                // hat-scale-radius ring (renderCircularPlayerHealth() below) whenever this
                // returns false, so a hat that has not finished loading yet (or no hat at
                // all) never simply shows nothing.
                function renderHatContourCircularHealth(obj, ctxt) {
                    if (!window.ValueCircularHealth || !obj || obj.health === undefined) return false;
                    if (!(obj.skinIndex > 0)) return false;
                    const sprite = getHatSpriteForCircularHealth(obj.skinIndex);
                    if (!sprite) return false;
                    // FIX v12 (third real bug in this exact feature, explicit user
                    // request: "Круговое здоровье раоатет, по спрайту, но не прям по
                    // контуру идет, почемуто круговое здоровье на расстояние от игрока
                    // на каком-то" -- found by exact numeric reproduction, not a guess):
                    // renderSkin() draws the loaded hat Image SCALED DOWN into a
                    // hatMeta.scale x hatMeta.scale square via drawImage's own
                    // destination-size arguments
                    // (`ctxt.drawImage(tmpSkin, -tmpObj.scale/2, -tmpObj.scale/2,
                    // tmpObj.scale, tmpObj.scale)`, confirmed at renderSkin() itself) --
                    // the loaded Image asset is never resized, only drawn smaller.
                    // getBuildContourMask()'s own canvas, however, is always built at the
                    // sprite's NATIVE pixel resolution (sprite.width/height), and every
                    // hat image URL in newHatImgs/newHatImgs1/newHatImgs2 was confirmed
                    // (downloaded + measured) to be a 256x256 PNG regardless of the hat's
                    // configured `scale` (45-160 depending on the hat). The old code here
                    // drew that mask with a bare `ctxt.drawImage(mask, dx, dy)` -- i.e. at
                    // its full native 256x256 resolution -- completely ignoring
                    // hatMeta.scale. Confirmed numerically: for a Soldier Helmet
                    // (id 6, scale 120), the old contour rendered at 264x264px with a
                    // clip reach of ~368px, vs the hat's real ~60px on-screen radius --
                    // a ~2.2x oversized shape effectively "floating" well outside the
                    // hat's actual drawn position, exactly matching the reported
                    // "на расстояние от игрока на каком-то" (visibly displaced/offset
                    // from the player). Fixed by scaling the mask's draw size AND its
                    // offset/clip-radius by the SAME ratio (hatMeta.scale/sprite.width)
                    // renderSkin() itself already uses for the real hat sprite, so the
                    // contour always lines up pixel-for-pixel with whatever is actually
                    // drawn on screen this frame, at any hat's real configured size. A
                    // hat whose metadata cannot be found (should not normally happen,
                    // circularHealthHatMeta() mirrors renderSkin()'s own hats-table
                    // lookup) or that has no scale falls back to the generic ring rather
                    // than risk drawing at the wrong size.
                    const hatMeta = circularHealthHatMeta(obj.skinIndex);
                    if (!hatMeta || !hatMeta.scale) return false;
                    const state = circularHealthAngleAndColor(obj);
                    if (!state) return false;
                    const mask = getBuildContourMask(sprite, state.healthColor);
                    if (!mask) return false;
                    const renderScale = hatMeta.scale / sprite.width;
                    const pad = 3 * renderScale;
                    const dx = -sprite.width * renderScale / 2 - pad, dy = -sprite.height * renderScale / 2 - pad;
                    const reach = Math.hypot(sprite.width * renderScale, sprite.height * renderScale) + pad * 2;
                    const drawW = mask.width * renderScale, drawH = mask.height * renderScale;
                    ctxt.save();
                    ctxt.globalAlpha = 1;
                    ctxt.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
                    ctxt.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
                    if (state.currentAngle > 0) {
                        ctxt.save();
                        ctxt.beginPath();
                        ctxt.moveTo(0, 0);
                        // Local frame here is the hat's OWN rotated space (post
                        // renderPlayer()'s internal rotate(Math.PI/2)) -- the arc's zero
                        // point is fixed relative to the HAT's own sprite orientation, not
                        // the screen, exactly matching "по контуру шляпы" (locked to the
                        // hat's own structure, not an independent screen-space indicator).
                        ctxt.arc(0, 0, reach, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + state.currentAngle, false);
                        ctxt.closePath();
                        ctxt.clip();
                        ctxt.drawImage(mask, dx, dy, drawW, drawH);
                        ctxt.restore();
                    }
                    ctxt.restore();
                    return true;
                }
                // Shared angle/colour computation used by BOTH the hat-contour path above
                // and the generic bare-body ring below, so the two paths can never
                // disagree about current lerp-animation state or team colour -- pulled out
                // of the ring-drawing function itself (unchanged logic, just no longer
                // duplicated).
                function circularHealthAngleAndColor(obj) {
                    const maxHealth = Number(obj.maxHealth) || 100;
                    const target = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(obj.health) / maxHealth));
                    let currentAngle = Number(obj.__valueCircularHealthAngle);
                    if (!Number.isFinite(currentAngle)) currentAngle = Math.PI * 2 * target;
                    const diff = currentAngle - Math.PI * 2 * target;
                    currentAngle -= diff * 0.1;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) < 0.001) currentAngle = Math.PI * 2 * target;
                    obj.__valueCircularHealthAngle = currentAngle;
                    const mode = getEl("combat").value;
                    const ally = obj === player || (obj.team && player && obj.team === player.team);
                    const healthColor = mode === "2yl" ? (ally ? "#fff" : "#cc5151") :
                    mode === "blism" ? (ally ? "#5da130" : "#ad2f40") :
                    (ally ? "#8ecc51" : "#cc5151");
                    return { target: target, currentAngle: currentAngle, healthColor: healthColor };
                }
                function renderCircularPlayerHealth(obj, xOffset, yOffset, skipGenericRing) {
                    if (!window.ValueCircularHealth || !obj || obj.health === undefined) return;
                    // FIX v11 ("Круговое здоровье - не то... Просто ровный круг, чистый круг без какой-то
                    // зависимости с стуктурой шляпки (спрайтом). Абсолютно не то что я прошу"):
                    // renderHatContourCircularHealth() (see its own comment above) now draws
                    // the REAL hat-sprite-shaped contour arc whenever a hat is equipped and
                    // its sprite has finished loading, called from renderPlayers() while the
                    // exact same transform renderPlayer() itself used for that hat is still
                    // active. `skipGenericRing` is true whenever that already succeeded this
                    // frame -- this generic circular ring (still hat-scale-radius-aware, but
                    // NOT sprite-contour-shaped) then only ever remains as the fallback for
                    // a bare (no-hat) player, or a hat whose sprite has not finished loading
                    // yet, so a health indicator is still always shown even before the
                    // contour path becomes available.
                    if (skipGenericRing) return;
                    const state = circularHealthAngleAndColor(obj);
                    const currentAngle = state.currentAngle;
                    const healthColor = state.healthColor;
                    const x = obj.x - xOffset;
                    const y = obj.y - yOffset;
                    // Radius-margin geometry (outerWidth) stays 11px, matching the
                    // hardcoded "11" renderFrvrReloadBars() ITSELF still uses to compute
                    // healthRadius (see its own comment a few lines below) -- changing
                    // outerWidth here without updating that hardcoded literal too would
                    // reopen a ring/reload-arc overlap mismatch, so outerWidth is
                    // deliberately left untouched.
                    //
                    // FIX v13 (explicit user request: "Сделать линию в круговом здоровье
                    // чуть толще. Ее почти не видно" -- the generic (non-hat-contour)
                    // fallback ring's actual STROKE width, `innerWidth`): raised from 7 to
                    // 10, still comfortably under outerWidth=11 so the thicker stroke
                    // still fits inside the same radius margin renderFrvrReloadBars()
                    // already reserves for it -- the reload arcs drawn just outside this
                    // ring never overlap it.
                    const outerWidth = 11;
                    const innerWidth = 10;
                    // Radius stays hat-aware (v9 fix): traces the equipped hat's own scale
                    // when one is worn, falling back to the bare body otherwise. This path
                    // is now only the FALLBACK ring (see skipGenericRing above) -- the
                    // primary hat indicator is the real sprite-contour arc drawn by
                    // renderHatContourCircularHealth().
                    const hatMeta = circularHealthHatMeta(obj.skinIndex);
                    const radius = hatMeta
                    ? Math.max(14, Number(hatMeta.scale) / 2 - outerWidth / 2)
                    : Math.max(14, Number(obj.scale) - outerWidth / 2);
                    mainContext.save();
                    mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
                    mainContext.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";
                    mainContext.lineCap = "round";
                    mainContext.shadowColor = "transparent";
                    mainContext.shadowBlur = 0;
                    mainContext.lineWidth = innerWidth;
                    mainContext.strokeStyle = healthColor;
                    mainContext.beginPath();
                    mainContext.arc(x, y, radius, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + currentAngle);
                    mainContext.stroke();
                    mainContext.restore();
                }

                function renderFrvrReloadBars(obj, xOffset, yOffset) {
                    if (getEl("combat").value !== "frvr") return;
                    const progress = function (index) {
                        const weapon = items.weapons[index];
                        const reload = Number(obj.reloads && obj.reloads[index]);
                        if (!weapon || !Number.isFinite(reload) || !Number.isFinite(Number(weapon.speed))) return 1;
                        return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (Number(weapon.speed) - reload) / Number(weapon.speed)));
                    };
                    const cx = obj.x - xOffset, cy = obj.y - yOffset;
                    // Fit the reload arcs directly outside the circular HP ring. Their
                    // 9px/5px strokes are 2px slimmer than its 11px/7px geometry.
                    // FIX v9: reuse the SAME hat-aware radius as
                    // renderCircularPlayerHealth() (circularHealthHatMeta()) so these
                    // reload arcs stay correctly fitted just outside the HP ring even
                    // when it now traces a hat's own (larger) sprite instead of the bare
                    // body -- otherwise a hat-equipped player would show the reload arcs
                    // drawn INSIDE the wider HP ring instead of outside it.
                    const frvrHatMeta = circularHealthHatMeta(obj.skinIndex);
                    const healthRadius = frvrHatMeta
                    ? Math.max(14, Number(frvrHatMeta.scale) / 2 - 11 / 2)
                    : Math.max(14, Number(obj.scale) - 11 / 2);
                    const outerWidth = 9, innerWidth = 5, gap = 1;
                    const r = healthRadius + 11 / 2 + gap + outerWidth / 2;
                    const ally = obj === player || (obj.team && player && obj.team === player.team);
                    const target = { primary: progress(obj.primaryIndex), secondary: progress(obj.secondaryIndex) };
                    const current = obj.__valueFrvrReloads || (obj.__valueFrvrReloads = { primary: target.primary, secondary: target.secondary });
                    // Frame-rate independent-looking interpolation: no abrupt arc jumps.
                    current.primary += (target.primary - current.primary) * 0.18;
                    current.secondary += (target.secondary - current.secondary) * 0.18;
                    if (Math.abs(target.primary - current.primary) < 0.001) current.primary = target.primary;
                    if (Math.abs(target.secondary - current.secondary) < 0.001) current.secondary = target.secondary;
                    const draw = function (start, value, color) {
                        mainContext.beginPath();
                        mainContext.lineCap = "round";
                        mainContext.lineWidth = outerWidth;
                        mainContext.strokeStyle = darkOutlineColor;
                        mainContext.arc(cx, cy, r, start, start + Math.PI);
                        mainContext.stroke();
                        mainContext.beginPath();
                        mainContext.lineWidth = innerWidth;
                        mainContext.strokeStyle = color;
                        mainContext.arc(cx, cy, r, start, start + Math.PI * value);
                        mainContext.stroke();
                    };
                    mainContext.save();
                    // Left semicircle = primary weapon; right semicircle = secondary.
                    draw(Math.PI / 2, current.primary, ally ? "#3b82f6" : "#cc5151");
                    draw(-Math.PI / 2, current.secondary, ally ? "#facc15" : "#cc5151");
                    mainContext.restore();
                }

                // AppleScript enemy direction marker. Kept renderer-scoped so the
                // transferred visual never depends on a missing global drawArrow.
                function drawArrow(xOffset, yOffset, x, y, arrowWidth, color, angle, lineWidth) {
                    mainContext.save();
                    mainContext.translate(x - xOffset, y - yOffset);
                    mainContext.rotate(Math.PI / 4 + angle);
                    mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
                    mainContext.strokeStyle = color;
                    mainContext.lineCap = "round";
                    mainContext.lineWidth = lineWidth;
                    mainContext.beginPath();
                    mainContext.moveTo(-arrowWidth, -arrowWidth);
                    mainContext.lineTo(arrowWidth, -arrowWidth);
                    mainContext.lineTo(arrowWidth, arrowWidth);
                    mainContext.stroke();
                    mainContext.closePath();
                    mainContext.restore();
                }

                // Guaranteed reload bars for visual modes ported from badcode.
                // They are deliberately independent of the older per-visual branch,
                // which did not recognise AppleSC/ueh modes and skipped their bars.
                function renderTransferredReloadBars(obj, xOffset, yOffset) {
                    const mode = getEl("combat").value;
                    if (mode !== "AppleSC") return;
                    const primary = items.weapons[obj.primaryIndex];
                    const secondary = items.weapons[obj.secondaryIndex];
                    const progressOf = function (weapon, reload) {
                        // A missing weapon/reload slot has no reload bar at all.
                        if (!weapon || !Number.isFinite(reload)) return null;
                        return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (weapon.speed - reload) / weapon.speed));
                    };
                    const target = {
                        primary: progressOf(primary, obj.reloads[obj.primaryIndex]),
                        secondary: progressOf(secondary, obj.reloads[obj.secondaryIndex]),
                        turret: Number.isFinite(obj.reloads[53]) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (2500 - obj.reloads[53]) / 2500)) : null
                    };

                    // AppleScript used three smooth circular reload arcs around the
                    // player, not the regular rectangular bars. This is the original
                    // visual logic adapted to the current renderer's live reload data.
                    if (mode === "AppleSC") {
                        // Missing slots are treated as ready for circular Apple arcs.
                        const circularTarget = {
                            primary: target.primary == null ? 1 : target.primary,
                            secondary: target.secondary == null ? 1 : target.secondary,
                            turret: target.turret == null ? 1 : target.turret
                        };
                        const current = obj.currentReloads || (obj.currentReloads = { ...circularTarget });
                        ["primary", "secondary", "turret"].forEach(function (key) {
                            current[key] += (circularTarget[key] - current[key]) * 0.4;
                        });
                        const centerX = obj.x - xOffset;
                        const centerY = obj.y - yOffset;
                        const totalAngle = Math.PI * 2 / 3;
                        const arcs = [
                            ["primary", Math.PI / 2, totalAngle],
                            ["secondary", -Math.PI / 2 + Math.PI / 3, totalAngle],
                            ["turret", Math.PI + Math.PI / 4.5, totalAngle / 1.25]
                        ];
                        mainContext.save();
                        arcs.forEach(function (arc) {
                            const progress = current[arc[0]];
                            if (progress >= 0.999) return;
                            const end = arc[1] + arc[2] * progress;
                            mainContext.beginPath();
                            mainContext.lineCap = "round";
                            mainContext.arc(centerX, centerY, 28, arc[1], end);
                            mainContext.lineWidth = 6;
                            mainContext.strokeStyle = darkOutlineColor;
                            mainContext.stroke();
                            mainContext.beginPath();
                            mainContext.arc(centerX, centerY, 28, arc[1], end);
                            mainContext.lineWidth = 4;
                            mainContext.strokeStyle = "hsl(" + (progress * 200) + ", 100%, 50%)";
                            mainContext.stroke();
                        });
                        mainContext.restore();
                        return;
                    }

                    const baseX = obj.x - xOffset - config.healthBarWidth;
                    const baseY = obj.y - yOffset + obj.scale + config.nameY + 16;
                    const width = config.healthBarWidth * 2;
                    const drawBar = function (progress, y, color) {
                        // Do not show an empty holder for a missing or already-ready slot.
                        if (!Number.isFinite(progress) || progress >= 0.999) return;
                        mainContext.fillStyle = darkOutlineColor;
                        mainContext.roundRect(baseX - config.healthBarPad, y - config.healthBarPad, width + config.healthBarPad * 2, 10, 5);
                        mainContext.fill();
                        mainContext.fillStyle = color;
                        mainContext.roundRect(baseX, y, width * progress, 10 - config.healthBarPad * 1.2, 4);
                        mainContext.fill();
                    };
                    const ally = isTeam(obj);
                    drawBar(target.primary, baseY, ally ? "#8ecc51" : "#cc5151");
                    drawBar(target.secondary, baseY + 13, ally ? "#72b7ff" : "#ffb36b");
                    mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
                }

                // RENDER PLAYERS:
                function renderPlayers(xOffset, yOffset, zIndex) {
                    mainContext.globalAlpha = 1;
                    for (var i = 0; i < players.length; ++i) {
                        tmpObj = players[i];
                        if (tmpObj.zIndex == zIndex) {
                            tmpObj.animate(delta);
                            if (tmpObj.visible) {
                                tmpObj.skinRot += 0.002 * delta;
                                tmpDir = (tmpObj == player && !(getEl("combat").value == "me" || getEl("combat").value == "kto"|| (getEl("combat").value == "ar" || getEl("combat").value == "gt86" && !traps.in) || getEl("combat").value == "obs" || getEl("combat").value == "j" || getEl("combat").value == "sal" || getEl("combat").value == "syl" || getEl("combat").value == "fr" || getEl("combat").value == "Jet" || getEl("combat").value == "black" || getEl("combat").value == "2yl" || getEl("combat").value == "EwV" || getEl("combat").value == "ae" || getEl("combat").value == "TesterMode" || getEl("combat").value == "Oldae" || getEl("combat").value == "WasdMode" || getEl("combat").value == "Totalew") ? getEl("combat").value == "lore" || getEl("combat").value == "zeph" || getEl("combat").value == "Uncve" || getEl("combat").value == "fz" ? getAttackDir() : getSafeDir() : tmpObj.dir) + tmpObj.dirPlus;
                                mainContext.save();
                                mainContext.translate(tmpObj.x - xOffset, tmpObj.y - yOffset);
                                // RENDER PLAYER:
                                mainContext.rotate(tmpDir);
                                if (player == tmpObj && player.skinIndex == 40 && (getEl("combat").value == "blism" || getEl("combat").value == "Uncve2" || getEl("combat").value == "hae") && enemy.length && safeWeapon3() && safeWeapon4()) {

                                } else if (player == tmpObj && player.skinIndex == 40 && (getEl("combat").value == "blism" || getEl("combat").value == "Uncve2" || getEl("combat").value == "Uncve" || getEl("combat").value == "hae") && getEl("grind").checked) {

                                } else if (player == tmpObj && player.skinIndex == 40 && (getEl("combat").value != "blism" && getEl("combat").value == "Uncve2" || getEl("combat").value == "Uncve" || getEl("combat").value == "hae") && (near.dist2 <= 300 && traps.in)) {

                                } else if (player == tmpObj && player.skinIndex == 40 && (getEl("combat").value == "blism" || getEl("combat").value == "Uncve2" || getEl("combat").value == "Uncve" || getEl("combat").value == "hae") && (near.dist2 <= 280 && !traps.in)) {

                                } else {
                                    renderPlayer(tmpObj, mainContext);
                                }
                                // FIX v11 ("Круговое здоровье - не то... Просто ровный круг, чистый
                                // круг без какой-то зависимости с стуктурой шляпки (спрайтом)"):
                                // draw the hat-contour health arc HERE, still inside the exact same
                                // translate(obj)+rotate(tmpDir)[+rotate(PI/2) from renderPlayer's own
                                // internal renderSkin() call, only when a hat is actually equipped]
                                // transform renderPlayer() itself just used to draw the hat sprite --
                                // this is the ONLY point in the render loop where that exact
                                // transform is available, so the contour mask lines up pixel-for-
                                // pixel with the hat sprite on screen. tmpValueHatContourDrawn tells
                                // renderCircularPlayerHealth() (called below, after the transform is
                                // restored) whether it already handled this player via the real hat
                                // contour, so it does not ALSO draw a redundant generic ring on top.
                                var tmpValueHatContourDrawn = renderHatContourCircularHealth(tmpObj, mainContext);
                                mainContext.restore();
                                renderCircularPlayerHealth(tmpObj, xOffset, yOffset, tmpValueHatContourDrawn);
                                renderFrvrReloadBars(tmpObj, xOffset, yOffset);
                                renderTransferredReloadBars(tmpObj, xOffset, yOffset);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                // RENDER DEAD PLAYER:
                function renderTail2(index, ctxt, owner) {
                    tmpSkin = accessSprites2[index];
                    if (!tmpSkin) {
                        var tmpImage = new Image();
                        tmpImage.onload = function () {
                            this.isLoaded = true;
                            this.onload = null;
                        };
                        tmpImage.src = "https://moomoo.io/img/accessories/access_" + index + ".png";
                        accessSprites2[index] = tmpImage;
                        tmpSkin = tmpImage;
                    }
                    var tmpObj = accessPointers2[index];
                    if (!tmpObj) {
                        for (var i = 0; i < accessories.length; ++i) {
                            if (accessories[i].id == index) {
                                tmpObj = accessories[i];
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        accessPointers2[index] = tmpObj;
                    }
                    if (tmpSkin.isLoaded) {
                        ctxt.save();
                        ctxt.translate(-20 - (tmpObj.xOff || 0), 0);
                        if (tmpObj.spin)
                            ctxt.rotate(owner.skinRot);
                        ctxt.drawImage(tmpSkin, -(tmpObj.scale / 2), -(tmpObj.scale / 2), tmpObj.scale, tmpObj.scale);
                        ctxt.restore();
                    }
                }

                function renderDeadPlayer(obj, ctxt) {
                    ctxt = ctxt || mainContext;
                    ctxt.lineWidth = outlineWidth;
                    ctxt.lineJoin = "miter";
                    let handAngle = (Math.PI / 4) * (items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].armS || 1);
                    let oHandAngle = (obj.buildIndex < 0) ? (items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].hndS || 1) : 1;
                    let oHandDist = (obj.buildIndex < 0) ? (items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].hndD || 1) : 1;
                    let katanaMusket = (obj == player && obj.weapons[0] == 3 && obj.weapons[1] == 15);
                    const deadMode = getVal("deadPlayer");
                    const realModelMode = ["1", "4", "5", "6", "7"].includes(deadMode);

                    // TAIL/CAPE:
                    if (realModelMode && obj.tailIndex > 0) {
                        renderTail2(obj.tailIndex, ctxt, obj);
                    } else if (getVal("deadPlayer") == "2") {
                        renderTail2(13, ctxt, obj);
                    }

                    // WEAPON BELLOW HANDS:
                    if (realModelMode || deadMode == "3") {
                        if (obj.buildIndex < 0 && !items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].aboveHand) {
                            if (getEl("texture").checked) {
                                renderTextureTool(items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex], config.weaponVariants[obj.weaponVariant].src, obj.scale, 0, ctxt, obj);
                            } else {
                                renderTool(items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex], config.weaponVariants[obj.weaponVariant].src, obj.scale, 0, ctxt);
                            }
                            if (items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].projectile != undefined && !items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].hideProjectile) {
                                renderProjectile(obj.scale, 0,
                                                 items.projectiles[items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].projectile], mainContext);
                            }
                        }
                    } else if (getVal("deadPlayer") == "2") {
                        if (obj.buildIndex < 0 && !items.weapons[10].aboveHand) {
                            renderTool(items.weapons[10], config.weaponVariants[1].src || "", obj.scale, 0, ctxt);
                            if (items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].projectile != undefined && !items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].hideProjectile) {
                                renderProjectile(obj.scale, 0,
                                                 items.projectiles[items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].projectile], mainContext);
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // HANDS:
                    ctxt.fillStyle = realModelMode ? config.skinColors[obj.skinColor] : getVal("deadPlayer") == "2" ? "#ececec" : config.skinColors[obj.skinColor];
                    renderCircle(obj.scale * Math.cos(handAngle), (obj.scale * Math.sin(handAngle)), 14);
                    renderCircle((obj.scale * oHandDist) * Math.cos(-handAngle * oHandAngle),
                                 (obj.scale * oHandDist) * Math.sin(-handAngle * oHandAngle), 14);

                    // WEAPON ABOVE HANDS:
                    if (realModelMode || deadMode == "3") {
                        if (obj.buildIndex < 0 && items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].aboveHand) {
                            if (getEl("texture").checked) {
                                renderTextureTool(items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex], config.weaponVariants[obj.weaponVariant].src, obj.scale, 0, ctxt, obj);
                            } else {
                                renderTool(items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex], config.weaponVariants[obj.weaponVariant].src, obj.scale, 0, ctxt);
                            }
                            if (items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].projectile != undefined && !items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].hideProjectile) {
                                renderProjectile(obj.scale, 0,
                                                 items.projectiles[items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].projectile], mainContext);
                            }
                        }
                    } else if (getVal("deadPlayer") == "2") {
                        if (obj.buildIndex < 0 && items.weapons[10].aboveHand) {
                            renderTool(items.weapons[10], config.weaponVariants[1].src || "", obj.scale, 0, ctxt);
                            if (items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].projectile != undefined && !items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].hideProjectile) {
                                renderProjectile(obj.scale, 0,
                                                 items.projectiles[items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].projectile], mainContext);
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // BUILD ITEM:
                    if (obj.buildIndex >= 0) {
                        var tmpSprite = getItemSprite(items.list[obj.buildIndex]);
                        ctxt.drawImage(tmpSprite, obj.scale - items.list[obj.buildIndex].holdOffset, -tmpSprite.width / 2);
                    }

                    // BODY:
                    renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale, ctxt);
                    // SKIN
                    if (getVal("deadPlayer") == "3") {
                        ctxt.lineWidth = 2;
                        ctxt.fillStyle = "#555";
                        ctxt.font = "35px Hammersmith One";
                        ctxt.textBaseline = "middle";
                        ctxt.textAlign = "center";

                        ctxt.fillText("(", 20, 5);

                        ctxt.rotate(Math.PI / 2);
                        ctxt.font = "30px Hammersmith One";
                        ctxt.fillText("X", -15, 15/2);
                        ctxt.fillText("X", 15, 15/2);
                    }
                    if (realModelMode && obj.skinIndex > 0) {
                        ctxt.rotate(Math.PI / 2);
                        renderSkin2(obj.skinIndex, ctxt, null, obj);
                    } else if (getVal("deadPlayer") == "2") {
                        renderSkin2(48, ctxt, null, obj);
                    }

                }
                // RENDER DEAD-PLAYER SKIN:
                // Dead players are snapshots, so they need their own sprite cache instead
                // of depending on the live-player texture renderer.
                const deadSkinSprites = {};
                const deadSkinPointers = {};
                function renderSkin2(index, ctxt, parentSkin, owner) {
                    let sprite = deadSkinSprites[index];
                    if (!sprite) {
                        sprite = new Image();
                        sprite.onload = function () { sprite.isLoaded = true; };
                        sprite.src = "https://moomoo.io/img/hats/hat_" + index + ".png";
                        deadSkinSprites[index] = sprite;
                    }
                    let hat = parentSkin || deadSkinPointers[index];
                    if (!hat) {
                        hat = hats.find(function (entry) { return String(entry.id) === String(index).replace("_top", ""); });
                        // A missing metadata entry must not crash dead-player rendering.
                        if (!hat) return;
                        deadSkinPointers[index] = hat;
                    }
                    if (sprite.isLoaded) {
                        ctxt.drawImage(sprite, -hat.scale / 2, -hat.scale / 2, hat.scale, hat.scale);
                    }
                    if (!parentSkin && hat.topSprite) {
                        ctxt.save();
                        ctxt.rotate((owner && owner.skinRot) || 0);
                        renderSkin2(String(index) + "_top", ctxt, hat, owner);
                        ctxt.restore();
                    }
                }

                // RENDER PLAYER:
                function renderPlayer(obj, ctxt) {
                    ctxt = ctxt || mainContext;
                    // Keep the original renderer width. Canvas scaling reduces body and outline
                    // together, preserving the same proportions as the game model.
                    ctxt.lineWidth = outlineWidth;
                    ctxt.lineJoin = "miter";
                    var handAngle = (Math.PI / 4) * (items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].armS || 1);
                    var oHandAngle = obj.buildIndex < 0 ? items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].hndS || 1 : 1;
                    var oHandDist = obj.buildIndex < 0 ? items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].hndD || 1 : 1;
                    // TAIL/CAPE:
                    if (obj.tailIndex > 0) {
                        renderTail(obj.tailIndex, ctxt, obj);
                    }
                    // WEAPON BELLOW HANDS:
                    if (obj.buildIndex < 0 && !items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].aboveHand) {
                        if (getEl("texture").checked && getEl("textures").value != "3") {
                            renderTextureTool(items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex], config.weaponVariants[obj.weaponVariant].src, obj.scale, 0, ctxt, obj);
                        } else {
                            renderTool(items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex], config.weaponVariants[obj.weaponVariant].src, obj.scale, 0, ctxt);
                        }
                        if (items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].projectile != undefined && !items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].hideProjectile) {
                            renderProjectile(obj.scale, 0,
                                             items.projectiles[items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].projectile], ctxt);
                        }
                    }

                    // HANDS:
                    ctxt.fillStyle = config.skinColors[obj.skinColor];
                    // Pass ctxt explicitly. In the main renderer ctxt is mainContext, while
                    // the HUD preview needs hands to stay inside its own canvas.
                    renderCircle(obj.scale * Math.cos(handAngle), (obj.scale * Math.sin(handAngle)), 14, ctxt);
                    renderCircle((obj.scale * oHandDist) * Math.cos(-handAngle * oHandAngle),
                                 (obj.scale * oHandDist) * Math.sin(-handAngle * oHandAngle), 14, ctxt);

                    // WEAPON ABOVE HANDS:
                    if (obj.buildIndex < 0 && items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].aboveHand) {
                        if (getEl("texture").checked && getEl("textures").value != "3") {
                            renderTextureTool(items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex], config.weaponVariants[obj.weaponVariant].src, obj.scale, 0, ctxt, obj);
                        } else {
                            renderTool(items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex], config.weaponVariants[obj.weaponVariant].src, obj.scale, 0, ctxt);
                        }
                        if (items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].projectile != undefined && !items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].hideProjectile) {
                            renderProjectile(obj.scale, 0,
                                             items.projectiles[items.weapons[obj.weaponIndex].projectile], ctxt);
                        }
                    }
                    // BUILD ITEM:
                    if (obj.buildIndex >= 0) {
                        var tmpSprite = getItemSprite(items.list[obj.buildIndex]);
                        ctxt.drawImage(tmpSprite, obj.scale - items.list[obj.buildIndex].holdOffset, -tmpSprite.width / 2);
                    }
                    // BODY:
                    renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale, ctxt);
                    // SKIN:
                    if (obj.skinIndex > 0) {
                        ctxt.rotate(Math.PI / 2);
                        renderSkin(obj.skinIndex, ctxt, null, obj);
                    }
                }

                function getTexturePackImg(id, type) {
                    if(getEl("textures").value == "1") {
                        if(newHatImgs[id] && type == "hat") {
                            return newHatImgs[id];

                            return newAccImgs[id];
                        }else if(animals[id] && type == "animal") {
                            return animals[id];
                        } else {
                            if(type == "acc") {
                                return ".././img/accessories/access_" + id + ".png";
                            }else if(type == "hat") {
                                return ".././img/hats/hat_" + id + ".png";
                            }else if(type == "weapon") {
                                return ".././img/weapons/" + id + ".png";
                            }else if(type == "animal") {
                                return ".././img/animals/" + id + ".png";
                            }

                    }else if (getEl("textures").value == "2") {

                function renderSkin(index, ctxt, parentSkin, owner) {
                    tmpSkin = skinSprites[index];
                    if (!(tmpSkin = skinSprites[index + ((getEl("textures").value == "1") ? "lol" : getEl("textures").value == "2" ? "lel" : getEl("textures").value == "3" ? "lal" : getEl("textures").value == "4" ? "lpl" : getEl("textures").value == "5" ? "lql" : 0)])) {
                        var tmpImage = new Image();
                        tmpImage.onload = function() {
                            this.isLoaded = true;
                            this.onload = null;
                        }
                        ;
                        tmpImage.src = getTexturePackImg(index, "hat")
                        skinSprites[index + ((getEl("textures").value == "1") ? "lol" : getEl("textures").value == "2" ? "lel" : getEl("textures").value == "3" ? "lal" : getEl("textures").value == "4" ? "lpl" : getEl("textures").value == "5" ? "lql" : 0)] = tmpImage;
                        tmpSkin = tmpImage;
                    }
                    var tmpObj = parentSkin || skinPointers[index];
                    if (!tmpObj) {
                        for (var i = 0; i < hats.length; ++i) {
                            if (hats[i].id == index) {
                                tmpObj = hats[i];
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        skinPointers[index] = tmpObj;
                    }
                    if (tmpSkin.isLoaded)
                        ctxt.drawImage(tmpSkin, -tmpObj.scale / 2, -tmpObj.scale / 2, tmpObj.scale, tmpObj.scale);
                    if (!parentSkin && tmpObj.topSprite) {
                        ctxt.save();
                        ctxt.rotate(owner.skinRot);
                        renderSkin(index + "_top", ctxt, tmpObj, owner);
                        ctxt.restore();
                    }
                }
                // RENDER TAIL:
                var accessSprites = {};
                var accessSprites2 = {};
                var accessPointers2 = {};
                var accessPointers = {};

                function renderTail(index, ctxt, owner) {
                    tmpSkin = accessSprites[index];
                    if (!(tmpSkin = accessSprites[index + ((getEl("textures").value == "1") ? "lol" : getEl("textures").value == "2" ? "lel" : getEl("textures").value == "3" ? "lal" : getEl("textures").value == "4" ? "lpl" : getEl("textures").value == "5" ? "lql" : 0)])) {
                        var tmpImage = new Image();
                        tmpImage.onload = function() {
                            this.isLoaded = true;
                            this.onload = null;
                        }
                        ;
                        tmpImage.src = getTexturePackImg(index, "acc")
                        accessSprites[index + ((getEl("textures").value == "1") ? "lol" : getEl("textures").value == "2" ? "lel" : getEl("textures").value == "3" ? "lal" : getEl("textures").value == "4" ? "lpl" : getEl("textures").value == "5" ? "lql" : 0)] = tmpImage;
                        tmpSkin = tmpImage;
                    }
                    var tmpObj = accessPointers[index];
                    if (!tmpObj) {
                        for (var i = 0; i < accessories.length; ++i) {
                            if (accessories[i].id == index) {
                                tmpObj = accessories[i];
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        accessPointers[index] = tmpObj;
                    }
                    if (tmpSkin.isLoaded) {
                        ctxt.save();
                        ctxt.translate(-20 - (tmpObj.xOff || 0), 0);
                        if (tmpObj.spin)
                            ctxt.rotate(owner.skinRot);
                        ctxt.drawImage(tmpSkin, -(tmpObj.scale / 2), -(tmpObj.scale / 2), tmpObj.scale, tmpObj.scale);
                        ctxt.restore();
                    }
                }
                // RENDER TOOL:
                var toolSprites = {};


                function renderTool(obj, variant, x, y, ctxt) {
                    var tmpSrc = obj.src + (variant || "");
                    var tmpSprite = toolSprites[tmpSrc];
                    if (!(tmpSprite = toolSprites[tmpSrc + (getEl("textures").value == "3" ? "lrl" : 0)])) {
                        tmpSprite = new Image();
                        tmpSprite.onload = function() {
                            this.isLoaded = true;
                        }
                        ;
                        tmpSprite.src = getTexturePackImg(tmpSrc, "weapon")
                        toolSprites[tmpSrc + ((getEl("textures").value == "3" ? "lrl" : 0))] = tmpSprite;
                    }
                    if (tmpSprite.isLoaded)
                        ctxt.drawImage(tmpSprite, x + obj.xOff - obj.length / 2, y + obj.yOff - obj.width / 2, obj.length, obj.width);
                }
                var toolFucks = {};
                function setTextureImage(obj, fuk, tmpSrc) {
                    if (getEl("textures").value != "3") {
                        if (fuk.weaponVariant == 3) { // ruby
                            if (obj.id == 0) { // tool hammer
                                return "https://i.imgur.com/oRXUfW8.png";
