                // RENDER TEXTURE TOOL:
                function renderTextureTool(obj, variant, x, y, ctxt, fuk) {
                    var tmpSrc = obj.src + (variant||"");
                    var tmpSprite = toolFucks[tmpSrc];
                    if (!tmpSprite) {
                        tmpSprite = new Image();
                        tmpSprite.onload = function() {
                            this.isLoaded = true;
                        }

                        // Texture Pack:
                        tmpSprite.src = setTextureImage(obj, fuk, tmpSrc);

                        toolFucks[tmpSrc] = tmpSprite;
                    }
                    if (tmpSprite.isLoaded)
                        ctxt.drawImage(tmpSprite, x+obj.xOff-(obj.length/2), y+obj.yOff-(obj.width/2), obj.length, obj.width);
                }
                // RENDER GAME OBJECTS:
                var gameObjectSprites = {};

                function getResSprite(obj) {
                    var biomeID = obj.y >= config.mapScale - config.snowBiomeTop ? 2 : obj.y <= config.snowBiomeTop ? 1 : 0;
                    var tmpIndex = obj.type + "_" + obj.scale + "_" + biomeID;
                    var tmpSprite = gameObjectSprites[tmpIndex];
                    if (!tmpSprite) {
                        var tmpCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
                        tmpCanvas.width = tmpCanvas.height = obj.scale * 2.1 + outlineWidth;
                        var tmpContext = tmpCanvas.getContext("2d");
                        tmpContext.translate(tmpCanvas.width / 2, tmpCanvas.height / 2);
                        tmpContext.rotate(UTILS.randFloat(0, Math.PI));
                        tmpContext.strokeStyle = outlineColor;
                        tmpContext.lineWidth = outlineWidth;
                        let colors = [["#b1d959", "#95b946"], ["#bade6e", "#aac76b"], ["#a7d544", "#86a63f"], ["#b4db62", "#9ebf57"], ];
                        let select = colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
                        if (obj.type == 0) {
                            var tmpScale;
                            for (var i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
                                tmpScale = tmpObj.scale * (!i ? 1 : 0.5);
                                renderStar(tmpContext, 7, tmpScale, tmpScale * 0.7);
                                tmpContext.fillStyle = !biomeID ? !i ? select[1] : select[0] : !i ? "#e3f1f4" : "#fff";
                                tmpContext.fill();
                                if (!i)
                                    tmpContext.stroke();
                            }
                        } else if (obj.type == 1) {
                            if (biomeID == 2) {
                                tmpContext.fillStyle = "#606060";
                                renderStar(tmpContext, 6, obj.scale * 0.3, obj.scale * 0.71);
                                tmpContext.fill();
                                tmpContext.stroke();
                                tmpContext.fillStyle = "#89a54c";
                                renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 0.55, tmpContext);
                                tmpContext.fillStyle = "#a5c65b";
                                renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 0.3, tmpContext, true);
                            } else {
                                renderBlob(tmpContext, 6, tmpObj.scale, tmpObj.scale * 0.7);
                                tmpContext.fillStyle = biomeID ? "#e3f1f4" : "#89a54c";
                                tmpContext.fill();
                                tmpContext.stroke();
                                tmpContext.fillStyle = biomeID ? "#6a64af" : "#c15555";
                                var tmpRange;
                                var berries = 4;
                                var rotVal = mathPI2 / berries;
                                for (var i = 0; i < berries; ++i) {
                                    tmpRange = UTILS.randInt(tmpObj.scale / 3.5, tmpObj.scale / 2.3);
                                    renderCircle(tmpRange * Math.cos(rotVal * i), tmpRange * Math.sin(rotVal * i), UTILS.randInt(10, 12), tmpContext);
                                }
                            }
                        } else if (obj.type == 2 || obj.type == 3) {
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = obj.type == 2 ? biomeID == 2 ? "#938d77" : "#939393" : "#e0c655";
                            renderStar(tmpContext, 3, obj.scale, obj.scale);
                            tmpContext.fill();
                            tmpContext.stroke();
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = obj.type == 2 ? biomeID == 2 ? "#b2ab90" : "#bcbcbc" : "#ebdca3";
                            renderStar(tmpContext, 3, obj.scale * 0.55, obj.scale * 0.65);
                            tmpContext.fill();
                        }
                        tmpSprite = tmpCanvas;
                        gameObjectSprites[tmpIndex] = tmpSprite;
                    }
                    return tmpSprite;
                }
                // GET ITEM SPRITE:
                var itemSprites = [];

                var minecraft = false;
                function getItemSprite(obj, asIcon) {
                    var tmpSprite = itemSprites[obj.id];
                    if (!tmpSprite || asIcon) {
                        var tmpCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                        tmpCanvas.width = tmpCanvas.height = (obj.scale * 2.5) + outlineWidth +
                            (items.list[obj.id].spritePadding||0);
                        var tmpContext = tmpCanvas.getContext('2d');
                        tmpContext.translate((tmpCanvas.width / 2), (tmpCanvas.height / 2));
                        tmpContext.rotate(asIcon?0:(Math.PI/2));
                        tmpContext.strokeStyle = outlineColor;
                        tmpContext.lineWidth = outlineWidth * (asIcon?(tmpCanvas.width/81):1);
                        if (obj.name == "apple") {
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#c15555";
                            if (minecraft) {
                                renderRect(0, 0, obj.scale*(Math.PI/2), obj.scale*(Math.PI/2), tmpContext);
                            } else {
                                renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale, tmpContext);
                            }
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#89a54c";
                            var leafDir = -(Math.PI / 2);
                            renderLeaf(obj.scale * Math.cos(leafDir), obj.scale * Math.sin(leafDir),
                                       25, leafDir + Math.PI/2, tmpContext);
                        } else if (obj.name == "cookie") {
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#cca861";
                            if (minecraft) {
                                renderRect(0, 0, obj.scale*(Math.PI/2), obj.scale*(Math.PI/2), tmpContext);
                            } else {
                                renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale, tmpContext);
                            }
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#937c4b";
                            var chips = 4;
                            var rotVal = mathPI2 / chips;
                            var tmpRange;
                            for (var i = 0; i < chips; ++i) {
                                tmpRange = UTILS.randInt(obj.scale / 2.5, obj.scale / 1.7);
                                renderCircle(tmpRange * Math.cos(rotVal * i), tmpRange * Math.sin(rotVal * i),
                                             UTILS.randInt(4, 5), tmpContext, true);
                            }
                        } else if (obj.name == "cheese") {
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#f4f3ac";
                            if (minecraft) {
                                renderRect(0, 0, obj.scale*(Math.PI/2), obj.scale*(Math.PI/2), tmpContext);
                            } else {
                                renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale, tmpContext);
                            }
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#c3c28b";
                            var chips = 4;
                            var rotVal = mathPI2 / chips;
                            var tmpRange;
                            for (var i = 0; i < chips; ++i) {
                                tmpRange = UTILS.randInt(obj.scale / 2.5, obj.scale / 1.7);
                                renderCircle(tmpRange * Math.cos(rotVal * i), tmpRange * Math.sin(rotVal * i),
                                             UTILS.randInt(4, 5), tmpContext, true);
                            }
                        } else if (obj.name == "wood wall" || obj.name == "stone wall" || obj.name == "castle wall") {
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = (obj.name == "castle wall")?"#83898e":(obj.name=="wood wall")?
                                "#a5974c":"#939393";
                            var sides = (obj.name == "castle wall")?4:3;
                            if (minecraft) {
                                renderRect(0, 0, obj.scale * (Math.PI/2) * 1.1, obj.scale * (Math.PI/2) * 1.1, tmpContext);
                            } else {
                                renderStar(tmpContext, sides, obj.scale * 1.1, obj.scale * 1.1);
                            }
                            tmpContext.fill();
                            tmpContext.stroke();
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = (obj.name == "castle wall")?"#9da4aa":(obj.name=="wood wall")?
                                "#c9b758":"#bcbcbc";
                            if (minecraft) {
                                renderRect(0, 0, obj.scale * (Math.PI/2) * 0.65, obj.scale * (Math.PI/2) * 0.65, tmpContext);
                            } else {
                                renderStar(tmpContext, sides, obj.scale * 0.65, obj.scale * 0.65);
                            }
                            tmpContext.fill();
                        } else if (obj.name == "spikes" || obj.name == "greater spikes" || obj.name == "poison spikes"
                                   || obj.name == "spinning spikes") {
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = (obj.name == "poison spikes")?"#7b935d":"#939393";
                            var tmpScale = (obj.scale * 0.6);
                            renderStar(tmpContext, (obj.name == "spikes")?5:6, obj.scale, tmpScale);
                            tmpContext.fill();
                            tmpContext.stroke();
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#a5974c";
                            if (minecraft) {
                                renderRect(0, 0, tmpScale * (Math.PI/(Math.PI/2)), tmpScale * (Math.PI/(Math.PI/2)), tmpContext);
                            } else {
                                renderCircle(0, 0, tmpScale, tmpContext);
                            }
                            if (player && obj.owner && player.sid != obj.owner.sid && !findAllianceBySid(obj.owner.sid)) {
                                //                        tmpContext.fillStyle = "#cc5151";
                                tmpContext.fillStyle = "#c9b758";
                            } else {
                                tmpContext.fillStyle = "#c9b758";
                            }
                            if (minecraft) {
                                renderRect(0, 0, (tmpScale * (Math.PI/(Math.PI/2))) * 0.65, (tmpScale * (Math.PI/(Math.PI/2))) * 0.65, tmpContext);
                            } else {
                                renderCircle(0, 0, tmpScale/2, tmpContext, true);
                            }
                        } else if (obj.name == "windmill" || obj.name == "faster windmill" || obj.name == "power mill") {
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#a5974c";
                            if (minecraft) {
                                renderRect(0, 0, obj.scale*(Math.PI/2), obj.scale*(Math.PI/2), tmpContext);
                            } else {
                                renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale, tmpContext);
                            }
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#c9b758";
                            renderRectCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 1.5, 29, 4, tmpContext);
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#a5974c";
                            if (minecraft) {
                                renderRect(0, 0, (obj.scale*(Math.PI/2))*0.5, (obj.scale*(Math.PI/2))*0.5, tmpContext);
                            } else {
                                renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 0.5, tmpContext);
                            }
                        } else if (obj.name == "mine") {
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#939393";
                            if (minecraft) {
                                renderRect(0, 0, obj.scale * (Math.PI/2), obj.scale * (Math.PI/2), tmpContext);
                            } else {
                                renderStar(tmpContext, 3, obj.scale, obj.scale);
                            }
                            tmpContext.fill();
                            tmpContext.stroke();
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#bcbcbc";
                            if (minecraft) {
                                renderRect(0, 0, (obj.scale * (Math.PI/2))*0.55, (obj.scale * (Math.PI/2))*0.55, tmpContext);
                            } else {
                                renderStar(tmpContext, 3, obj.scale * 0.55, obj.scale * 0.65);
                            }
                            tmpContext.fill();
                        } else if (obj.name == "sapling") {
                            for (var i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
                                var tmpScale = obj.scale * (!i?1:0.5);
                                if (minecraft) {
                                    renderRect(0, 0, tmpScale * (Math.PI/2), tmpScale * (Math.PI/2), tmpContext);
                                } else {
                                    renderStar(tmpContext, 7, tmpScale, tmpScale * 0.7);
                                }
                                tmpContext.fillStyle = (!i?"#9ebf57":"#b4db62");
                                tmpContext.fill();
                                if (!i) tmpContext.stroke();
                            }
                        } else if (obj.name == "pit trap") {
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#a5974c";
                            renderStar(tmpContext, 3, obj.scale * 1.1, obj.scale * 1.1);
                            tmpContext.fill();
                            tmpContext.stroke();
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = outlineColor
                            renderStar(tmpContext, 3, obj.scale * 0.65, obj.scale * 0.65);
                            tmpContext.fill();
                        } else if (obj.name == "boost pad") {
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#7e7f82";
                            renderRect(0, 0, obj.scale*2, obj.scale*2, tmpContext);
                            tmpContext.fill();
                            tmpContext.stroke();
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#dbd97d";
                            renderTriangle(obj.scale * 1, tmpContext);
                        } else if (obj.name == "turret") {
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#a5974c";
                            renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale, tmpContext);
                            tmpContext.fill();
                            tmpContext.stroke();
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#939393";
                            var tmpLen = 50;
                            renderRect(0, -tmpLen/2, obj.scale * 0.9, tmpLen, tmpContext);
                            renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 0.6, tmpContext);
                            tmpContext.fill();
                            tmpContext.stroke();
                        } else if (obj.name == "platform") {
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#cebd5f";
                            var tmpCount = 4;
                            var tmpS = obj.scale * 2;
                            var tmpW = tmpS / tmpCount;
                            var tmpX = -(obj.scale/2);
                            for (var i = 0; i < tmpCount; ++i) {
                                renderRect(tmpX - (tmpW/2), 0, tmpW, obj.scale*2, tmpContext);
                                tmpContext.fill();
                                tmpContext.stroke();
                                tmpX += tmpS / tmpCount;
                            }
                        } else if (obj.name == "healing pad") {
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#7e7f82";
                            renderRect(0, 0, obj.scale*2, obj.scale*2, tmpContext);
                            tmpContext.fill();
                            tmpContext.stroke();
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#db6e6e";
                            renderRectCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 0.65, 20, 4, tmpContext, true);
                        } else if (obj.name == "spawn pad") {
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#7e7f82";
                            renderRect(0, 0, obj.scale*2, obj.scale*2, tmpContext);
                            tmpContext.fill();
                            tmpContext.stroke();
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#71aad6";
                            renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 0.6, tmpContext);
                        } else if (obj.name == "blocker") {
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#7e7f82";
                            renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale, tmpContext);
                            tmpContext.fill();
                            tmpContext.stroke();
                            tmpContext.rotate(Math.PI / 4);
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#db6e6e";
                            renderRectCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 0.65, 20, 4, tmpContext, true);
                        } else if (obj.name == "teleporter") {
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#7e7f82";
                            renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale, tmpContext);
                            tmpContext.fill();
                            tmpContext.stroke();
                            tmpContext.rotate(Math.PI / 4);
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#d76edb";
                            renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 0.5, tmpContext, true);
                        }
                        tmpSprite = tmpCanvas;
                        if (!asIcon)
                            itemSprites[obj.id] = tmpSprite;
                    }
                    return tmpSprite;
                }
                var objSprites = [];

                function getObjSprite(obj) {
                    var tmpSprite = objSprites[obj.id];
                    if (!tmpSprite) {
                        var tmpCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
                        tmpCanvas.width = tmpCanvas.height = obj.scale * 2.5 + outlineWidth + (items.list[obj.id].spritePadding || 0);
                        var tmpContext = tmpCanvas.getContext("2d");
                        tmpContext.translate(tmpCanvas.width / 2, tmpCanvas.height / 2);
                        tmpContext.rotate(Math.PI / 2);
                        tmpContext.strokeStyle = outlineColor;
                        tmpContext.lineWidth = outlineWidth;
                        if (obj.name == "spikes" || obj.name == "greater spikes" || obj.name == "poison spikes" || obj.name == "spinning spikes") {
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = obj.name == "poison spikes" ? "#7b935d" : "#939393";
                            var tmpScale = obj.scale * 0.6;
                            renderStar(tmpContext, obj.name == "spikes" ? 5 : 6, obj.scale, tmpScale);
                            tmpContext.fill();
                            tmpContext.stroke();
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#a5974c";
                            renderCircle(0, 0, tmpScale, tmpContext);
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = (player && obj.owner && obj.owner.sid == player.sid ? "" : (obj.owner && player && player.team && isTeam(tmpObj) ? "#2a2770" : "#780c0c"))
                            renderCircle(0, 0, tmpScale / 2, tmpContext, true);
                        } else if (obj.name == "pit trap") {
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#a5974c";
                            renderStar(tmpContext, 3, obj.scale * 1.1, obj.scale * 1.1);
                            tmpContext.fill();
                            tmpContext.stroke();
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = (player && obj.owner && obj.owner.sid == player.sid ? "#a5974c" : (obj.owner && player && player.team && isTeam(tmpObj) ? "#2a2770" : "#780c0c"))
                            renderStar(tmpContext, 3, obj.scale * 0.65, obj.scale * 0.65);
                            tmpContext.fill();
                        }
                        tmpSprite = tmpCanvas;
                        objSprites[obj.id] = tmpSprite;
                    }
                    return tmpSprite;
                }
                // GET MARK SPRITE:
                function getMarkSprite(obj, tmpContext, tmpX, tmpY) {
                    let center = {
                        x: screenWidth / 2,
                        y: screenHeight / 2,
                    };
                    tmpContext.lineWidth = outlineWidth;
                    mainContext.globalAlpha = 0.45;
                    tmpContext.strokeStyle = outlineColor;
                    tmpContext.save();
                    tmpContext.translate(tmpX, tmpY);
                    tmpContext.rotate(obj.dir || getAttackDir());
                    if (obj.name == "spikes" || obj.name == "greater spikes" || obj.name == "poison spikes" || obj.name == "spinning spikes") {
                        tmpContext.fillStyle = (obj.name == "poison spikes") ? "#7b935d" : "#939393";
                        var tmpScale = (obj.scale * 0.6);
                        renderStar(tmpContext, (obj.name == "spikes") ? 5 : 6, obj.scale, tmpScale);
                        tmpContext.fill();
                        tmpContext.stroke();
                        tmpContext.fillStyle = "#a5974c";
                        renderCircle(0, 0, tmpScale, tmpContext);
                        if (player && obj.owner && player.sid != obj.owner.sid && !tmpObj.findAllianceBySid(obj.owner.sid)) {
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#a34040";
                        } else {
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#c9b758";
                        }
                        renderCircle(0, 0, tmpScale / 2, tmpContext, true);
                    } else if (obj.name == "turret") {
                        tmpContext.fillStyle = "#a5974c";
                        renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale, tmpContext);
                        tmpContext.fill();
                        tmpContext.stroke();
                        tmpContext.fillStyle = "#939393";
                        let tmpLen = 50;
                        renderRect(0, -tmpLen / 2, obj.scale * 0.9, tmpLen, tmpContext);
                        renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 0.6, tmpContext);
                        tmpContext.fill();
                        tmpContext.stroke();
                    } else if (obj.name == "teleporter") {
                        tmpContext.fillStyle = "#7e7f82";
                        renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale, tmpContext);
                        tmpContext.fill();
                        tmpContext.stroke();
                        tmpContext.rotate(Math.PI / 4);
                        tmpContext.fillStyle = "#d76edb";
                        renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 0.5, tmpContext, true);
                    } else if (obj.name == "platform") {
                        tmpContext.fillStyle = "#cebd5f";
                        let tmpCount = 4;
                        let tmpS = obj.scale * 2;
                        let tmpW = tmpS / tmpCount;
                        let tmpX = -(obj.scale / 2);
                        for (let i = 0; i < tmpCount; ++i) {
                            renderRect(tmpX - (tmpW / 2), 0, tmpW, obj.scale * 2, tmpContext);
                            tmpContext.fill();
                            tmpContext.stroke();
                            tmpX += tmpS / tmpCount;
                        }
                    } else if (obj.name == "healing pad") {
                        tmpContext.fillStyle = "#7e7f82";
                        renderRect(0, 0, obj.scale * 2, obj.scale * 2, tmpContext);
                        tmpContext.fill();
                        tmpContext.stroke();
                        tmpContext.fillStyle = "#db6e6e";
                        renderRectCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 0.65, 20, 4, tmpContext, true);
                    } else if (obj.name == "spawn pad") {
                        tmpContext.fillStyle = "#7e7f82";
                        renderRect(0, 0, obj.scale * 2, obj.scale * 2, tmpContext);
                        tmpContext.fill();
                        tmpContext.stroke();
                        tmpContext.fillStyle = "#71aad6";
                        renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 0.6, tmpContext);
                    } else if (obj.name == "blocker") {
                        tmpContext.fillStyle = "#7e7f82";
                        renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale, tmpContext);
                        tmpContext.fill();
                        tmpContext.stroke();
                        tmpContext.rotate(Math.PI / 4);
                        tmpContext.fillStyle = "#db6e6e";
                        renderRectCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 0.65, 20, 4, tmpContext, true);
                    } else if (obj.name == "windmill" || obj.name == "faster windmill" || obj.name == "power mill") {
                        tmpContext.fillStyle = "#a5974c";
                        renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale, tmpContext);
                        tmpContext.fillStyle = "#c9b758";
                        renderRectCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 1.5, 29, 4, tmpContext);
                        tmpContext.fillStyle = "#a5974c";
                        renderCircle(0, 0, obj.scale * 0.5, tmpContext);
                    } else if (obj.name == "pit trap") {
                        tmpContext.fillStyle = "#a5974c";
                        renderStar(tmpContext, 3, obj.scale * 1.1, obj.scale * 1.1);
                        tmpContext.fill();
                        tmpContext.stroke();
                        if (player && obj.owner && player.sid != obj.owner.sid && !tmpObj.findAllianceBySid(obj.owner.sid)) {
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = "#a34040";
                        } else {
                            tmpContext.fillStyle = outlineColor;
                        }
                        renderStar(tmpContext, 3, obj.scale * 0.65, obj.scale * 0.65);
                        tmpContext.fill();
                    }
                    tmpContext.restore();
                }
                // RENDER LEAF:
                function renderLeaf(x, y, l, r, ctxt) {
                    var endX = x + l * Math.cos(r);
                    var endY = y + l * Math.sin(r);
                    var width = l * 0.4;
                    ctxt.moveTo(x, y);
                    ctxt.beginPath();
                    ctxt.quadraticCurveTo((x + endX) / 2 + width * Math.cos(r + Math.PI / 2), (y + endY) / 2 + width * Math.sin(r + Math.PI / 2), endX, endY);
                    ctxt.quadraticCurveTo((x + endX) / 2 - width * Math.cos(r + Math.PI / 2), (y + endY) / 2 - width * Math.sin(r + Math.PI / 2), x, y);
                    ctxt.closePath();
                    ctxt.fill();
                    ctxt.stroke();
                }
                // RENDER CIRCLE:
                function renderCircle(x, y, scale, tmpContext, dontStroke, dontFill) {
                    tmpContext = tmpContext || mainContext;
                    tmpContext.beginPath();
                    tmpContext.arc(x, y, scale, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
                    if (!dontFill)
                        tmpContext.fill();
                    if (!dontStroke)
                        tmpContext.stroke();
                }

                function renderCircle2(x, y, scale, tmpContext, dontStroke, dontFill) {
                    tmpContext = tmpContext || mainContext;
                    tmpContext.beginPath();
                    tmpContext.ellipse(x, y, scale * 1.5, scale, Math.PI / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    if (!dontFill)
                        tmpContext.fill();
                    if (!dontStroke)
                        (tmpContext.lineWidth = 3.5),
                            tmpContext.stroke();
                }
                // RENDER STAR SHAPE:
                function renderStar(ctxt, spikes, outer, inner) {
                    var rot = (Math.PI / 2) * 3;
                    var x, y;
                    var step = Math.PI / spikes;
                    ctxt.beginPath();
                    ctxt.moveTo(0, -outer);
                    for (var i = 0; i < spikes; i++) {
                        x = Math.cos(rot) * outer;
                        y = Math.sin(rot) * outer;
                        ctxt.lineTo(x, y);
                        rot += step;
                        x = Math.cos(rot) * inner;
                        y = Math.sin(rot) * inner;
                        ctxt.lineTo(x, y);
                        rot += step;
                    }
                    ctxt.lineTo(0, -outer);
                    ctxt.closePath();
                }
                // RENDER RECTANGLE:
                function renderRect(x, y, w, h, ctxt, stroke) {
                    ctxt.fillRect(x - w / 2, y - h / 2, w, h);
                    if (!stroke)
                        ctxt.strokeRect(x - w / 2, y - h / 2, w, h);
                }
                // RENDER RECTCIRCLE:
                function renderRectCircle(x, y, s, sw, seg, ctxt, stroke) {
                    ctxt.save();
                    ctxt.translate(x, y);
                    seg = Math.ceil(seg / 2);
                    for (var i = 0; i < seg; i++) {
                        renderRect(0, 0, s * 2, sw, ctxt, stroke);
                        ctxt.rotate(Math.PI / seg);
                    }
                    ctxt.restore();
                }
                // RENDER BLOB:
                function renderBlob(ctxt, spikes, outer, inner) {
                    var rot = (Math.PI / 2) * 3;
                    var x, y;
                    var step = Math.PI / spikes;
                    var tmpOuter;
                    ctxt.beginPath();
                    ctxt.moveTo(0, -inner);
                    for (var i = 0; i < spikes; i++) {
                        tmpOuter = UTILS.randInt(outer + 0.9, outer * 1.2);
                        ctxt.quadraticCurveTo(Math.cos(rot + step) * tmpOuter, Math.sin(rot + step) * tmpOuter, Math.cos(rot + step * 2) * inner, Math.sin(rot + step * 2) * inner);
                        rot += step * 2;
                    }
                    ctxt.lineTo(0, -inner);
                    ctxt.closePath();
                }
                // RENDER TRIANGLE:
                function renderTriangle(s, ctx) {
                    ctx = ctx || mainContext;
                    var h = s * (Math.sqrt(3) / 2);
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(0, -h / 2);
                    ctx.lineTo(-s / 2, h / 2);
                    ctx.lineTo(s / 2, h / 2);
                    ctx.lineTo(0, -h / 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.closePath();
                }

                function renderTriangle2(s, ctx) {
                    ctx = ctx || mainContext;
                    var h = s * (Math.sqrt(3) / 2);
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(0, -h / 3.5);
                    ctx.lineTo(-s / 2, h / 2);
                    ctx.lineTo(s / 2, h / 2);
                    ctx.lineTo(0, -h / 3.5);
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.closePath();
                    ctx.stroke();
                }

                function renderTriangle3(s, ctx) {
                    ctx = ctx || mainContext;
                    var h = s * (Math.sqrt(3) / 2);
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(0, -h / 2);
                    ctx.lineTo(-s / 1.5, h / 1.5);
                    ctx.lineTo(s / 1.5, h / 1.5);
                    ctx.lineTo(0, -h / 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.closePath();
                }

                // CREATE FAKE OBJECTS:
                function makeFakeObjects() {
                    if (getEl("fakeObj").checked) {
                        for (let i = 0; i < 300; i++) {
                            let randomXY = {
                                x: Math.floor(Math.random() * 14400),
                                y: Math.floor(Math.random() * 14400),
                            };
                            let rT = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
                            objectManager.add(i, randomXY.x, randomXY.y, 0, (rT == 0 ? config.treeScales : rT == 1 ? config.bushScales : rT >= 2 && config.rockScales)[Math.florr(Math.random() * (rT == 0 ? 4 : 3))], rT);
                        }
                    }
                }
                // ANTI TRAP:
                let earlyAutoBreak = {
                    start: false
                };

                function antiTrap(aim) {
                    if (near.dist2 <= 300) {
                        for (let i = -45; i <= 45; i += 90) {
                            checkPlace(2, aim + UTILS.toRad(i) + Math.PI);
                        }
                    } else if (near.dist2 <= 600) {
                        for (let i = -45; i <= 45; i += 90) {
                            if (enemy.length) {
                                checkPlace(4, aim + UTILS.toRad(i) + Math.PI);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                // LOAD GAME OBJECT:
                let myTeles = [];

                function loadGameObject(data) {
                    for (var i = 0; i < data.length; ) {
                        objectManager.add(data[i], data[i + 1], data[i + 2], data[i + 3], data[i + 4], data[i + 5], items.list[data[i + 6]], true, data[i + 7] >= 0 ? {
                            sid: data[i + 7]
                        } : null);
                        try {
                            const loadedObj = findObjectBySid(data[i]);
                            if (loadedObj && loadedObj.dmg && player && loadedObj.owner && loadedObj.owner.sid !== player.sid && typeof AutoHealCore !== "undefined" && AutoHealCore.recordSpikeAppearance) AutoHealCore.recordSpikeAppearance(loadedObj);
                        } catch (_) { }
                        let XY = {
                            x: data[i + 1],
                            y: data[i + 2],
                        };
                        if (data[i + 6] == 15 && Math.hypot(data[i + 2] - player.y2, data[i + 1] - player.x2) <= 60 && player.sid != data[i + 7] && !findAllianceBySid(data[i + 7])) {
                            hitCount = 0;
                            trapSid = data[i];
                        }
                        let dist = UTILS.getDist(XY, player, 0, 2);
                        let aim = UTILS.getDirect(XY, player, 0, 2);
                        if (data[i + 6] == 22 && player.sid == data[i + 7]) {
                            myTeles.push({
                                x: data[i + 1],
                                y: data[i + 2]
                            });
                            setTimeout(()=>{
                                myTeles.shift();
                            }
                                       , 30000);
                        }
                        if (data[i + 6] == 15 && dist <= 600 && player.sid != data[i + 7] && !findAllianceBySid(data[i + 7])) {
                            setTickout(()=>{
                                antiTrap(aim);
                            }
                                       , 1);
                        }
                        if (data[i + 6] == 15 && dist <= 100 && player.sid != data[i + 7] && !findAllianceBySid(data[i + 7])) {
                            setTimeout(()=>{
                                dist = UTILS.getDist(XY, player, 0, 2);
                                aim = UTILS.getDirect(XY, player, 0, 2);
                                traps.in = true;
                                traps.aim = aim;
                                if (!earlyAutoBreak.start) {
                                    earlyAutoBreak.start = true;
                                    earlyAutoBreak.hit = 0;
                                    earlyAutoBreak.miss = 0;
                                }
                                if (dist <= 75) {
                                    earlyAutoBreak.hit++;
                                } else {
                                    earlyAutoBreak.miss++;
                                }
                            });
                        }
                        i += 8;
                    }
                }
                // WIGGLE GAME OBJECT:
                let ticktickticky = [];

                function antiSyncHealing(timearg) {
                    antiSync = true;
                    let healAnti = setInterval(()=>{
                        if (player.shameCount < 5) {
                            place(0, getAttackDir());
                        }
                    }
                                               , 80);
                    setTimeout(()=>{
                        clearInterval(healAnti);
                        setTimeout(()=>{
                            antiSync = false;
                        }, config.tickRate);
                    }
                               , config.tickRate * timearg);
                }
                function wiggleGameObject(dir, sid) {
                    try { if (typeof PlacementCoreV2 !== "undefined" && PlacementCoreV2.isNewPlacementEnabled && PlacementCoreV2.isNewPlacementEnabled() && PlacementCoreV2.onSelfObjectHitCue) PlacementCoreV2.onSelfObjectHitCue(sid, dir); } catch (_) { }
                    tmpObj = findObjectBySid(sid);
                    if (tmpObj) {
                        tmpObj.xWiggle += config.gatherWiggle * Math.cos(dir);
                        tmpObj.yWiggle += config.gatherWiggle * Math.sin(dir);
                        if (tmpObj.health) {
                            hittedObj.push(tmpObj);
                            hittedObj2.push(tmpObj);
                        }
                    }
                }
                // SHOOT TURRET:
                function shootTurret(sid, dir) {
                    tmpObj = findObjectBySid(sid);
                    if (tmpObj) {
                        tmpObj.dir = dir;
                        tmpObj.xWiggle += config.gatherWiggle * Math.cos(dir + Math.PI);
                        tmpObj.yWiggle += config.gatherWiggle * Math.sin(dir + Math.PI);
                        tmpObj.shootted = 1;
                    }
                }
                // ADD PROJECTILE:
                let doSync = false;
                let antiSync = false;
                let runAtNextTick = [];
                let rangeBackup = [];

                function addProjectile(x, y, dir, range, speed, indx, layer, sid) {
                    if (inWindow) {
                        projectileManager.addProjectile(x, y, dir, range, speed, indx, null, null, layer).sid = sid;
                    }
                    runAtNextTick.push(Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments));
                }

                function checkProjectileHolder(x, y, dir, range, speed, indx, layer, sid) {
                    let weaponIndx = indx == 0 ? 9 : indx == 2 ? 12 : indx == 3 ? 13 : indx == 5 && 15;
                    let projOffset = config.playerScale * 2;
                    let projXY = {
                        x: indx == 1 ? x : x - projOffset * Math.cos(dir),
                        y: indx == 1 ? y : y - projOffset * Math.sin(dir),
                    };
                    let fixXY = function(tmpObj) {
                        return {
                            x2: UTILS.fixTo(tmpObj.x2, 2),
                            y2: UTILS.fixTo(tmpObj.y2, 2),
                        };
                    };
                    let nearPlayer = players.filter((e)=>e.visible && UTILS.getDist(projXY, e, 0, 2) <= e.scale).sort(function(a, b) {
                        return (UTILS.getDist(projXY, a, 0, 2) - UTILS.getDist(projXY, b, 0, 2));
                    })[0];
                    if (nearPlayer) {
                        nearPlayer.projDist = UTILS.getDist(projXY, nearPlayer, 0, 2);
                        if (indx == 1) {
                            nearPlayer.shooting[53] = 1;
                        } else {
                            nearPlayer.shootIndex = weaponIndx;
                            nearPlayer.shooting[1] = 1;
                            antiBull(nearPlayer, dir, range, speed, indx, weaponIndx);
                        }
                    }
                }
                let projectileCount = 0;

                function antiBull(tmpObj, dir, range, speed, index, weaponIndex) {
                    if (!isTeam(tmpObj)) {
                        tmpDir = UTILS.getDirect(player, tmpObj, 2, 2);
                        if (UTILS.getAngleDist(tmpDir, dir) <= 0.2) {
                            tmpObj.bowThreat[weaponIndex]++;
                            if (index == 5) {
                                projectileCount++;
                            }
                            setTimeout(()=>{
                                tmpObj.bowThreat[weaponIndex]--;
                                if (index == 5) {
                                    projectileCount--;
                                }
                            }
                                       , range / speed);
                            if (tmpObj.bowThreat[9] >= 1 && (tmpObj.bowThreat[12] >= 1 || tmpObj.bowThreat[15] >= 1)) {
                                place(1, tmpObj.aim2);
                                if (!antiSync) {
                                    anti0Tick = 4;
                                    if (getEl("combat").value == "ae" && getEl("combat").value == "TesterMode" || getEl("combat").value == "Oldae") {
                                        io.send("ch", "range is homo");
                                    } else {
                                        io.send("ch", "range detect");
                                    }
                                    antiSyncHealing(4);
                                }
                            } else {
                                if (projectileCount >= 2) {
                                    place(1, tmpObj.aim2);
                                    anti0Tick = 4;
                                    if (getEl("antisync").checked && !antiSync) {
                                        if (getEl("combat").value != "ae" && getEl("combat").value != "TesterMode" || getEl("combat").value != "Oldae") {
                                            io.send("ch", getEl("combat").value == "hans" || getEl("combat").value == "goofy" || getEl("combat").value == "hae" || getEl("combat").value == "devs" || getEl("combat").value == "EwV" ? "sync is homo" : "range is homo");
                                        }
                                        antiSyncHealing(4);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                // REMOVE PROJECTILE:
                function remProjectile(sid, range) {
                    for (var i = 0; i < projectiles.length; ++i) {
                        if (projectiles[i].sid == sid) {
                            projectiles[i].range = range;
                            let tmpObjects = hittedObj;
                            let aaaaaaaaaaaaaa = projectiles[i].dmg;
                            hittedObj = [];
                            doNextTick(()=>{
                                tmpObjects.forEach((tmp)=>{
                                    if (tmp.projDmg) {
                                        tmp.health -= aaaaaaaaaaaaaa;
                                        tmp.buildHealth = tmp.health;
                                    }
                                }
                                                  );
                            }
                                      );
                        }
                    }
                }
                // ANIMATE AI:
                function animateAI(sid) {
                    tmpObj = findAIBySID(sid);
                    if (tmpObj) {
                        tmpObj.startAnim();
                        tmpObj.weaponHitted = 1;
                        tmpObj.doTickUpdate = true;
                        let tmpObjects = hittedObj;
                        hittedObj = [];
                        doNextTick(()=>{
                            tmpObjects.forEach((tmp)=>{
                                tmp.health -= 232;
                                tmp.buildHealth = tmp.health;
                            }
                                              );
                        }
                                  );
                    }
                }
                // ADD AI:
                function loadAI(data) {
                    for (var i = 0; i < ais.length; ++i) {
                        ais[i].forcePos = !ais[i].visible;
                        ais[i].visible = false;
                    }
                    if (data) {
                        var tmpTime = Date.now();
                        for (var i = 0; i < data.length; ) {
                            tmpObj = findAIBySID(data[i]);
                            if (tmpObj) {
                                tmpObj.index = data[i + 1];
                                tmpObj.t1 = tmpObj.t2 === undefined ? tmpTime : tmpObj.t2;
                                tmpObj.t2 = tmpTime;
                                tmpObj.x1 = tmpObj.x;
                                tmpObj.y1 = tmpObj.y;
                                tmpObj.x2 = data[i + 2];
                                tmpObj.y2 = data[i + 3];
                                tmpObj.d1 = tmpObj.d2 === undefined ? data[i + 4] : tmpObj.d2;
                                tmpObj.d2 = data[i + 4];
                                tmpObj.health = data[i + 5];
                                tmpObj.dt = 0;
                                tmpObj.visible = true;
                                if (tmpObj.name == "MOOSTAFA") {
                                    if (tmpObj.doTickUpdate) {
                                        tmpObj.doTickUpdate = false;
                                    }
                                    if (tmpObj.weaponHitted) {
                                        tmpObj.weaponHitted = false;
                                        tmpObj.weaponReload = 600;
                                    } else {
                                        tmpObj.weaponReload = Math.max(0, tmpObj.weaponReload - config.tickRate);
                                    }
                                }
                            } else {
                                tmpObj = aiManager.spawn(data[i + 2], data[i + 3], data[i + 4], data[i + 1]);
                                tmpObj.x2 = tmpObj.x;
                                tmpObj.y2 = tmpObj.y;
                                tmpObj.d2 = tmpObj.dir;
                                tmpObj.health = data[i + 5];
                                if (!aiManager.aiTypes[data[i + 1]].name)
                                    tmpObj.name = config.cowNames[data[i + 6]];
                                tmpObj.forcePos = true;
                                tmpObj.sid = data[i];
                                tmpObj.visible = true;
                            }
                            i += 7;
                        }
                    }
                }
                // RENDER AI:
                var aiSprites = {};

                function renderAI(obj, ctxt) {
                    var tmpIndx = obj.index;
                    var tmpSprite = aiSprites[tmpIndx];
                    var tmpSrcs = obj.src;
                    if (!(tmpSprite = aiSprites[tmpIndx + ((getEl("textures").value == "1") ? "lol" : 0)])) {
                        var tmpImg = new Image();
                        tmpImg.onload = function() {
                            this.isLoaded = true;
                            this.onload = null;
                        }
                        ;
                        tmpImg.src = getTexturePackImg(tmpSrcs, "animal");
                        tmpSprite = tmpImg;
                        aiSprites[tmpIndx + ((getEl("textures").value == "1") ? "lol" : 0)] = tmpSprite;
                    }
                    if (tmpSprite.isLoaded) {
                        var tmpScale = obj.scale * 1.2 * (obj.spriteMlt || 1);
                        ctxt.drawImage(tmpSprite, -tmpScale, -tmpScale, tmpScale * 2, tmpScale * 2);
                    }
                }
                // OBJECT ON SCREEN:
                function isOnScreen(x, y, s) {
                    return (x + s >= 0 && x - s <= maxScreenWidth && y + s >= 0 && (y, s, maxScreenHeight));
                }
                // FUNCTIONS:
                function place(id, rad, rmd) {
                    try {
                        if (id == undefined) return;
                        let item = items.list[player.items[id]];
                        let tmpS = player.scale + item.scale + (item.placeOffset || 0);
                        let tmpX = player.x2 + tmpS * Math.cos(rad);
                        let tmpY = player.y2 + tmpS * Math.sin(rad);
                        if ((player.alive && inGame && player.itemCounts[item.group.id] == undefined ? true : player.itemCounts[item.group.id] < (config.isSandbox ? 299 : item.group.limit ? item.group.limit : 99))) {
                            selectToBuild(player.items[id] || id);
                            sendAtck(1, rad);
                            selectWeapon(configs.weaponCode, true);
                            sendAtck(0, rad);
                            if (rmd && getCheck("placeVis")) {
                                placeVisible.push({
                                    x: tmpX,
                                    y: tmpY,
                                    name: item.name,
                                    scale: item.scale,
                                    dir: rad
                                });
                                setTickout(() => {
                                    placeVisible.shift();
                                }, 1)
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (e) { }
                }

                function checkPlace(id, radian, rmd) {
                    try {
                        var item = items.list[player.items[id]];
                        var tmpS = player.scale + item.scale + (item.placeOffset || 0);
                        var tmpX = player.x2 + tmpS * Math.cos(radian);
                        var tmpY = player.y2 + tmpS * Math.sin(radian);
                        if (objectManager.checkItemLocation(tmpX, tmpY, item.scale, 0.6, item.id, false, player)) {
                            if (player.itemCounts[item.group.id] == undefined ? true : player.itemCounts[item.group.id] < (config.isSandbox ? 299 : item.group.limit ? item.group.limit : 99)) {
                                selectToBuild(player.items[id]);
                                sendAtck(1, radian);
                                selectWeapon(configs.weaponCode, true);
                                sendAtck(0, radian); // BUGFIX: was sendAtck(0, rad) referencing the global
                                // degrees->radians helper `function rad(ang)` instead of the
                                // intended placement angle (checkPlace's own parameter is
                                // named `radian`, not `rad`). This silently broke the confirming
                                // attack packet's aim on every checkPlace call (mills, legacy
                                // autoPlace(), and the killObject() replace path).

                                if (rmd && getCheck("placeVis")) {
                                    placeVisible.push({
                                        x: tmpX,
                                        y: tmpY,
                                        name: item.name,
                                        scale: item.scale,
                                        dir: radian // BUGFIX: cosmetic marker also referenced the global rad() function
                                    });
                                    setTickout(() => {
                                        placeVisible.shift();
                                    }, 1)
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (e) {}
                }
                /* ==================================================================
             * VALUE PLACEMENT ENGINE v4 (PlacementCoreV2)
             * -----------------------------------------------------------------
             * v4 changelog (in response to a second round of live-game testing
             * feedback, after v3 shipped its own fixes + a visible F8 log panel):
             *
             *   1. AUTOPLACE FIX ("на дальней дистанции ~300 пишет что нет
             *      свободного угла; на близкой работает но с ошибками"): the
             *      real cause was NOT missing free angles -- TRAP_CLOSE and
             *      TRAP_APPROACH both required `dist(me, target) <= reach`
             *      where `reach` = player.scale+trap.scale*2+target.scale+18 =~
             *      183 units. Since these roles were allowed to fire up to
             *      CLOSE_RANGE=220 / NEAR_TICK_RANGE=300, EVERY attempt between
             *      ~183 and 300 units was rejected before findAngle() ever ran,
             *      always for the same physical reason, but logged as an opaque
             *      "no valid angle". FIXED: TRAP_APPROACH (the 183-300 unit
             *      band) no longer requires an immediate reach -- it places a
             *      forward defensive trap in the enemy's direction (matching
             *      the legacy script's own blind `checkPlace(4, near.aim2)` at
             *      that range), which is a valid, physically achievable action
             *      even though it can't catch them THIS instant. TRAP_CLOSE
             *      (<=220 units) keeps the strict "must be able to catch them
             *      right now" requirement, since that is its whole purpose.
             *
             *   2. AUTOPLACE FIX ("плейсит трапки когда лучше spike, когда враг
             *      в ловушке"): the trapped/not-trapped classification used
             *      `predictedTarget()` -- the knockback-boosted (x2.2)
             *      extrapolation meant for AIMING -- to decide whether the
             *      enemy was still caught. Every hit on a trapped enemy causes
             *      a knockback, so right after our own spike landed, the
             *      predicted point would fly outside the trap almost every
             *      tick, making composePlans() wrongly conclude "they escaped"
             *      and place a redundant new trap instead of continuing with a
             *      spike. FIXED: trapped/not-trapped state is now decided from
             *      `currentPosition()` (the target's real, non-extrapolated
             *      x2/y2), never from the boosted prediction. Aiming (where to
             *      actually put the point) still uses predictedTarget().
             *
             *   3. AUTOREPLACE FIX ("основная - всегда replace ловушек, не видел
             *      replace spike"; hint: "умный, если игрок в трапке реплейсит
             *      спайки куда подойдет"): replace used to mechanically rebuild
             *      whatever type (trap or spike) had just died, at its own old
             *      position. It never reconsidered whether that was still the
             *      right call. FIXED: a new `decideReplacementPlan()` routes
             *      every replace/preplace decision through the SAME
             *      "умный"/smart tactical logic as autoplace
             *      (`decideEnemyRole()`): if the enemy is trapped near the
             *      center, a dead object (trap OR spike) is replaced with a
             *      SPIKE_GUARD_ARC/KILL_SHOT spike wherever geometrically valid
             *      (full-circle search, not tied to the old position); if the
             *      enemy isn't trapped, it reacts with TRAP_CLOSE/TRAP_APPROACH
             *      instead. Only falls back to mechanically restoring the same
             *      item type at the same spot ("self-hold") when there is no
             *      usable enemy context at all (nobody around).
             *
             *   4. AUTOREPLACE FIX ("убери лимит после которого реплейс
             *      прекращает работу"): the previous chainCount>=10 cap has
             *      been removed entirely. Replace now keeps reacting for as
             *      long as #autoReplace is on and a geometrically valid spot
             *      exists, with no arbitrary cutoff after N replacements of the
             *      same position.
             *
             *   5. PREPLACE FIX ("не видел ни логов ни работы"; clarified scope:
             *      "нужно конкретно препрейсить spike/trap"): preplace now logs
             *      PREPLACE_ARM/PREPLACE_DISARM/PREPLACE_SKIP for every decision
             *      (visible on the F8 overlay added in v3.1), and both preplace
             *      paths (enemy about to break mine / I am about to break
             *      mine-or-theirs) are scoped strictly to spike/trap objects
             *      (`obj.trap || obj.dmg`) -- an earlier revision had wrongly
             *      generalised "I am about to break something" to any object
             *      type, which was a misreading of the original request.
             *      Preplace also now runs decideReplacementPlan() (see #3), so
             *      a pre-armed claim can already be the smart reaction (e.g.
             *      spike-guard instead of mechanically rebuilding a trap).
             *
             *   6. All buildPlan() failures now set `lastBuildFailReason` to a
             *      specific string (no_target, no_free_angle,
             *      target_too_far_to_catch, not_lethal, no_trap_item_equipped,
             *      etc.) which every caller logs -- replacing the old generic
             *      "no valid angle" reason that hid several unrelated causes
             *      and made the v3 feedback ("не видел работы", "с ошибками")
             *      hard to diagnose from logs alone.
             *
             * Everything else (analytic forbidden-arc geometry, obstacle
             * caching bounded to OBSTACLE_RADIUS, EMA position prediction with
             * knockback boost for AIMING, the SELF_RING anti-spam anchor
             * coverage check, `validNear()` hardening, the F8 diagnostic
             * overlay, and the single `window.__valueUseNewPlacement = false`
             * legacy fallback switch) is unchanged from v3.
             *

             *   1. RESIDUAL DEAD-ZONE BUG (same class as v4 item #1, ~10 units

             *      never disagree -- used a "+18" buffer, but buildPlan()'s OWN

             *      succeeds for the SAME role decideEnemyRole() picked at that

             *      FIXED: both post-solution reach checks now use the SAME new
             *      named constant `TRAP_CATCH_BUFFER = 8` that trapCatchReach()
             *      itself uses, so there is now exactly ONE number for this

             * v5 changelog (second live-game feedback round, "Нюансы" +
             * "Возможности" -- 6 numbered items, all found/fixed/tested this
             * session, tests/run_tests.js grew from 16 to 27 tests +
             * tests/priority_autobreak_test.js with 4 more):
             *
             *   1. AUTOPLACE FIX ("радианы для спавна на расстоянии сломаны,
             *      на близком целятся исключительно в игрока [противника],
             *      нужно расcчитывать вектор движения игрока, оба -
             *      относительный вектор"): predictedTarget()/rememberTarget()
             *      used to re-sample the target's velocity on EVERY call, and
             *      tick()/onObjectRemoved() call predictedTarget() several
             *      times per game tick (preArmFromEnemyAttack,
             *      preArmFromMyAttack, composePlans, both preplace paths).
             *      Each re-sample within the same tick measured dt against a
             *      timestamp written a fraction of a millisecond earlier by
             *      the FIRST call that tick, collapsing the computed velocity
             *      toward zero -- by the time composePlans() actually ran,
             *      "future" had silently degenerated into "current position",
             *      i.e. aiming AT the enemy instead of leading them. FIXED:
             *      sampleMotion() now samples at most once per (key, game
             *      tick) via a shared tick-stamped history map, reused by both
             *      rememberTarget() (enemy) and the new rememberSelf() (my own
             *      motion, tracked identically). predictedTarget() now
             *      computes RELATIVE velocity (target vx/vy minus my own
             *      vx/vy, each independently knockback-boosted per their own
             *      sampleMotion() flag) and leads by that relative vector over
             *      the latency window -- if I'm closing distance myself at the
             *      same rate the enemy is moving, the lead correctly collapses
             *      toward "aim at their current spot" instead of over-leading.
             *
             *   2. PREPLACE FIX ("preplace работает на дальние объекты хотя
             *      должен на те что в радиусе оружия"): preArmFromEnemyAttack()
             *      armed EVERY tracked spike/trap in `records` purely from "is
             *      the enemy's weapon ready + would their next hit be lethal",
             *      with ZERO check that the enemy was anywhere near the object
             *      in question -- an object on the other side of the map could
             *      arm just because a tracked enemy happened to have a ready
             *      weapon. FIXED: new enemyWeaponReach()/
             *      enemyWithinStrikeRangeOf() gate mirrors the reach check
             *      preArmFromMyAttack() already had for MY OWN swing, applied
             *      to the enemy's weapon range instead.
             *
             *   3. AUTOREPLACE FIX #1 ("когда враг в трапке и я ломаю СВОЮ
             *      трапку рядом стоящую -- ставится трапка, а не spike,
             *      потенциальный шанс убить утерян"): traced to a genuine
             *      threshold mismatch -- preArmReplacements()/onObjectRemoved()
             *      gated "is there a usable target at all" on a hardcoded 440,
             *      while decideEnemyRole() (the actual smart classification)
             *      only ever considers targets within its own separate
             *      NEAR_TICK_RANGE=300. Any enemy in the silent 300-440 gap
             *      looked "usable" at the outer gate, but decideEnemyRole()
             *      then immediately rejected it as out of range, so the smart
             *      branch always silently fell through to the dumb
             *      self-hold-restore-same-type fallback. FIXED: both gates now
             *      share the ONE NEAR_TICK_RANGE constant, so they can never
             *      disagree again -- confirmed with a test reproducing exactly
             *      this "break trap A elsewhere while enemy sits in trap B"
             *      scenario, now correctly reacting with smart_SPIKE_GUARD_ARC
             *      instead of self_hold_restore.
             *
             *   4. AUTOREPLACE FIX #2 ("умный реплейс не очень... если мы в
             *      трапке, ставить в любой свободный угол ловушку/spike
             *      зависит от ситуации"): this is exactly what
             *      decideReplacementPlan()/decideEnemyRole() already compute
             *      (see v4 item #4) -- once fix #3 above closed the
             *      300/440 threshold mismatch that silently prevented that
             *      logic from ever running for a large class of real
             *      encounters, this "не очень" symptom itself is the observed
             *      effect of that upstream bug, not a second, separate defect
             *      in the decision logic. Verified via TEST14.
             *
             *   5. AUTOREPLACE FIX #3 ("ты сделал реплейс только моих
             *      построек, а если я вражескую сломаю то че? ничего да"):
             *      onObjectRemoved() used to require `ownObject(object)` to
             *      react AT ALL without a prior preplace `meta` -- breaking an
             *      ENEMY's spike/trap reactively (i.e. without having lucked
             *      into the exact preplace timing window) produced zero
             *      reaction whatsoever, confirmed by a reproducing test
             *      (result: false, no logs). FIXED: any trap/spike death now
             *      triggers decideReplacementPlan(), regardless of prior
             *      ownership -- the smart branch (decideEnemyRole) never cared
             *      whose object died in the first place, it reacts to the
             *      freed tile as a tactical opportunity. Ownership is now
             *      checked in exactly ONE place: decideReplacementPlan()'s
             *      self-hold FALLBACK (no usable enemy context at all) will
             *      only mechanically rebuild MY/allied objects -- rebuilding
             *      an enemy's own object at their own old spot for free, with
             *      no enemy around to react to, would just help them.
             *
             *   6. NEW COMBAT FEATURE ("если в поле досягаемости моего оружия
             *      есть spike вражеский, сначала ломать его потом ловушку в
             *      которой мы находимся; только если это не смертельно"):
             *      inside updatePlayers()'s existing trap-fight block (NOT
             *      inside PlacementCoreV2 -- this is a reactive melee-target
             *      priority swap, not a placement decision), `nearSpike`
             *      (already computed there every tick for other purposes, no
             *      extra scan cost) is checked for being within my current
             *      weapon's actual reach; if so, AND the spike's own contact
             *      damage would not itself drop my current health to 0 or
             *      below this tick ("только если это не смертельно" --
             *      confirmed: no margin, exactly not-lethal), the attack
             *      retargets to the enemy spike (by reassigning `traps.aim`,
             *      the same variable getAttackDir() already reads whenever
             *      traps.in is true -- NOT by inventing a nonexistent
             *      parameter on io.send("7", ...), which never carries an aim
             *      argument anywhere else in this file) instead of the trap
             *      I'm caught in. Verified in isolation by
             *      tests/priority_autobreak_test.js (4 tests: priority when
             *      safe, trap-priority when lethal, unchanged fallback when no
             *      spike in reach, and the exact damage==health boundary).
             *      The REPLACE side of this same example ("сломаю спайк -> он
             *      должен поставить трапку") already works correctly as a
             *      direct consequence of fix #5 above (no additional replace
             *      code needed) -- verified with a dedicated test breaking an
             *      enemy spike near an untrapped enemy and confirming a smart
             *      TRAP_CLOSE plan is sent, not silence.
             *
             *   7. AUTOPLACE FIX ("проверь точно ли не будет блокирования
             *      spike плейсемента из-за плейсемента трапок, бывает что
             *      игрок в трапке а плейсится все равно ловушка на возможное
             *      для спайка место"): `obstacles` was built ONCE per tick()
             *      call and never updated as composePlans()'s own plans were
             *      emitted within that SAME tick's for-loop -- a plan emitted
             *      earlier in the batch (e.g. SPIKE_GUARD_ARC) was invisible
             *      to the geometry check for the NEXT plan in that same batch
             *      (e.g. a SELF_RING_GROUP sub-plan), letting them land
             *      overlapping. Reproduced exactly: SPIKE_GUARD_ARC and a
             *      SELF_RING sub-plan landed ~7 units apart in the same tick
             *      (needed ~99, spike scale 49 + trap scale 50). FIXED:
             *      emitOne() now pushes its own just-placed point into the
             *      shared `obstacles` array immediately after a successful
             *      send, so every subsequent emitOne() call within the same
             *      tick's batch sees it -- confirmed fixed (118 units apart on
             *      the same repro) and covered by TEST16.
             *
             *   8. NEW: SELF_RING gained a second, independent trigger
             *      ("кольцо из 4 трапок на дистанции >220 -- новый триггер")
             *      at LONG_RANGE_RING=220, restoring the legacy script's own
             *      long-range full-circle ring behaviour (`this.dist2 >= 205
             *      ... this.placer(4, 0, 2*Math.PI, Math.PI/9, ...)`) as a
             *      proactive defensive perimeter while the enemy is still
             *      closing -- deliberately NOT replacing the existing close-
             *      range PANIC_RANGE=120 trigger (the two ranges never
             *      overlap; 120-220 remains a dead zone by design, verified by
             *      TEST10a/b).
