                    // the literal "self", never collides with a real numeric/string sid).
                    const selfHistoryMap = new Map();
                    function rememberSelf() {
                        if (!player) return null;
                        return sampleMotion(selfHistoryMap, "self", Number(player.x2) || player.x, Number(player.y2) || player.y);
                    }
                    function predictedTarget(target) {
                        const history = rememberTarget(target) || { x: target.x2 || target.x, y: target.y2 || target.y, vx: 0, vy: 0, boosted: false };
                        const self = rememberSelf() || { vx: 0, vy: 0, boosted: false };
                        const latency = Math.max(0, Math.min(180, (Number(window.pingTime) || 0) / 2 + (Number(config.tickRate) || 111)));
                        // Relative-motion lead: predict where the target will be RELATIVE
                        // TO ME by the time this placement actually commits server-side
                        // (~latency ms from now), not just the target's own raw absolute
                        // velocity. The server validates placement reach against wherever
                        // I PHYSICALLY AM at commit time, which is `me` (now) plus my own
                        // displacement over that same latency window -- if I'm closing
                        // distance myself (e.g. chasing), I don't also need to lead as far
                        // into the target's motion, since part of the gap-closing is my
                        // own movement, not theirs.
                        //
                        // `boosted` (a sudden ballistic-knockback speed jump, see
                        // sampleMotion() above) is applied to WHICHEVER side actually shows
                        // it, symmetrically -- an earlier version of this fix hard-coded the
                        // 2.2x boost multiplier to the target's velocity only, reasoning
                        // "my own motion during a boosted target-tick is still ordinary
                        // walking speed". That is not generally true: I can just as easily
                        // be the one riding a knockback (I hit something, or got hit,
                        // myself) at the exact same moment, and sampleMotion() already
                        // detects that independently per entity via its own speed-jump
                        // check -- self.boosted and history.boosted are two independent
                        // flags, so each side's multiplier must be evaluated from its own
                        // flag, not assumed from the target's.
                        const targetBoost = history.boosted ? 2.2 : 1;
                        const selfBoost = self.boosted ? 2.2 : 1;
                        const relVX = history.vx * targetBoost - self.vx * selfBoost;
                        const relVY = history.vy * targetBoost - self.vy * selfBoost;
                        return { x: history.x + relVX * latency, y: history.y + relVY * latency, scale: target.scale || 35 };
                    }
                    // FIX ("ставит трапки когда враг уже в моей трапе, вместо spike"):
                    // classifying "is the enemy still caught" MUST use the target's actual
                    // CURRENT position, never the knockback-boosted predictedTarget()
                    // extrapolation used for AIMING. Every hit on a trapped enemy causes a
                    // knockback, and the x2.2 boost multiplier would fling the predicted
                    // point clear outside the trap on almost every tick right after our own
                    // spike lands -- composePlans() then wrongly concluded "they escaped"
                    // and fell back to TRAP_CLOSE (placing a redundant trap) instead of
                    // continuing to finish them with a spike. Aiming still uses
                    // predictedTarget(); state classification (trapped or not) uses this.
                    function currentPosition(target) {
                        return { x: Number(target.x2) || target.x, y: Number(target.y2) || target.y, scale: target.scale || 35 };
                    }

                    function resetBudget() {
                        const tick = (typeof ticks !== "undefined" && ticks && Number.isFinite(ticks.tick)) ? ticks.tick : Math.floor(now() / Math.max(1, (config && config.tickRate) || 111));
                        if (tick !== budgetTick) { budgetTick = tick; normalUsed = 0; emergencyUsed = 0; }
                    }
                    function canEmit(emergency) {
                        resetBudget();
                        return emergency ? emergencyUsed < MAX_EMERGENCY_PLACES : normalUsed < MAX_NORMAL_PLACES;
                    }

                    // === narrow replace/preplace guard (fix for "trap doesn't replace
                    // while enemy is trapped") ===
                    // The old spikeTickGuard() (still used, unmodified, for the AUTOPLACE
                    // path below) also trips on instaC.isTrue and on waitSpikeTick/2/3 --
                    // heuristic flags raised by updateHealth() almost every time damage is
                    // exchanged near a spike (see the waitSpikeTick3 conditions), i.e.
                    // constantly during exactly the fights where a trap/spike is about to
                    // be broken. Gating replace on that flag silently ate replacements.
                    // Replace/preplace now only defers for a real, narrow packet-timing
                    // conflict: a build/attack packet burst already in flight for an
                    // instant-kill combo (instaC.isTrue), which is a hard conflict (the
                    // weapon slot itself is mid-swap), not a speculative heuristic.
                    function replaceBlocked() {
                        return !!(typeof instaC !== "undefined" && instaC && instaC.isTrue);
                    }
                    function spikeTickGuard() {
                        if ((typeof waitSpikeTick !== "undefined" && waitSpikeTick) || (typeof waitSpikeTick2 !== "undefined" && waitSpikeTick2) || (typeof waitSpikeTick3 !== "undefined" && waitSpikeTick3) || (typeof instaC !== "undefined" && instaC && instaC.isTrue)) return true;
                        try {
                            if (typeof instaC !== "undefined" && instaC && instaC.checkSpikeTick && instaC.checkSpikeTick()) {
                                waitSpikeTick = true;
                                log("SPIKE_TICK_RESERVED", { sid: near && near.sid });
                                return true;
                            }
                        } catch (_) { }
                        return false;
                    }

                    function ringAnchorCovered(anchorDir, me, obstacles, coverageRadius) {
                        for (let i = 0; i < obstacles.length; i++) {
                            const obj = obstacles[i];
                            if (!obj.trap || !ownObject(obj)) continue;
                            const d = dist(me, obj);
                            if (d > coverageRadius) continue;
                            const objDir = dirTo(me, obj);
                            if (angleDist(objDir, anchorDir) <= Math.PI / 6) return true;
                        }
                        return false;
                    }

                    // Mirrors the server's own player.changeHealth() multiplier chain
                    // (amount *= skin.dmgMult||1; amount *= tail.dmgMult||1) so "will this
                    // spike kill the target right now" uses the exact numbers the server
                    // will actually apply, not a guess. hats/tails carrying dmgMult (damage
                    // TAKEN multiplier, e.g. Soldier Helmet 0.75) are looked up by id.
                    function targetDefenseMultiplier(target) {
                        let mult = 1;
                        try {
                            if (target && Array.isArray(hats) && typeof target.skinIndex === "number") {
                                const hat = hats.find(function (h) { return h.id === target.skinIndex; });
                                if (hat && hat.dmgMult) mult *= hat.dmgMult;
                            }
                            if (target && Array.isArray(accessories) && typeof target.tailIndex === "number") {
                                const tail = accessories.find(function (a) { return a.id === target.tailIndex; });
                                if (tail && tail.dmgMult) mult *= tail.dmgMult;
                            }
                        } catch (_) { }
                        return mult;
                    }
                    function spikeKillDamage(item, target) {
                        if (!item || !item.dmg) return 0;
                        return item.dmg * targetDefenseMultiplier(target);
                    }
                    function targetCurrentHealth(target) {
                        return Number.isFinite(target.health) ? target.health : 100;
                    }

                    function buildPlan(role, target, future, obstacles, contextObj, ignoreSid) {
                        lastBuildFailReason = "unknown";
                        if (!playerIsActive()) { lastBuildFailReason = "player_dead"; return null; }
                        const me = playerPoint();
                        // Two fundamentally different aiming intents share this function:
                        //   - PROACTIVE roles (TRAP_CLOSE/TRAP_APPROACH/KILL_SHOT/
                        //     SPIKE_GUARD_ARC) must aim at where the ENEMY actually is (or
                        //     will be), because the whole point is to catch or hit them -- a
                        //     solution that lands somewhere else is useless even if
                        //     geometrically "free".
                        //   - REACTIVE replace roles (REPLACE_TRAP/REPLACE_SPIKE) restore a
                        //     SPECIFIC defensive spot -- `contextObj` is that spot (the
                        //     destroyed object's last known position, when there is no
                        //     tactical reason to aim elsewhere). Aiming these at the enemy's
                        //     current position instead (an earlier version's bug) meant that
                        //     if the enemy had moved, or the direct arc toward them was
                        //     blocked, the replace could reject a perfectly good point on the
                        //     *original* side because it now measured success against the
                        //     enemy's unrelated position.
                        const isReplaceRole = (role === "REPLACE_TRAP" || role === "REPLACE_SPIKE" || role === "RETRAP");
                        const anchorPoint = isReplaceRole && contextObj ? { x: contextObj.x, y: contextObj.y } : future;
                        const toAnchor = dirTo(me, anchorPoint);
                        let slot, desired, maxDeviation, requireReach = false;
                        if (role === "TRAP_CLOSE") {
                            if (!target || !target.alive) { lastBuildFailReason = "no_target"; return null; }
                            slot = SLOT_TRAP;
                            desired = toAnchor;
                            maxDeviation = Math.PI;
                            requireReach = true; // must actually be able to catch them NOW
                            const trapItem = itemForSlot(slot);
                            if (!trapItem) { lastBuildFailReason = "no_trap_item_equipped"; return null; }
                            const reach = trapCatchReach(future.scale);
                            if (dist(me, future) > reach) { lastBuildFailReason = "target_too_far_to_catch"; return null; }
                        } else if (role === "TRAP_APPROACH") {
                            // FIX ("на дальней дистанции ~300 пишет что нет свободного угла"):
                            // TRAP_APPROACH used to share TRAP_CLOSE's "must be able to catch
                            // the enemy RIGHT NOW" reach requirement (~183 units, i.e.
                            // player.scale+trap.scale*2+target.scale+buffer). Since
                            // CLOSE_RANGE/NEAR_TICK_RANGE allow this role up to 220-300 units,
                            // EVERY attempt in that whole 183-300 band was rejected before
                            // findAngle() ever ran -- always for the same physical reason, but
                            // logged as an opaque "no valid angle". TRAP_APPROACH is not meant
                            // to catch the enemy immediately (physically impossible at this
                            // range); it is a forward defensive trap in their direction, same
                            // as the legacy script's blind `checkPlace(4, near.aim2)` at range
                            // <=300. It only needs a valid, unobstructed spot -- no reach
                            // precondition.
                            if (!target || !target.alive) { lastBuildFailReason = "no_target"; return null; }
                            slot = SLOT_TRAP;
                            desired = toAnchor;
                            maxDeviation = Math.PI;
                            if (!itemForSlot(slot)) { lastBuildFailReason = "no_trap_item_equipped"; return null; }
                        } else if (role === "RETRAP") {
                            if (!target || !target.alive || !contextObj) { lastBuildFailReason = "retrap_context_missing"; return null; }
                            slot = SLOT_TRAP;
                            desired = dirTo(me, contextObj);
                            maxDeviation = Math.PI;
                            requireReach = true;
                            if (!itemForSlot(slot)) { lastBuildFailReason = "no_trap_item_equipped"; return null; }
                        } else if (role === "REPLACE_TRAP") {
                            slot = SLOT_TRAP;
                            desired = toAnchor;
                            // FIX ("проверять круг 360 для реплейсера"): REPLACE_TRAP used to
                            // search only a half-circle (PI/2) toward the enemy. If that half
                            // was blocked by terrain/other objects, the trap replace gave up
                            // even with free space on the other side. All replace roles search
                            // the full circle so a replacement is never skipped just because
                            // of which side happens to be clear.
                            maxDeviation = Math.PI;
                            if (!itemForSlot(slot)) { lastBuildFailReason = "no_trap_item_equipped"; return null; }
                        } else if (role === "KILL_SHOT") {
                            if (!target || !target.alive) { lastBuildFailReason = "no_target"; return null; }
                            slot = SLOT_SPIKE;
                            desired = toAnchor;
                            maxDeviation = Math.PI;
                        } else if (role === "REPLACE_SPIKE") {
                            slot = SLOT_SPIKE;
                            desired = toAnchor;
                            maxDeviation = Math.PI;
                            if (!itemForSlot(slot)) { lastBuildFailReason = "no_spike_item_equipped"; return null; }
                        } else if (role === "PRESSURE_SPIKE") {
                            // FIX v10 (explicit user request: close-range spike priority --
                            // "\u041d\u0430 \u0434\u0438\u0441\u0442\u0430\u043d\u0446\u0438\u0438 \u0432 120 \u0438\u043b\u0438 \u043e\u043a\u043e\u043b\u043e \u0442\u043e\u0433\u043e, \u0441\u0442\u0430\u0432\u0438\u0442\u044c \u0441\u043f\u0430\u0439\u043a\u0438 \u0432 \u043f\u0440\u0438\u043e\u0440\u0438\u0442\u0435\u0442\u0435 \u0447\u0435\u043c \u0442\u0440\u0430\u043f\u043a\u0438, \u0442\u043e\u0435\u0441\u0442\u044c \u0432\u044b\u0447\u0438\u0441\u043b\u044f\u0435\u0442\u0441\u044f \u0438\u0434\u0435\u0430\u043b\u044c\u043d\u044b\u0439 \u0443\u0433\u043e\u043b \u0438 \u0435\u0441\u043b\u0438 \u043e\u043d \u0441\u0432\u043e\u0431\u043e\u0434\u0435\u043d \u0442\u043e \u043d\u0430 \u044d\u0442\u043e \u043c\u0435\u0441\u0442\u043e \u0441\u0442\u0430\u0432\u0438\u0442\u044c spike \u0430 \u0442\u0440\u0430\u043f\u043a\u0443 \u0432 \u0434\u0440\u0443\u0433\u043e\u0439 \u0443\u0433\u043e\u043b \u043a\u043e\u0442\u043e\u0440\u044b\u0439 \u043f\u0443\u0441\u0442\u043e\u0439 \u043a\u043e\u0442\u043e\u0440\u044b\u0439 \u043d\u0435 \u043f\u043e\u0434\u0445\u043e\u0434\u0438\u0442 \u043f\u043e\u0434 \u044d\u0442\u043e" -- a NEW close-range role, deliberately
                            // distinct from both TRAP_CLOSE (places a TRAP at the ideal
                            // angle) and KILL_SHOT (places a spike but ONLY if it is lethal
                            // on contact, per the existing strict no-margin requirement). This
                            // one places a spike at the SAME ideal angle a TRAP_CLOSE would
                            // have used, with NEITHER a reach precondition NOR a lethality
                            // requirement -- purely "claim the ideal spot with a spike
                            // instead of a trap", so composePlans() can then route the
                            // trap placement to a genuinely different, still-valid angle
                            // instead (see composePlans()'s own close-range branch for how
                            // the trap's own obstacle list is grown with this spike's chosen
                            // point so the two placements never land on the same spot).
                            //
                            // FIX v12 (explicit user request: "Ограничь действие вычисления
                            // круга для spike когда враг не в ловушке основываясь на текущем
                            // направление врага, тоесть ставить сбоку от игрока, а не ему в
                            // лицо" -- PRESSURE_SPIKE only ever fires here, inside the
                            // untrapped TRAP_CLOSE classification, so this scoping is already
                            // exactly "when the enemy is NOT in a trap", per decideEnemyRole()'s
                            // own branch structure; SPIKE_GUARD_ARC/KILL_SHOT, the roles used
                            // WHILE trapped, are deliberately left untouched below -- those
                            // still need to aim precisely at/through the guarded trap, changing
                            // them would reopen the exact reach-blindness bug fixed in v11).
                            // Instead of aiming the ideal-angle search straight at the enemy's
                            // OWN current/predicted position (`toAnchor`, dead center), bias the
                            // desired angle toward a point offset to whichever SIDE of the
                            // enemy is perpendicular to their current travel direction (falling
                            // back to their facing `target.dir` when they are not moving fast
                            // enough to have a reliable velocity sample, and to the old
                            // straight-at-them `toAnchor` only when neither is available at
                            // all -- so behaviour never regresses to "no spike at all" for a
                            // brand-new target with zero motion history). findAngle() still
                            // searches the FULL circle (maxDeviation=PI unchanged) for a
                            // genuinely free point nearest this new desired direction -- this
                            // only changes WHICH direction counts as "ideal", never removes the
                            // full-circle search itself.
                            if (!target || !target.alive) { lastBuildFailReason = "no_target"; return null; }
                            slot = SLOT_SPIKE;
                            desired = toAnchor;
                            maxDeviation = Math.PI;
                            if (!itemForSlot(slot)) { lastBuildFailReason = "no_spike_item_equipped"; return null; }
                            const pressureMotion = rememberTarget(target);
                            const pressureSpeed = pressureMotion ? Math.hypot(pressureMotion.vx, pressureMotion.vy) : 0;
                            // 0.02 px/ms is comfortably below every real walking speed in this
                            // engine's own speed table (module.exports.hats/config speeds are
                            // all >=0.0007 px/ms at 100x scale already well above this after
                            // unit conversion via the tick loop's own delta-scaled xVel/yVel --
                            // confirmed the SAME threshold sampleMotion()/predictedTarget()
                            // already treat as "genuinely moving" is not needed here, this is a
                            // deliberately looser, purely directional gate) and comfortably
                            // above the numerical noise floor of two consecutive tick samples.
                            let pressureTravelDir = null;
                            if (pressureSpeed > 0.02) pressureTravelDir = Math.atan2(pressureMotion.vy, pressureMotion.vx);
                            else if (Number.isFinite(target.dir)) pressureTravelDir = target.dir;
                            if (pressureTravelDir !== null) {
                                const flankA = normAngle(pressureTravelDir + Math.PI / 2);
                                const flankB = normAngle(pressureTravelDir - Math.PI / 2);
                                const flankDir = angleDist(flankA, toAnchor) <= angleDist(flankB, toAnchor) ? flankA : flankB;
                                // Offset by the item's own placement distance so the flank
                                // point sits a full spike-width beside the target, not merely a
                                // nudged angle from ME (which would barely move at this range).
                                const flankOffset = placementDistance(itemForSlot(slot));
                                const flankPoint = { x: future.x + flankOffset * Math.cos(flankDir), y: future.y + flankOffset * Math.sin(flankDir) };
                                desired = dirTo(me, flankPoint);
                            }
                        } else if (role === "SPIKE_GUARD_ARC") {
                            if (!target || !target.alive) { lastBuildFailReason = "no_target"; return null; }
                            slot = SLOT_SPIKE;
                            if (!contextObj) { lastBuildFailReason = "no_trap_context"; return null; }
                            // Aim toward the trap being guarded; the forbidden arc carved out
                            // by the trap itself plus the rim check below push the actual
                            // solution to the trap's perimeter rather than its center -- a
                            // trapped enemy at the center cannot be validly reached anyway
                            // (see the concentricity note below), so "seal the exits" is the
                            // only geometrically valid outcome here.
                            desired = dirTo(me, contextObj);
                            maxDeviation = Math.PI;
                        } else {
                            lastBuildFailReason = "unknown_role";
                            return null;
                        }
                        // FIX v8 (Проблема #2, "нет той логики что нужно реплейсить заместо
                        // трапки спайк в ситуации когда враг в ловушке" -- found by
                        // building a reproducing test, NOT a guess): `ignoreSid` is the sid
                        // of the object that died/is-about-to-die THIS call, and it used to
                        // be forwarded UNCONDITIONALLY into findAngle()/pointIsFree() for
                        // EVERY role, including the smart proactive ones (TRAP_CLOSE,
                        // KILL_SHOT, SPIKE_GUARD_ARC, TRAP_APPROACH). That is only correct
                        // for REPLACE_TRAP/REPLACE_SPIKE (self-hold restore), whose entire
                        // point is to rebuild the SAME item at the EXACT SAME footprint the
                        // dying object still occupies during preplace (obj.active is still
                        // true there) -- so that footprint must be excluded from its own
                        // collision math, or a legitimate restore-in-place would always
                        // reject itself as "blocked by itself".
                        //
                        // For the SMART roles the aim point is a DIFFERENT location (near
                        // the trap/enemy), and the dying-but-still-active trap/spike is a
                        // perfectly real obstacle that must still be respected -- excluding
                        // it broke the trap's own forbidden arc AND the SPIKE_GUARD_ARC
                        // concentricity guard below (confirmed with a reproducing test:
                        // ignoring the trap made findAngle() return the trap's own dead
                        // center as "free", which the concentricity check then correctly
                        // rejected as `inside_trap_radius` -- so the smart SPIKE_GUARD_ARC
                        // that WOULD have worked with the trap correctly treated as an
                        // obstacle instead silently failed, and decideReplacementPlan() fell
                        // all the way through to the dumb REPLACE_TRAP self-hold fallback --
                        // exactly the reported "ставит ловушку вместо spike" symptom). This
                        // is the actual root cause the user asked to be found and verified,
                        // not the aiming-angle math itself (which was already correct).
                        const selectedRoleItem = itemForSlot(slot);
                        if (!roleItemValid(role, slot, selectedRoleItem)) {
                            lastBuildFailReason = slot === SLOT_SPIKE ? "spike_slot_item_mismatch" : "trap_slot_item_mismatch";
                            return null;
                        }
                        if (role === "KILL_SHOT" && spikeKillDamage(selectedRoleItem, target) < targetCurrentHealth(target)) {
                            lastBuildFailReason = "not_lethal";
                            return null;
                        }
                        const geometryIgnoreSid = isReplaceRole ? ignoreSid : null;
                        // FIX v11 (see findAngle()'s own comment above for the full
                        // numeric reproduction): pass the SAME reach/geometry constraints
                        // this function used to only check AFTER the fact, so findAngle()
                        // itself can skip a free-but-unreachable candidate and keep
                        // searching for one that is both free AND useful, instead of
                        // committing to the first free point and failing the whole plan.
                        let acceptPoint = null;
                        const searchItem = itemForSlot(slot);
                        const searchItemScale = (searchItem && searchItem.scale) || 0;
                        if (requireReach) {
                            // TRAP_CLOSE: must actually catch the (predicted) enemy.
                            acceptPoint = function (point) { return dist(point, future) <= searchItemScale + (future.scale || 35) + TRAP_CATCH_BUFFER; };
                        } else if (role === "KILL_SHOT") {
                            // KILL_SHOT: must reach the (predicted) enemy (lethality itself
                            // does not depend on WHICH point is chosen, only on the item's
                            // damage vs the target's current health, so it stays a post-hoc
                            // check below -- only the geometric reach constraint belongs here).
                            acceptPoint = function (point) { return dist(point, future) <= searchItemScale + (future.scale || 35) + TRAP_CATCH_BUFFER; };
                        } else if (role === "SPIKE_GUARD_ARC" && contextObj) {
                            // SPIKE_GUARD_ARC: must both reach the guarded trap AND land
                            // outside its own radius (concentricity) -- both genuinely
                            // point-dependent, both belong here so the search can route
                            // around a point that fails either one.
                            const trapScale = contextObj.scale;
                            acceptPoint = function (point) {
                                const dToTrap = dist(point, contextObj);
                                return dToTrap >= trapScale * 0.6 && dToTrap <= searchItemScale + trapScale + TRAP_CATCH_BUFFER;
                            };
                        }
                        const solution = findAngle(slot, desired, geometryIgnoreSid, maxDeviation, obstacles, acceptPoint);
                        if (!solution) { lastBuildFailReason = "no_free_angle"; return null; }
                        // A TRAP_CLOSE catch that can no longer reach the predicted enemy is
                        // not a catch, it is an expensive random wall -- reject it.
                        // TRAP_APPROACH/replace roles are exempt: their success criterion is
                        // "a valid defensive position", not "touches a specific moving enemy
                        // right now" (see the anchor/requireReach notes above).
                        if (requireReach && dist(solution.point, future) > solution.item.scale + (future.scale || 35) + TRAP_CATCH_BUFFER) {
                            lastBuildFailReason = "solution_cant_reach_target";
                            return null;
                        }
                        // KILL_SHOT hard requirement (confirmed with user: no margin, strict
                        // "this placement kills on contact" only): the spike's real damage
                        // against this target's current defenses must meet or exceed its
                        // current health right now.
                        if (role === "KILL_SHOT") {
                            const dmg = spikeKillDamage(solution.item, target);
                            const hp = targetCurrentHealth(target);
                            if (dmg < hp) { lastBuildFailReason = "not_lethal"; return null; }
                            if (dist(solution.point, future) > solution.item.scale + (future.scale || 35) + TRAP_CATCH_BUFFER) { lastBuildFailReason = "solution_cant_reach_target"; return null; }
                        }
                        // Concentricity guard (per spec): a spike placed on top of the trap's
                        // own center cannot pass validation against the trap AND still be
                        // close enough to touch a centered enemy at the same time (r_spike +
                        // r_player <= ~60.5 needed to touch, but r_spike + r_trap >= ~75.5
                        // needed just to place next to the trap) -- so a guard-arc spike must
                        // land outside the trap's own radius, never inside it.
                        if (role === "SPIKE_GUARD_ARC" && contextObj && dist(solution.point, contextObj) < contextObj.scale * 0.6) { lastBuildFailReason = "inside_trap_radius"; return null; }
                        // FIX (same class as decideEnemyRole()'s spikeGuardReach() gate
                        // above): buildPlan() can be called directly for SPIKE_GUARD_ARC by
                        // decideReplacementPlan() (reactive replace / preplace paths), which
                        // does NOT go through decideEnemyRole()'s own spikeGuardReach()
                        // check first. Without this second guard here, a replace/preplace
                        // call could still send a spike toward a guarded trap far outside
                        // its physically reachable ring, landing nowhere near it -- the
                        // wasted-placement bug, reachable from a second call site.
                        if (role === "SPIKE_GUARD_ARC" && contextObj && dist(solution.point, contextObj) > solution.item.scale + contextObj.scale + TRAP_CATCH_BUFFER) { lastBuildFailReason = "solution_cant_reach_trap_context"; return null; }
                        // FIX (same v8 root cause as geometryIgnoreSid above): the plan's own
                        // stored `ignoreSid` is re-read later by emitOne()/resolvePending()'s
                        // FINAL pointIsFree() re-check right before the packet is actually
                        // sent. If this still carried the raw (unscoped) `ignoreSid` for a
                        // SMART role, that final re-check would silently ignore the very
                        // trap/spike the whole plan is built around -- reintroducing the
                        // identical "treated as not-an-obstacle" bug at a second call site
                        // even after the geometry search itself was fixed above. Both must
                        // agree, always.
                        return { role: role, slot: slot, item: solution.item, angle: solution.angle, point: solution.point, priority: ROLE_PRIORITY[role] || 50, targetSid: (target && target.sid !== undefined) ? target.sid : null, ignoreSid: (geometryIgnoreSid === undefined ? null : geometryIgnoreSid), contextSid: (contextObj && contextObj.sid !== undefined) ? contextObj.sid : null };
                    }

                    // === "умный реплейсер" core: decide the CURRENTLY correct tactical role
                    // against `target`, independent of what (if anything) is being replaced.
                    // Shared by proactive autoplace (composePlans) and reactive/preplace
                    // replace, so replace always reacts to the CURRENT battle state instead of
                    // blindly restoring whatever type just died (that was the direct cause of
                    // "replacer always replaces traps, never spikes": a dead spike used to be
                    // force-replaced as REPLACE_SPIKE even when, say, the enemy had since
                    // walked into a trap and a guard-arc spike or a fresh trap was the better
                    // response -- or vice-versa). This uses currentPosition(), not
                    // predictedTarget(), for the trapped/not-trapped classification -- see the
                    // currentPosition() note above. ===
                    function decideEnemyRole(target, obstacles, maxRange) {
                        if (!target || !target.alive) return null;
                        const me = playerPoint();
                        const currentPos = currentPosition(target);
                        const targetDistance = dist(me, currentPos);
                        const allowedRange = Number.isFinite(maxRange) ? maxRange : AUTOPLACE_PVP_RANGE;
                        if (targetDistance > allowedRange + DISTANCE_EPSILON) return null;
                        const enemyTrap = pointInsideOwnTrap(currentPos, obstacles);
                        if (enemyTrap) {
                            const reachable = dist(me, enemyTrap) <= spikeGuardReach(enemyTrap.scale);
                            if (!reachable) {
                                return { role: "TRAPPED_WAIT", contextObj: enemyTrap, enemyTrapped: true, targetDistance: targetDistance, reason: "trapped_but_spike_ring_unreachable" };
                            }
                            const edgeRatio = dist(currentPos, enemyTrap) / Math.max(1, enemyTrap.scale);
                            return {
                                role: edgeRatio < 0.5 ? "SPIKE_GUARD_ARC" : "KILL_SHOT",
                                contextObj: enemyTrap,
                                enemyTrapped: true,
                                edgeRatio: edgeRatio,
                                targetDistance: targetDistance
                            };
                        }
                        if (targetDistance <= trapCatchReach(currentPos.scale)) {
                            return { role: "TRAP_CLOSE", contextObj: null, enemyTrapped: false, targetDistance: targetDistance };
                        }
                        return { role: "TRAP_APPROACH", contextObj: null, enemyTrapped: false, targetDistance: targetDistance };
                    }

                    // === "умный реплейсер": decide what to replace a destroyed spike/trap
                    // with, reacting to the CURRENT tactical situation (via decideEnemyRole)
                    // rather than mechanically restoring the same item type that just died.
                    // Shared by the reactive path (onObjectRemoved) and both preplace paths
                    // (enemy about to break mine / me about to break mine-or-theirs). Falls
                    // back to "self-hold" (restore the same type at the same spot) only when
                    // there is no usable enemy to react to at all. ===
                    function targetInsideRemovedTrap(target, trapObject) {
                        if (!target || !target.alive || !trapObject || !trapObject.trap) return false;
                        return dist(currentPosition(target), trapObject) <= (target.scale || 35) + (trapObject.scale || 50) + 4;
                    }
                    function retrapEligible(diedObject, target) {
                        if (!diedObject || !diedObject.trap || !ownObject(diedObject) || !targetInsideRemovedTrap(target, diedObject)) return false;
                        return dist(playerPoint(), currentPosition(target)) <= Math.min(placementPvPRange("retrap", RETRAP_PVP_RANGE), trapCatchReach(target.scale || 35)) + DISTANCE_EPSILON;
                    }
                    function fillReactiveGuardAngles(target, contextTrap, working, plans, ignoreSid) {
                        if (!target || !target.alive || !contextTrap) return plans;
                        const targetDistance = dist(playerPoint(), currentPosition(target));
                        let guardIndex = 0;
                        while (plans.length < MAX_REPLACER_PLANS_PER_TICK) {
                            let guard = null;
                            // v38: mass replace now starts at 285. Above 165 units, prefer
                            // traps 70/30 over spikes so the replacement net catches/retraps
                            // instead of overcommitting spike-only mass fill at long range.
                            if (targetDistance > MASS_TRAP_PREFERENCE_START) {
                                const slotInTen = guardIndex % 10;
                                if (slotInTen < 7) {
                                    const role = targetDistance <= trapCatchReach((target.scale || 35)) ? "TRAP_CLOSE" : "TRAP_APPROACH";
                                    guard = buildPlan(role, target, predictedTarget(target), working, null, ignoreSid);
                                    if (guard) guard.reason = "smart_mass_trap_prefill";
                                }
                                if (!guard) {
                                    guard = buildPlan("SPIKE_GUARD_ARC", target, predictedTarget(target), working, contextTrap, ignoreSid);
                                    if (guard) guard.reason = "smart_mass_spike_30_fill";
                                }
                            } else {
                                guard = buildPlan("SPIKE_GUARD_ARC", target, predictedTarget(target), working, contextTrap, ignoreSid);
                                if (guard) guard.reason = "smart_mass_guard_fill";
                                if (!guard) {
                                    const role = targetDistance <= trapCatchReach((target.scale || 35)) ? "TRAP_CLOSE" : "TRAP_APPROACH";
                                    guard = buildPlan(role, target, predictedTarget(target), working, null, ignoreSid);
                                    if (guard) guard.reason = "smart_mass_gap_trap_seal";
                                }
                            }
                            if (!guard) break;
                            plans.push(guard);
                            appendPlanObstacle(working, guard, "planned:mass-guard:" + plans.length);
                            guardIndex++;
                        }
                        if (plans.length < MAX_REPLACER_PLANS_PER_TICK) {
                            log("MASS_FILL_GAP", { targetSid: target.sid, filled: plans.length, reason: lastBuildFailReason, distance: Math.round(targetDistance) });
                        } else {
                            log("MASS_FILL_COMPLETE", { targetSid: target.sid, filled: plans.length, distance: Math.round(targetDistance) });
                        }
                        return plans;
                    }
                    function buildRetrapPlans(diedObject, target, obstacles, ignoreSid) {
                        if (!retrapEligible(diedObject, target)) return [];
                        const working = obstaclesWithoutSid(obstacles, diedObject.sid);
                        const retrap = buildPlan("RETRAP", target, currentPosition(target), working, diedObject, ignoreSid);
                        if (!retrap) { lastBuildFailReason = "retrap_no_reachable_angle"; return []; }
                        retrap.reason = "smart_retrap_same_trap";
                        retrap.priority = 170;
                        const plans = [retrap];
                        appendPlanObstacle(working, retrap, "planned:retrap");
                        const lethal = buildPlan("KILL_SHOT", target, predictedTarget(target), working, null, ignoreSid);
                        if (lethal) {
                            lethal.reason = "smart_retrap_bonus_lethal";
                            plans.push(lethal);
                            appendPlanObstacle(working, lethal, "planned:retrap-lethal");
                        }
                        const retrapContext = { sid: "planned:retrap-context", x: retrap.point.x, y: retrap.point.y, scale: retrap.item.scale, trap: true, owner: player, active: true };
                        fillReactiveGuardAngles(target, retrapContext, working, plans, ignoreSid);
                        return plans.slice(0, MAX_REPLACER_PLANS_PER_TICK);
                    }
                    function buildSmartTacticalPlans(target, obstacles, ignoreSid, includeRing, maxRange, reactiveMode) {
                        const plans = [];
                        const decision = decideEnemyRole(target, obstacles, maxRange);
                        if (!decision) return { plans: plans, decision: null };
                        if (decision.role === "TRAPPED_WAIT") {
                            lastBuildFailReason = decision.reason;
                            log("SMART_WAIT", { targetSid: target.sid, reason: decision.reason });
                            return { plans: plans, decision: decision };
                        }
                        const future = predictedTarget(target);
                        const working = obstacles.slice();
                        const add = function (plan, reason) {
                            if (!plan) return false;
                            plan.reason = reason;
                            plans.push(plan);
                            appendPlanObstacle(working, plan, "planned:" + plans.length + ":" + plan.role);
                            return true;
                        };

                        if (decision.role === "SPIKE_GUARD_ARC") {
                            let spike = buildPlan("KILL_SHOT", target, future, working, null, ignoreSid);
                            if (!spike) spike = buildPlan("SPIKE_GUARD_ARC", target, future, working, decision.contextObj, ignoreSid);
                            add(spike, "smart_trapped_spike");
                        } else if (decision.role === "KILL_SHOT") {
                            let spike = buildPlan("KILL_SHOT", target, future, working, null, ignoreSid);
                            if (!spike && decision.contextObj) spike = buildPlan("SPIKE_GUARD_ARC", target, future, working, decision.contextObj, ignoreSid);
                            add(spike, "smart_trapped_spike");
                        } else if (decision.role === "TRAP_CLOSE") {
                            const lethal = buildPlan("KILL_SHOT", target, future, working, null, ignoreSid);
                            if (lethal) add(lethal, "smart_lethal_first");
                            const trap = buildPlan("TRAP_CLOSE", target, future, working, null, ignoreSid);
                            add(trap, "smart_trap_close");
                            if (!lethal && decision.targetDistance <= PANIC_RANGE) {
                                add(buildPlan("PRESSURE_SPIKE", target, future, working, null, ignoreSid), "smart_pressure_after_trap");
                            }
                        } else if (decision.role === "TRAP_APPROACH") {
                            add(buildPlan("TRAP_APPROACH", target, future, working, null, ignoreSid), "smart_trap_approach");
                        }

                        if (reactiveMode && withinPvPRange(decision.targetDistance, "massReplace", MASS_REPLACE_PVP_RANGE)) {
                            let fillContext = decision.enemyTrapped ? decision.contextObj : null;
                            if (!fillContext) {
                                for (let i = 0; i < plans.length; i++) {
                                    if (plans[i].item && plans[i].item.trap && plans[i].point) {
                                        fillContext = { sid: "planned:mass-trap-context", x: plans[i].point.x, y: plans[i].point.y, scale: plans[i].item.scale, trap: true, owner: player, active: true };
                                        break;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            if (fillContext) fillReactiveGuardAngles(target, fillContext, working, plans, ignoreSid);
                        }

                        if (includeRing && !decision.enemyTrapped && (!reactiveMode || plans.length < MAX_REPLACER_PLANS_PER_TICK) && (decision.targetDistance <= PANIC_RANGE || decision.targetDistance > LONG_RANGE_RING)) {
                            add(buildSelfRingPlan(playerPoint(), target, working), decision.targetDistance <= PANIC_RANGE ? "smart_panic_ring" : "smart_long_ring");
                        }
                        plans.sort(function (a, b) { return (b.priority || 0) - (a.priority || 0); });
                        return { plans: plans, decision: decision };
                    }

                    function directRestorePlansForObject(obj, obstacles, ignoreSid, reason) {
                        const out = [];
                        if (!obj || !(obj.trap || obj.dmg)) return out;
                        const roles = obj.dmg ? ["REPLACE_SPIKE", "REPLACE_TRAP"] : ["REPLACE_TRAP", "REPLACE_SPIKE"];
                        for (let i = 0; i < roles.length && out.length < 2; i++) {
                            const plan = buildPlan(roles[i], null, { x: obj.x, y: obj.y, scale: obj.scale || 35 }, obstacles, obj, ignoreSid);
                            if (plan) {
                                plan.reason = reason || "direct_gap_restore";
                                plan.priority = roles[i] === "REPLACE_SPIKE" ? ROLE_PRIORITY.REPLACE_SPIKE : ROLE_PRIORITY.REPLACE_TRAP;
                                out.push(plan);
                                appendPlanObstacle(obstacles, plan, "planned:direct-restore:" + out.length);
                            }
                        }
                        return out;
                    }
                    function selfTrapDefensePlans(diedObject, obstacles, ignoreSid) {
                        if (!diedObject || !ownObject(diedObject) || !(diedObject.trap || diedObject.dmg)) return [];
                        if (!(typeof traps !== "undefined" && traps && traps.in)) return [];
                        const me = playerPoint();
                        if (dist(me, diedObject) > 235) return [];
                        const working = obstaclesWithoutSid(obstacles, diedObject.sid);
                        const plans = directRestorePlansForObject(diedObject, working, ignoreSid, "self_trapped_restore_gap");
                        // Add a small defensive trap on the side opposite the enemy when possible;
                        // this closes the rear hole after my back spike/trap is broken.
                        const target = validNear();
                        if (target && plans.length < MAX_REPLACER_PLANS_PER_TICK) {
                            const backAim = dirTo(currentPosition(target), me) + Math.PI;
                            const sideTrap = findAngle(SLOT_TRAP, backAim, null, Math.PI / 2, working);
                            if (sideTrap) {
                                const p = { role: "SELF_RING", slot: SLOT_TRAP, item: sideTrap.item, angle: sideTrap.angle, point: sideTrap.point, priority: ROLE_PRIORITY.SELF_RING + 30, targetSid: target.sid, ignoreSid: null, reason: "self_trapped_backseal" };
                                plans.push(p);
                                appendPlanObstacle(working, p, "planned:self-trap-backseal");
                            }
                        }
                        return plans.slice(0, MAX_REPLACER_PLANS_PER_TICK);
                    }

                    function decideReplacementPlan(diedObject, target, obstacles, ignoreSid) {
                        if (target && target.alive) {
                            const retrapPlans = buildRetrapPlans(diedObject, target, obstacles, ignoreSid);
                            if (retrapPlans.length) return retrapPlans[0];
                            const tactical = buildSmartTacticalPlans(target, obstacles, ignoreSid, false, placementPvPRange("replacer", REPLACER_PVP_RANGE), true);
                            if (tactical.plans.length) return tactical.plans[0];
                            if (tactical.decision && tactical.decision.enemyTrapped) {
                                if (diedObject && diedObject.dmg && ownObject(diedObject)) {
                                    const hold = buildPlan("REPLACE_SPIKE", null, { x: diedObject.x, y: diedObject.y, scale: 35 }, obstacles, diedObject, ignoreSid);
                                    if (hold) hold.reason = "trapped_spike_restore_only";
                                    return hold;
                                }
                                lastBuildFailReason = "enemy_trapped_no_valid_spike";
                                return null;
                            }
                        }
                        if (!diedObject) { lastBuildFailReason = "no_died_object"; return null; }
                        if (!ownObject(diedObject)) { lastBuildFailReason = "no_enemy_context_for_foreign_object"; return null; }
                        const role = diedObject.trap ? "REPLACE_TRAP" : (diedObject.dmg ? "REPLACE_SPIKE" : null);
                        if (!role) { lastBuildFailReason = "died_object_not_trap_or_spike"; return null; }
                        const plan = buildPlan(role, null, { x: diedObject.x, y: diedObject.y, scale: 35 }, obstacles, diedObject, ignoreSid);
                        if (plan) plan.reason = "self_hold_restore";
                        return plan;
                    }

                    // FIX ("реплейсит не несколько раз а всего в одном направление и один
                    // раз... можно после break поставить два обьекта в идеальные позиции
                    // он поставит в один, это делает уязвимости"): decideReplacementPlan()
                    // above always returns exactly ONE plan, even in situations where the
                    // PROACTIVE autoplace path (composePlans()) would happily emit several
                    // at once for the identical tactical situation -- e.g. TRAP_CLOSE (not
                    // yet caught, close range) ALSO gets an opportunistic KILL_SHOT
                    // alongside it if that spike would be lethal on contact; a mutual-trap
                    // panic range also adds a SELF_RING_GROUP. Reactive replace/preplace had
                    // no equivalent, so an object death that could have been reinforced with
                    // TWO ideal placements (confirmed with a reproducing test: TRAP_CLOSE +
                    // a simultaneously-lethal KILL_SHOT both geometrically valid at once)
                    // only ever got one, leaving the other opportunity -- and the resulting
                    // vulnerability -- on the table. This wraps decideReplacementPlan()'s
                    // exact SAME decision (never duplicates or second-guesses its role
                    // choice) and, only for the one case composePlans() itself treats as a
                    // genuine "two independent placements" situation (untrapped TRAP_CLOSE +
                    // an opportunistic simultaneous KILL_SHOT), tries to add the second plan
                    // too -- via the SAME buildPlan() call composePlans() uses, so the two
                    // paths can never diverge on when a second placement is valid.
                    function decideReplacementPlans(diedObject, target, obstacles, ignoreSid) {
                        const selfDefense = selfTrapDefensePlans(diedObject, obstacles, ignoreSid);
                        if (selfDefense.length) return selfDefense;
                        if (target && target.alive) {
                            const retrapPlans = buildRetrapPlans(diedObject, target, obstacles, ignoreSid);
                            if (retrapPlans.length) return retrapPlans;
                            const tactical = buildSmartTacticalPlans(target, obstacles, ignoreSid, true, placementPvPRange("replacer", REPLACER_PVP_RANGE), true);
                            if (tactical.plans.length) return tactical.plans.slice(0, MAX_REPLACER_PLANS_PER_TICK);
                            if (tactical.decision && tactical.decision.enemyTrapped) {
                                const spikeOnly = decideReplacementPlan(diedObject, target, obstacles, ignoreSid);
                                return spikeOnly ? [spikeOnly] : [];
                            }
                        }
                        const fallback = decideReplacementPlan(diedObject, target, obstacles, ignoreSid);
                        if (fallback) return [fallback];
                        // v48: when I break/lose a foreign spike/trap or smart geometry cannot
                        // find a tactical point, still try to claim the just-freed tile. This
                        // prevents exploitable holes and enemy instant counter-spikes.
                        const working = obstaclesWithoutSid(obstacles, diedObject && diedObject.sid);
                        return directRestorePlansForObject(diedObject, working, ignoreSid, "last_resort_gap_claim").slice(0, MAX_REPLACER_PLANS_PER_TICK);
                    }

                    function buildSelfRingPlan(me, target, obstacles) {
                        const trapItem = itemForSlot(SLOT_TRAP);
                        if (!trapItem || !itemLimitAvailable(trapItem) || !resourcesAvailable(trapItem)) return null;
                        const baseAim = dirTo(me, target);
                        // Four anchors covering the back and both flanks relative to the
                        // player-enemy line -- deliberately NOT the 0 (straight-at-enemy)
                        // direction, since that lane belongs to the player's own attack /
                        // the TRAP_CLOSE / KILL_SHOT roles, not a defensive ring.
                        const anchors = [baseAim + Math.PI * 0.75, baseAim - Math.PI * 0.75, baseAim + Math.PI * 0.50, baseAim - Math.PI * 0.50, baseAim + Math.PI * 0.25, baseAim - Math.PI * 0.25];
                        const coverageRadius = (trapItem.scale + (player.scale || 35)) * 1.18; // v38 tighter coverage: do not leave exploitable small gaps between self-ring traps
                        const subPlans = [];
                        // FIX ("игрок находится прямо посреди моих ловушек в центре а их
                        // спавн продолжается -> итог некуда ставить spike для убийства,
                        // бесконечная битва"): confirmed numerically -- with the ring's
                        // actual forbidden-arc half-width (~77 degrees, driven by
                        // trap+spike scale sums at this placement distance) and the 90
                        // degree spacing between the four anchors above, a FULLY BUILT ring
                        // covers mathematically 100% of the circle around the player,
                        // including the "reserved" 0-direction toward the enemy the old
                        // comment assumed would stay open -- that assumption was never
                        // actually enforced anywhere. Once all 4 anchors are filled, EVERY
                        // subsequent SPIKE_GUARD_ARC/TRAP_CLOSE/KILL_SHOT search (which scans
                        // the full circle, maxDeviation=PI) permanently fails with
                        // no_free_angle, and the fight can never be finished with a spike --
                        // an unrecoverable deadlock. This obstacle snapshot (obstaclesAfterRing)
                        // is grown with each already-decided ring sub-plan's own point as the
                        // loop progresses, and BEFORE committing anchor N we verify a spike
                        // can still find SOME angle anywhere around the player once anchor N
                        // is added -- if not, that anchor is skipped instead of sealing the
                        // last remaining gap. This directly enforces the invariant the old
                        // code only assumed by convention, using the exact same full-circle
                        // search buildPlan() itself performs for spike roles.
                        const obstaclesAfterRing = obstacles.slice();
                        for (let i = 0; i < anchors.length; i++) {
                            // Anti-spam fix: an anchor direction that already has one of my
                            // own traps roughly along it is treated as filled and skipped, so
                            // the ring stops emitting once complete instead of re-placing on
                            // top of itself every tick.
                            if (ringAnchorCovered(anchors[i], me, obstaclesAfterRing, coverageRadius)) {
                                log("SELF_RING_SKIP", { reason: "anchor_covered", anchor: i });
                                continue;
                            }
                            const solved = findAngle(SLOT_TRAP, anchors[i], null, Math.PI / 9, obstaclesAfterRing);
                            if (!solved) { log("SELF_RING_SKIP", { reason: "no_free_angle", anchor: i }); continue; }
                            const candidateObstacle = { sid: "ring-candidate:" + i, x: solved.point.x, y: solved.point.y, scale: solved.item.scale, blocker: solved.item.blocker, isItem: true, active: true };
                            const probeObstacles = obstaclesAfterRing.concat([candidateObstacle]);
                            const spikeStillPossible = findAngle(SLOT_SPIKE, baseAim, null, Math.PI, probeObstacles);
                            if (!spikeStillPossible) {
                                log("SELF_RING_SKIP", { reason: "would_seal_spike_lane", anchor: i });
                                continue;
                            }
                            obstaclesAfterRing.push(candidateObstacle);
                            subPlans.push({ role: "SELF_RING", slot: SLOT_TRAP, item: solved.item, angle: solved.angle, point: solved.point, priority: ROLE_PRIORITY.SELF_RING, targetSid: target.sid, ignoreSid: null });
                        }
                        return subPlans.length ? { role: "SELF_RING_GROUP", plans: subPlans, priority: ROLE_PRIORITY.SELF_RING } : null;
                    }

                    function composePlans(obstacles) {
                        const target = validNear();
                        if (!playerIsActive() || !target || !enemy.length) return [];
                        const tactical = buildSmartTacticalPlans(target, obstacles, null, true, placementPvPRange("autoplace", AUTOPLACE_PVP_RANGE), false);
                        if (!tactical.decision) {
                            log("PLACE_SKIP_ROLE", { reason: "out_of_range_or_invalid_target" });
                            return [];
                        }
                        if (!tactical.plans.length) {
                            log("PLACE_SKIP_ROLE", { role: tactical.decision.role, reason: lastBuildFailReason, trapped: !!tactical.decision.enemyTrapped });
                            return [];
                        }
                        for (let i = 0; i < tactical.plans.length; i++) {
                            log("PLACE_PLAN", { role: tactical.plans[i].role, reason: tactical.plans[i].reason, priority: tactical.plans[i].priority });
                        }
                        return tactical.plans;
                    }

                    function emitOne(plan, emergency, obstacles) {
                        if (!plan || !plan.item || !plan.point) return false;
                        try { window.__valuePlacementBusyUntil = Date.now() + 150; } catch (_) { }
                        if (!canEmit(emergency)) { log("PLACE_SKIP_ROLE", { role: plan.role, reason: "tick_budget_exhausted", emergency: !!emergency }); return false; }
                        if (!pointIsFree(plan.point, plan.item, plan.ignoreSid, obstacles)) { log("PLACE_SKIP_ROLE", { role: plan.role, reason: "point_no_longer_free" }); return false; }
                        const restoreWeapon = Number.isFinite(Number(configs.weaponCode)) ? Number(configs.weaponCode) : player.weaponIndex;
                        const id = ++serial;
                        try {
                            selectToBuild(player.items[plan.slot]);
                            sendAtck(1, plan.angle);
                            selectWeapon(restoreWeapon, true);
                            sendAtck(0, plan.angle);
                        } catch (error) {
                            log("SEND_ERROR", { role: plan.role, message: String(error) });
                            return false;
                        }
                        if (emergency) emergencyUsed++; else normalUsed++;
                        pending.set(id, { id: id, slot: plan.slot, item: plan.item, role: plan.role, point: plan.point, angle: plan.angle, targetSid: plan.targetSid, sentAt: now(), timeout: emergency ? RETRY_TIMEOUT : NORMAL_TIMEOUT });
                        // FIX ("проверить точно ли не будет блокирования spike плейсемента
                        // из-за плейсемента трапок"): `obstacles` is a single snapshot built
                        // ONCE per tick() call and threaded through every plan in that same
                        // tick's batch (composePlans() can return several plans -- e.g.
                        // SPIKE_GUARD_ARC + a SELF_RING_GROUP of up to 4 traps -- all emitted
                        // in the same for-loop). Without this, a trap placed earlier in the
                        // SAME tick was invisible to the geometry check (findAngle/
                        // pointIsFree) run for the NEXT plan in that same batch, since that
                        // check only sees the beginning-of-tick obstacle list plus whatever
                        // was ALREADY pending from a PREVIOUS tick -- not anything emitted
                        // moments earlier in the CURRENT tick's own loop. Confirmed by a
                        // reproducing test: SPIKE_GUARD_ARC and a SELF_RING sub-plan landed
                        // ~7 units apart (needed ~99 to not overlap, spike scale 49 + trap
                        // scale 50) in the exact same tick. Pushing this plan's own freshly
                        // placed point into the shared array immediately closes that gap for
                        // every subsequent emitOne() call within the same tick's batch.
                        obstacles.push({ sid: "pending:" + id, x: plan.point.x, y: plan.point.y, scale: plan.item.scale, blocker: plan.item.blocker, isItem: true, active: true });
                        log("PLACE_SENT", { id: id, role: plan.role, slot: plan.slot, emergency: !!emergency, reason: plan.reason, angle: Number(plan.angle.toFixed(3)), x: Math.round(plan.point.x), y: Math.round(plan.point.y) });
                        return true;
                    }
                    function emitPlan(plan, emergency, obstacles) {
                        if (!plan) return false;
                        if (plan.role === "SELF_RING_GROUP") {
                            let any = false;
                            for (let i = 0; i < plan.plans.length; i++) {
                                if (!canEmit(emergency)) break;
                                if (emitOne(plan.plans[i], emergency, obstacles)) any = true;
                            }
                            return any;
                        }
                        return emitOne(plan, emergency, obstacles);
                    }

                    function resolvePending() {
                        if (!pending.size) return;
                        const obstacles = buildObstacles(playerPoint());
                        pending.forEach(function (entry, id) {
                            const confirmed = obstacles.find(function (obj) {
                                return typeof obj.sid === "number" && ownObject(obj) && obj.isItem && obj.id === entry.item.id && dist(obj, entry.point) <= 18;
                            });
                            if (confirmed) {
                                records.set(confirmed.sid, { sid: confirmed.sid, slot: entry.slot, item: entry.item, role: entry.role, point: entry.point, targetSid: entry.targetSid, createdAt: now(), lastHealth: confirmed.health, armed: null });
                                pending.delete(id);
                                log("PLACE_CONFIRMED", { id: id, sid: confirmed.sid, role: entry.role });
                                return;
                            }
                            if (now() - entry.sentAt > entry.timeout) {
                                pending.delete(id);
                                log("PLACE_UNCONFIRMED", { id: id, role: entry.role, reason: "timeout_no_matching_object" });
                            }
                        });
                    }

                    function inferRecord(obj) {
                        if (!obj || !ownObject(obj)) return null;
                        const slot = obj.trap ? SLOT_TRAP : (obj.dmg ? SLOT_SPIKE : null);
                        if (slot === null) return null;
                        const item = itemForSlot(slot);
                        if (!item) return null;
                        return { sid: obj.sid, slot: slot, item: item, role: obj.trap ? "REPLACE_TRAP" : "REPLACE_SPIKE", point: { x: obj.x, y: obj.y }, targetSid: near && near.sid, createdAt: now(), lastHealth: obj.health, armed: null };
                    }

                    // Sweep all active own/allied trap+spike objects within OBSTACLE_RADIUS
                    // and back-fill any that are missing from `records` (e.g. placed before
                    // this tab loaded, placed by an ally, or a PLACE_CONFIRMED match that was
                    // somehow missed). Runs on a throttled interval, not every tick.
                    function syncOwnedRecords(obstacles) {
                        if (now() - lastSyncAt < SYNC_INTERVAL) return;
                        lastSyncAt = now();
                        for (let i = 0; i < obstacles.length; i++) {
                            const obj = obstacles[i];
                            if (typeof obj.sid !== "number") continue; // skip synthetic "pending:*" entries
                            if (!obj.active || !(obj.trap || obj.dmg) || !ownObject(obj)) continue;
                            if (records.has(obj.sid)) continue;
                            const inferred = inferRecord(obj);
                            if (inferred) { records.set(obj.sid, inferred); log("REPLACE_SYNC", { sid: obj.sid, role: inferred.role, reason: "adopted_untracked_own_object" }); }
                        }
                    }

                    function enemyActiveWeaponIndex(target) {
                        if (!target) return -1;
                        const recentWindow = Math.max(180, (Number(window.pingTime) || 0) + (Number(config.tickRate) || 111));
                        const gatherIndex = Number(target.__valueLastGatherIndex);
                        if (target.__valueLastGatherAt && now() - target.__valueLastGatherAt <= recentWindow && Number.isFinite(gatherIndex) && items.weapons[gatherIndex]) return gatherIndex;
                        const current = Number(target.weaponIndex);
                        if (Number.isFinite(current) && items.weapons[current]) return current;
                        const primary = Number(target.primaryIndex);
                        if (Number.isFinite(primary) && items.weapons[primary]) return primary;
                        return -1;
                    }

                    function enemyWeaponReady(target) {
                        const idx = enemyActiveWeaponIndex(target);
                        if (idx < 0) return false;
                        const reload = Number(target.reloads && target.reloads[idx]);
                        return Number.isFinite(reload) && reload <= (config.tickRate || 111);
                    }
                    // FIX ("preplace работает почему-то и на дальние объекты хотя должен на
                    // те что в радиусе условно оружия"): preArmFromEnemyAttack() used to arm
                    // EVERY tracked spike/trap in `records` purely from "is the enemy's
                    // weapon ready + would their next hit be lethal", with zero check that
                    // the enemy is anywhere near the object in question -- an object on the
                    // other side of the map could get armed just because the tracked enemy
                    // happened to have a ready weapon and enough damage on paper. This
                    // mirrors the reach check preArmFromMyAttack() already has for MY OWN
                    // swing (`objDist > range` / `angleDist(...) > gatherAngle`), applied to
                    // the enemy's weapon instead of mine.
                    // FIX (found by comparing line-by-line against the REAL server
                    // formula, Player.gather() ~line 28693: `tmpDist = distance(this,
                    // tmpObj) - tmpObj.scale; if (tmpDist <= weapon.range)` -- i.e. the
                    // ATTACKER's own scale never enters the reach check at all, only the
                    // TARGET object's scale is subtracted from the raw distance before
                    // comparing to weapon.range). This function used to add the enemy's
                    // OWN scale to their weapon's range, inflating their real reach by
                    // ~35 units and making preplace arm too early/too far compared to
                    // what the server will actually allow to connect.
                    function enemyWeaponReach(target) {
                        const idx = enemyActiveWeaponIndex(target);
                        const weapon = idx >= 0 ? items.weapons[idx] : null;
                        return weapon ? (weapon.range || 65) : 0;
                    }
                    function enemyWithinStrikeRangeOf(target, obj) {
                        if (!target || !obj) return false;
                        const targetPoint = currentPosition(target);
                        const objDist = dist(targetPoint, obj) - (obj.scale || 0);
                        if (objDist > enemyWeaponReach(target)) return false;
                        const facing = Number.isFinite(target.d2) ? target.d2 : (Number.isFinite(target.dir) ? target.dir : null);
                        if (facing !== null) {
                            const objectDir = dirTo(targetPoint, obj);
                            if (angleDist(objectDir, facing) > (config.gatherAngle || Math.PI / 2.6) + 0.08) return false;
                        }
                        return true;
                    }
                    function enemyHitDamage(target) {
                        const idx = enemyActiveWeaponIndex(target);
                        const weapon = idx >= 0 ? items.weapons[idx] : null;
                        if (!weapon) return 0;
                        const variantIdx = idx < 9
                        ? (target.primaryVariant === undefined ? 0 : target.primaryVariant)
                        : (target.secondaryVariant === undefined ? 0 : target.secondaryVariant);
                        const variant = (config.weaponVariants && (config.weaponVariants[variantIdx] || config.weaponVariants[0])) || { val: 1 };
                        const bDmg = target.skinIndex === 40 ? 3.3 : 1;
                        return (weapon.dmg || 0) * (variant.val || 1) * (weapon.sDmg || 1) * bDmg;
                    }
                    // My own weapon "about to hit" check -- mirrors enemyWeaponReady() but
                    // for the player, and additionally requires an active attack input
                    // (mouse held or auto-attack), since a merely-ready weapon that is not
                    // being swung will not actually break anything this tick.
                    function activePlacementWeaponIndex() {
                        // PREPLACE SELF-BREAK FIX v38: mirror the weapon the input loop will
                        // actually use. When right-click/tool-break is held, the MOUSE EVENT
                        // block selects secondary[1]==10 even if player.weaponIndex still
                        // says primary for this same tick. Using player.weaponIndex first made
                        // self-preplace compute damage/range for the wrong weapon and miss the
                        // exact "I break it myself" final-hit window.
                        const rightBreak = !!(typeof clicks !== "undefined" && clicks && clicks.right && player && player.weapons && player.weapons[1] == 10);
                        if (rightBreak && items.weapons[player.weapons[1]]) return player.weapons[1];
                        const current = Number(player && player.weaponIndex);
                        if (Number.isFinite(current) && items.weapons[current]) return current;
                        const primary = Number(player && player.weapons && player.weapons[0]);
                        if (Number.isFinite(primary) && items.weapons[primary]) return primary;
                        const configured = Number(configs && configs.weaponCode);
                        if (Number.isFinite(configured) && items.weapons[configured]) return configured;
                        return 0;
                    }
                    function activePlacementAttackDirection() {
                        if (typeof traps !== "undefined" && traps && traps.in && Number.isFinite(traps.aim)) return traps.aim;
                        try {
                            if (typeof getAttackDir === "function") {
                                const value = getAttackDir();
                                if (Number.isFinite(value)) return value;
                            }
                        } catch (_) { }
                        return Number(player.dir) || 0;
                    }

                    function myWeaponAboutToHit() {
                        if (!playerIsActive()) return false;
                        const idx = activePlacementWeaponIndex();
                        const weapon = items.weapons[idx];
                        if (!weapon || weapon.gather === undefined) return false;
                        const reload = Number(player.reloads && player.reloads[idx]);
                        if (!Number.isFinite(reload) || reload > (config.tickRate || 111)) return false;
                        const manual = !!(typeof clicks !== "undefined" && (clicks.left || clicks.right));
                        const automatic = !!(typeof autoAim !== "undefined" && autoAim)
                        || !!(typeof autos !== "undefined" && autos && autos.bull)
                        || !!(player && player.gathering)
                        || !!(typeof traps !== "undefined" && traps && traps.in)
                        || !!(typeof configs !== "undefined" && configs && configs.waitHit);
                        return manual || automatic;
                    }
                    function myHitDamage() {
                        if (!player) return 0;
                        const idx = activePlacementWeaponIndex();
                        const weapon = items.weapons[idx];
                        if (!weapon) return 0;
                        const variantIdx = player.primaryVariant === undefined ? 0 : player.primaryVariant;
                        const variant = (config.weaponVariants && (config.weaponVariants[variantIdx] || config.weaponVariants[0])) || { val: 1 };
                        return (weapon.dmg || 0) * (variant.val || 1) * (weapon.sDmg || 1);
                    }

                    // === REPLACE preplace: enemy about to break MY spike/trap. Routes
                    // through decideReplacementPlan() (the same "умный" logic as the reactive
                    // path) instead of blindly rebuilding the same type that is about to die,
                    // so an about-to-die spike can be pre-armed as a fresh trap-catch (or vice
                    // versa) if that is the better current reaction. ===
                    function armedPlanInFlight(plan) {
                        if (!plan || !plan.point || !plan.item) return false;
