                        }
                        return cost;
                    }
                    function targetPointAM(target) {
                        return { x: Number(target && (target.x2 !== undefined ? target.x2 : target.x)) || 0, y: Number(target && (target.y2 !== undefined ? target.y2 : target.y)) || 0, sid: target && target.sid, scale: (target && target.scale) || 35, health: target && target.health, maxHealth: target && target.maxHealth, alive: target && target.alive, team: target && target.team };
                    }
                    function predictedTargetAM(target) {
                        const base = targetPointAM(target);
                        const sid = base.sid;
                        const t = now();
                        const old = targetMotionAM.get(sid);
                        let vx = 0, vy = 0;
                        if (old && t > old.t) {
                            const dt = Math.max(50, Math.min(350, t - old.t));
                            vx = (base.x - old.x) / dt;
                            vy = (base.y - old.y) / dt;
                            // clamp to plausible player velocity in world-units/ms; prevents
                            // network correction spikes from flipping the whole tactical goal.
                            const sp = Math.hypot(vx, vy);
                            if (sp > 0.95) { vx = vx / sp * 0.95; vy = vy / sp * 0.95; }
                        }
                        targetMotionAM.set(sid, { x: base.x, y: base.y, t: t, vx: vx, vy: vy });
                        const lead = 170 + Math.min(110, Number(window.pingTime) || 0);
                        return Object.assign({}, target, { x: base.x + vx * lead, y: base.y + vy * lead, x2: base.x + vx * lead, y2: base.y + vy * lead, vxAM: vx, vyAM: vy, realXAM: base.x, realYAM: base.y });
                    }
                    function currentWeaponRangeAM() {
                        const idx = Number(player && player.weaponIndex);
                        const w = Number.isFinite(idx) && items.weapons[idx] ? items.weapons[idx] : (player && player.weapons && items.weapons[player.weapons[0]]);
                        return (w && w.range) || 65;
                    }

                    function trapItemAM() {
                        for (let i = 0; i < items.list.length; i++) if (items.list[i] && items.list[i].trap) return items.list[i];
                        return { scale: 50, placeOffset: -5, trap: true, ignoreCollision: true, name: "suspected trap" };
                    }
                    function addSuspectedTrapAM(point, confidence, reason, ttl) {
                        if (!point || !Number.isFinite(point.x) || !Number.isFinite(point.y)) return;
                        const trap = trapItemAM();
                        const cell = Math.round(point.x / 28) + ":" + Math.round(point.y / 28);
                        const old = suspectedTrapMemoryAM.get(cell);
                        const t = now();
                        const conf = Math.max(0.08, Math.min(0.60, confidence || 0.18));
                        if (old) {
                            old.x = (old.x * 0.72 + point.x * 0.28);
                            old.y = (old.y * 0.72 + point.y * 0.28);
                            old.confidence = Math.min(0.60, Math.max(old.confidence * 0.96, conf));
                            old.reason = reason || old.reason;
                            old.expires = Math.max(old.expires || 0, t + (ttl || 9000));
                            old.updated = t;
                        } else {
                            suspectedTrapMemoryAM.set(cell, { sid: "susTrap:" + cell, x: point.x, y: point.y, scale: trap.scale || 50, trap: true, ignoreCollision: true, active: true, owner: null, suspectedTrap: true, confidence: conf, reason: reason || "trail", created: t, updated: t, expires: t + (ttl || 9000) });
                        }
                    }
                    function removeSuspectedTrapNearAM(point, radius) {
                        if (!point) return;
                        suspectedTrapMemoryAM.forEach(function (z, key) {
                            if (dist(point, z) <= (radius || 70)) suspectedTrapMemoryAM.delete(key);
                        });
                    }
                    function hostileSpikeNearAM(point, obstacles, radius) {
                        let count = 0;
                        for (let i = 0; i < obstacles.length; i++) {
                            const obj = obstacles[i];
                            if (!obj || !obj.active || !isHostileDamageAM(obj)) continue;
                            if (dist(point, obj) <= (radius || 125)) count++;
                        }
                        return count;
                    }
                    function updateTrailTrapSuspicionsAM(me, target, obstacles) {
                        if (!target || !me) return;
                        const t = now();
                        if (t - lastTrapMemoryUpdateAM < 180) return;
                        lastTrapMemoryUpdateAM = t;
                        // If I just got caught at a predicted point, remove the ghost: it is
                        // no longer a prediction and otherwise keeps double-penalising pathing.
                        if (typeof traps !== "undefined" && traps && traps.in) removeSuspectedTrapNearAM(me, currentWeaponRangeAM());
                        const real = { x: Number(target.realXAM) || Number(target.x2) || Number(target.x) || 0, y: Number(target.realYAM) || Number(target.y2) || Number(target.y) || 0 };
                        if (dist(me, real) <= 700) {
                            const spikeCount = hostileSpikeNearAM(real, obstacles, 145);
                            const speed = Math.hypot(Number(target.vxAM) || 0, Number(target.vyAM) || 0);
                            // Enemy can walk through their own hidden trap; their recent trail is
                            // a plausible trap line. Confidence grows near enemy spike structures.
                            const conf = 0.12 + Math.min(0.26, spikeCount * 0.055) + Math.min(0.10, speed * 1.25);
                            addSuspectedTrapAM(real, conf, "enemy_trail", 8500);
                            if (speed > 0.04) {
                                addSuspectedTrapAM({ x: real.x - target.vxAM * 210, y: real.y - target.vyAM * 210 }, conf * 0.82, "enemy_trail_back", 7200);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    function updateGeometryTrapSuspicionsAM(me, target, obstacles) {
                        // v45 perf: spike-pair geometry is O(n^2). On dense spike bases this
                        // was the likely source of multi-second FPS drops. Run it slower and
                        // only on the nearest/highest-relevance hostile spikes.
                        const t = now();
                        if (t - lastTrapGeometryUpdateAM < 850) return;
                        lastTrapGeometryUpdateAM = t;
                        const trap = trapItemAM();
                        const trapScale = trap.scale || 50;
                        const spikes = [];
                        for (let i = 0; i < obstacles.length; i++) {
                            const obj = obstacles[i];
                            if (!obj || !obj.active || !isHostileDamageAM(obj)) continue;
                            const relevance = Math.min(dist(me, obj), target ? dist(target, obj) : Infinity);
                            if (relevance > 620) continue;
                            spikes.push({ obj: obj, relevance: relevance });
                        }
                        spikes.sort(function (a, b) { return a.relevance - b.relevance; });
                        const capped = spikes.slice(0, 16).map(function (e) { return e.obj; });
                        for (let i = 0; i < capped.length; i++) {
                            for (let j = i + 1; j < capped.length; j++) {
                                const a = capped[i], b = capped[j];
                                const D = dist(a, b);
                                const minFit = objectScaleAM(a) + objectScaleAM(b) + trapScale * 1.55;
                                const maxFit = objectScaleAM(a) + objectScaleAM(b) + trapScale * 2.75;
                                if (D < minFit || D > maxFit) continue;
                                const mid = { x: (a.x + b.x) / 2, y: (a.y + b.y) / 2 };
                                let blockedByNonSpike = false;
                                for (let k = 0; k < obstacles.length; k++) {
                                    const o = obstacles[k];
                                    if (!o || !o.active || o === a || o === b || o.ignoreCollision || isHostileDamageAM(o)) continue;
                                    if (dist(mid, o) <= trapScale + objectScaleAM(o) * 0.75) { blockedByNonSpike = true; break; }
                                }
                                if (!blockedByNonSpike) addSuspectedTrapAM(mid, 0.46 + Math.max(0, 55 - Math.abs(D - (minFit + maxFit) / 2)) / 350, "spike_gap", 14000);
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    function getSuspectedTrapZonesAM(me, target, obstacles) {
                        updateTrailTrapSuspicionsAM(me, target, obstacles);
                        if (!(window.__valuePlacementBusyUntil && Date.now() < window.__valuePlacementBusyUntil) && !(typeof currentFPS !== "undefined" && currentFPS && currentFPS < 48)) updateGeometryTrapSuspicionsAM(me, target, obstacles);
                        const t = now();
                        const zones = [];
                        suspectedTrapMemoryAM.forEach(function (z, key) {
                            if ((z.expires || 0) < t) { suspectedTrapMemoryAM.delete(key); return; }
                            // fade with age but keep strong geometry candidates visible up to .6
                            const life = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (z.expires - t) / 14000));
                            const confidence = Math.max(0.06, Math.min(0.60, z.confidence * (0.55 + life * 0.45)));
                            zones.push(Object.assign({}, z, { confidence: confidence, owner: target || z.owner }));
                        });
                        zones.sort(function (a, b) { return b.confidence - a.confidence; });
                        return zones.slice(0, 28);
                    }

                    function breakWeaponIndexAM(obj) {
                        if (!player || !player.weapons) return Number(player && player.weaponIndex) || 0;
                        const primary = Number(player.weapons[0]);
                        const secondary = player.weapons[1] == 10 ? Number(player.weapons[1]) : NaN;
                        const primaryDmg = (items.weapons[primary] && items.weapons[primary].dmg) || 0;
                        const hp = Number(obj && obj.health);
                        if (Number.isFinite(secondary) && items.weapons[secondary] && ((Number.isFinite(hp) && hp > primaryDmg) || primary === 5)) return secondary;
                        return Number.isFinite(primary) && items.weapons[primary] ? primary : (Number(player.weaponIndex) || 0);
                    }
                    function breakWeaponRangeAM(obj) {
                        const idx = breakWeaponIndexAM(obj);
                        const w = items.weapons[idx];
                        return (w && w.range) || 65;
                    }
                    function breakButtonAM(obj) {
                        const idx = breakWeaponIndexAM(obj);
                        return (player && player.weapons && idx === player.weapons[1] && player.weapons[1] == 10) ? "right" : "left";
                    }
                    function canBreakTacticalObjectAM(obj) {
                        if (!obj || !obj.active || friendlyOwnedAM(obj)) return false;
                        if (isHostileDamageAM(obj)) return true;
                        // Do not treat ownerless trees/rocks/bushes/cactus as tactical break
                        // targets. They are pathing obstacles/danger, not "enemy objects".
                        // For cutting a route, only enemy-owned placed items/buildings qualify.
                        return !!(obj.owner && obj.isItem && obj.health && !friendlyOwnedAM(obj));
                    }

                    function breakWeaponDamageAM(obj) {
                        const idx = breakWeaponIndexAM(obj);
                        const weapon = items.weapons[idx];
                        if (!weapon) return 0;
                        const variantIdx = player && player.primaryVariant === undefined ? 0 : player.primaryVariant;
                        const variant = (config.weaponVariants && (config.weaponVariants[variantIdx] || config.weaponVariants[0])) || { val: 1 };
                        return (weapon.dmg || 0) * (variant.val || 1) * (weapon.sDmg || 1);
                    }
                    function breakWeaponSpeedAM(obj) {
                        const idx = breakWeaponIndexAM(obj);
                        const weapon = items.weapons[idx];
                        return (weapon && weapon.speed) || 400;
                    }
                    function estimateBreakTimeAM(obj) {
                        const hp = Number(obj && obj.health);
                        const dmg = breakWeaponDamageAM(obj);
                        if (!Number.isFinite(hp) || hp <= 0) return 0;
                        if (!dmg || dmg <= 0) return Infinity;
                        return Math.ceil(hp / dmg) * breakWeaponSpeedAM(obj);
                    }
                    function approachPointForBreakAM(me, obj) {
                        const reach = breakWeaponRangeAM(obj);
                        const objScale = objectScaleAM(obj);
                        const desired = Math.max(20, reach - 10 + objScale);
                        const fromObjToMe = dirTo(obj, me);
                        return { x: obj.x + desired * Math.cos(fromObjToMe), y: obj.y + desired * Math.sin(fromObjToMe) };
                    }
                    function setBreakPlanMetaAM(obj, mode, point, score, reason) {
                        if (!obj) return obj;
                        obj.__autoModBreakMode = mode || "break";
                        obj.__autoModBreakPoint = point || null;
                        obj.__autoModBreakScore = score || 0;
                        obj.__autoModBreakReason = reason || "break";
                        return obj;
                    }

                    function chooseApproachGoalAM(me, target, range, obstacles) {
                        const playerRadius = (player && player.scale) || 35;
                        const standoffDist = Math.max(45, range - 15);
                        const base = dirTo(target, me);
                        const nowMs = now();
                        if (lastTacticalGoal && lastTacticalGoalSid === target.sid && nowMs - lastTacticalGoalAt < 620) {
                            const dLocked = dist(me, lastTacticalGoal);
                            const lockedDir = dirTo(me, lastTacticalGoal);
                            const lockedUnsafe = dLocked > 12 && (segmentUnsafeAM(me, lockedDir, obstacles, playerRadius, Math.min(FALLBACK_STEP_DIST, dLocked)) || segmentHitsHostileDamageAM(me, lockedDir, obstacles, playerRadius, Math.min(FALLBACK_STEP_DIST, dLocked)));
                            if (!lockedUnsafe && dLocked > 35) {
                                setDebugRaysAM([{ dir: lockedDir, type: "selected", label: "locked" }]);
                                return { point: lastTacticalGoal, key: "locked", offDeg: 0, dir: lockedDir, rays: [{ dir: lockedDir, type: "selected", label: "locked" }] };
                            }
                        }
                        const directGoal = { x: target.x + standoffDist * Math.cos(base), y: target.y + standoffDist * Math.sin(base) };
                        const directUnsafe = pointUnsafeAM(directGoal, obstacles, playerRadius, true) || segmentUnsafeAM(me, dirTo(me, directGoal), obstacles, playerRadius, Math.min(FALLBACK_STEP_DIST, dist(me, directGoal)));
                        const side = approachSide || 1;
                        const offsets = [0, side * 28, side * 55, -side * 28, side * 85, -side * 55, -side * 85, side * 120, -side * 120, 180];
                        let best = null, bestScore = -Infinity;
                        const rays = [];
                        for (let i = 0; i < offsets.length; i++) {
                            const offDeg = offsets[i];
                            const dir = base + offDeg * Math.PI / 180;
                            const point = { x: target.x + standoffDist * Math.cos(dir), y: target.y + standoffDist * Math.sin(dir) };
                            const toPoint = dirTo(me, point);
                            const localUnsafe = segmentUnsafeAM(me, toPoint, obstacles, playerRadius, Math.min(FALLBACK_STEP_DIST, dist(me, point))) || (pointUnsafeAM(point, obstacles, playerRadius, true) && dangerCostAM(point, obstacles, playerRadius) === Infinity);
                            const danger = localUnsafe ? Infinity : dangerCostAM(point, obstacles, playerRadius);
                            let score = -Infinity;
                            if (danger !== Infinity) {
                                const travel = dist(me, point);
                                const targetDist = dist(point, target);
                                const offAbs = Math.abs(offDeg);
                                score = 600 - travel * 0.28 - danger - Math.abs(targetDist - standoffDist) * 0.35 - offAbs * 0.18;
                                if (directUnsafe && offAbs >= 28) score += 65; // if direct is bad, commit to flank
                                if (Math.sign(offDeg || side) === side && offAbs > 0) score += 28; // side hysteresis
                                if (nowMs - lastApproachSideSwitchAt < 650 && Math.sign(offDeg || side) !== side && offAbs > 0) score -= 80;
                                if (lastTacticalGoal && lastTacticalGoalSid === target.sid) {
                                    const keep = Math.max(0, 130 - dist(point, lastTacticalGoal));
                                    score += keep * 0.45;
                                }
                            }
                            rays.push({ dir: toPoint, type: localUnsafe ? "blocked" : "candidate", label: "g" + offDeg, score: score });
                            if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = { point: point, key: "g" + offDeg, offDeg: offDeg, dir: toPoint, rays: rays }; }
                        }
                        // v29 Predictive Geometry: if the enemy is moving, add aggressive
                        // cutoff goals on their motion vector. This makes the agent try to
                        // meet/cut the enemy's future route instead of forever chasing the
                        // current/last server position from behind.
                        const mvx = Number(target.vxAM) || 0, mvy = Number(target.vyAM) || 0;
                        const mSpeed = Math.hypot(mvx, mvy);
                        if (mSpeed > 0.045) {
                            const md = Math.atan2(mvy, mvx);
                            const futureLead = Math.max(95, Math.min(260, dist(me, target) * 0.42));
                            const future = { x: target.x + Math.cos(md) * futureLead, y: target.y + Math.sin(md) * futureLead };
                            const cutOffsets = [0, 38, -38, 72, -72];
                            for (let ci = 0; ci < cutOffsets.length; ci++) {
                                const off = cutOffsets[ci];
                                const sideA = md + Math.PI + off * Math.PI / 180;
                                const point = { x: future.x + standoffDist * Math.cos(sideA), y: future.y + standoffDist * Math.sin(sideA) };
                                const toPoint = dirTo(me, point);
                                const localUnsafe = segmentUnsafeAM(me, toPoint, obstacles, playerRadius, Math.min(FALLBACK_STEP_DIST, dist(me, point))) || segmentHitsHostileDamageAM(me, toPoint, obstacles, playerRadius, Math.min(FALLBACK_STEP_DIST, dist(me, point))) || (pointUnsafeAM(point, obstacles, playerRadius, true) && dangerCostAM(point, obstacles, playerRadius) === Infinity);
                                const danger = localUnsafe ? Infinity : dangerCostAM(point, obstacles, playerRadius);
                                let score = -Infinity;
                                if (danger !== Infinity) {
                                    const travel = dist(me, point);
                                    const futureDist = dist(point, future);
                                    const continuity = lastTacticalGoal && lastTacticalGoalSid === target.sid ? Math.max(0, 150 - dist(point, lastTacticalGoal)) * 0.42 : 0;
                                    const interceptBonus = 95 + Math.min(95, mSpeed * 160);
                                    score = 650 + interceptBonus - travel * 0.34 - danger * 0.72 - Math.abs(futureDist - standoffDist) * 0.25 - Math.abs(off) * 0.12 + continuity;
                                    // If enemy is moving away from me, cutoff is especially valuable.
                                    const awayDot = ((target.x - me.x) * mvx + (target.y - me.y) * mvy);
                                    if (awayDot > 0) score += 55;
                                }
                                const label = "cut" + off;
                                rays.push({ dir: toPoint, type: localUnsafe ? "blocked" : "candidate", label: label, score: score });
                                if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = { point: point, key: label, offDeg: off, dir: toPoint, rays: rays, intercept: true }; }
                            }
                        }
                        if (!best) return { point: directGoal, key: "direct", rays: rays };
                        for (let r = 0; r < rays.length; r++) if (rays[r].label === best.key) rays[r].type = "selected";
                        if (best.offDeg && Math.sign(best.offDeg) !== approachSide) {
                            approachSide = Math.sign(best.offDeg);
                            lastApproachSideSwitchAt = nowMs;
                            resetPathCache();
                        }
                        lastTacticalGoal = best.point;
                        lastTacticalGoalSid = target.sid;
                        lastTacticalGoalAt = nowMs;
                        return best;
                    }
                    function findBreakTargetAM(me, goal, obstacles, range, target) {
                        let best = null, bestScore = -Infinity;
                        const candidatesAM = [];
                        const targetDist = target ? dist(me, target) : Infinity;
                        for (let i = 0; i < obstacles.length; i++) {
                            const obj = obstacles[i];
                            if (!canBreakTacticalObjectAM(obj)) continue;
                            if (target && dist(me, obj) > targetDist + 18 && linePointDistanceAM(me, obj, target) <= ((target.scale || 35) + (player && player.scale || 35) + 10)) continue;
                            const objScale = objectScaleAM(obj);
                            const objDist = dist(me, obj) - objScale;
                            const weaponReach = breakWeaponRangeAM(obj);
                            const lineD = linePointDistanceAM(me, goal, obj);
                            const aimD = angleAbsAM(dirTo(me, goal), dirTo(me, obj));
                            const onCriticalPath = lineD <= objScale + (isHostileDamageAM(obj) ? 65 : 42) || aimD <= 0.45;
                            if (!onCriticalPath) continue;
                            // v31 Break Decision Core v2: if it is important but barely out
                            // of reach, APPROACH_BREAK instead of air-hitting or ignoring.
                            const inReach = objDist <= weaponReach - 4;
                            const canApproach = objDist <= weaponReach + 82;
                            if (!inReach && !canApproach) continue;
                            const breakTime = estimateBreakTimeAM(obj);
                            if (!Number.isFinite(breakTime)) continue;
                            // Enemy/neutral damage objects are worth clearing. Non-damage enemy
                            // buildings are only worth it if not too expensive versus bypass.
                            if (!isHostileDamageAM(obj) && breakTime > 1150) continue;
                            let score = (isHostileDamageAM(obj) ? 260 : 145)
                            - objDist * 0.34
                            - lineD * 1.05
                            - aimD * 32
                            - breakTime * (isHostileDamageAM(obj) ? 0.035 : 0.075);
                            if (Number.isFinite(obj.health)) score += Math.max(0, 160 - obj.health) * 0.22;
                            if (target && dist(me, obj) > targetDist + 18) score -= 135;
                            if (!inReach) score -= (objDist - weaponReach) * 1.45 + 38;
                            // If pathfinder already found a reasonably clean route around a
                            // non-damage object, do not stop to chop it.
                            if (!isHostileDamageAM(obj) && dangerCostAM(goal, obstacles, (player && player.scale) || 35) < 45) score -= 70;
                            const mode = inReach ? "break" : "approach_break";
                            const approachPoint = inReach ? null : approachPointForBreakAM(me, obj);
                            candidatesAM.push({ obj: obj, score: score, reason: mode });
                            if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = setBreakPlanMetaAM(obj, mode, approachPoint, score, mode); }
                        }
                        if (bestScore < 42) best = null;
                        addBreakDebugCandidatesAM(candidatesAM, best, best && best.__autoModBreakMode || "path_break");
                        return best;
                    }

                    function findFriendlyTrapHoldingTargetAM(target) {
                        if (!target) return null;
                        let best = null, bestD = Infinity;
                        for (let i = 0; i < gameObjects.length; i++) {
                            const obj = gameObjects[i];
                            if (!obj || !obj.active || !obj.trap || !friendlyOwnedAM(obj)) continue;
                            const d = dist(target, obj);
                            if (d <= ((target.scale || 35) + objectScaleAM(obj) + 10) && d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = obj; }
                        }
                        return best;
                    }
                    function findBlockingHostileDamageToTargetAM(me, target, obstacles, range) {
                        if (!target) return null;
                        const weaponReach = Math.max(45, range - MELEE_RANGE_BUFFER);
                        const targetDist = dist(me, target);
                        let best = null, bestScore = -Infinity;
                        for (let i = 0; i < obstacles.length; i++) {
                            const obj = obstacles[i];
                            if (!obj || !obj.active || !isHostileDamageAM(obj)) continue;
                            const od = dist(me, obj);
                            // only objects BETWEEN me and target, never behind the trapped enemy
                            if (od >= targetDist - 8) continue;
                            const radius = objectScaleAM(obj) + (player && player.scale || 35) * 0.35 + 18;
                            const lineD = linePointDistanceAM(me, target, obj);
                            if (lineD > radius) continue;
                            const objDist = od - objectScaleAM(obj);
                            if (objDist > weaponReach - 4) continue; // strict real reach
                            const score = 220 - objDist * 0.55 - lineD * 1.2 + (Number.isFinite(obj.health) ? Math.max(0, 140 - obj.health) * 0.25 : 0);
                            if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = obj; }
                        }
                        return best;
                    }
                    function friendlySpikeCandidatesForTrapAM(target, trap) {
                        const out = [];
                        if (!target || !trap) return out;
                        for (let i = 0; i < gameObjects.length; i++) {
                            const obj = gameObjects[i];
                            if (!obj || !obj.active || !obj.dmg || !friendlyOwnedAM(obj)) continue;
                            const dt = dist(obj, trap);
                            const dtEnemy = dist(obj, target);
                            const maxD = (target.scale || 35) + objectScaleAM(trap) + objectScaleAM(obj) + 70;
                            if (dt > maxD) continue;
                            out.push({ obj: obj, trapDist: dt, enemyDist: dtEnemy, baseScore: 500 - dtEnemy * 1.35 - dt * 0.22 });
                        }
                        out.sort(function (a, b) { return b.baseScore - a.baseScore; });
                        return out.slice(0, 6);
                    }
                    function lineBlockedBySolidAM(from, to, obstacles, ignoreA, ignoreB) {
                        const playerRadius = (player && player.scale) || 35;
                        for (let i = 0; i < obstacles.length; i++) {
                            const obj = obstacles[i];
                            if (!obj || !obj.active || obj === ignoreA || obj === ignoreB) continue;
                            if (obj.sid !== undefined && (obj.sid === (ignoreA && ignoreA.sid) || obj.sid === (ignoreB && ignoreB.sid))) continue;
                            if (obj.ignoreCollision) continue;
                            const radius = objectScaleAM(obj) + playerRadius * 0.45;
                            if (linePointDistanceAM(from, to, obj) <= radius) return obj;
                        }
                        return null;
                    }
                    function pushLaneHostileBlockerAM(target, spike, obstacles) {
                        let best = null, bestD = Infinity;
                        for (let hb = 0; hb < obstacles.length; hb++) {
                            const o = obstacles[hb];
                            if (!o || !o.active || !isHostileDamageAM(o) || o === spike) continue;
                            const laneD = linePointDistanceAM(target, spike, o);
                            if (laneD <= objectScaleAM(o) + (target.scale || 35) * 0.55) {
                                const od = dist(target, o);
                                if (od < bestD) { bestD = od; best = o; }
                            }
                        }
                        return best;
                    }
                    function computeTrapPushPlanAM(me, target, trap, obstacles) {
                        // v39 Advanced Push Logic v2: evaluate several friendly spikes and
                        // several push-position offsets, then choose the highest-scoring real
                        // push lane instead of the first nearby spike. Invalid lanes blocked by
                        // hostile spikes are rejected so Tactical Core can clear them first.
                        const candidates = friendlySpikeCandidatesForTrapAM(target, trap);
                        if (!candidates.length) return null;
                        const playerRadius = (player && player.scale) || 35;
                        let best = null, bestScore = -Infinity;
                        for (let si = 0; si < candidates.length; si++) {
                            const spike = candidates[si].obj;
                            const laneBlocker = pushLaneHostileBlockerAM(target, spike, obstacles);
                            if (laneBlocker) continue;
                            const basePushDir = dirTo(target, spike); // enemy -> our spike
                            const offsets = [0, 0.22, -0.22, 0.42, -0.42];
                            for (let oi = 0; oi < offsets.length; oi++) {
                                const pushDir = basePushDir + offsets[oi];
                                const pos = {
                                    x: spike.x + 250 * Math.cos(pushDir),
                                    y: spike.y + 250 * Math.sin(pushDir),
                                    x2: spike.x + (dist(target, spike) + playerRadius) * Math.cos(pushDir),
                                    y2: spike.y + (dist(target, spike) + playerRadius) * Math.sin(pushDir),
                                };
                                const pushPoint = { x: pos.x2, y: pos.y2 };
                                const solidBlocker = lineBlockedBySolidAM(me, pushPoint, obstacles, trap, spike);
                                if (solidBlocker && !friendlyOwnedAM(solidBlocker)) continue;
                                const moveDir = UTILS.lineInRect(me.x - playerRadius / 10, me.y - playerRadius / 10, me.x + playerRadius / 10, me.y + playerRadius / 10, target.x, target.y, pos.x, pos.y)
                                ? dirTo(me, target)
                                : dirTo(me, pushPoint);
                                const stepLen = Math.min(FALLBACK_STEP_DIST, dist(me, pushPoint));
                                const unsafe = segmentHitsHostileDamageAM(me, moveDir, obstacles, playerRadius, stepLen);
                                if (unsafe) continue;
                                const travel = dist(me, pushPoint);
                                const laneAngleError = Math.abs(offsets[oi]);
                                const danger = dangerCostAM(pushPoint, obstacles, playerRadius);
                                if (!Number.isFinite(danger)) continue;
                                // Prefer spikes that are very close to trapped enemy, short travel,
                                // and straight push lanes. Slight side offsets are allowed when the
                                // direct push point is awkward.
                                let score = candidates[si].baseScore + 420 - travel * 0.42 - danger * 0.18 - laneAngleError * 90;
                                if (oi === 0) score += 35;
                                if (lastTacticalActionAM === "PUSH_KILL") score += 55;
                                if (score > bestScore) {
                                    bestScore = score;
                                    best = { spike: spike, trap: trap, point: pushPoint, dir: moveDir, pushDir: pushDir, blocker: solidBlocker || null, score: score, laneOffset: offsets[oi] };
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (best) {
                            best.alternatives = candidates.length;
                            return best;
                        }
                        return null;
                    }

                    function findEnemySpikeToClearForTrapPushAM(me, target, trap, pushPlan, obstacles, range) {
                        let best = null, bestScore = -Infinity;
                        const candidatesAM = [];
                        // If no valid push plan exists because a hostile spike blocks every
                        // friendly-spike lane, explicitly score those lane blockers for clear.
                        if (!pushPlan) {
                            const spikes = friendlySpikeCandidatesForTrapAM(target, trap);
                            for (let si = 0; si < spikes.length; si++) {
                                const blocker = pushLaneHostileBlockerAM(target, spikes[si].obj, obstacles);
                                if (!blocker || !canBreakTacticalObjectAM(blocker)) continue;
                                const od = dist(me, blocker) - objectScaleAM(blocker);
                                const weaponReach = breakWeaponRangeAM(blocker);
                                if (od > weaponReach + 82) continue;
                                const score = 360 - od * 0.85 + spikes[si].baseScore * 0.22 - Math.max(0, estimateBreakTimeAM(blocker) - 450) * 0.045;
                                candidatesAM.push({ obj: blocker, score: score, reason: "blocked_push_lane" });
                                if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = blocker; }
                            }
                        }
                        for (let i = 0; i < obstacles.length; i++) {
                            const obj = obstacles[i];
                            if (!canBreakTacticalObjectAM(obj)) continue;
                            const od = dist(me, obj) - objectScaleAM(obj);
                            const weaponReach = breakWeaponRangeAM(obj);
                            if (od > weaponReach - 4) continue; // v30: strict real reach; avoid air-hitting out-of-range clear target
                            // Clear enemy spikes that are near the trapped enemy / trap / push lane,
                            // not random spikes behind the enemy body.
                            const nearTrap = dist(obj, trap) <= objectScaleAM(trap) + objectScaleAM(obj) + (target.scale || 35) + 65;
                            const onPushLane = pushPlan ? linePointDistanceAM(me, pushPlan.point, obj) <= objectScaleAM(obj) + 55 : false;
                            const betweenMeAndEnemy = linePointDistanceAM(me, target, obj) <= objectScaleAM(obj) + 45 && dist(me, obj) < dist(me, target) + 10;
                            if (!nearTrap && !onPushLane && !betweenMeAndEnemy) continue;
                            // Do not choose a spike physically behind the trapped enemy if it does
                            // not affect push lane; that caused walking through enemy to break it.
                            if (!onPushLane && dist(me, obj) > dist(me, target) + 18) continue;
                            const score = (isHostileDamageAM(obj) ? 260 : 190) - od * 0.7 + (nearTrap ? 65 : 0) + (onPushLane ? 105 : 0) + (betweenMeAndEnemy ? 45 : 0) + (Number.isFinite(obj.health) ? Math.max(0, 180 - obj.health) * 0.18 : 0);
                            candidatesAM.push({ obj: obj, score: score, reason: onPushLane ? "push_lane" : nearTrap ? "near_trap" : "between" });
                            if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = obj; }
                        }
                        addBreakDebugCandidatesAM(candidatesAM, best, "clear_trap_push");
                        return best;
                    }

                    function chooseKillTrappedGoalAM(me, target, trap, range, obstacles) {
                        // Choose the shortest safe point on a killing ring around the trapped
                        // enemy. This is deliberately different from normal APPROACH: when
                        // target is trapped, do not wander/flank widely; get to a clear lethal
                        // angle with minimum travel and hold it.
                        const playerRadius = (player && player.scale) || 35;
                        const desired = Math.max(48, Math.min(range * 0.78, range - 10));
                        const base = dirTo(target, me);
                        const offsets = [0, 18, -18, 35, -35, 55, -55, 80, -80, 110, -110, 145, -145, 180];
                        let best = null, bestScore = -Infinity;
                        const rays = [];
                        for (let i = 0; i < offsets.length; i++) {
                            const off = offsets[i];
                            const a = base + off * Math.PI / 180;
                            const point = { x: target.x + desired * Math.cos(a), y: target.y + desired * Math.sin(a) };
                            const moveDir = dirTo(me, point);
                            const moveLen = Math.min(FALLBACK_STEP_DIST, dist(me, point));
                            const moveBlocked = segmentUnsafeAM(me, moveDir, obstacles, playerRadius, moveLen) || segmentHitsHostileDamageAM(me, moveDir, obstacles, playerRadius, moveLen);
                            const attackBlocked = segmentHitsHostileDamageAM(point, dirTo(point, target), obstacles, playerRadius, Math.min(desired, dist(point, target)));
                            const danger = dangerCostAM(point, obstacles, playerRadius);
                            let score = -Infinity;
                            if (!moveBlocked && !attackBlocked && Number.isFinite(danger)) {
                                const travel = dist(me, point);
                                const continuity = lastTacticalGoal && lastTacticalGoalSid === target.sid ? Math.max(0, 120 - dist(point, lastTacticalGoal)) * 0.55 : 0;
                                score = 900 - travel * 0.85 - danger * 0.22 - Math.abs(off) * 0.16 + continuity;
                                // Prefer staying near the trap center's current side instead of
                                // crossing through the trapped enemy.
                                if (trap && linePointDistanceAM(me, point, target) <= (target.scale || 35) * 0.8) score -= 120;
                            }
                            rays.push({ dir: moveDir, type: score === -Infinity ? "blocked" : "candidate", label: "kill" + off, score: score });
                            if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = { point: point, key: "kill" + off, dir: moveDir, rays: rays }; }
                        }
                        if (!best) {
                            const fallback = { x: target.x + desired * Math.cos(base), y: target.y + desired * Math.sin(base) };
                            return { point: fallback, key: "killFallback", rays: rays };
                        }
                        for (let r = 0; r < rays.length; r++) if (rays[r].label === best.key) rays[r].type = "selected";
                        setDebugRaysAM(rays);
                        lastTacticalGoal = best.point;
                        lastTacticalGoalSid = target.sid;
                        lastTacticalGoalAt = now();
                        return best;
                    }

                    function stableMoveDirAM(dir, obstacles, me) {
                        if (dir === undefined || !Number.isFinite(dir)) { lastChosenMoveDir = undefined; return undefined; }
                        if (!Number.isFinite(lastChosenMoveDir)) { lastChosenMoveDir = dir; return dir; }
                        const delta = angleDeltaAM(dir, lastChosenMoveDir);
                        if (Math.abs(delta) < 0.16) return lastChosenMoveDir;
                        // Blend small/medium corrections to remove left-right jitter between
                        // spike gaps. Large emergency turns stay immediate.
                        const blended = Math.abs(delta) > 1.35 ? dir : lastChosenMoveDir + delta * 0.55;
                        const playerRadius = (player && player.scale) || 35;
                        if (obstacles && me && segmentUnsafeAM(me, blended, obstacles, playerRadius, FALLBACK_STEP_DIST * 0.65)) {
                            lastChosenMoveDir = dir;
                            return dir;
                        }
                        lastChosenMoveDir = blended;
                        return blended;
                    }
                    function fallbackMoveDirAM(me, goal, obstacles, straightDir) {
                        const playerRadius = (player && player.scale) || 35;
                        const candidates = [0, 10, -10, 20, -20, 34, -34, 50, -50, 70, -70, 95, -95, 125, -125, 160, -160, 180];
                        let best = undefined, bestScore = -Infinity;
                        let riskBest = undefined, riskBestScore = -Infinity;
                        const rays = [{ dir: straightDir, type: "straight", label: "direct" }];
                        for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
                            const off = candidates[i];
                            const dir = straightDir + off * Math.PI / 180;
                            const blocked = segmentUnsafeAM(me, dir, obstacles, playerRadius, FALLBACK_STEP_DIST);
                            const next = { x: me.x + Math.cos(dir) * FALLBACK_STEP_DIST, y: me.y + Math.sin(dir) * FALLBACK_STEP_DIST };
                            const progress = dist(me, goal) - dist(next, goal);
                            const turnPenalty = Math.abs(off) / 180;
                            const continuity = Number.isFinite(lastChosenMoveDir) ? Math.max(0, 1 - angleAbsAM(dir, lastChosenMoveDir) / Math.PI) * 28 : 0;
                            const sideBias = Math.sign(off || approachSide) === approachSide ? 12 : -8;
                            const danger = dangerCostAM(next, obstacles, playerRadius);
                            let score = progress - turnPenalty * 30 + continuity + sideBias - (Number.isFinite(danger) ? danger * 0.18 : 9999);
                            if (!blocked) {
                                if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = dir; }
                                rays.push({ dir: dir, type: "candidate", score: score, label: String(off) });
                            } else {
                                // Keep a controlled-risk option: if everything is red because of
                                // nearby side/own spikes, still move toward the least bad escaping
                                // direction instead of freezing and oscillating.
                                if (Number.isFinite(danger) && danger < 95 && progress > -25 && !segmentHitsHostileDamageAM(me, dir, obstacles, playerRadius, FALLBACK_STEP_DIST)) {
                                    const riskScore = score - 35;
                                    if (riskScore > riskBestScore) { riskBestScore = riskScore; riskBest = dir; }
                                }
                                rays.push({ dir: dir, type: "blocked", score: score, label: String(off) });
                            }
                        }
                        const chosen = best !== undefined ? best : riskBest;
                        if (chosen !== undefined) {
                            for (let r = 0; r < rays.length; r++) if (Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(rays[r].dir - chosen), Math.cos(rays[r].dir - chosen))) < 0.001) rays[r].type = best !== undefined ? "selected" : "risk";
                            setDebugRaysAM(rays);
                            setDebugPathAM([me, { x: me.x + Math.cos(chosen) * FALLBACK_STEP_DIST, y: me.y + Math.sin(chosen) * FALLBACK_STEP_DIST }]);
                            log(best !== undefined ? "PATH_FALLBACK" : "PATH_RISK", { deg: Math.round((chosen - straightDir) * 180 / Math.PI), score: Math.round(best !== undefined ? bestScore : riskBestScore) });
                            return chosen;
                        }
                        const escapeDir = escapeDirFromObstaclesAM(me, obstacles, playerRadius);
                        if (Number.isFinite(escapeDir)) {
                            rays.push({ dir: escapeDir, type: "selected", label: "escape" });
                            setDebugRaysAM(rays);
                            setDebugPathAM([me, { x: me.x + Math.cos(escapeDir) * FALLBACK_STEP_DIST, y: me.y + Math.sin(escapeDir) * FALLBACK_STEP_DIST }]);
                            log("PATH_ESCAPE", { reason: "crowded_by_objects" });
                            return escapeDir;
                        }
                        setDebugRaysAM(rays);
                        setDebugPathAM([me]);
                        log("PATH_HOLD", { reason: "no_safe_fallback" });
                        return undefined;
                    }

                    function pathLengthAM(path) {
                        if (!path || path.length < 2) return 0;
                        let total = 0;
                        for (let i = 1; i < path.length; i++) total += dist(path[i - 1], path[i]);
                        return total;
                    }
                    function pathTurnCostAM(path) {
                        if (!path || path.length < 3) return 0;
                        let cost = 0;
                        for (let i = 2; i < path.length; i++) {
                            const a = dirTo(path[i - 2], path[i - 1]);
                            const b = dirTo(path[i - 1], path[i]);
                            cost += angleAbsAM(a, b);
                        }
                        return cost;
                    }
                    function pathDangerCostAM(path, obstacles, playerRadius) {
                        if (!path || path.length < 2) return Infinity;
                        let cost = 0;
                        for (let i = 0; i < path.length; i++) {
                            const d = dangerCostAM(path[i], obstacles, playerRadius);
                            if (!Number.isFinite(d)) return Infinity;
                            cost += d * (i === 0 ? 0.15 : 1);
                            if (i > 0) {
                                const segDir = dirTo(path[i - 1], path[i]);
                                const segLen = dist(path[i - 1], path[i]);
                                if (segmentHitsHostileDamageAM(path[i - 1], segDir, obstacles, playerRadius, segLen)) return Infinity;
                            }
                        }
                        return cost;
                    }
                    function smoothPathAM(path, obstacles, playerRadius) {
                        if (!path || path.length <= 2) return path;
                        const result = [path[0]];
                        let anchorIdx = 0;
                        while (anchorIdx < path.length - 1) {
                            let best = anchorIdx + 1;
                            for (let j = path.length - 1; j > anchorIdx + 1; j--) {
                                const dir = dirTo(path[anchorIdx], path[j]);
                                const len = dist(path[anchorIdx], path[j]);
                                if (!segmentUnsafeAM(path[anchorIdx], dir, obstacles, playerRadius, len) && !segmentHitsHostileDamageAM(path[anchorIdx], dir, obstacles, playerRadius, len)) {
                                    best = j;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                            result.push(path[best]);
                            anchorIdx = best;
                        }
                        return result;
                    }
                    function buildCandidateGoalCellsAM(hazard, goalG) {
                        const candidates = [];
                        const seen = new Set();
                        function add(gx, gy, label, penalty) {
                            if (gx < 0 || gy < 0 || gx >= hazard.size || gy >= hazard.size) return;
                            const key = gx + ":" + gy;
                            if (seen.has(key)) return;
                            seen.add(key);
                            candidates.push({ x: gx, y: gy, label: label, penalty: penalty || 0 });
                        }
                        add(goalG.gx, goalG.gy, "goal", 0);
                        // v30 perf: do not run 25 A* searches every repath. 9-13 nearby
                        // candidates are enough to escape blocked goal cells while avoiding
                        // multi-second frame drops on object-heavy PvP bases.
                        const r = 1, penalty = CELL_SIZE * 0.42;
                        add(goalG.gx + r, goalG.gy, "E1", penalty);
                        add(goalG.gx - r, goalG.gy, "W1", penalty);
                        add(goalG.gx, goalG.gy + r, "S1", penalty);
                        add(goalG.gx, goalG.gy - r, "N1", penalty);
                        add(goalG.gx + r, goalG.gy + r, "SE1", penalty + 8);
                        add(goalG.gx + r, goalG.gy - r, "NE1", penalty + 8);
                        add(goalG.gx - r, goalG.gy + r, "SW1", penalty + 8);
                        add(goalG.gx - r, goalG.gy - r, "NW1", penalty + 8);
                        add(goalG.gx + 2, goalG.gy, "E2", CELL_SIZE * 0.95);
                        add(goalG.gx - 2, goalG.gy, "W2", CELL_SIZE * 0.95);
                        add(goalG.gx, goalG.gy + 2, "S2", CELL_SIZE * 0.95);
                        add(goalG.gx, goalG.gy - 2, "N2", CELL_SIZE * 0.95);
                        return candidates;
                    }
                    function findBestPathAM(hazard, start, goalG, obstacles, playerRadius) {
                        const allCandidates = buildCandidateGoalCellsAM(hazard, goalG);
                        const dense = obstacles && obstacles.length || 0;
                        const candidateLimit = dense >= CRITICAL_OBSTACLE_LIMIT ? 1 : dense >= DENSE_OBSTACLE_LIMIT ? 5 : allCandidates.length;
                        const candidates = allCandidates.slice(0, candidateLimit);
                        const startTime = (performance && performance.now) ? performance.now() : Date.now();
                        let best = null, bestScore = Infinity, checked = 0, budgetHit = false;
                        for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
                            if (i > 0) {
                                const elapsed = ((performance && performance.now) ? performance.now() : Date.now()) - startTime;
                                if (elapsed > PATHFIND_BUDGET_MS) { budgetHit = true; break; }
                            }
                            const c = candidates[i];
                            const raw = findPath(hazard.grid, start, { x: c.x, y: c.y });
                            checked++;
                            if (!raw || raw.length < 2) continue;
                            let world = raw.map(function (pt) { return hazard.gridToWorld(pt.x, pt.y); });
                            // v34: smoothing is useful but O(path^2) with segment checks. Skip
                            // it in dense-base mode to protect frame time.
                            if (dense < DENSE_OBSTACLE_LIMIT) world = smoothPathAM(world, obstacles, playerRadius);
                            const length = pathLengthAM(world);
                            const danger = pathDangerCostAM(world, obstacles, playerRadius);
                            if (!Number.isFinite(danger)) continue;
                            const turns = dense < DENSE_OBSTACLE_LIMIT ? pathTurnCostAM(world) : 0;
                            const continuity = (cachedPath && cachedPath.length > 1) ? Math.max(0, 150 - dist(world[1], cachedPath[1] || cachedPath[0])) * -0.35 : 0;
                            const score = length + danger * 0.36 + turns * 28 + c.penalty + continuity;
                            if (score < bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = { path: world, score: score, label: c.label }; }
                        }
                        if (budgetHit && best && now() - lastPathBestLogAt > 1000) {
                            lastPathBestLogAt = now();
                            log("PATH_BUDGET", { label: best.label, checked: checked, dense: dense });
                        }
                        return best;
                    }

                    // Computes a hazard-aware safe move direction toward `goal`,
                    // rebuilding/re-pathing at most once every REPATH_INTERVAL ms. v15:
                    // when A* fails, NEVER fall back to a blind straight line through the
                    // obstacle/spike that blocked the path; use a local tangent sweep, or
                    // hold still if every candidate is unsafe.
                    function safeMoveDirTo(me, goal, obstacles, goalSid) {
                        const straightDir = dirTo(me, goal);
                        const needsRepath = (now() - lastRepathAt >= REPATH_INTERVAL) || !cachedPath || cachedPathGoalSid !== goalSid;
                        if (needsRepath) {
                            lastRepathAt = now();
                            cachedPathGoalSid = goalSid;
                            const playerRadius = (player && player.scale) || 35;
                            const hazard = buildHazardGrid(me, obstacles, playerRadius);
                            const startG = hazard.worldToGrid(me.x, me.y);
                            const clampedGoal = {
                                x: Math.max(me.x - GRID_RADIUS * CELL_SIZE, Math.min(me.x + GRID_RADIUS * CELL_SIZE, goal.x)),
                                y: Math.max(me.y - GRID_RADIUS * CELL_SIZE, Math.min(me.y + GRID_RADIUS * CELL_SIZE, goal.y)),
                            };
                            const goalG = hazard.worldToGrid(clampedGoal.x, clampedGoal.y);
                            const start = { x: startG.gx, y: startG.gy };
                            const bestPath = findBestPathAM(hazard, start, goalG, obstacles, playerRadius);
                            if (bestPath && bestPath.path && bestPath.path.length > 1) {
                                cachedPath = bestPath.path;
                            } else {
                                cachedPath = null;
                                log("PATH_NONE", { reason: "no_candidate_route", goalSid: goalSid });
                            }
                        }
                        if (!cachedPath || cachedPath.length < 2) return stableMoveDirAM(fallbackMoveDirAM(me, goal, obstacles, straightDir), obstacles, me);
                        while (cachedPath.length > 1 && dist(me, cachedPath[0]) < CELL_SIZE * 0.6) cachedPath.shift();
                        const pathDir = dirTo(me, cachedPath[1] || cachedPath[0]);
                        const playerRadius = (player && player.scale) || 35;
                        if (segmentUnsafeAM(me, pathDir, obstacles, playerRadius, FALLBACK_STEP_DIST * 0.85)) {
                            resetPathCache();
                            return stableMoveDirAM(fallbackMoveDirAM(me, goal, obstacles, straightDir), obstacles, me);
                        }
                        setDebugRaysAM([
                            { dir: straightDir, type: "straight", label: "direct" },
                            { dir: pathDir, type: "selected", label: "route" },
                            cachedPath && cachedPath.length > 2 ? { dir: dirTo(me, cachedPath[cachedPath.length - 1]), type: "candidate", label: "end" } : null
                        ].filter(Boolean));
                        setDebugPathAM(cachedPath);
                        return stableMoveDirAM(pathDir, obstacles, me);
                    }

                    function resetPathCache() {
                        cachedPath = null; cachedPathGoalSid = null; lastRepathAt = 0;
                    }

                    // === v20 Intent/Arbiter layer =====================================
                    // AutoMod no longer directly "does" every movement/attack decision in
                    // the tactical branches. Branches publish intents; this small arbiter
                    // chooses the highest-priority action and performs one final safety pass
                    // before sending packets. This is the base for integrating push/break/
                    // combat without packet fights.
                    let moveIntentAM = null;
                    let attackIntentAM = null;
                    let lastIntentDebugAM = null;
                    let lastTacticalActionAM = null;
                    let lastTacticalActionAtAM = 0;
                    function beginIntentAM() {
                        moveIntentAM = null;
                        attackIntentAM = null;
                        lastIntentDebugAM = null;
                        beginBreakDebugAM();
                    }
                    function requestMoveAM(source, dir, priority, reason) {
                        const intent = { source: source, dir: dir, priority: priority || 0, reason: reason || "" };
                        if (!moveIntentAM || intent.priority >= moveIntentAM.priority) moveIntentAM = intent;
                    }
                    function requestAttackAM(source, active, aimDir, button, priority, reason) {
                        const intent = { source: source, active: !!active, aimDir: aimDir, button: button || "left", priority: priority || 0, reason: reason || "" };
                        if (!attackIntentAM || intent.priority >= attackIntentAM.priority) attackIntentAM = intent;
                    }
                    function finalSafeMoveAM(me, goal, obstacles, requestedDir, priority) {
                        if (!Number.isFinite(requestedDir)) return undefined;
                        const playerRadius = (player && player.scale) || 35;
                        if (segmentHitsHostileDamageAM(me, requestedDir, obstacles, playerRadius, FALLBACK_STEP_DIST)) {
                            const fallbackGoal = goal || { x: me.x + Math.cos(requestedDir) * 160, y: me.y + Math.sin(requestedDir) * 160 };
                            const fallback = fallbackMoveDirAM(me, fallbackGoal, obstacles, requestedDir);
                            if (Number.isFinite(fallback) && !segmentHitsHostileDamageAM(me, fallback, obstacles, playerRadius, FALLBACK_STEP_DIST)) return fallback;
                            const escape = escapeDirFromObstaclesAM(me, obstacles, playerRadius);
                            if (Number.isFinite(escape) && !segmentHitsHostileDamageAM(me, escape, obstacles, playerRadius, FALLBACK_STEP_DIST)) return escape;
                            log("MOVE_SUPPRESSED", { reason: "hostile_damage_segment", source: moveIntentAM && moveIntentAM.source });
                            return undefined;
                        }
                        // Low priority approach should not push into hard natural/solid
                        // collision. High-priority escape/retreat may use controlled-risk.
                        if ((priority || 0) < 70 && segmentUnsafeAM(me, requestedDir, obstacles, playerRadius, FALLBACK_STEP_DIST * 0.8)) {
                            const fallback = fallbackMoveDirAM(me, goal || { x: me.x + Math.cos(requestedDir) * 160, y: me.y + Math.sin(requestedDir) * 160 }, obstacles, requestedDir);
                            return Number.isFinite(fallback) ? fallback : undefined;
                        }
                        return requestedDir;
                    }
                    function flushIntentAM(me, goal, obstacles) {
                        const mv = moveIntentAM;
                        const atk = attackIntentAM;
                        let finalDir = mv ? finalSafeMoveAM(me, goal, obstacles || [], mv.dir, mv.priority) : undefined;
                        if (mv && mv.dir === undefined) finalDir = undefined;
                        sendMoveCommandAM(finalDir);
                        if (atk && atk.active) setAttackAM(true, atk.aimDir, atk.button);
                        else setAttackAM(false);
                        lastIntentDebugAM = { move: mv, attack: atk, finalDir: finalDir };
                    }

                    // === v43 Online Tactical Adaptation ==========================
                    // Lightweight, persistent, non-ML tactical memory. It adjusts action
                    // scores by recent outcomes (damage dealt/taken, trap mistakes, death).
                    const LEARN_KEY_AM = "Value_AutoMod_Learning_v1";
                    let learnMemAM = null;
                    const actionBufferAM = [];
                    let lastLearnSaveAM = 0;
                    let lastOutcomeSnapshotAM = null;
                    let lastOutcomeObserveAtAM = 0;
                    let lastRecordedActionTypeAM = null;
                    let lastRecordedActionAtAM = 0;
                    function clampAM(v, lo, hi) { return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v)); }
                    function loadLearningAM() {
                        if (learnMemAM) return learnMemAM;
                        try { learnMemAM = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LEARN_KEY_AM) || "null"); } catch (_) { learnMemAM = null; }
                        if (!learnMemAM || learnMemAM.version !== 1) learnMemAM = { version: 1, actionBias: {}, featureBias: {}, stats: { deaths: 0, rewards: 0, damageDone: 0, damageTaken: 0 } };
                        return learnMemAM;
                    }
                    function saveLearningAM(force) {
                        const t = now();
                        if (!force && t - lastLearnSaveAM < 5000) return;
                        lastLearnSaveAM = t;
                        try { localStorage.setItem(LEARN_KEY_AM, JSON.stringify(loadLearningAM())); } catch (_) { }
                    }
                    function featureKeysAM(type, ctx) {
                        const keys = [type];
                        if (!ctx) return keys;
                        if (ctx.hpRatio < 0.35) keys.push(type + ":lowHp");
                        if (ctx.enemyHpRatio < 0.35) keys.push(type + ":enemyLowHp");
                        if (ctx.trap) keys.push(type + ":enemyTrapped");
                        if (ctx.minefield && ctx.minefield.active) keys.push(type + ":minefield");
                        if (ctx.clearTarget && isHostileDamageAM(ctx.clearTarget)) keys.push(type + ":clearSpike");
                        if (ctx.breakTarget && isHostileDamageAM(ctx.breakTarget)) keys.push(type + ":breakSpike");
                        if (ctx.directDanger) keys.push(type + ":directDanger");
                        if (ctx.pushPlan) keys.push(type + ":pushPlan");
                        return keys;
                    }
                    function learningBiasAM(type, ctx) {
                        const mem = loadLearningAM();
                        let total = Number(mem.actionBias[type]) || 0;
                        const keys = featureKeysAM(type, ctx);
                        for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) total += (Number(mem.featureBias[keys[i]]) || 0) * 0.75;
                        // v44 anti-cowardice guard: learning can tune tactics, but it must
                        // not train the agent into infinite retreat / refusing all pressure.
                        if (type === "RETREAT" || type === "MINEFIELD_ESCAPE") return clampAM(total, -120, 75);
                        if (type === "APPROACH" || type === "INTERCEPT" || type === "COMBAT" || type === "PUSH_KILL" || type === "PLACEMENT_SETUP") return clampAM(total, -55, 180);
                        return clampAM(total, -140, 160);
                    }
                    function rewardKeysAM(keys, amount, reason) {
                        const mem = loadLearningAM();
                        if (!keys || !keys.length || !Number.isFinite(amount) || !amount) return;
                        const lr = 0.10;
                        const action = keys[0];
                        mem.actionBias[action] = clampAM((Number(mem.actionBias[action]) || 0) + amount * lr, -160, 160);
                        for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) mem.featureBias[keys[i]] = clampAM((Number(mem.featureBias[keys[i]]) || 0) + amount * lr * 0.85, -140, 140);
                        mem.stats.rewards = (mem.stats.rewards || 0) + amount;
                    }
                    function rewardRecentAM(amount, reason, windowMs) {
                        const t = now();
                        const win = windowMs || 5000;
                        for (let i = actionBufferAM.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                            const rec = actionBufferAM[i];
                            const age = t - rec.t;
                            if (age > win) break;
                            const decay = 1 - age / win;
                            rewardKeysAM(rec.keys, amount * decay, reason);
                        }
                        saveLearningAM(Math.abs(amount) >= 80);
                    }
                    function recordActionLearningAM(action, ctx) {
                        if (!action || !ctx || !ctx.target) return;
                        // v46 perf: do not append identical action records every server tick.
                        // Outcome rewards still hit recent decisions, but buffer churn is much lower.
                        const t = now();
                        if (lastRecordedActionTypeAM === action.type && t - lastRecordedActionAtAM < 320) return;
                        lastRecordedActionTypeAM = action.type;
                        lastRecordedActionAtAM = t;
                        const keys = featureKeysAM(action.type, ctx);
                        actionBufferAM.push({ t: t, type: action.type, keys: keys, hp: ctx.me.health, enemyHp: ctx.target.health, dist: ctx.dist });
                        while (actionBufferAM.length > 60) actionBufferAM.shift();
                    }
                    function observeOutcomeLearningAM(ctx) {
                        if (!ctx || !ctx.target) return;
                        const tNow = now();
                        if (tNow - lastOutcomeObserveAtAM < 260) return;
                        lastOutcomeObserveAtAM = tNow;
                        const snap = { hp: Number(ctx.me.health) || 0, enemyHp: Number(ctx.target.health) || 0, trapped: !!(typeof traps !== "undefined" && traps && traps.in), targetSid: ctx.target.sid };
                        if (lastOutcomeSnapshotAM && lastOutcomeSnapshotAM.targetSid === snap.targetSid) {
                            const dmgDone = Math.max(0, lastOutcomeSnapshotAM.enemyHp - snap.enemyHp);
                            const dmgTaken = Math.max(0, lastOutcomeSnapshotAM.hp - snap.hp);
                            if (dmgDone > 0) { rewardRecentAM(Math.min(35, dmgDone * 0.42), "damage_done", 2500); loadLearningAM().stats.damageDone += dmgDone; }
                            if (dmgTaken > 0) { rewardRecentAM(-Math.min(45, dmgTaken * 0.62), "damage_taken", 3200); loadLearningAM().stats.damageTaken += dmgTaken; }
                            if (!lastOutcomeSnapshotAM.trapped && snap.trapped) rewardRecentAM(-38, "got_trapped", 3500);
                            if (snap.enemyHp <= 0 && lastOutcomeSnapshotAM.enemyHp > 0) rewardRecentAM(130, "target_kill", 5200);
                        }
                        lastOutcomeSnapshotAM = snap;
                    }
                    function onDeathLearningAM() {
                        const mem = loadLearningAM();
                        mem.stats.deaths = (mem.stats.deaths || 0) + 1;
                        rewardRecentAM(-125, "death", 5200);
                        saveLearningAM(true);
                    }
                    window.ValueAutoModLearning = {
                        get: function () { return loadLearningAM(); },
                        reset: function () { localStorage.removeItem(LEARN_KEY_AM); learnMemAM = null; actionBufferAM.length = 0; return loadLearningAM(); },
                        rewardRecent: rewardRecentAM
                    };

                    // === v32 Tactical Scoring Core ================================
                    // Every tick builds a tactical context, evaluates possible actions and
                    // executes the highest score. This replaces brittle "first matching if"
                    // priority with explicit scores + hysteresis.
                    function analyzeMinefieldAM(me, target, obstacles) {
                        const dangerRadius = 245;
                        let count = 0, close = 0, suspected = 0, vx = 0, vy = 0, maxThreat = 0;
                        const toTarget = target ? dirTo(me, target) : 0;
                        for (let i = 0; i < obstacles.length; i++) {
                            const obj = obstacles[i];
                            if (!obj || !obj.active) continue;
                            const hostile = isHostileDamageAM(obj);
                            const susTrap = !!(obj.suspectedTrap || obj.predictedTrap);
                            if (!hostile && !susTrap) continue;
                            const d = Math.max(1, dist(me, obj));
                            if (d > dangerRadius) continue;
                            const hard = hostile ? hardRadiusForAM(obj, (player && player.scale) || 35) : ((obj.scale || 50) + ((player && player.scale) || 35) * 0.45);
                            const influence = hostile ? hard + 125 : hard + 65;
                            if (d > influence) continue;
                            const w = Math.max(0.05, (influence - d) / influence) * (hostile ? 2.7 : 1.15) * (Number(obj.confidence) || 1);
                            vx += (me.x - obj.x) / d * w;
                            vy += (me.y - obj.y) / d * w;
                            count++;
                            if (d < hard + 35) close++;
                            if (susTrap) suspected++;
                            if (w > maxThreat) maxThreat = w;
                        }
                        const mag = Math.hypot(vx, vy);
                        let escapeDir = mag > 0.001 ? Math.atan2(vy, vx) : undefined;
                        // If pure repulsion points exactly away from target but a side exit is
                        // cleaner, bias it 35deg toward a flank instead of walking backwards
                        // forever inside the same minefield.
                        if (Number.isFinite(escapeDir) && target) {
                            const awayFromTarget = angleAbsAM(escapeDir, toTarget + Math.PI);
                            if (awayFromTarget < 0.42) escapeDir += (approachSide || 1) * 0.62;
                        }
                        const active = count >= 5 || close >= 2 || (count >= 4 && suspected >= 1) || maxThreat > 2.25;
                        return { active: active, count: count, close: close, suspected: suspected, dir: escapeDir, threat: maxThreat };
                    }

                    function placementItemAM(slot) {
                        try { return player && player.items && items.list[player.items[slot]]; } catch (_) { return null; }
                    }
                    function placementDistAM(item) {
                        return ((player && player.scale) || 35) + ((item && item.scale) || 50) + ((item && item.placeOffset) || 0);
                    }
                    function trapCatchReachAM(targetScale) {
                        const trap = placementItemAM(4) || { scale: 50, placeOffset: -5 };
                        return ((player && player.scale) || 35) + (trap.scale || 50) * 2 + (targetScale || 35) + 58;
                    }
                    function spikeGuardReachAM(targetScale) {
                        const spike = placementItemAM(2) || { scale: 49, placeOffset: -5 };
                        const trap = placementItemAM(4) || { scale: 50, placeOffset: -5 };
                        return placementDistAM(spike) + (spike.scale || 49) + (trap.scale || 50) + (targetScale || 35) + 58;
                    }
                    function placementCoordinatorEnabledAM() {
                        try { return !!(getCheck("autoplc") || getCheck("autoReplace") || getCheck("autoPreplace")); } catch (_) { return false; }
                    }
                    function hypoPlacementPointFreeAM(point, item, obstacles, ignoreObj) {
                        if (!point || !item) return false;
                        if (typeof config !== "undefined" && Number.isFinite(config.mapScale)) {
                            const r = item.scale || 50;
                            if (point.x <= r || point.y <= r || point.x >= config.mapScale - r || point.y >= config.mapScale - r) return false;
                        }
                        for (let i = 0; i < obstacles.length; i++) {
                            const obj = obstacles[i];
                            if (!obj || !obj.active || obj === ignoreObj) continue;
                            if (obj.suspectedTrap || obj.predictedTrap) continue; // prediction should guide movement, not block own placement sim absolutely
                            const radius = obj.blocker ? obj.blocker : objectScaleAM(obj);
                            if (dist(point, obj) < (item.scale || 50) + radius + 3) return false;
                        }
                        if (item.id !== 18 && typeof config !== "undefined" && point.y >= config.mapScale / 2 - config.riverWidth / 2 && point.y <= config.mapScale / 2 + config.riverWidth / 2) return false;
                        return true;
                    }
                    function evaluatePlacementOpportunityAM(candidateMe, target, obstacles) {
                        const trap = placementItemAM(4);
                        const spike = placementItemAM(2);
                        const result = { score: 0, ghosts: [], trapCount: 0, spikeCount: 0 };
                        if (!target || !candidateMe) return result;
                        const base = dirTo(candidateMe, target);
                        const targetScale = target.scale || 35;
                        const specs = [];
                        if (trap) specs.push({ slot: 4, item: trap, kind: "trap", offsets: [0, 0.22, -0.22, 0.45, -0.45] });
                        if (spike) specs.push({ slot: 2, item: spike, kind: "spike", offsets: [0, 0.28, -0.28, 0.58, -0.58] });
                        for (let si = 0; si < specs.length; si++) {
                            const spec = specs[si];
                            const pd = placementDistAM(spec.item);
                            for (let oi = 0; oi < spec.offsets.length; oi++) {
                                const a = base + spec.offsets[oi];
                                const point = { x: candidateMe.x + pd * Math.cos(a), y: candidateMe.y + pd * Math.sin(a) };
                                if (!hypoPlacementPointFreeAM(point, spec.item, obstacles, null)) continue;
                                const td = dist(point, target);
                                let score = 0;
                                if (spec.kind === "trap") {
                                    const catchBand = targetScale + (spec.item.scale || 50) + 26;
                                    if (td <= catchBand) score = 90 - Math.max(0, td - (targetScale + (spec.item.scale || 50))) * 0.8;
                                } else {
