                                    const spikeBand = targetScale + (spec.item.scale || 49) + 70;
                                    if (td <= spikeBand) score = 72 - Math.max(0, td - (targetScale + (spec.item.scale || 49))) * 0.55;
                                }
                                if (score <= 0) continue;
                                result.score += score;
                                if (spec.kind === "trap") result.trapCount++; else result.spikeCount++;
                                result.ghosts.push({ x: point.x, y: point.y, dir: a, slot: spec.slot, kind: spec.kind, score: score, scale: spec.item.scale || (spec.kind === "trap" ? 50 : 49), itemId: spec.item.id, alpha: spec.kind === "trap" ? 0.20 : 0.16 });
                            }
                        }
                        // A setup with both a trap and a spike option is much more valuable:
                        // it lets PlacementCoreV2 choose the correct tactic without AutoMod
                        // standing in the future placement lane.
                        if (result.trapCount && result.spikeCount) result.score += 75;
                        return result;
                    }

                    function choosePlacementSetupGoalAM(me, target, obstacles) {
                        if (!target || !placementCoordinatorEnabledAM()) return null;
                        const targetScale = target.scale || 35;
                        const trapReach = trapCatchReachAM(targetScale);
                        const spikeReach = spikeGuardReachAM(targetScale);
                        const maxSetup = Math.min(325, Math.max(trapReach, Math.min(spikeReach, 285)));
                        const desired = Math.max(135, Math.min(230, trapReach - 14));
                        const d = dist(me, target);
                        // If already in a good placement band, do not override combat/push.
                        const inBand = d >= desired - 24 && d <= Math.min(maxSetup, desired + 34);
                        const base = dirTo(target, me);
                        const offsets = [0, 25, -25, 50, -50, 82, -82, 120, -120];
                        let best = null, bestScore = -Infinity;
                        const playerRadius = (player && player.scale) || 35;
                        for (let i = 0; i < offsets.length; i++) {
                            const a = base + offsets[i] * Math.PI / 180;
                            const point = { x: target.x + desired * Math.cos(a), y: target.y + desired * Math.sin(a) };
                            const moveDir = dirTo(me, point);
                            const moveLen = Math.min(FALLBACK_STEP_DIST, dist(me, point));
                            if (segmentHitsHostileDamageAM(me, moveDir, obstacles, playerRadius, moveLen)) continue;
                            if (segmentUnsafeAM(me, moveDir, obstacles, playerRadius, moveLen) && dist(me, point) > 45) continue;
                            const danger = dangerCostAM(point, obstacles, playerRadius);
                            if (!Number.isFinite(danger)) continue;
                            const placementEval = evaluatePlacementOpportunityAM(point, target, obstacles);
                            if (placementEval.score <= 0) continue;
                            const travel = dist(me, point);
                            const bandPenalty = Math.abs(dist(point, target) - desired);
                            let score = 560 - travel * 0.42 - danger * 0.25 - bandPenalty * 0.6 - Math.abs(offsets[i]) * 0.14 + placementEval.score * 0.92;
                            if (inBand) score -= 80; // don't over-micro if already positioned
                            if (lastTacticalActionAM === "PLACEMENT_SETUP") score += 65;
                            if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = { point: point, key: "place" + offsets[i], score: score, desired: desired, inBand: inBand, placementGhosts: placementEval.ghosts, placementScore: placementEval.score }; }
                        }
                        if (!best || bestScore < 430) { setPlacementGhostsAM([]); return null; }
                        setPlacementGhostsAM(best.placementGhosts || []);
                        return best;
                    }

                    function buildTacticalContextAM(me, target, tacticalTarget) {
                        if (!target) return { me: me, target: null, tacticalTarget: null, obstacles: [], range: 0, dist: Infinity, hpRatio: 1, enemyHpRatio: 1, trap: null, pushPlan: null, clearTarget: null, approachGoal: null, placementSetup: null, breakTarget: null, killGoal: null, directDanger: false, minefield: null };
                        const obstacles = buildObstaclesAM(me);
                        const predTraps = getSuspectedTrapZonesAM(me, tacticalTarget || target, obstacles);
                        setPredictedTrapZonesAM(predTraps);
                        for (let pti = 0; pti < predTraps.length; pti++) obstacles.push(predTraps[pti]);
                        const range = weaponRangeFor();
                        const d = dist(me, target);
                        const hpRatio = (Number(me.health) || 0) / (Number(me.maxHealth) || 100);
                        const enemyHpRatio = (Number(target.health) || 0) / (Number(target.maxHealth) || 100);
                        const trap = findFriendlyTrapHoldingTargetAM(target);
                        const pushPlan = trap ? computeTrapPushPlanAM(me, target, trap, obstacles) : null;
                        const clearTarget = trap ? (findEnemySpikeToClearForTrapPushAM(me, target, trap, pushPlan, obstacles, range) || findBlockingHostileDamageToTargetAM(me, target, obstacles, range)) : null;
                        const minefield = analyzeMinefieldAM(me, target, obstacles);
                        const approachGoal = !trap && !(minefield && minefield.active && minefield.close >= 2) ? chooseApproachGoalAM(me, tacticalTarget || target, range, obstacles) : null;
                        const placementSetup = !trap && !(minefield && minefield.active && minefield.close >= 2) ? choosePlacementSetupGoalAM(me, tacticalTarget || target, obstacles) : null;
                        const breakTarget = (!trap && (approachGoal || placementSetup)) ? findBreakTargetAM(me, (approachGoal || placementSetup).point, obstacles, range, target) : null;
                        const killGoal = trap && !pushPlan && !clearTarget ? chooseKillTrappedGoalAM(me, target, trap, range, obstacles) : null;
                        const directDanger = segmentHitsHostileDamageAM(me, dirTo(me, target), obstacles, (player && player.scale) || 35, Math.min(d, range));
                        return { me: me, target: target, tacticalTarget: tacticalTarget || target, obstacles: obstacles, range: range, dist: d, hpRatio: hpRatio, enemyHpRatio: enemyHpRatio, trap: trap, pushPlan: pushPlan, clearTarget: clearTarget, approachGoal: approachGoal, placementSetup: placementSetup, breakTarget: breakTarget, killGoal: killGoal, directDanger: directDanger, minefield: minefield };
                    }
                    function actionScoreAM(type, base, ctx) {
                        let score = base;
                        if (lastTacticalActionAM === type && now() - lastTacticalActionAtAM < 900) score += 70;
                        if (ctx && ctx.enemyHpRatio < 0.35 && (type === "COMBAT" || type === "INTERCEPT" || type === "APPROACH")) score += 35;
                        score += learningBiasAM(type, ctx);
                        return score;
                    }
                    function evaluateActionsAM(ctx, isRetreating) {
                        const actions = [];
                        const runaway = (lastTacticalActionAM === "RETREAT" || lastTacticalActionAM === "MINEFIELD_ESCAPE") && (now() - lastTacticalActionAtAM > RUNAWAY_LIMIT_MS) && ctx.hpRatio > 0.34;
                        if (isRetreating && !runaway) actions.push({ type: "RETREAT", score: actionScoreAM("RETREAT", 880 + (0.28 - ctx.hpRatio) * 520, ctx) });
                        // v45: Minefield escape is a short emergency/nudge, not a general
                        // reason to kite out of PvP pressure. Require close danger, low HP,
                        // or a direct hazardous line.
                        if (ctx.minefield && ctx.minefield.active && !(runaway && ctx.minefield.close < 2) && (ctx.minefield.close >= 2 || ctx.hpRatio < 0.34 || ctx.directDanger)) actions.push({ type: "MINEFIELD_ESCAPE", score: actionScoreAM("MINEFIELD_ESCAPE", 560 + ctx.minefield.count * 14 + ctx.minefield.close * 55 + ctx.minefield.threat * 22 - (ctx.hpRatio > 0.55 ? 150 : 0), ctx) });
                        if (ctx.trap && ctx.clearTarget) actions.push({ type: "CLEAR_TRAP_PUSH", score: actionScoreAM("CLEAR_TRAP_PUSH", 940 + (isHostileDamageAM(ctx.clearTarget) ? 80 : 0) - Math.max(0, estimateBreakTimeAM(ctx.clearTarget) - 450) * 0.05, ctx) });
                        if (ctx.trap && ctx.pushPlan) actions.push({ type: "PUSH_KILL", score: actionScoreAM("PUSH_KILL", 1120 + AGGRESSION_BONUS, ctx) });
                        if (ctx.trap && ctx.killGoal) actions.push({ type: "RETRAP_SETUP", score: actionScoreAM("RETRAP_SETUP", 760, ctx) });
                        if (ctx.breakTarget) {
                            const mode = ctx.breakTarget.__autoModBreakMode || "break";
                            actions.push({ type: mode === "approach_break" ? "APPROACH_BREAK" : "BREAK_OBJECT", score: actionScoreAM(mode === "approach_break" ? "APPROACH_BREAK" : "BREAK_OBJECT", (mode === "approach_break" ? 610 : 700) + Math.max(0, ctx.breakTarget.__autoModBreakScore || 0) * 0.35, ctx) });
                        }
                        if (ctx.dist <= ctx.range && !ctx.directDanger) actions.push({ type: "COMBAT", score: actionScoreAM("COMBAT", 560 + AGGRESSION_BONUS + (1 - ctx.enemyHpRatio) * 150, ctx) });
                        // Do not let placement setup pull the agent away from a close PvP
                        // opportunity. It should set up pressure at mid range, not kite forever.
                        if (ctx.placementSetup && ctx.dist > ctx.range * 1.05) actions.push({ type: "PLACEMENT_SETUP", score: actionScoreAM("PLACEMENT_SETUP", 505 + AGGRESSION_BONUS * 0.45 + Math.max(0, ctx.dist - ctx.range) * 0.08 + (ctx.placementSetup.inBand ? -95 : 0), ctx) });
                        if (ctx.approachGoal && ctx.approachGoal.intercept) actions.push({ type: "INTERCEPT", score: actionScoreAM("INTERCEPT", 540 + AGGRESSION_BONUS + Math.max(0, ctx.dist - ctx.range) * 0.18 + (runaway ? 120 : 0), ctx) });
                        if (ctx.approachGoal) actions.push({ type: "APPROACH", score: actionScoreAM("APPROACH", 390 + AGGRESSION_BONUS + Math.max(0, ctx.dist - ctx.range) * 0.14 + (runaway ? 140 : 0), ctx) });
                        actions.sort(function (a, b) { return b.score - a.score; });
                        return actions;
                    }
                    function setActionStateAM(type, extra) {
                        if (currentState !== type) log("STATE_CHANGE", Object.assign({ from: currentState, to: type }, extra || {}));
                        currentState = type;
                        lastTacticalActionAM = type;
                        lastTacticalActionAtAM = now();
                    }
                    function activeCombatWeaponIndexAM() {
                        const current = Number(player && player.weaponIndex);
                        if (Number.isFinite(current) && items.weapons[current]) return current;
                        const primary = Number(player && player.weapons && player.weapons[0]);
                        if (Number.isFinite(primary) && items.weapons[primary]) return primary;
                        return 0;
                    }
                    function weaponDamageAM(owner, idx) {
                        const weapon = items.weapons[idx];
                        if (!weapon) return 0;
                        const variantIdx = owner && owner.primaryVariant === undefined ? 0 : owner.primaryVariant;
                        const variant = (config.weaponVariants && (config.weaponVariants[variantIdx] || config.weaponVariants[0])) || { val: 1 };
                        const bull = owner && owner.skinIndex === 7 ? 1.5 : 1;
                        const bDmg = owner && owner.skinIndex === 40 ? 3.3 : 1;
                        return (weapon.dmg || 0) * (variant.val || 1) * (weapon.sDmg || 1) * bull * bDmg;
                    }
                    function activeEnemyWeaponIndexAM(target) {
                        if (!target) return -1;
                        const recentWindow = Math.max(180, (Number(window.pingTime) || 0) + (Number(config.tickRate) || 111));
                        const gatherIndex = Number(target.__valueLastGatherIndex);
                        if (target.__valueLastGatherAt && now() - target.__valueLastGatherAt <= recentWindow && Number.isFinite(gatherIndex) && items.weapons[gatherIndex]) return gatherIndex;
                        const current = Number(target.weaponIndex);
                        if (Number.isFinite(current) && items.weapons[current]) return current;
                        const primary = Number(target.primaryIndex);
                        if (Number.isFinite(primary) && items.weapons[primary]) return primary;
                        return -1;
                    }
                    function reloadReadyAM(obj, idx) {
                        if (!obj || !obj.reloads || !Number.isFinite(idx)) return false;
                        const r = Number(obj.reloads[idx]);
                        return Number.isFinite(r) && r <= (config.tickRate || 111);
                    }
                    function buildCombatContextAM(ctx) {
                        const me = ctx.me, target = ctx.target, obstacles = ctx.obstacles || [];
                        const myIdx = activeCombatWeaponIndexAM();
                        const enemyIdx = activeEnemyWeaponIndexAM(target);
                        const myWeapon = items.weapons[myIdx] || { range: 65, speed: 400 };
                        const enemyWeapon = items.weapons[enemyIdx] || { range: 65, speed: 400 };
                        const myReady = reloadReadyAM(player, myIdx);
                        const enemyReady = reloadReadyAM(target, enemyIdx) || !!(target && target.__valueLastGatherAt && now() - target.__valueLastGatherAt < 170);
                        const myDamage = weaponDamageAM(player, myIdx);
                        const enemyDamage = weaponDamageAM(target, enemyIdx);
                        const targetPoint = ctx.tacticalTarget || target;
                        const aimDir = dirTo(me, targetPoint);
                        const realTargetDir = dirTo(me, target);
                        const distToTarget = ctx.dist;
                        const myRange = (myWeapon.range || 65) + MELEE_RANGE_BUFFER;
                        const enemyRange = (enemyWeapon.range || 65) + ((target && target.scale) || 35) * 0.8 + ((player && player.scale) || 35) * 0.7;
                        const clearHitLine = !segmentHitsHostileDamageAM(me, aimDir, obstacles, (player && player.scale) || 35, Math.min(distToTarget, myRange));
                        const canHitEnemy = distToTarget <= myRange && clearHitLine;
                        const enemyCanHitMe = enemyReady && distToTarget <= enemyRange;
                        const myHp = Number(player && player.health) || 100;
                        const enemyHp = Number(target && target.health) || 100;
                        const nearHostileSpike = obstacles.some(function (obj) { return obj && obj.active && isHostileDamageAM(obj) && dist(me, obj) <= hardRadiusForAM(obj, (player && player.scale) || 35) + 70; });
                        return {
                            myIdx: myIdx,
                            enemyIdx: enemyIdx,
                            myReady: myReady,
                            enemyReady: enemyReady,
                            myDamage: myDamage,
                            enemyDamage: enemyDamage,
                            myHp: myHp,
                            enemyHp: enemyHp,
                            myHpAfterTrade: myHp - (enemyCanHitMe ? enemyDamage : 0),
                            enemyHpAfterHit: enemyHp - myDamage,
                            canHitEnemy: canHitEnemy,
                            enemyCanHitMe: enemyCanHitMe,
                            clearHitLine: clearHitLine,
                            nearHostileSpike: nearHostileSpike,
                            aimDir: aimDir,
                            realTargetDir: realTargetDir,
                            dist: distToTarget,
                            myRange: myRange,
                            enemyRange: enemyRange
                        };
                    }
                    function decideCombatAttackAM(ctx) {
                        const c = buildCombatContextAM(ctx);
                        if (!c.canHitEnemy) return { active: false, mode: "NO_ATTACK", reason: c.clearHitLine ? "out_of_range" : "blocked_hit_line", aimDir: c.aimDir };
                        if (!c.myReady) return { active: false, mode: "WAIT_RELOAD", reason: "my_reload", aimDir: c.aimDir };
                        if (c.enemyHpAfterHit <= 0) return { active: true, mode: "FORCE_HIT", reason: "lethal", aimDir: c.aimDir, priority: 92 };
                        if (c.enemyCanHitMe && c.myHpAfterTrade <= Math.max(25, c.myHp * 0.38) && c.enemyHpAfterHit > 0) {
                            return { active: false, mode: "BAIT_RELOAD", reason: "bad_trade", aimDir: c.aimDir, priority: 76 };
                        }
                        if (c.nearHostileSpike && c.enemyCanHitMe && c.enemyHpAfterHit > 0) {
                            return { active: false, mode: "HOLD_SPIKE_EDGE", reason: "dangerous_spike_trade", aimDir: c.aimDir, priority: 70 };
                        }
                        if (ctx.minefield && ctx.minefield.active && ctx.minefield.close >= 2) {
                            return { active: false, mode: "ESCAPE_FIRST", reason: "minefield_close", aimDir: c.aimDir, priority: 74 };
                        }
                        return { active: true, mode: "PULSE_HIT", reason: "good_trade", aimDir: c.aimDir, priority: 65 };
                    }

                    function executeActionAM(action, ctx) {
                        if (!action) return;
                        recordActionLearningAM(action, ctx);
                        const me = ctx.me, target = ctx.target, obstacles = ctx.obstacles;
                        if (action.type === "RETREAT") {
                            setActionStateAM("RETREAT", { targetSid: target.sid, healthRatio: Number(ctx.hpRatio.toFixed(2)), score: Math.round(action.score) });
                            const awayGoal = { x: me.x + (me.x - target.x), y: me.y + (me.y - target.y) };
                            const safeDir = safeMoveDirTo(me, awayGoal, obstacles, "retreat");
                            requestMoveAM("retreat", safeDir, 90, "low_hp");
                            requestAttackAM("retreat", false, null, "left", 90, "low_hp");
                            flushIntentAM(me, awayGoal, obstacles); return;
                        }
                        if (action.type === "MINEFIELD_ESCAPE") {
                            setActionStateAM("MINEFIELD_ESCAPE", { count: ctx.minefield.count, close: ctx.minefield.close, suspected: ctx.minefield.suspected, score: Math.round(action.score) });
                            let dir = Number.isFinite(ctx.minefield.dir) ? ctx.minefield.dir : escapeDirFromObstaclesAM(me, obstacles, (player && player.scale) || 35);
                            if (Number.isFinite(dir) && ctx.hpRatio > 0.34 && target) {
                                const next = { x: me.x + Math.cos(dir) * 120, y: me.y + Math.sin(dir) * 120 };
                                if (dist(next, target) > dist(me, target) + 35) dir = dirTo(me, target) + (approachSide || 1) * Math.PI / 2;
                            }
                            const goal = Number.isFinite(dir) ? { x: me.x + Math.cos(dir) * 145, y: me.y + Math.sin(dir) * 145 } : me;
                            const safeDir = Number.isFinite(dir) ? stableMoveDirAM(dir, obstacles, me) : undefined;
                            requestMoveAM("minefield_escape", safeDir, 89, "dense_spike_trap_zone");
                            requestAttackAM("minefield_escape", false, null, "left", 70, "escape_first");
                            setDebugRaysAM(Number.isFinite(dir) ? [{ dir: dir, type: "selected", label: "mine exit" }] : []);
                            setDebugPathAM(Number.isFinite(dir) ? [me, goal] : [me]);
                            flushIntentAM(me, goal, obstacles); return;
                        }
                        if (action.type === "CLEAR_TRAP_PUSH") {
                            const obj = ctx.clearTarget;
                            setActionStateAM("BREAK_OBJECT", { sid: obj.sid, reason: "clear_trap_push", score: Math.round(action.score) });
                            requestMoveAM("break", undefined, 90, "clear_trap_push");
                            requestAttackAM("break", true, dirTo(me, obj), breakButtonAM(obj), 94, "clear_trap_push");
                            setDebugRaysAM([{ dir: dirTo(me, obj), type: "selected", label: obj.dmg ? "clear enemy spike" : "clear obj" }]);
                            setDebugPathAM([me, obj]);
                            flushIntentAM(me, obj, obstacles); return;
                        }
                        if (action.type === "PUSH_KILL") {
                            const pp = ctx.pushPlan;
                            setActionStateAM("PUSH_KILL", { targetSid: target.sid, spikeSid: pp.spike.sid, score: Math.round(action.score) });
                            resetPathCache();
                            requestMoveAM("push_kill", stableMoveDirAM(pp.dir, obstacles, me), 96, "push_trapped_to_spike");
                            requestAttackAM("push_kill", false, null, "left", 55, "movement_kill");
                            setDebugRaysAM([{ dir: pp.dir, type: "selected", label: "push kill" }, { dir: pp.pushDir, type: "candidate", label: "enemy->spike" }]);
                            setDebugPathAM([me, pp.point, pp.spike]);
                            flushIntentAM(me, pp.point, obstacles); return;
                        }
                        if (action.type === "RETRAP_SETUP") {
                            setActionStateAM("KILL_TRAPPED", { targetSid: target.sid, reason: "retrap_setup", score: Math.round(action.score) });
                            resetPathCache();
                            const safeDir = safeMoveDirTo(me, ctx.killGoal.point, obstacles, String(target.sid) + ":retrap:" + (ctx.killGoal.key || "goal"));
                            requestMoveAM("retrap_setup", safeDir, 82, ctx.killGoal.key || "retrap_distance");
                            requestAttackAM("retrap_setup", false, null, "left", 40, "waiting_spike_setup");
                            flushIntentAM(me, ctx.killGoal.point, obstacles); return;
                        }
                        if (action.type === "BREAK_OBJECT" || action.type === "APPROACH_BREAK") {
                            const obj = ctx.breakTarget;
                            const mode = obj.__autoModBreakMode || "break";
                            const state = mode === "approach_break" ? "APPROACH_BREAK" : "BREAK_OBJECT";
                            setActionStateAM(state, { sid: obj.sid, score: Math.round(action.score) });
                            if (mode === "approach_break") {
                                const point = obj.__autoModBreakPoint || approachPointForBreakAM(me, obj);
                                const dir = safeMoveDirTo(me, point, obstacles, String(target.sid) + ":approachBreak:" + obj.sid);
                                requestMoveAM("approach_break", dir, 72, obj.dmg ? "approach_spike" : "approach_object");
                                requestAttackAM("approach_break", false, null, "left", 35, "closing_break_range");
                                setDebugPathAM([me, point, obj]);
                                flushIntentAM(me, point, obstacles); return;
                            }
                            requestMoveAM("break", undefined, 75, obj.dmg ? "break_spike" : "break_object");
                            requestAttackAM("break", true, dirTo(me, obj), breakButtonAM(obj), 82, obj.dmg ? "break_spike" : "break_object");
                            setDebugPathAM([me, obj]); flushIntentAM(me, obj, obstacles); return;
                        }
                        if (action.type === "COMBAT") {
                            const attackDecision = decideCombatAttackAM(ctx);
                            setActionStateAM("COMBAT", { targetSid: target.sid, dist: Math.round(ctx.dist), score: Math.round(action.score), mode: attackDecision.mode });
                            resetPathCache();
                            const strafeDir = stableMoveDirAM(pickCombatStrafeDir(me, target, ctx.range, obstacles), obstacles, me);
                            requestMoveAM("combat", strafeDir, attackDecision.mode === "BAIT_RELOAD" ? 74 : 62, attackDecision.mode === "BAIT_RELOAD" ? "bait_strafe" : "orbit");
                            requestAttackAM("combat", !!attackDecision.active, attackDecision.aimDir, "left", attackDecision.priority || 65, attackDecision.reason || attackDecision.mode);
                            flushIntentAM(me, target, obstacles); return;
                        }
                        if (action.type === "PLACEMENT_SETUP") {
                            const goal = ctx.placementSetup;
                            setActionStateAM("PLACEMENT_SETUP", { targetSid: target.sid, dist: Math.round(ctx.dist), goal: goal && goal.key, score: Math.round(action.score) });
                            const safeDir = safeMoveDirTo(me, goal.point, obstacles, String(target.sid) + ":placeSetup:" + (goal.key || "goal"));
                            requestMoveAM("placement_setup", safeDir, 67, goal.key || "placement_band");
                            requestAttackAM("placement_setup", false, null, "left", 30, "hold_for_placement");
                            setDebugRaysAM([{ dir: dirTo(me, goal.point), type: "selected", label: "place setup" }]);
                            setDebugPathAM(goal.placementGhosts && goal.placementGhosts.length ? [me, goal.point, goal.placementGhosts[0]] : [me, goal.point]);
                            flushIntentAM(me, goal.point, obstacles); return;
                        }
                        // INTERCEPT / APPROACH share execution, differ by priority/labels.
                        const goal = ctx.approachGoal;
                        const state = action.type === "INTERCEPT" ? "INTERCEPT" : "APPROACH";
                        setActionStateAM(state, { targetSid: target.sid, dist: Math.round(ctx.dist), goal: goal && goal.key, score: Math.round(action.score) });
                        const safeDir = safeMoveDirTo(me, goal.point, obstacles, String(target.sid) + ":" + (goal.key || "goal"));
                        requestMoveAM(action.type === "INTERCEPT" ? "intercept" : "approach", safeDir, action.type === "INTERCEPT" ? 58 : 45, goal.key || "goal");
                        requestAttackAM(action.type === "INTERCEPT" ? "intercept" : "approach", false, null, "left", 20, action.type === "INTERCEPT" ? "cutoff_move" : "moving_to_goal");
                        flushIntentAM(me, goal.point, obstacles);
                    }

                    function autoModShouldUseLightTickAM() {
                        const placementBusy = !!(window.__valuePlacementBusyUntil && Date.now() < window.__valuePlacementBusyUntil);
                        const fpsLow = (typeof currentFPS !== "undefined" && currentFPS && currentFPS < 48);
                        return placementBusy || fpsLow;
                    }
                    function runLightTickAM(me, target, tacticalTarget, reason) {
                        // v60 perf co-scheduler: when PlacementCoreV2 is doing expensive
                        // close-range geometry/building in the same server tick (or FPS is
                        // already low), AutoMod must not run its full tactical/path stack too.
                        // Reuse/hold last safe movement and keep only minimal pressure aim.
                        const d = dist(me, target);
                        const range = weaponRangeFor();
                        const lastDir = getMoveDirAM();
                        const keepDir = Number.isFinite(lastDir) ? lastDir : undefined;
                        if (currentState !== "LIGHT_HOLD") log("STATE_CHANGE", { from: currentState, to: "LIGHT_HOLD", reason: reason, fps: (typeof currentFPS !== "undefined" ? currentFPS : null) });
                        currentState = "LIGHT_HOLD";
                        beginIntentAM();
                        if (d > range && Number.isFinite(keepDir)) requestMoveAM("light", keepDir, 25, reason || "reuse_last");
                        else requestMoveAM("light", undefined, 25, reason || "hold");
                        const idx = activeCombatWeaponIndexAM ? activeCombatWeaponIndexAM() : (player && player.weaponIndex);
                        const ready = reloadReadyAM ? reloadReadyAM(player, idx) : false;
                        requestAttackAM("light", !!(ready && d <= range), dirTo(me, tacticalTarget || target), "left", 35, "light_pressure");
                        setDebugRaysAM([{ dir: dirTo(me, tacticalTarget || target), type: "selected", label: "light" }]);
                        setDebugPathAM([me, target]);
                        flushIntentAM(me, target, []);
                    }

                    // Main per-tick decision entry point. Called once per updatePlayers()
                    // tick (see its own call site) -- deliberately AFTER `near`/`enemy`/
                    // `traps.in` are already computed for this tick, so AutoModCore's own
                    // targeting can never disagree with what the rest of the file already
                    // knows about the current battle state this same tick.
                    function tick() {
                        if (!toggleOn()) { if (currentState !== "IDLE") { currentState = "IDLE"; resetPathCache(); } return; }
                        if (!player || !player.alive || !inGame) return;
                        // FIX (defense-in-depth, same class of bug this file's own v9
                        // player.alive/enemy.length gating fixes already guard against
                        // elsewhere): never drive movement/attack while genuinely caught
                        // in an enemy trap -- the existing trap-escape logic elsewhere in
                        // this same tick already fully owns movement in that state, and
                        // AutoModCore fighting it for the move-direction packet would be
                        // pure wasted network traffic at best, actively counterproductive
                        // at worst (see autoPush()'s own identical `!traps.in` gate,
                        // fixed this same session for the exact same reason).
                        if (traps.in) { setAttackAM(false); return; }
                        // Movement ownership compatibility: autoPush writes the same move
                        // packet as AutoMod. If the existing autoPush has an active push line,
                        // AutoMod must not overwrite it later in the same server tick.
                        if (typeof pushState !== "undefined" && pushState && pushState.active) {
                            setAttackAM(false);
                            return;
                        }

                        const me = { x: player.x2, y: player.y2, health: player.health, maxHealth: player.maxHealth };
                        beginIntentAM();
                        // Stuck-detection: if the bot has barely moved for
                        // STUCK_TICKS_LIMIT consecutive ticks despite issuing a real
                        // move command, force an immediate repath next tick instead of
                        // silently retrying the same now-provably-bad path forever.
                        if (lastPosition) {
                            const moved = dist(me, lastPosition);
                            if (moved < 4) stuckTicks++; else stuckTicks = 0;
                            if (stuckTicks >= STUCK_TICKS_LIMIT) { resetPathCache(); stuckTicks = 0; log("STUCK_REPATH", {}); }
                        }
                        lastPosition = me;

                        const target = pickTarget(me, enemy);
                        const tacticalTarget = target ? predictedTargetAM(target) : null;
                        if (!target) {
                            if (currentState !== "IDLE") log("STATE_CHANGE", { from: currentState, to: "IDLE" });
                            currentState = "IDLE";
                            resetPathCache();
                            lastTacticalGoal = null; lastTacticalGoalSid = null; lastChosenMoveDir = undefined;
                            setPredictedTrapZonesAM([]);
                            setPlacementGhostsAM([]);
                            requestMoveAM("idle", undefined, 10, "no_target");
                            requestAttackAM("idle", false, null, "left", 10, "no_target");
                            flushIntentAM(me, me, []);
                            return;
                        }
                        const isRetreating = decideRetreatState(me);
                        const lightReasonAM = (window.__valuePlacementBusyUntil && Date.now() < window.__valuePlacementBusyUntil) ? "placement_busy" : ((typeof currentFPS !== "undefined" && currentFPS && currentFPS < 48) ? "low_fps" : null);
                        if (lightReasonAM && !isRetreating && !(typeof traps !== "undefined" && traps && traps.in)) {
                            runLightTickAM(me, target, tacticalTarget, lightReasonAM);
                            return;
                        }
                        const ctx = buildTacticalContextAM(me, target, tacticalTarget);
                        observeOutcomeLearningAM(ctx);
                        const actions = evaluateActionsAM(ctx, isRetreating);
                        executeActionAM(actions[0], ctx);
                    }

                    // Orbit-strafe geometry: blends a purely tangential (perpendicular)
                    // direction around the target with a radial correction term so the
                    // bot naturally settles onto -- and stays at -- ORBIT_RADIUS instead
                    // of drifting inward/outward over time. Validated in isolation before
                    // integration: at exactly the orbit radius, motion is ~exactly
                    // perpendicular to the target line; when further out, the direction
                    // biases back toward the target; when closer in, it biases away.
                    function computeOrbitDir(me, target, orbitRadius, sign) {
                        const toTarget = dirTo(me, target);
                        const d = dist(me, target);
                        const radialError = d - orbitRadius;
                        const correctionStrength = Math.max(-0.5, Math.min(0.5, radialError / orbitRadius));
                        return toTarget + sign * (Math.PI / 2 - correctionStrength * (Math.PI / 2));
                    }
                    // Cheap LOCAL hazard check for combat/orbit/fallback candidate points.
                    // v15: this is no longer spike-only; combat strafe must also avoid
                    // ordinary physical objects and the spike soft barrier, otherwise the
                    // bot solves the approach path correctly and then rams into objects once
                    // it reaches melee range.
                    function pointNearEnemySpike(point, obstacles, playerRadius) {
                        // Kept for tests/backward debug API name, now delegates to the
                        // stronger unified unsafe predicate.
                        return pointUnsafeAM(point, obstacles, playerRadius, true);
                    }
                    function pickCombatStrafeDir(me, target, range, obstacles) {
                        const orbitRadius = Math.max(55, range * 0.82);
                        const stepDist = 38;
                        const playerRadius = (player && player.scale) || 35;
                        const preferred = computeOrbitDir(me, target, orbitRadius, orbitSign);
                        const flippedSign = -orbitSign;
                        const flipped = computeOrbitDir(me, target, orbitRadius, flippedSign);
                        const away = dirTo(target, me);
                        const rays = [];
                        function blocked(dir) {
                            return segmentUnsafeAM(me, dir, obstacles, playerRadius, stepDist);
                        }
                        const b1 = blocked(preferred); rays.push({ dir: preferred, type: b1 ? "blocked" : "candidate", label: "orbit+" });
                        if (!b1) { rays[0].type = "selected"; setDebugRaysAM(rays); return preferred; }
                        const b2 = blocked(flipped); rays.push({ dir: flipped, type: b2 ? "blocked" : "candidate", label: "orbit-" });
                        if (!b2) { orbitSign = flippedSign; rays[1].type = "selected"; setDebugRaysAM(rays); return flipped; }
                        const b3 = segmentUnsafeAM(me, away, obstacles, playerRadius, stepDist); rays.push({ dir: away, type: b3 ? "blocked" : "candidate", label: "away" });
                        if (!b3) { rays[2].type = "selected"; setDebugRaysAM(rays); return away; }
                        setDebugRaysAM(rays);
                        return undefined; // every combat movement candidate blocked -- hold still rather than walk into danger
                    }

                    // Obstacle collection scoped to AutoMod's own hazard radius --
                    // deliberately independent from PlacementCoreV2's OBSTACLE_RADIUS
                    // scan (different purpose, different radius requirement), but the
                    // same "bound the scan cost regardless of total map population"
                    // principle already proven there.
                    function buildObstaclesAM(origin) {
                        const t = now();
                        const moved = autoModObstacleCacheOrigin ? dist(origin, autoModObstacleCacheOrigin) : Infinity;
                        if (autoModObstacleCache && t - autoModObstacleCacheAt <= 135 && moved <= 28) return autoModObstacleCache;
                        const list = [];
                        for (let i = 0; i < gameObjects.length; i++) {
                            const obj = gameObjects[i];
                            if (!obj || !obj.active) continue;
                            const dx = obj.x - origin.x, dy = obj.y - origin.y;
                            if (dx * dx + dy * dy > HAZARD_SCAN_RADIUS * HAZARD_SCAN_RADIUS) continue;
                            list.push(obj);
                        }
                        if (list.length > 170) {
                            list.sort(function (a, b) {
                                const ad = (isHostileDamageAM(a) ? -900000 : 0) + ((a.trap || a.suspectedTrap) ? -200000 : 0) + ((a.x - origin.x) * (a.x - origin.x) + (a.y - origin.y) * (a.y - origin.y));
                                const bd = (isHostileDamageAM(b) ? -900000 : 0) + ((b.trap || b.suspectedTrap) ? -200000 : 0) + ((b.x - origin.x) * (b.x - origin.x) + (b.y - origin.y) * (b.y - origin.y));
                                return ad - bd;
                            });
                            list.length = 170;
                        }
                        autoModObstacleCache = list;
                        autoModObstacleCacheAt = t;
                        autoModObstacleCacheOrigin = { x: origin.x, y: origin.y };
                        return list;
                    }

                    let lastSentMoveDir = "unset";
                    function getMoveDirAM() { return lastSentMoveDir; }
                    // v14 (explicit user request: "Нужно сделать линию отходящую
                    // от игрока (центра) которая показывает куда идет игрок при
                    // auto-mod"): exposes the CURRENT real move direction (or undefined
                    // when not moving) to the renderer, so the requested indicator line
                    // always matches exactly what was actually last sent to the server,
                    // never a stale/guessed value.
                    function currentMoveDirForTrail() {
                        return (typeof lastSentMoveDir === "number") ? lastSentMoveDir : undefined;
                    }
                    function sendMoveCommandAM(dir) {
                        if (dir === lastSentMoveDir) return;
                        lastSentMoveDir = dir;
                        try { io.send("33", dir); } catch (_) { }
                    }
                    let lastAttackState = false;
                    let autoModOwnsLeft = false;
                    let autoModOwnsRight = false;
                    function autoModWeaponReadyAM(button) {
                        if (!player || !player.reloads) return false;
                        let idx = Number(player.weaponIndex);
                        if (button === "right" && player.weapons && player.weapons[1] == 10) idx = Number(player.weapons[1]);
                        else if (button === "left" && player.weapons) idx = Number(player.weapons[0]);
                        if (!Number.isFinite(idx)) return false;
                        const reload = Number(player.reloads[idx]);
                        return Number.isFinite(reload) && reload <= (config.tickRate || 111);
                    }
                    function setAttackAM(active, aimDir, button) {
                        // v16 attack intent: AutoMod can aim at an object (break spike)
                        // or enemy independently from near.aim2, but still only pulses the
                        // existing click pipeline during a ready swing window. For object
                        // breaking prefer the script's right-click path when secondary tool
                        // is available (player.weapons[1] == 10), matching existing logic.
                        button = button || "left";
                        if (Number.isFinite(aimDir)) attackAimOverride = aimDir;
                        const allowed = !!(active && autoModWeaponReadyAM(button) && !(typeof instaC !== "undefined" && instaC && instaC.isTrue) && !(typeof traps !== "undefined" && traps && traps.in));
                        if (allowed) {
                            if (button === "right") {
                                if (!clicks.right) { clicks.right = true; autoModOwnsRight = true; }
                            } else {
                                if (!clicks.left) { clicks.left = true; autoModOwnsLeft = true; }
                            }
                            lastAttackState = true;
                            return;
                        }
                        if (autoModOwnsLeft) { clicks.left = false; autoModOwnsLeft = false; }
                        if (autoModOwnsRight) { clicks.right = false; autoModOwnsRight = false; }
                        if (!active) attackAimOverride = null;
                        if (lastAttackState && !active) { try { sendAtckState(); } catch (_) { } }
                        lastAttackState = false;
                    }

                    return {
                        tick: tick,
                        toggleOn: toggleOn,
                        findPath: findPath,
                        buildHazardGrid: buildHazardGrid,
                        pickTarget: pickTarget,
                        MinHeap: MinHeap,
                        currentMoveDirForTrail: currentMoveDirForTrail,
                        getDebugRays: getDebugRaysAM,
                        getDebugPath: getDebugPathAM,
                        getPredictedTrapZones: getPredictedTrapZonesAM,
                        getPlacementGhosts: getPlacementGhostsAM,
                        getBreakMark: getBreakMarkAM,
                        attackAimOverride: function () { return attackAimOverride; },
                        getIntentDebug: function () { return lastIntentDebugAM; },
                        getState: function () { return currentState; },
                        onDeath: onDeathLearningAM,
                        _debug: {
                            decideRetreatState: decideRetreatState,
                            weaponRangeFor: weaponRangeFor,
                            safeMoveDirTo: safeMoveDirTo,
                            resetPathCache: resetPathCache,
                            getState: function () { return currentState; },
                            getRetreating: function () { return retreating; },
                            computeOrbitDir: computeOrbitDir,
                            pointNearEnemySpike: pointNearEnemySpike,
                            pickCombatStrafeDir: pickCombatStrafeDir,
                            findNearestFreeCell: findNearestFreeCell,
                            getOrbitSign: function () { return orbitSign; },
                        },
                    };
                })();
                var trapSid = undefined;
                // ADD NEW PLAYER:
                function addPlayer(data, isYou) {
                    var tmpPlayer = findPlayerByID(data[0]);
                    if (!tmpPlayer) {
                        tmpPlayer = new Player(data[0], data[1], config, UTILS, projectileManager, objectManager, players, ais, items, hats, accessories);
                        players.push(tmpPlayer);
                    }
                    tmpPlayer.spawn(isYou ? moofoll : null);
                    tmpPlayer.visible = false;
                    tmpPlayer.pR = 0;
                    tmpPlayer.sR = 0;
                    tmpPlayer.x2 = undefined;
                    tmpPlayer.y2 = undefined;
                    tmpPlayer.x3 = undefined;
                    tmpPlayer.y3 = undefined;
                    tmpPlayer.setData(data);
                    if (isYou) {
                        player = tmpPlayer;
                        camX = player.x;
                        camY = player.y;
                        updateItems();
                        updateStatusDisplay();
                        updateAge();
                        updateUpgrades(0);
                        gameUI.style.display = "block";
                        updateItemCountHTML();
                        // Re-apply the selected visual mode's on-screen label / UI
                        // now that the player and items exist. If the visual was
                        // picked on the main menu, changeCom(true) threw earlier
                        // (player was null), so the label was never configured.
                        try { changeCom(); } catch (e) {}
                        setTimeout(()=>{
                            for (let i = 0; i < healthBased(); i++) {
                                place(0, getAttackDir());
                                console.log('test')
                            }
                        }, 200);
                    }
                }
                // REMOVE PLAYER:
                function removePlayer(id) {
                    for (var i = 0; i < players.length; i++) {
                        if (players[i].id == id) {
                            if (getEl("enemyradar" + players[i].sid)) {
                                getEl("enemyradar" + players[i].sid).remove();
                            }
                            players.splice(i, 1);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                // UPDATE PLAYER ITEM VALUES:
                let isItemSetted = [];

                function updateItemCountHTML(index=undefined) {
                    // On the main menu `player` and the action bar items do not
                    // exist yet. changeCom(true) runs here when a visual mode is
                    // picked in the menu; without this guard it throws and aborts
                    // before the on-screen label (e.g. "ms / (c) King Hans") is
                    // configured, so the label never shows in-game.
                    if (!player) return;
                    for (let i = 0; i < items.list.length; ++i) {
                        let id = items.list[i].group.id;
                        let tmpI = items.weapons.length + i;
                        if (!isItemSetted[tmpI]) {
                            isItemSetted[tmpI] = document.createElement("div");
                            isItemSetted[tmpI].id = "itemCount" + tmpI;
                            getEl("actionBarItem" + tmpI).appendChild(isItemSetted[tmpI]);
                            isItemSetted[tmpI].style = `
                    display: block;
                    position: absolute;
                    padding-left: 5px;
                    font-size: 2em;
                    color: #fff;
                    `;
                            if (i < 3) {
                                isItemSetted[tmpI].innerHTML = Math.floor(player.food / items.list[i].req[1]);
                            } else {
                                isItemSetted[tmpI].innerHTML = player.itemCounts[id] || 0;
                            }
                        } else {
                            if (index == id) {
                                isItemSetted[tmpI].innerHTML = player.itemCounts[index] || 0;
                            }
                            if (index == undefined) {
                                if (i < 3) {
                                    isItemSetted[tmpI].innerHTML = Math.floor(player.food / items.list[i].req[1]);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (getEl("combat").value == "0" || getEl("combat").value == "ae" || getEl("combat").value == "EwV" || getEl("combat").value == "WasdMode" || getEl("combat").value == "TesterMode" || getEl("combat").value == "Oldae" || getEl("combat").value == "hae" || getEl("combat").value == "devs" || getEl("combat").value == "jet" || getEl("combat").value == "hans" || getEl("combat").value == "gt86" || getEl("combat").value == "goofy") {
                            if (isItemSetted[tmpI].style.display == "block") {
                                isItemSetted[tmpI].style.display = "none";
                            }
                        } else {
                            if (isItemSetted[tmpI].style.display == "none") {
                                isItemSetted[tmpI].style.display = "block";
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                function updateItemCounts(index, value) {
                    if (player) {
                        player.itemCounts[index] = value;
                        updateItemCountHTML(index);
                    }
                }
                // UPDATE PLAYER VALUE:
                function updatePlayerValue(index, value, updateView) {
                    if (player) {
                        player[index] = value;
                        if (index == "food") {
                            for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                                let tmpI = items.weapons.length + i;
                                getEl("itemCount" + tmpI).innerHTML = Math.floor(player.food / items.list[i].req[1]);
                            }
                        } else if (index == "wood") {} else if (index == "stone") {} else if (index == "kills") {
                        }
                        if (index == "food" || index == "wood" || index == "stone") {
                            let XP = value - parseFloat(getEl(index + "Display").innerText);
                            if (XP > 0) {
                                doNextTick(()=>{
                                    player.addWeaponXP(XP);
                                }
                                          );
                            }
                        }
                        if (updateView)
                            updateStatusDisplay();
                    }
                }
                // ADVANCED:
                function applCxC(value) {
                    if (player.health == 100)
                        return 0;
                    if (player.skinIndex != 45 && player.skinIndex != 56) {
                        return Math.ceil(value / items.list[player.items[0]].healing);
                    }
                    return 0;
                }
                function healthBased(value) {
                    if (player.health == 100)
                        return 0;
                    if (player.skinIndex != 45 && player.skinIndex != 56) {
                        return Math.ceil((100 - player.health) / items.list[player.items[0]].healing);
                    }
                    return 0;
                }

                function calcDmg(value) {
                    return value * (player && player.skinIndex == 6 ? 0.75 : 1);
                }

                            if (value >= 20) {
                                hittedTime = Date.now();
                                judgeAtNextTick = true;
                            }
                        } else {
                            if (traps.in) {
                                healIntrap(tmpObj, value);
                            } else {
                                setTimeout (()=>{
                                    for (let i = 0; i < applCxC(value); i++) {
                                        place(0, getAttackDir());
                                    }
                                }
                                            , pingHeal());
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if(!player.alive) console.log(value + " You died to this damage")
                }

                // CALC DAMAGE:
                function checkCanInsta(nobull) {
                    let totally = 0;
                    if (player.alive) {
                        let primary = {
                            weapon: player.weapons[0],
                            variant: player.primaryVariant,
                            dmg: player.weapons[0] == undefined ? 0 : items.weapons[player.weapons[0]].dmg,
                        };
                        let secondary = {
                            weapon: player.weapons[1],
                            variant: player.secondaryVariant,
                            dmg: player.weapons[1] == undefined ? 0 : items.weapons[player.weapons[1]].Pdmg,
                        };
                        let bull = player.skins[7] && !nobull ? 1.5 : 1;
                        let pV = primary.variant != undefined ? config.weaponVariants[primary.variant].val : 1;
                        if (primary.weapon != undefined && player.reloads[primary.weapon] == 0) {
                            totally += primary.dmg * pV * bull;
                        }
                        if (secondary.weapon != undefined && player.reloads[secondary.weapon] == 0) {
                            totally += secondary.dmg;
                        }
                        if (player.skins[53] && player.reloads[53] == 0 && near.skinIndex != 22) {
                            totally += 25;
                        }
                        totally *= near.skinIndex == 6 ? 0.75 : 1;
                        return totally;
                    }
                    return 0;
                }

                function getDamageThreat(tmpObj) {
                    tmpObj.instaThreat = 0;
                    if (isTeam(tmpObj)) {
                        let primary = {
                            weapon: tmpObj.primaryIndex,
                            variant: tmpObj.primaryVariant,
                            dmg: tmpObj.primaryIndex == undefined ? 45 : items.weapons[tmpObj.primaryIndex].dmg,
                        };
                        let secondary = {
                            weapon: tmpObj.secondaryIndex,
                            variant: tmpObj.secondaryVariant,
                            dmg: tmpObj.secondaryIndex == undefined ? 50 : items.weapons[tmpObj.secondaryIndex].Pdmg,
                        };
                        let bull = tmpObj.skinIndex == 7 ? 1.5 : 1;
                        let pV = primary.variant != undefined ? config.weaponVariants[primary.variant].val : 1.18;
                        if (primary.weapon != undefined && tmpObj.reloads[primary.weapon] == 0) {
                            tmpObj.instaThreat += primary.dmg * pV * bull;
                        }
                        if (secondary.weapon != undefined && tmpObj.reloads[secondary.weapon] == 0) {
                            tmpObj.instaThreat += secondary.dmg;
                        }
                        if (tmpObj.reloads[53] === 0) {
                            tmpObj.instaThreat += 25;
                        }
                        tmpObj.instaThreat *= player.skinIndex == 6 ? 0.75 : 1;
                    }
                }
                let predictDamage = 0;

                function guessDamagePrediction() {
                    predictDamage = 0;
                    if (enemy.length) {
                        if (near.dist2 <= 300) {
                            if (configs.antiBull2 > 0 && near.skinIndex == 11) {
                                predictDamage += items.weapons[player.weapons[0]].dmg * 0.45;
                            }
                            if (configs.antiBull2 > 0 && near.tailIndex == 21) {
                                predictDamage += items.weapons[player.weapons[0]].dmg * 0.25;
                            }
                            predictDamage *= player.skinIndex == 6 ? 0.75 : 1;
                            if ((ticks.tick - player.bTick) % config.serverUpdateRate === 0 && player.shameCount > 0) {
                                predictDamage += 5;
                                if (player.tailIndex == 13) {
                                    predictDamage -= 3;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // RENDER TRACER / CREDIT TO NEKOSAN:
                function addUser(tmpObj) {
                    let center = {
                        x: screenWidth / 2,
                        y: screenHeight / 2,
                    };
                    let rad = UTILS.getDirect(tmpObj, player, 2, 2)
                    let alpha = Math.min(1, (UTILS.getDistance(0, 0, player.x2 - tmpObj.x2, (player.y2 - tmpObj.y2) * (16 / 9)) * 100) / (config.maxScreenHeight / 2) / center.y);
                    let dist = center.y * alpha;
                    let tmpX = center.x + dist * Math.cos(rad) - 20 / 2;
                    let tmpY = center.y + dist * Math.sin(rad) - 20 / 2;
                    if (!getEl("enemyradar" + tmpObj.sid)) {
                        let addRadar = document.createElement("div");
                        addRadar.id = "enemyradar" + tmpObj.sid;
                        document.body.append(addRadar);
                        addRadar.style = `
                        display: none;
                    position: absolute;
                    left: 0;
                    top: 0;
                    color: #fff
                    width: 0;
                    height: 0;
                    border-style: solid;
                    border-width: 10px 0 10px 20px;
                    border-color: transparent transparent transparent #fff
                    `;
                    }
                    if (getEl("enemyradar" + tmpObj.sid)) {
                        getEl("enemyradar" + tmpObj.sid).style.left = tmpX + "px";
                        getEl("enemyradar" + tmpObj.sid).style.top = tmpY + "px";
                        getEl("enemyradar" + tmpObj.sid).style.display = !isTeam(tmpObj) ? "block" : "none";
                        getEl("enemyradar" + tmpObj.sid).style.opacity = alpha;
                        getEl("enemyradar" + tmpObj.sid).style.transform = "rotate(" + UTILS.toAng(rad) + "deg)";
                    }
                }

                            if (gameObjects.length) {
                                nearSpike = [];
                                // FIX ("Breakspike все равно не работает, таргет только на ловушку
                                // и все" -- Проблема #2): found the exact reason `nearSpike`
                                // almost never populated in real combat. This filter used
                                // `UTILS.getDist(tmp, player, 0, 2) < (tmp.scale + player.scale)`
                                // -- i.e. TOUCHING distance (~84 units for a 49-scale spike and a
                                // 35-scale player) -- as the population threshold, while the
                                // PRIORITY AUTOBREAK check further below (`enemySpikeInReach`)
                                // compares against the ACTUAL weapon range (154-226+ units
                                // depending on weapon). Confirmed numerically: an enemy spike
                                // sitting 120 units away -- already well within a polearm's real
                                // ~226 unit reach -- was NEVER added to `nearSpike` at all, because
                                // 120 is not < 84. Since `nearSpike` is computed ONCE per tick and
                                // reused as-is by the priority-swap check (by design, to avoid a
                                // second scan), that check almost always saw `nearSpike ===
                                // undefined` and silently fell back to targeting the trap --
                                // exactly the reported "таргет только на ловушку" symptom. Fixed
                                // by using the REAL weapon range (mirrors the server's own
                                // Player.gather() formula: distance - target.scale <= weapon.range,
                                // confirmed line-by-line against it in the v6 preplace fix) instead
                                // of the touching-distance threshold, so nearSpike now actually
                                // contains any enemy spike within real striking distance.
                                //
                                // FIX v8 (Проблема #1, "spike должен находится в зоне
                                // досягаемости того оружия что я держу, условно GreatHammer...
                                // из-за чего из ловушки не выбраться никогда" -- found by a
                                // numeric reproduction, not a guess): the range used here (and by
                                // enemySpikeInReach below) was ALWAYS `items.weapons[player.weapons[0]].range`
                                // -- the PRIMARY tool's range (e.g. a polearm's 142) -- but the
                                // weapon that will ACTUALLY swing is chosen per-target a few lines
                                // below by `breakWeaponIdx`, which switches to the SECONDARY
                                // weapon (Great Hammer, id 10, real range only 75) whenever the
                                // target's health exceeds what the primary tool can reasonably
                                // chip through. Confirmed numerically: an enemy spike at 130 units
                                // -- inside the primary polearm's 142 range, so it passed this scan
                                // and was picked as `breakTarget` -- gets `breakWeaponIdx` switched
                                // to the Great Hammer for a tough spike, whose real 75-unit range
                                // cannot physically reach 130 units. The swing packet was still
                                // sent (there was no reach re-check before io.send("7", 1) at all),
                                // so it always missed and the spike never broke -- exactly
                                // "прицел на спайк который сломать не может, из ловушки не
                                // выбраться никогда". Fixed by computing, for EACH candidate, the
                                // range of the weapon that would ACTUALLY be selected against an
                                // object with that candidate's own health (the exact same
                                // health-vs-dmg formula `breakWeaponIdx` already uses below, kept
                                // in one place so they can never disagree again), and by adding a
                                // final hard reach re-check right before the attack packet is sent
                                // as a second, independent safety net.
                                const breakWeaponFor = function (targetHealth) {
                                    const primaryIdx = player.weapons[0];
                                    const secondaryIdx = player.weapons[1];
                                    const primaryDmg = (items.weapons[primaryIdx] && items.weapons[primaryIdx].dmg) || 0;
                                    const useSecondary = (Number(targetHealth) > primaryDmg) && secondaryIdx == 10;
                                    const idx = useSecondary ? secondaryIdx : primaryIdx;
                                    const range = (items.weapons[idx] && items.weapons[idx].range) || 65;
                                    return { idx: idx, range: range };
                                };
                                // PERF FIX v8 (Проблема #3, "фпс все равно падает на 20 кадров в
                                // пвп" -- one of several concrete, measured contributors, not a
                                // guess): the `nearSpike` scan below is an O(N) filter() PLUS a
                                // full sort() over the ENTIRE `gameObjects` array -- with NO
                                // distance bound at all (unlike PlacementCoreV2's own
                                // buildObstacles(), which caps its scan at OBSTACLE_RADIUS=620) --
                                // and it used to run UNCONDITIONALLY every single server tick
                                // (~111ms), regardless of whether the player was anywhere near a
                                // trap. `nearSpike` is ONLY ever read a few lines below, strictly
                                // inside the `traps.in` branch (confirmed by a full-file grep: its
                                // only other read sites are inside that same `if` block) -- i.e. it
                                // is USELESS work on every tick where the player isn't currently
                                // caught in an enemy trap, which in a real base fight is the
                                // overwhelming majority of ticks even during active PvP (you spend
                                // far more time approaching/fighting than actually standing inside
                                // a trap). A base with 150-300+ placed spikes/traps (a completely
                                // normal built-up PvP hive) previously paid this full scan's cost
                                // every tick unconditionally; now it is entirely skipped unless the
                                // player is actually inside a trap this tick. `trap1` itself must
                                // still be found every tick (it drives `traps.aim`/`traps.in`
                                // themselves), so only the strictly redundant SECOND scan is
                                // removed, with zero change to any decision this block makes.

                // GAME TICKOUT:
                function setTickout(doo, timeout) {
                    if (typeof doo != "function") return;
                    if (!ticks.manage[ticks.tick + timeout]) {
                        ticks.manage[ticks.tick + timeout] = [doo];
                    } else {
                        ticks.manage[ticks.tick + timeout].push(doo);
                    }
                }

                function torad(a) {
                    return a * 0.0174532925;
                }
                function toRadian(angle) {
                    let fixedAngle = (angle % 360) * (Math.PI / 180);
                    return fixedAngle < 0 ? (2 * Math.PI + fixedAngle) : fixedAngle;
                }

                    function f(e) {
                        if (e == 0) return 0;
                        return Math.round(((0.360 + ((e * 0.180 / Math.PI) + 0.180) - 0.180) % 0.360) * 1000) % 360;
                    }
                    let d = (d2) => {
                        return Math.atan2(Math.sin(d2), Math.cos(d2));
                    }
                    return gia[f(d(ang))]
                }
                // AUTO PLACE:
                function autoPlace() {
                    let nearObj = [];
                    let randomDir = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                    if (gameObjects.length && enemy.length) {
                        let nearsa = {
                            inTrap: false,
                        };
                        nearObj = gameObjects.filter((e)=>e.trap).sort(function(a, b) {
                            return (UTILS.getDist(a, near, 0, 2) - UTILS.getDist(b, near, 0, 2));
                        })[0];
                        if (nearObj) {
                            if (!(player.sid != nearObj.owner.sid && !findAllianceBySid(nearObj.owner.sid)) && UTILS.getDist(nearObj, near, 0, 2) <= 70 && nearObj.active) {
                                nearsa.inTrap = true;
                            } else {
                                nearsa.inTrap = false;
                            }
                            let weaponReady = player.reloads[player.weapons[0]] <= 1;
                            if (near.dist2 <= 300) {
                                if (nearsa.inTrap && near.dist2 <= 120) {
                                    let bv = near.aim2;
                                    if (weaponReady && player.weapons[0] != 7) checkPlace(2, bv + (50 * Math.PI / 180));
                                }
                                if (nearsa.inTrap || near.dist2 <= items.weapons[player.weapons[0]].range + near.scale * 1.8) {
                                    if (near.dist2 <= 225) {
                                        if (near.dist2 <= 120) {
                                            for (let i = 0; i < Math.PI * 2; i += Math.PI / 1) {
                                                checkPlace(2, near.aim2 + i, 1);
                                            }
                                        } else if (near.dist2 <= 165) {
                                            for (let i = Math.PI / 12; i < Math.PI * 2; i += Math.PI / 12) {
                                                checkPlace(2, near.aim2 + i, 1);
                                            }
                                        } else {
                                            if (!nearsa.inTrap && weaponReady) checkPlace(4, near.aim2 + toRadian(Math.PI / 2), 1);
                                        }
                                    } else {
                                        let t = 4;
                                        if (nearObj <= 245) t = 2;
                                        for (let i = Math.PI / 1.5; i < Math.PI * 2; i += Math.PI / 1.5) {
                                            checkPlace(t, near.aim2 + i, 1);
                                        }
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    if (player.items[4] == 15) {
                                        if (UTILS.getDist(oldXY, player, 0, 2) >= 125) {
                                            for (let i = 0; i < Math.PI * 2; i += Math.PI / 2) {
                                                checkPlace(4, randomDir + i, 1);
                                            }
                                            oldXY.x = player.x2;
                                            oldXY.y = player.y2;
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        } else {
                            if (near.dist2 <= 400) {
                                if (player.items[4] == 15) {
                                    checkPlace(4, near.aim2, 1);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                            // (index == 1) {...}` dispatch, which does literally nothing when
                            // `index` is undefined (neither branch matches). This call sits
                            // inside changeAcc("trap")'s "Uncve2" combat-mode branch, gated on
                            // `turretEmp > 0 || doEmpAntiInsta` -- an EMP/anti-insta situation,
                            // exactly the kind of moment auto-insta swaps accessories for combat
                            // advantage. Missing `, 1` here meant the accessory (e.g. Monkey
                            // Tail, id 11) never got re-equipped in this one specific branch --
                            // it could silently stay off (never re-buy) or, if some other code
                            // path happened to already be mid-swap, appear to "remove itself"
                            // with nothing replacing it, exactly the reported symptom. Every
                            // other one of the 166 buyEquip() calls in this file was checked and
                            // correctly passes its index -- this was the sole omission.

                // FIND OBJECTS BY ID/SID:
                function findID(tmpObj, tmp) {
                    return tmpObj.find((THIS) => THIS.id == tmp);
                }

                function findSID(tmpObj, tmp) {
                    return tmpObj.find((THIS) => THIS.sid == tmp);
                }

                function findPlayerByID(id) {
                    return findID(players, id);
                }

                function findPlayerBySID(sid) {
                    return findSID(players, sid);
                }

                function findAIBySID(sid) {
                    return findSID(ais, sid);
                }

                function findObjectBySid(sid) {
                    return findSID(gameObjects, sid);
                }

                function findProjectileBySid(sid) {
                    return findSID(gameObjects, sid);
                }

                function findAllianceBySid(sid) {
                    return player.team ? alliancePlayers.find((THIS)=>THIS === sid) : null;
                }
                function Mi(sid) {
                    for (var t = 0; t < gameObjects.length; ++t){
                        if (gameObjects[t].sid == sid){
                            return gameObjects[t];
                        }
                    }
                    return null
                }

                // PING:
                var lastPing = -1;
                var maxPing = NaN;
                var minPing = NaN;
                var pingCount = 0;
                var doAutoQ = false;

                function pingSocketResponse() {
                    var pingTime = Date.now() - lastPing;
                    window.pingTime = pingTime;
                    pingCount++;
                    if (pingTime > maxPing || isNaN(maxPing)) {
                        maxPing = pingTime;
                    }
                    if (pingTime < minPing || isNaN(minPing)) {
                        minPing = pingTime;
                    }
                    if (getEl("combat").value == "zeph") {
                        pingDisplay.innerText = "Ping: " + pingTime + " ms | FPS: " + currentFPS + " frames";
                    } else if (getEl("combat").value == "hans" || getEl("combat").value == "hae") {
                        pingDisplay.innerText = "Ping: " + pingTime + " ms / © King Hans";
                    } else {
                        pingDisplay.innerText = "Ping: " + pingTime + " ms";
                    }
                    if (pingTime >= 90) {
                        doAutoQ = true;
                    } else {
                        doAutoQ = false;
                    }
                }
                pingDisplay.style.display = "none";
                document.body.appendChild(pingDisplay);

                function pingSocket() {
                    lastPing = Date.now();
                    io.send("pp");
                }
                // SERVER SHUTDOWN NOTICE:
                function serverShutdownNotice(countdown) {
                    if (countdown < 0)
                        return;
                    var minutes = Math.floor(countdown / 60);
                    var seconds = countdown % 60;
                    seconds = ("0" + seconds).slice(-2);
                    shutdownDisplay.hidden = false;
                }
